Lumbering Charge.name: 迟缓冲锋 Lumbering Charge
Lumbering Charge.description:
丧！角龙疾奔至多 10 英尺，然后进行一次打击。

The Zo!ceratops Strides up to 10 feet and then makes a Strike.

Vicious Impalement.name: 凶残穿刺 Vicious Impalement
Vicious Impalement.description:
如果目标在同一轮中因环境效果或危险而受到伤害，则一只丧角龙对其造成额外 2d6 点持续性流血伤害。

A Zo!ceratops deals 2d6 extra persistent bleed damage to a target that takes damage from an environmental effect or hazard in the same round.

Trample.description:
大型或更小，足部，@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Newborn Cult Lore.name: 新诞者邪教知识 Newborn Cult Lore

Aucturnite Chakram.name: 奥克腾岩飞环 Aucturnite Chakram
Aucturnite Chakram.description:
升级： 1

这个带刃的环刃由一块奥克腾材料雕刻而成，被塑造成类似行星环的样子。这种材料遍布协约世界及更遥远的地方，在距离奥克腾原始轨道数光年之外的地方神秘地出现。

Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of Aucturn and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has been found throughout the Pact Worlds and beyond, mysteriously appearing lightyears from Aucturn's original orbit.

Fanatical Frenzy.name: 狂热乱攻 Fanatical Frenzy
Fanatical Frenzy.description:
需求 传道者已受到伤害，且既不处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏} 状态，也尚未处于狂暴之中

效果 传道者陷入持续1分钟的狂暴。处于狂暴时，传道者的攻击检定获得+1状态加值，伤害检定获得+2状态加值，并且其AC承受–2状态减值。传道者不能自愿停止其狂暴。狂暴结束后，传道者陷入疲乏状态。

Requirements The evangelist has taken damage and is neither @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} nor already in a frenzy

Effect The evangelist flies into a frenzy that lasts 1 minute. While frenzied, the evangelist gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls, and they take a –2 status penalty to AC. The evangelist can't voluntarily stop their frenzy. After the frenzy, the evangelist is fatigued.

Captain Vasoya.name: 瓦索娅船长 Captain Vasoya

Advanced Machine Gun.name: 先进机枪 Advanced Machine Gun

Advanced Veskarium Imperial Plate.name: 先进型维斯卡里姆帝国板甲 Advanced Veskarium Imperial Plate
Advanced Veskarium Imperial Plate.description:
升级： 1

这种重甲由相互咬合的金属板制成，贴合穿戴者的身体轮廓，呈现出鳞片般的图案。尾部护甲和带爪手套是这种护甲的标准配备。

Upgrades: 1

This heavy armor is made of interlocking metal plates contoured to the wearer's body with a scalelike pattern. Tailguards and clawed gloves are standard for this armor.

Advanced Plasma Doshko.name: 先进等离子体多什科 Advanced Plasma Doshko

Quick Swap.name: 快速切换 Quick Swap
Quick Swap.description:
触发 一名敌人移动到与瓦索娅船长相邻的位置

效果 瓦索娅船长收起她当前的武器并拔出她的等离子多什科战刃。

Trigger An enemy moves adjacent to Captain Vasoya

Effect Captain Vasoya stows her current weapon and draws her plasma doshko.

Commanding Laughter.name: 支配性大笑 Commanding Laughter
Commanding Laughter.description:
瓦索娅船长尝试进行 Intimidate 检定，对30英尺内每个处于 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制} 状态的生物使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{恫吓}。她也可以对当前处于 frightened 或受压制状态的任何盟友使用恫吓。如果她成功，该盟友会失去该状态，而不是获得 frightened 状态。

Captain Vasoya attempts Intimidate checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each creature within 30 feet who is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed}. She can also Demoralize any allies who are currently frightened or suppressed. If she succeeds, the ally loses that condition instead of gaining the frightened condition.

Into the Fray.name: 冲入战局 Into the Fray
Into the Fray.description:
瓦索娅船长进行两次Stride。若她在移动结束时位于至少一个敌人的近战触及范围内，则她可以对该敌人进行一次近战Strike。

Captain Vasoya Strides twice. If she ends her movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, she can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

Primary Target.name: 主要目标 Primary Target
Primary Target.description:
要求 瓦索娅船长的上一动作是自动火力

效果 瓦索娅船长用她的机枪对从其自动火力锥形区域起点开始算起最近的目标进行一次远程打击。

Requirements Captain Vasoya's last action was an Auto-Fire

Effect Captain Vasoya makes a ranged Strike with her machine gun against the closest target from the start of her Auto-Fire's cone.

Suppression.name: 压制 Suppression
Suppression.description:
任何未能通过对瓦索娅船长进行的自动射击攻击的豁免的生物，或被瓦索娅用她的多什科击中的生物，都会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}，直到其下个回合结束。

Any creature that fails its save against an Auto-Fire attack made by Captain Vasoya or who Vasoya hits with her doshko becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of its next turn.

Captain Vasoya.blurb:
女性维斯克蜥人军官
Female vesk military officer

Amnieka Bubble.name: 阿姆涅卡泡泡 Amnieka Bubble
Amnieka Bubble.tokenName: 阿姆涅卡气泡 Amnieka Bubble

Psychic Doula.name: 心灵助产士 Psychic Doula
Psychic Doula.description:
触发条件 阿姆涅卡的回合开始

效果 阿姆涅卡不断将不可知实体的碎片驱赶进它当前所处的现实中。每轮都会有一个半透明的血肉气泡出现在阿姆涅卡的空间内。气泡会在阿姆涅卡的回合中朝最近的生物漂浮，每轮速度为10英尺。当气泡进入与某个生物相同的方格时，它就会爆裂，在该生物为中心形成一次 @Template[type:burst|distance:10] 爆炸，并造成 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害（@Check[type:fortitude|dc:21|basic:true] 豁免）。生物可以在气泡进入某个生物的方格之前，以其为目标并发动攻击。气泡使用以下数据：AC 12，HP 6；强韧 +2，反射 +8。阿姆涅卡同时存在的活跃气泡数量不能超过它当前正在对抗的敌人数量。

Trigger Amnieka's turn begins

Effect Amnieka constantly shepherds fragments of unknowable entities into its current reality. A translucent, fleshy bubble appears in Amnieka's space each round. The bubble floats toward the nearest creature at a Speed of 10 feet per round on Amnieka's turn. A bubble bursts when it enters the same square as a creature, exploding in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on the creature that deals @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:21|basic:true] save). Creatures can target and attack a bubble before it enters a creature's square. A bubble uses the following statistics: AC 12, HP 6; Fort +2, Ref +8. Amnieka can only have a number of active bubbles equal to the number of enemies it's fighting at one time.

Amnieka Bubble.prototypeToken: 阿姆涅卡气泡 Amnieka Bubble

Aucturnite Swarm.name: 奥克腾岩虫群 Aucturnite Swarm
Aucturnite Swarm.tokenName: 奥克腾岩虫群 Aucturnite Swarm

Aucturnite Susurrus.name: 奥克腾岩低语 Aucturnite Susurrus
Aucturnite Susurrus.description:
20尺。奥克腾岩虫群振翅的嗡鸣回荡着慌乱低语与呜咽哀鸣的声音。所有能听到这阵沙沙低语的生物都会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}，持续1轮（@Check[type:will|dc:15|basic:true] 豁免）。豁免成功的生物会暂时免疫此能力1分钟。

20 feet. The buzz of an aucturnite swarm's wings echoes with the sounds of frantic whispers and mewling whimpers. All creatures able to hear the susurrus are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} for 1 round (@Check[type:will|dc:15|basic:true] save). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to this ability for 1 minute.

Aucturnite Ichor.name: 奥克腾岩灵液 Aucturnite Ichor
Aucturnite Ichor.description:
豁免检定 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17]

最长持续时间 4轮

阶段 1 1d4毒素伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 1d6毒素伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}（2轮）

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 poison and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} (2 rounds)

Swarming Stings.name: 蜂群之蜇 Swarming Stings
Swarming Stings.description:
虫群空间内的每个敌人受到 @Damage[2d6[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:17|basic:true] 豁免），并暴露于奥克腾岩毒液。豁免成功则抵消此次毒素暴露。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[type:reflex|dc:17|basic:true] save) and is exposed to aucturnite ichor. A successful save negates the poison exposure.

Aucturnite Swarm.prototypeToken: 奥克腾岩虫群 Aucturnite Swarm

Tashtari Alpha.name: 塔什塔里阿尔法 Tashtari Alpha

Bristle Flash.name: 刚毛闪光 Bristle Flash
Bristle Flash.description:
塔什塔里使其丝状物发出强烈的光。位于 @Template[type:emanation|distance:40] 内的非塔什塔里必须尝试一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:21] 豁免。尝试过此豁免的生物会对所有刺毛闪光免疫 1 分钟。塔什塔里的毛皮会失去光辉，且在至少沐浴阳光 10 分钟之前，它不能再次使用此能力。

严重成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 状态，持续 1 轮。

失败 该生物目眩 1 分钟。

严重失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明} 状态，持续 1 轮，并目眩 1 分钟。

The tashtari causes its filaments to glow with intense light. Non-tashtaris within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:40] must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:21] save. A creature that attempts this save is immune to all Bristle Flashes for 1 minute. The tashtari's fur loses its glow, and it can't use this ability until it basks in sunlight for at least 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute.

Solar Cry.name: 太阳之啼 Solar Cry
Solar Cry.description:
炽烈的彩虹从塔什塔里首领口中迸发而出，它猛地后仰头部，释放出一道强力的吻部光束，直冲天空。随后，这道光束分裂成无数道五彩斑斓的光线，向四面八方轰然坠落，对一个@Template[type:emanation|distance:20]内的每个非塔什塔里造成 @Damage[4d6[fire]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:19|basic:true] 豁免）。豁免大失败的生物还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 状态，持续1分钟。区域内的其他塔什塔里会恢复其每日一次的“刚毛闪光”使用次数。塔什塔里首领发光的心脏随之黯淡，在至少晒太阳1小时完成充能之前，它无法再次使用此能力。

A searing rainbow erupts from the tashtari alpha's mouth as it throws back its head to unleash a powerful muzzle beam that soars into the sky. The beam then splits into countless rays of multicolored light that crash down in every direction, dealing @Damage[4d6[fire]] damage to each non-tashtari in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:19|basic:true] save). A creature that critically fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute. Other tashtaris in the area recharge their daily use of bristle flash. The tashtari alpha's glowing heart dims, and it can't use this ability until it recharges by basking in sunlight for at least 1 hour.

Tashtari Alpha.publicNotes:
塔什塔里原产于绿色世界卡斯卓韦，如今在更广阔的银河中已以“激光狼”之名闻名。这些狼形的群居猎手体表覆盖着一层柔韧的丝状体，能发出磷光，使它们能够通过一套独特的视觉语言进行无声交流。每只塔什塔里的喉部都有一个节点，使其能够引导体内储存的太阳能量，并释放出一道集中的光束，这也让这一物种获得了“激光狼”的称号。由一对配偶——其中包含一只或两只阿尔法个体——领导塔什塔里狼群；它们通常会成为大片区域中的顶级掠食者，而这些区域往往包含一处或多处森林地带。树木对夜行性的塔什塔里至关重要；它们白天会睡在树上，沐浴阳光，为自身的太阳能量充能。

激光狼平均体长为4到5英尺，尾巴长2英尺。它们平均重120磅。阿尔法个体体型略宽、体重更重，但更显著的特征是它们更为宽大的吻部，其中含有更高密度的丝状体，能够形成更复杂的光纹图案。

Native to the green world of Castrovel, the tashtari has become known throughout the wider galaxy as the laser wolf. These wolflike pack hunters have a layer of flexible filaments that emit phosphorescent lights, which allow them to silently communicate through a bespoke visual language. Each tashtari possesses a node within its throat that allows it to channel its stored solar energy and unleash a beam of focused light, giving the species their moniker of laser wolves. A mating pair, comprising one or two alphas, lead packs of tashtaris, who generally become the apex predators of large areas that include one or more forested regions. The presence of trees is important for the nocturnal tashtaris; they use them to sleep atop during the day, basking in sunlight to recharge their solar energies.

Laser wolves have an average length of 4 to 5 feet, with a 2-foot-long tail. They weigh an average of 120 pounds. Alpha specimens are slightly broader and weigh more but are more notable for their expanded muzzle that contains a higher concentration of filaments to create more elaborate light patterns.

Toppling Crates.name: 倾倒的板条箱 Toppling Crates

Topple Over.name: 绊倒 Topple Over
Topple Over.description:
触发条件 一个生物触碰地下室中的一个物体

效果 陷阱对触发的生物造成 @Damage[(2d4+1)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] 豁免）；若失败，该生物还会被击倒并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧} 状态。

Trigger A creature touches an object in the basement

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(2d4+1)[bludgeoning]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] save); on a failure, the creature is additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Toppling Crates.disable:
@Check[type:athletics|dc:15] 以将板条箱扶正

@Check[type:athletics|dc:15] to hold the crates upright
Toppling Crates.hazarddescription:
移动错误的物体会导致堆叠的板条箱倒下并砸到一个生物。

Moving the wrong object causes stacked crates to fall onto a creature.

Reactive Strike (Tendril Only).name: 借机攻击（仅限触须） Reactive Strike (Tendril Only)
Reactive Strike (Tendril Only).description:
触发条件 你触及范围内的一个生物使用了一个操纵动作或一个移动动作、进行了一次远程攻击，或在其正在使用的移动动作中离开一个方格。

你猛然攻击露出破绽的敌人。对触发该反应的生物进行一次近战打击。若你的攻击造成重击，且触发条件是一个操纵动作，则你打断该动作。此次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，且你的多重攻击减值也不适用于此次打击。

Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Camouflage.name: 伪装 Camouflage
Camouflage.description:
蛮灵兽可以改变其毛皮的色泽与纹理，使之与周围环境相匹配。它在以隐匿检定尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{躲藏} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行} 时，不需要掩护。

The stridermander can change the shade and texture of its fur to match its surroundings. It doesn't need cover to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} with a Stealth check.

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原始本能法术 Primal Innate Spells

Fear.name: 恐惧 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标植入恐惧；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 1轮。

升阶（3环） 你的目标最多可以是五个生物。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Darkness.name: 黑暗 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你制造出一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光穿透该区域或在其中发散。光无法进入该区域，任何非魔法光源，如火把或提灯，在区域内时都不会发出任何光芒，即使它们的照明半径本会延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗法术同环级或更低的魔法光。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从区域外看去，它显现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

强化（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉的生物（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过这片黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Knock.name: 敲击 Knock
Knock.description:
你让目标更容易被打开。敲击使任何尝试以运动或盗窃检定打开目标门、锁或容器的生物获得+4状态加值。作为施放敲击的一部分，你可以尝试一次盗窃检定来打开目标，即使你未受训，你也能加入你的等级。

敲击反制 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{锁闭}。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{法术效果：敲击}

You make the target easier to open. Knock grants a +4 status bonus to any creature that tries to open the target door, lock, or container with an Athletics or a Thievery check. You can attempt a Thievery check to open the target as part of casting knock, and you add your level even if you're untrained.

Knock counteracts @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock}.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{Spell Effect: Knock}

Daze.name: 恍惚 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，并以一次精神冲击使其恍惚。该冲击造成 1d6 点精神伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在此次豁免中严重失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Figment.name: 幻象 Figment
Figment.description:
你制造一个简单的幻象声音或景象。声音会使该法术获得听觉（特征），且该声音不能包含可理解的词语或复杂的音乐。景象会使该法术获得视觉（特征），其尺寸不能大于5英尺立方，且若从15英尺内观看，会明显显得粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你可以借助该幻象尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{制造佯动}，并在你的欺瞒检定中获得+2处境加值。若此次尝试对某个生物失败，则该生物会识破这个幻景。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：幻景}

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

Gorge.name: 峡谷 Gorge
Gorge.description:
需求 一个大型或更小的生物在蛮灵兽的进食触须中处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}状态

效果 蛮灵兽将该生物拉近10尺，并对该生物进行一次颚击，且此次攻击的攻击检定获得+2处境加值。

Requirements A Large or smaller creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in the stridermander's feeding tendril

Effect The stridermander pulls the creature 10 feet closer and makes a jaws Strike against that creature, with a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

Sentry Turret.name: 哨戒炮塔 Sentry Turret

Open Fire.name: 开火 Open Fire
Open Fire.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到炮塔30尺内

效果 炮塔对该生物进行一次远程打击；该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the turret

Effect The turret makes a ranged Strike against the creature; the trap rolls initiative.

Machine Gun.name: 机枪 Machine Gun
Machine Gun.description:
没有多重攻击减值

no multiple attack penalty

Sentry Turret.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:20]（受训）以重编程炮塔，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:18]（受训）以干扰传感器

@Check[type:computers|dc:20] (trained) to reprogram the turret, or @Check[type:crafting|dc:18] (trained) to jam the sensor
Sentry Turret.hazarddescription:
当入侵者进入射程时，一座机械化炮塔会弹出并发动攻击。

A mechanized turret pops up on intruders when they enter range.
Sentry Turret.reset:
该陷阱会在 1 分钟后重置。

The trap resets after 1 minute.
Sentry Turret.routine:
（3 个动作）该陷阱对射程内至多三个生物进行一次打击；如果没有其他目标，则可对射程内一个生物进行多次打击。

(3 actions) The trap makes a Strike against up to three creatures in range, or multiple Strikes against one creature in range if it has no additional targets.

Energy Shield Shards.name: 能量护盾碎片 Energy Shield Shards
Energy Shield Shards.tokenName: 能量护盾碎片 Energy Shield Shards

Bombardment.name: 轰炸 Bombardment
Bombardment.description:
触发条件 事件 3 开始

效果 第一块能量护盾碎片坠落到离 PCs 30 英尺远的地面上。每名 PC 受到 @Damage[(1d6+2)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:17|basic:true] 豁免），然后该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger Event 3 begins

Effect The first energy shield shard crashes into the ground 30 feet from the PCs. Each PC takes @Damage[(1d6+2)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[type:reflex|dc:17|basic:true] save), and the trap then rolls initiative.

Energy Shield Shards.disable:
@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:16] 以闪避，@Check[type:athletics|dc:17] 以跑赢灾害，@Check[type:survival|dc:19]（受训）以在岩石地形中寻找掩护；如果可行，@Check[type:Life Science Lore|dc:15]（受训）或 @Check[type:nature|dc:17] 或 @Check[type:religion|dc:17]（受训）以利用附近岩层露头中的生命精华生成一道防护屏障。若成功通过生成防护屏障的检定，则在此次事件的剩余时间内，使每名 PC 为停用该危害所进行的检定获得 +2 状态加值。总共需要四次成功才能停用该危害。

@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:16] to dodge, @Check[type:athletics|dc:17] to outrun the disaster, @Check[type:survival|dc:19] (trained) to seek shelter in rocky terrain; if accessible, @Check[type:Life Science Lore|dc:15] (trained) or @Check[type:nature|dc:17] or @Check[type:religion|dc:17] (trained) to generate a protective barrier using life essence from nearby outcroppings. On a successful check to generate a protective barrier, grant a +2 status bonus to each PC's checks to disable the hazard for the remainder of the event. Four total successes are required to disable the hazard.
Energy Shield Shards.hazarddescription:
这颗行星的能量护盾碎片坠落到丛林地面，劈开枝条，并使能量冲击和碎片向四面八方飞散。

Shards of the planet's energy shield crash to the jungle floor, slicing through branches and sending energy blasts and debris flying in every direction.
Energy Shield Shards.reset:
该险境在 5 轮后停用，且不会重置。

The hazard deactivates after 5 rounds and doesn't reset.
Energy Shield Shards.routine:
（1 动作）另一块碎片坠落在附近，对每个生物造成 @Damage[(1d4+1)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] 豁免）。

(1 action) Another shard lands nearby, dealing @Damage[(1d4+1)[bludgeoning]] damage to each creature (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] save).
Energy Shield Shards.prototypeToken: 能量护盾碎片 Energy Shield Shards

Aeon Guard Soldier.name: 万古卫队士兵 Aeon Guard Soldier
Aeon Guard Soldier.tokenName: 万古卫队士兵 Aeon Guard Soldier

Evasive Maneuver.name: 回避机动 Evasive Maneuver
Evasive Maneuver.description:
触发条件 士兵受到一次远程打击或法术造成的伤害

效果 士兵进行一步移动或采取掩护。

Trigger The soldier takes damage from a ranged Strike or spell

Effect The soldier Steps or Takes Cover.

Coordinated Fire.name: 协同火力 Coordinated Fire
Coordinated Fire.description:
在士兵尝试对一个目标进行一次打击后（无论成功还是失败），士兵的一名盟友随后对同一目标进行的下一次打击，其攻击检定获得+2处境加值。若一次带有协同火力加值的打击命中，则该目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制} 状态，直到进行攻击的盟友的下个回合结束。

After the soldier attempts a Strike against a target (regardless of success or failure), the next Strike one of the soldier's allies makes against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. If a Strike with a bonus from coordinated fire hits, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of the attacking ally's next turn.

Sharpshooter.name: 神枪手 Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.description:
当士兵对因次级或标准掩护而获得 AC 加值的目标进行一次远程打击时，该次打击使其 AC 加值减少 1。

When the soldier makes a ranged Strike against a target with an AC bonus from lesser or standard cover, they reduce the AC bonus by 1 for that Strike.

Show No Mercy.name: 绝不留情 Show No Mercy
Show No Mercy.description:
士兵对@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}目标的伤害掷骰获得 +2 处境加值。

The soldier gains a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} targets.

Aeon Guard Armor (Commercial).name: 万古卫队护甲（商用） Aeon Guard Armor (Commercial)

Aeon Rifle (Commercial).name: 永劫步枪（商业型） Aeon Rifle (Commercial)

Pulse Gauntlet (Commercial).name: 脉冲护臂（商用） Pulse Gauntlet (Commercial)

Aeon Stone (Consumed).name: 永恒石（已消耗） Aeon Stone (Consumed)
Aeon Stone (Consumed).description:
数千年来，这些神秘且经过精巧切割的宝石一直被秘学者与狂热分子囤积，希望发现其中的秘密。尽管它们有着千差万别的形态与功能，但据称这些石头全都是异界实体在太古时代用来构筑物质宇宙的水晶工具碎片。

当你灌注这些精确塑形的水晶之一时，这块石头会绕着你的头部旋转，而不是佩戴在身上。你可以用一个交互动作收起一枚万象石，而一枚正在环绕的石头也可以被人以对你成功的缴械动作从空中夺走。被收起或移除的石头仍然保持灌注，但其效果会受到压制，直到你让它再次回到头部周围环绕为止。

万象石有多种类型，每种都有不同的外观和魔法效果。每一枚万象石在嵌入一种名为寻路仪的特殊魔法物品时，还会获得一种共鸣能力。

一枚已耗尽的万象石是一块失去魔法属性的暗淡石块。它仍会像其他万象石一样绕着你的头部旋转，因此可以作为某些以物体为目标的法术的一种时髦且免手持的选择。

这枚万象石没有共鸣能力。

Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a wayfinder.

A consumed aeon stone is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object.

This aeon stone has no resonant power.

Aeon Guard Soldier.prototypeToken: 万古卫队士兵 Aeon Guard Soldier

Skorrfern.name: 斯科芬 Skorrfern

Skorresh Symbiosis.name: 斯科雷什共生体 Skorresh Symbiosis
Skorresh Symbiosis.description:
这种蕨类会对暴怒的 skorrfern 的存在作出反应，帮助该 skorresh 抵御攻击者。每当 skorrfern 的一个孢芽爆裂时，60 英尺内的每个 skorresh 都会获得 5 点临时生命值，持续 1 分钟。

The fern reacts to the presence of an enraged skorresh, helping the skorresh to fend off attackers. Whenever one of the skorrfern's spore buds burst, each skorresh within 60 feet gains 5 temporary Hit Points which last for 1 minute.

Bursting Spore Bud.name: 爆裂孢子芽苞 Bursting Spore Bud
Bursting Spore Bud.description:
频率 每轮一次

触发 一个生物接触 skorrfern、击中它或对其造成伤害，或者 60 英尺内的一个 skorresh 使用 Shell Display

效果 skorrfern 的一个花苞猛烈爆裂，对其 60 英尺内的非 skorresh 生物造成 @Damage[1d4[poison]] 伤害（@Check[type:fortitude|dc:16|basic:true] 豁免）。

Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature touches the skorrfern, hits it, or damages it, or a skorresh within 60 feet uses Shell Display

Effect One of the skorrfern's buds violently bursts, dealing @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage to non-skorresh creatures within 60 feet of it (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:16|basic:true] save).

Skorrfern.disable:
@Check[type:survival|dc:12]（受训）或 @Check[type:thievery|dc:14]（受训）以安全地移除两个孢芽中的一个（若获得重大成功，则移除所有剩余的孢芽）。

@Check[type:survival|dc:12] (trained) or @Check[type:thievery|dc:14] (trained) to safely remove one of the two spore buds (or all remaining buds on a critical success).
Skorrfern.hazarddescription:
当附近的一只斯科雷什陷入危险时，一株奇异的开花蕨类会释放出危险的孢子。

A strange flowering fern releases dangerous spores when a skorresh in the vicinity is in danger.
Skorrfern.reset:
斯科恩蕨每24小时会重新长出一个孢子芽（最多两个芽）。

The skorrfern regrows one spore bud every 24 hours (maximum two buds).

Cockatrice Summoning Rune.name: 鸡蛇兽召唤符文 Cockatrice Summoning Rune
Cockatrice Summoning Rune.tokenName: 鸡蛇兽召唤符文 Cockatrice Summoning Rune

Summon Monster.name: 召唤怪物 Summon Monster
Summon Monster.description:
触发条件 一个生物进入魔法传感器云团

效果 这个陷阱召唤出一只鸡蛇兽。鸡蛇兽掷先攻，并持续存在 [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6轮}，之后法术结束且该生物消失。如果在持续时间结束前有人解除该陷阱，该生物也会消失。与大多数被召唤生物不同，鸡蛇兽每轮可以使用3个动作，并且可以使用反应。

Trigger A creature enters the cloud of magical sensors

Effect This trap summons a cockatrice. The cockatrice rolls initiative and remains for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the creature disappears. The creature also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. The cockatrice can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

Cockatrice Summoning Rune.disable:
@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:20] 以在不触发陷阱的情况下接近，然后进行 @Check[type:thievery|dc:23] （受训）以抹除符文，或者使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（3阶；对抗 DC 20）来对抗该符文

@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:20] to approach without triggering the trap followed by @Check[type:thievery|dc:23] (trained) to erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG] (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
Cockatrice Summoning Rune.hazarddescription:
一团处于10英尺半径内的隐形魔法传感器云团包围着一枚隐形的墙面或地板符文，其大小与将要被召唤的生物相同。

A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 10-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.
Cockatrice Summoning Rune.reset:
这个陷阱每天黎明时重置。

The trap resets each day at dawn.
Cockatrice Summoning Rune.prototypeToken: 鸡蛇召唤符文 Cockatrice Summoning Rune

Corpse Fleet Sniper.name: 尸骸舰队狙击手 Corpse Fleet Sniper
Corpse Fleet Sniper.tokenName: 尸骸舰队狙击手 Corpse Fleet Sniper

Advanced Injection Rifle.name: 先进注射步枪 Advanced Injection Rifle
Advanced Injection Rifle.description:
升级： 2

注射步枪内置一罐毒药，可为装填在弹膛中的任何空心飞镖注满毒液。这种步枪的前身最初是为了在保育目的下麻醉危险动物而设计的，而一些现代使用者则改用镇静或腐蚀性飞镖。

Upgrades: 2

The injection rifle includes a cannister of poison that fills any empty darts loaded in the chamber. This rifle's precursors were designed to tranquilize dangerous animals for conservation purposes, and some modern wielders use sedative or corrosive darts instead.

Advanced Needler Pistol.name: 先进针刺手枪 Advanced Needler Pistol
Advanced Needler Pistol.description:
升级： 2

这把短鼻手枪发射的是注射针筒而非子弹，使持用者能够在安全距离外投送一剂药物或毒药。早期的针射手枪是红白相间的玩具枪样式，并标有某位神祇的圣洁符号。古董和复制品如今仍在市面上流通，但与更为低调的现代设计相比，它们不过是些稀罕玩意。

Upgrades: 2

This snub-nosed pistol shoots syringes instead of bullets, allowing the wielder to deliver a dose of medicine or poison from a safe distance. Early needler pistols were red and white peashooters marked with a deity's holy symbol. Antiques and replicas remain on the market, but are curiosities compared to subtler modern designs.

Carbon Skin (Advanced).name: 碳化皮肤（先进） Carbon Skin (Advanced)
Carbon Skin (Advanced).description:
升级： 1

这套贴身的碳纤维护装包覆全身。量产版本通常是暗灰色的实用服装，而更昂贵的定制款则如钻石般耀眼夺目。

Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Mass-produced versions are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.

Jetpack (Commercial).name: 喷气背包（商用） Jetpack (Commercial)
Jetpack (Commercial).description:
体型如背包般大小的推进器会安装在你护甲的背部，让你能够飞行。

激活—飞行 1 (操纵)

效果 你激活喷气背包以获得 20 尺的飞行速度。该效果持续 1 分钟，或直到你将其解除。你可以使用一个动作飞行 0 尺以悬浮在原地，但在这样做时你处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态。如果你处于超载状态，喷气背包无法将你抬起。

Boosters the size of a backpack attach to the back of your armor and allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

TranquiliZo!.name: 宁静易! TranquiliZo!
TranquiliZo!.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

最长持续时间 5 分钟

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速 2}（1 轮）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{昏迷}，且不能进行察觉检定来醒来（1 分钟）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Maximum Duration 5 minutes

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 minute)

Aim.name: 瞄准 Aim
Aim.description:
该船员谨慎地瞄准单一目标。直到本回合结束前，他们以注射步枪对该标记进行的远程打击会额外造成 2d4 精准伤害，并将该标记因掩护获得的 AC 处境加值降低 1。只有当该标记位于该武器的第一距离增量内时，这些增益才会生效。

The crewmember takes careful aim against a single target. Until the end of this turn, their ranged Strikes against this mark using an injection rifle deal an additional 2d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC the mark gets from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if the mark is within the weapon's first range increment.

Defensive Reload.name: 防御性装填 Defensive Reload
Defensive Reload.description:
尸骸舰队狙击手为其持握的一把武器重新装填，然后采取掩护。

The Corpse Fleet sniper reloads a weapon they're holding, then Takes Cover.

Magazine (Injection Rifle).name: 弹匣（注射步枪） Magazine (Injection Rifle)

Magazine (Needler Pistol).name: 弹匣（飞针手枪） Magazine (Needler Pistol)

Corpse Fleet Sniper.prototypeToken: 尸骸舰队狙击手 Corpse Fleet Sniper

Spore Salvo.name: 孢子齐射 Spore Salvo
Spore Salvo.description:
孢子幼体向一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 喷射孢子，对区域内每个生物造成 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true]）。在此次豁免中严重失败的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}（1轮），并受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] 伤害。

The sporeling fires spores in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15], dealing @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage to each creature in the area (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true]). Creatures that critically fail this save are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round) and take @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage.

Spike, Eldritch Squox.name: 尖峰区，秘法松鼠狐 Spike, Eldritch Squox
Spike, Eldritch Squox.tokenName: 尖峰区，异界松鼠狐 Spike, Eldritch Squox

Go for the Eyes!.name: 攻击眼睛！ Go for the Eyes!
Go for the Eyes!.description:
尖峰区大步移动，尝试进行一次 @Check[type:acrobatics|defense:perception] 检定，对抗一名相邻生物的察觉 DC，然后进行一次颚击 Strike。

严重成功 目标被尖峰区突然的跃起打了个措手不及，变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，直到尖峰区下个回合结束。

成功 目标只是短暂地受惊，变为措手不及，直到尖峰区当前回合结束。

严重失败 尖峰区误判了与目标面部的距离，摔倒并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{伏卧}。

Spike Strides, attempts an @Check[type:acrobatics|defense:perception] check against an adjacent creature's Perception DC, and then makes a jaws Strike.

Critical Success Thrown by Spike's sudden leap, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of Spike's next turn.

Success The target is only momentarily startled and becomes off-guard until the end of Spike's current turn.

Critical Failure Spike misjudges the distance to its target's face and falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Squox Tricks.name: 松鼠狐把戏 Squox Tricks
Squox Tricks.description:
尖峰区可以用它的尾巴对生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，并以特技替代运动，即使它没有空闲手也可以。尖峰区可以尝试对比它大至多两个体型且处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态的生物进行缴械或绊摔，并且对处于措手不及状态的目标进行缴械或绊摔时获得+2处境加值。

Spike can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures with its tail using Acrobatics instead of Athletics, even if it doesn't have a free hand. Spike can attempt to Disarm or Trip @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures up to two sizes larger than it and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Disarm or Trip an off-guard target.

Spike, Eldritch Squox.prototypeToken: 尖峰区，奥秘松鼠狐 Spike, Eldritch Squox

Siphon.name: 虹吸 Siphon
Siphon.description:
当一只电噬兽以一次打击对持用科技装备的活体生物或具有科技特征的构装体造成重击时，它会虹吸走目标的一部分电能。这使电噬兽恢复 @Damage[5[healing]] 生命值。

When an electrovore scores a critical hit with a Strike against a living creature wielding tech gear or a construct with the tech trait, it siphons off a portion of the target's electrical energy. This restores @Damage[5[healing]] Hit Points to the electrovore.

Sudden Discharge.name: 猝然放电 Sudden Discharge
Sudden Discharge.description:
噬电体释放出一道冲击波，对 @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] 内的生物造成 @Damage[2d6[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:16] 豁免）。它在 [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Sudden Discharge]]{1d4 轮} 内不能再次使用“猝然放电”。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。具有科技特征的生物和装备陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}。

失败 目标受到全部伤害。具有科技特征的生物和装备陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2}。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害。具有科技特征的生物和装备陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 3}。

The electrovore unleashes a shockwave that deals @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage to creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16] save). It can't use Sudden Discharge again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Sudden Discharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage. Creatures and gear with the tech trait are @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Failure The target takes full damage. Creatures and gear with the tech trait are @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage. Creatures and gear with the tech trait are @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 3}.

Computer Glitch Gremlin.name: 电脑故障小魔怪 Computer Glitch Gremlin
Computer Glitch Gremlin.tokenName: 电脑故障小魔怪 Computer Glitch Gremlin

Digital Telepathy.name: 数字心灵感应 Digital Telepathy
Digital Telepathy.description:
该生物可以与数字设备以及其他能够这样做的生物进行心灵感应交流。这使该生物能够尝试进行计算机检定，以访问心灵感应范围内的任何计算机。

This creature can communicate telepathically with digital devices and with other creatures that can do so. This allows the creature to attempt Computers checks to access any computer within the telepathy's range.

Sense Tech (100 feet).name: 感知科技（100英尺） Sense Tech (100 feet)
Sense Tech (100 feet).description:
该生物能够感知所列距离内具有科技（特征）的物品和生物。

This creature can sense items and creatures with the tech trait within the listed distance.

Glitch Aura.name: 故障灵光 Glitch Aura
Glitch Aura.description:
位于故障小魔怪 @Template[distance:20|type:emanation] 内、具有科技特征的生物和物品难以可靠地运作。具有科技特征的生物、无人持用且具有科技特征的物品，或持有具有科技特征装备且在其回合开始时位于该灵光内的生物，必须尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:16] 豁免。

严重成功 无效果，且该生物或物品在1分钟内暂时免疫于小魔怪的故障灵光。

成功 该生物或物品不受影响。

失败 该生物、物品，或该生物持有的所有物品变为 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}。

严重失败 该生物、物品，或该生物持有的所有物品变为 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2}。

Creatures and items with the tech trait within a @Template[distance:20|type:emanation] of the glitch gremlin struggle to function reliably. Creatures with the tech trait, unattended items with the tech trait, or creatures holding equipment with the tech trait that start their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:16] save.

Critical Success No effect and the creature or item is temporarily immune to the gremlin's glitch aura for 1 minute.

Success The creature or items are unaffected.

Failure The creature, item, or all the creature's held items become @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Critical Failure The creature, item, or all the creature's held items become @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原始本能法术 Primal Innate Spells

Electric Arc.name: 电弧术 Electric Arc
Electric Arc.description:
一道电弧从一个目标跃向另一个目标。你造成等于 1d4 加上你的施法关键属性调整值的电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. You deal electricity damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Thunderstrike.name: 雷霆打击 Thunderstrike
Thunderstrike.description:
你召下一道伴随着雷鸣炸裂的闪电触须，对目标造成1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害，目标进行一次基础反射豁免。穿着金属护甲或由金属构成的目标在此次豁免上承受–1处境加值，且如果因该法术受到伤害，则会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害。

You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.

Figment.name: 幻景 Figment
Figment.description:
你制造出一个简单的幻觉声音或影像。声音会为该法术添加听觉（特征），且该声音不能包含可理解的词语或复杂的音乐。影像会添加视觉（特征），其尺寸不能大于一个 5 尺立方体，并且如果从 15 尺内观看，会明显显得粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你可以借助该幻觉尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{佯攻转移注意}，使你的欺瞒检定获得 +2 处境加值。如果此次尝试对某个生物失败，该生物就会识破这个虚像。

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

Computer Glitch Gremlin.publicNotes:
在令人眼花缭乱的精类样本中，故障小魔怪便是其中之一。这些通常一根筋的精类将自己在物质宇宙中的存在奉献给制造混乱，并与特定类型的科技联系在一起。卑微的计算机故障小魔怪就是这样一种样本，其存在本能地与现代时代的计算机化设备和网络紧密相连。这些欢闹嬉戏的精类以尽可能制造更多破坏为使命，通过影响计算机系统并在所到之处制造混乱来达成目的。它们以天生能够与数字设备交流的能力而闻名，这些精类经常会迷恋这类系统，常常将其视作一种古怪的游戏，琢磨自己如何才能最好地颠覆哪怕是防护最严密的数字系统。

计算机故障小魔怪的外貌往往取决于它所吞食的具体数据类型，但它们几乎总是高约1英尺，重约4磅。出于某种特殊缘故，许多计算机故障小魔怪都会呈现出明显的地精外貌，只不过它们的眼睛被数字屏幕所取代，显示着与其特定兴趣相关的信息。

Among the dizzying specimens of fey are the glitch gremlins. These typically single-minded fey dedicate their existence in the universe to creating mayhem through their association with specific types of technology. The lowly computer glitch gremlin is one such specimen, having its being intuitively tied with the computerized devices and networks of the modern age. These cavorting fey make it their mission to create as much havoc as they can by influencing computer systems and creating chaos in their wake. Known for their innate ability to communicate with digital devices, these fey routinely become infatuated with such systems, often viewing it as a strange game of how they can best subvert even the most well-protected of digital systems.

A computer glitch gremlin has an appearance often based on the specific types of data it has consumed, but they almost always stand about 1 foot tall and weigh around 4 pounds. Due to some peculiarity, a large number of computer glitch gremlins take on the telltale appearance of a goblin, save that their eyes are replaced with a digital screen that displays information relevant to their specific interests.
Computer Glitch Gremlin.prototypeToken: 计算机故障小魔怪 Computer Glitch Gremlin

Light Vulnerability.name: 畏光 Light Vulnerability
Light Vulnerability.description:
一个散发魔法光的物体（例如由@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{light}法术产生）在用于攻击影之回响时，会造成双倍伤害。

An object shedding magical light (such as from the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{light} spell) deals double damage when used to attack the umbral echo.

Slink in Shadows.name: 暗影潜行者 Slink in Shadows
Slink in Shadows.description:
幽影回响可以在一个生物或物体的影子中进行躲藏，或结束其 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}。

The umbral echo can Hide or end its @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in a creature's or object's shadow.

Steal Shadow.name: 窃取阴影 Steal Shadow
Steal Shadow.description:
需求 暗影回声在其上一个动作中以暗影触须打击命中过一个活着的生物

效果 暗影回声拉扯目标的影子，使该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1}。这可与来自其他暗影回声的虚弱状态累加，最高可达@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 3}。如果这使某个生物的虚弱状态值提高到3，则目标的影子会与其身体分离（见暗影孽生体）。来自“窃取影子”的虚弱状态值每小时减少1。

Requirements The umbral echo hit a living creature with a shadow tendril Strike on its previous action

Effect The umbral echo pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}. This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from umbral echoes, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3, the target's shadow is separated from its body (see umbral spawn). The enfeebled condition value from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.

Umbral Spawn.name: 幽影孽生物 Umbral Spawn
Umbral Spawn.description:
当一个生物的影子被“窃影”拉出体外时，它会变成一个受创造它的暗影回响指挥的暗影孽物。这个暗影孽物拥有暗影回响的属性和能力，但以下情况除外：它没有“窃影”，并且永久且无法治愈地处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}。如果被拉出暗影孽物的那个生物死亡，暗影孽物就会变成一个完全成熟的、自主的暗影回响。如果该生物从其虚弱中恢复，它的影子就会回到它身上，而暗影孽物则会熄灭。

When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes an umbral spawn under the command of the umbral echo that created it. This umbral spawn has the statistics and abilities of an umbral echo aside from the following: it doesn't have Steal Shadow and is perpetually and incurably @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If the creature the umbral spawn was pulled from dies, the umbral spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous umbral echo. If the creature recovers from its enfeeblement, its shadow returns to it and the umbral spawn is extinguished.

Shimmerstone Mech.name: 闪晶石机甲 Shimmerstone Mech

Power Up.name: 强化 Power Up
Power Up.description:
触发条件 战斗开始

效果 这台机甲在启动时发出低沉的嗡鸣声。随后，该陷阱进行先攻检定。

Trigger Combat begins

Effect The mech hums as it powers up. The trap then rolls initiative.

Missile Barrage.name: 飞弹齐射 Missile Barrage
Missile Barrage.description:
陷阱发射出一阵导弹，对其200英尺内一个@Template[type:burst|distance:30]中的所有生物造成 @Damage[5d12[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic] 豁免）。若豁免失败，目标还会 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 1轮（若严重失败，则改为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明} 1轮）。

The trap fires a barrage of missiles, dealing @Damage[5d12[piercing]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] within 200 feet of it (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic] save). On a failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure).

Shimmerstone Mech.disable:
@Check[arcana|dc:40] or @Check[occultism|dc:40]（专家）以从马科萨手中夺取机甲的控制权，@Check[computers|dc:38]（专家）以重新编程机甲，或 @Check[crafting|dc:36] or @Check[thievery|dc:36]（专家）以将其停用；总共需要两次成功才能停用这个陷阱。

@Check[arcana|dc:40] or @Check[occultism|dc:40] (expert) to wrest control of the mech from Makosa, @Check[computers|dc:38] (expert) to reprogram the mech, or @Check[crafting|dc:36] or @Check[thievery|dc:36] (expert) to disable it; two total successes are required to disable the trap.
Shimmerstone Mech.hazarddescription:
一个由闪晶石和钢铁构成的巨型构装体已被从地下部分挖掘出来。

A gargantuan construct of shimmerstone and steel has been partially excavated from the ground.
Shimmerstone Mech.routine:
（2动作）该陷阱要么花费2个动作发射一轮飞弹齐射，要么花费2个动作用其激光束或剑鞭进行打击。它会优先锁定攻击玛科萨的目标。

(2 actions) The trap either uses 2 actions to fire a Missile Barrage or uses 2 actions to make Strikes with its laser beam or sword whip. It focuses on targets that attack Makosa.

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 英尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Motion Sense.name: 运动感知 Motion Sense
Motion Sense.description:
溶解兽能够通过振动以及空气或水的流动感知附近的生物。

The dissolver can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

Swarm Mind.name: 虫群思维 Swarm Mind
Swarm Mind.description:
30尺。所有在彼此所列范围内、具有虫群思维的盟友都会保持恒常的心灵感应交流，并知晓彼此所知道的所有威胁。只要位于至少一个具有虫群思维的盟友范围内，当溶解者针对一个心灵效果进行豁免并获得成功时，它改为获得大成功。

30 feet. All allies with swarm mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats they know about. While within range of at least one ally with swarm mind, when a dissolver rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

Corrosive Jet.name: 腐蚀喷流 Corrosive Jet
Corrosive Jet.description:
溶解兽从口中喷出一道腐蚀性化学物质射流，对 @Template[type:line|distance:30] 内的所有生物造成 @Damage[11d6[acid]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] 豁免）。溶解兽在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Corrosive Jet]]{1d4 轮}内不能再次使用腐蚀喷流。

The dissolver spews a jet of corrosive chemicals from its mouth, dealing @Damage[11d6[acid]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save). The dissolver can't use Corrosive Jet again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Corrosive Jet]]{1d4 rounds}.

溶解兽迅速拍动翅膀，制造出一股强劲的狂风。距离溶解兽 @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 英尺} 内的每个生物受到 @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] 豁免）。豁免失败的生物被推开 10 英尺；重度失败的生物被推开 20 英尺并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧}。溶解兽在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Wing Gust]]{1d4 轮} 内不能再次使用“振翼狂风”。

The dissolver flaps its wings rapidly to create a powerful gust of wind. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet} of the dissolver takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save). Creatures that fail their save are pushed away 10 feet; creatures that critically fail are pushed away 20 feet and knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The dissolver can't use Wing Gust again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Wing Gust]]{1d4 rounds}.

Crest-eaters ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble, sand, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.

Crest-Eater.publicNotes:
冠食兽是大型四足野兽，同时兼具爬行动物与哺乳动物的特征。它们起源于遥远的卡萨斯世界，随后扩散至整个宇宙，伴随众多卡萨斯人迁徙，甚至在协约世界的世界飞船伊达里号上也有一小片聚居地。冠食兽是一种掠食者，以吞食猎物的骨骼而闻名。它们使用一种腐蚀性极强的酸性毒液，能够轻松蚀穿矿物。它们的名字源于其过往习性：追踪卡萨斯人并敲开他们细长的头骨，以取食其中的“骨冠”。随着冠食兽吞食骨骼及其他物质，它们的身体各处会生长出大型矿物突起。冠食兽是群居生物，常会结成兽群协同狩猎，若被接纳，也会与附近的其他物种共同生活——因此，在星舰船员队伍或本地劫掠团伙中发现一只或多只被收养的冠食兽，并不罕见。那些世代与冠食兽一同狩猎的驯兽者，会在伙伴死后用其遗体制作一只仪式用拳套；尽管冠食兽骨骼价值高昂、需求旺盛，这项传统至今仍在延续。

大多数冠食兽体长14英尺，蹲伏时高约6英尺（不包括其显眼的矿物突起）。由于体内富含矿物，它们的体重通常超过1,000磅，这在某种程度上会妨碍它们在无法承受其庞大身躯的环境中行动。幼年和成年的冠食兽通常会以小型兽群形式共同活动，不过在食物来源稀缺的环境中，也有些会成为独行猎手。体型特别庞大的雄性往往会随着年龄增长而愈发具有攻击性，也常因敌意强烈和贪食无度而被兽群其他成员驱逐。若这些独行野兽存活得够久，就可能变成反复无常且危险的威胁，试图通过袭击沙漠聚落来建立领地并寻找食物。许多卡萨斯人的史诗中，都会出现一位或多位英勇战士保卫村庄、对抗古老雄性冠食兽的故事。无论是被当地传说中的英雄讨伐，还是最终悄然死去，这些超大型冠食兽都可能留下一处珍贵的矿物缓存库，供有进取心的冒险者发掘。

太阳能

冠食兽的矿物突起中充满了微小的反射性化合物，能够储存能量，并为这些野兽提供额外养分。很久以前，来自古老卡萨斯的卡萨斯人研究了这些晶体化合物，而它们后来成为卡萨斯太阳能科技的基础。据说，一些冠食兽若能稳定接触阳光并坐拥广阔骨原，便会毫无节制地大吃大喝。这样的个体会变得极其庞大且领地意识极强；人们相信，古老卡萨斯上的数片骨原正由这样的巨兽守护，而对于那些留在故乡的卡萨斯人来说，它们早已成为地方传说。

Crest-eaters are large four-legged beasts with the traits of both reptiles and mammals. Originating from the distant world of Kasath, they've spread throughout the cosmos, accompanying numerous kasathans and even having a small enclave aboard the Idari worldship in the Pact Worlds. A crest-eater is a predator known for consuming the bones of their prey. They use a highly corrosive acidic venom that chews through minerals with ease. Their name comes from their history of tracking down kasathas and cracking open their elongated skulls to feed on the "bony crests" within. As a crest-eater consumes bones and other substances, it produces large mineral protrusions across its body. Crest-eaters are social creatures and often form prides to hunt together or join with other nearby species if they're accepted—it's not uncommon to find a starship crew or local raider gang with one or more crest-eaters they've adopted. Tamers who've hunted with crest-eaters for generations craft a ceremonial cestus from their comrade's body after they pass, a tradition still practiced to this day despite the high value and demand for crest-eater bones.

Most crest-eaters are 14 feet long and squat at about 6 feet tall (not including their noticeable mineral protrusions). Thanks to their mineral-laden composition, they often weigh in excess of 1,000 pounds, somewhat hampering their mobility in environments that can't support their girth. Young and mature crest-eaters tend to stay together in small prides, though some act as solitary hunters in environments where food sources are scarce. Especially large males frequently become increasingly aggressive as they age and are often driven away by the rest of the pride for both their hostility and gluttonous appetites. If these solitary beasts survive long enough, they can become unpredictable and dangerous threats that attempt to establish territory and find food by attacking desert settlements. Many kasathan epics feature one or more brave warriors defending their village against an ancient male crest-eater. Whether dispatched by local legends or eventually dying off in secret, these oversized crest-eaters can leave behind a valuable cache of minerals for enterprising adventurers.

Solar Power

A crest-eater's mineral protrusions are filled with tiny reflective compounds that store energy and provide additional sustenance for the beasts. Ages ago, kasathas from old Kasath studied these crystalline compounds, and they have since become the basis of kasathan solar technology. Some crest-eaters, given ready access to sunlight and vast fields of bone, are said to gorge themselves to excess. Such specimen become truly immense and territorial, and it's believed several bone fields on old Kasath are guarded by such vast guardians, who have become local legends to the kasathas who remained behind.

Venting Airlock.name: 排放气闸舱 Venting Airlock

Vent.name: 排气口 Vent
Vent.description:
触发条件 一个或多个生物进入气闸舱室

效果 外侧气闸门打开，将可呼吸空气排放到外面的真空或有害大气中。该生物开始窒息，并且必须进行一次 @Check[type:reflex|dc:20] 豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标被从气闸中吸出 10 英尺，并受到 @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害。

大失败 目标被从气闸中吸出 10 英尺，并受到 @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害。

Trigger One or more creatures enters the airlock compartment

Effect The outer airlock door opens, venting breathable air out into the vacuum or harmful atmosphere beyond. The creature begins suffocating and must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:20] save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is sucked 10 feet out of the airlock and takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Failure The target is sucked 10 feet out of the airlock and takes @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage.

Venting Airlock.disable:
@Check[type:crafting|dc:17]（受训）修理气闸舱门

@Check[type:crafting|dc:17] (trained) to repair the airlock
Venting Airlock.hazarddescription:
一个发生故障的气闸在生物还在里面时意外开启。

A malfunctioning airlock opens unexpectedly while creatures are inside.

Eldritch Maw.name: 异界之喉 Eldritch Maw

Eldritch Belch.name: 秘法喷嗝 Eldritch Belch
Eldritch Belch.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到陷阱30英尺内

效果 巨口喷吐，然后掷先攻。

Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the trap

Effect The maw Belches, then rolls initiative.

Belch.name: 打嗝 Belch
Belch.description:
巨口喷出一团有毒蒸气云，形成一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:20]。区域内的所有生物都必须进行一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1} 状态，持续 1 轮。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2} 状态，持续 1 轮。

大失败 该生物陷入恶心 2 状态，持续 1 分钟。

The maw belches a cloud of noxious vapors in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20]. All creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2 for 1 minute.

Swallow Whole.name: 整吞 Swallow Whole
Swallow Whole.description:
巨口会试图吞下一个被触手 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}（见下文）且在其例行动作开始时与其相邻的中型或更小生物（@Check[type:reflex|dc:17]）。若成功，它会吞下该生物。这个怪物不能攻击被吞下的生物。被吞下的生物处于被擒抱状态、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速 1}，并且必须屏住呼吸，否则就会开始窒息。该生物在首次被吞下时以及此后每当其回合结束时，只要仍被吞下，都会受到 @Damage[2d6[acid]] 伤害。若受害者成功脱离此能力造成的被擒抱状态，它会通过巨口脱出。被吞下的生物可以攻击巨口，但只能使用徒手攻击，或使用总体积为轻或更低的武器。巨口对此攻击处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态。若巨口因单次攻击或法术受到等于或超过所列损坏阈值的穿刺或挥砍伤害，则被吞下的生物会割开自己脱困。通过脱离或割开自己脱困而获得自由的生物可以立即呼吸，并离开这个陷阱的空间。若该陷阱被摧毁或停用，则被吞下的生物可以由与其相邻的生物解救；这些生物若合计花费 3 个动作，并使用造成穿刺或挥砍伤害的武器或徒手攻击将墙壁的肉质部分切开，即可将其救出。

The maw attempts to swallow a Medium or smaller creature that is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a tentacle (see below) and adjacent to it at the start of its routine (@Check[type:reflex|dc:17]). On a success, it swallows the creature. The monster can't attack a swallowed creature. A swallowed creature is grabbed, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and has to hold its breath or start suffocating. The swallowed creature takes @Damage[2d6[acid]] damage when first swallowed and at the end of each of its turns while it's swallowed. If the victim Escapes this ability's grabbed condition, it exits through the maw. A swallowed creature can attack the maw, but only with unarmed attacks or with weapons of light Bulk or less. The maw is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the attack. If the maw takes piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding the listed Broken Threshold from a single attack or spell, the swallowed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either Escaping or cutting itself free can immediately breathe and exits the trap's space. If the trap is destroyed or disabled, a swallowed creature can be freed by creatures adjacent to it if they spend a combined total of 3 actions cutting the fleshy parts of the wall open with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

Eldritch Maw.disable:
@Check[type:athletics|dc:18] 将嘴巴卡住使其闭合 1 轮，或 @Check[type:occultism|dc:17] 或 @Check[type:religion|dc:17]（受训）成功两次，将入侵者从这个现实中放逐

@Check[type:athletics|dc:18] to jam the mouth closed for 1 round, or @Check[type:occultism|dc:17] or @Check[type:religion|dc:17] (trained) twice to banish the intrusion from this reality
Eldritch Maw.hazarddescription:
一张宽达10英尺的可憎巨口猛然撕开地面，甩动着它的酸性舌头，并喷吐出有毒烟雾。

A hideous 10-foot-wide mouth rips the ground open, lashing out with its acidic tongue and belching noxious fumes.
Eldritch Maw.routine:
（3 个动作）陷阱在其回合开始时，如果有生物与其相邻且被一根触手 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒抱}，则用它的第一个动作进行“整吞”。它用剩余的动作对触及范围内（10 英尺）的生物进行舌击打击，并对射程内（60 英尺）的生物进行邪异射线打击。每 [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 轮}，陷阱会用它的最后一个动作进行“喷吐”。

(3 actions) The trap uses its first action to Swallow Whole if a creature is adjacent to it and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a tentacle when it begins its turn. It uses its remaining actions to make tongue lash Strikes against creatures within reach (10 feet) and eldritch ray Strikes against creatures within range (60 feet). Every [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, the trap uses its last action to Belch.

Asteray.name: 阿斯特雷 Asteray

Wake Rider.name: 尾流骑手 Wake Rider
Wake Rider.description:
通过接触一艘星舰，星鳐能够与其在旅行时留下的能量尾迹建立联结。星鳐可以与该星舰保持同速并随其一同行进，只要它始终处于100英尺内，就将该舰视为“地面”。如果星舰进入漂流域，星鳐可以选择随它一同进入漂流域，或者以一个反应脱离并留在原处。

By touching a starship, an asteray can bond to the energy wake it leaves as it travels. The asteray can match speeds with the starship and ride along with it, treating the ship as if it were the "ground" so long as it remains within 100 feet. If the starship enters the Drift, the asteray can choose to accompany it into the Drift, or it can disengage as a reaction and remain behind.

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原始天生法术 Primal Innate Spells

Gecko Grip (At Will).name: 壁虎攀附（随意） Gecko Grip (At Will)
Gecko Grip (At Will).description:
细小的附着毛发从生物的手脚上长出，使其几乎能在任何表面上抓附。目标获得等同于其速度的攀爬速度。

升阶（5环） 持续时间增加至1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.qn7uO5Ih01yLJot7]{法术效果：壁虎之握}

Tiny clinging hairs sprout across the creature's hands and feet, offering purchase on nearly any surface. The target gains a climb Speed equal to its Speed.

Heightened (5th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.qn7uO5Ih01yLJot7]{Spell Effect: Gecko Grip}

Charm.name: 魅惑 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语如蜜般甜美，你的面容仿佛笼罩在朦胧梦幻的薄雾中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近威胁过它或对它使用了敌对动作，则此次豁免获得+4处境加值。

你可以解除该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。当法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑，除非它与你之间的友谊，或你说服它采取的行动，与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你有可能通过普通手段说服目标继续把你当作朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你曾试图魅惑它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑，除非它识别出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友好}。如果它原本已是友好，则变为@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于助人}。它不能对你使用敌对动作。

大失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，并且不能对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延长至你下一次进行每日准备时。

升阶（8环） 持续时间延长至你下一次进行每日准备时，且你最多可以指定10个生物为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Confusion.name: 困惑 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用奇异的冲动扰乱目标，使其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以Dismiss该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时再次进行一次豁免，以终止该混乱状态。

大失败 目标陷入Confused，持续1分钟，且不能通过豁免提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以将10个生物作为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Discharge.name: 放电 Discharge
Discharge.description:
你引发出一道突如其来的电火花，涌入一个科技生物或物体。你使一件具有科技特征的物品失去动力，或扰乱一个具有科技特征的生物，其效果取决于你选择的是生物还是物体。

  • 生物 如果你的目标是一个具有科技特征的生物，它必须进行一次意志豁免。若失败，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}；若大失败，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2}。
  • 物体 如果你的目标是一个被持用的物体，则持有该物体的生物进行一次意志豁免。若成功，该物体失去其最大充能数的一半。若失败，或者你以一个未被持用的物体为目标，则该物体失去其所有剩余充能。

You ignite a sudden spark of electricity that surges into a technological creature or object. You depower an item with the tech trait or disrupt a creature with the tech trait, with effects based on choosing creature or object.

  • Creature If your target is a creature with the tech trait, it attempts a Will Save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}; On a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.
  • Object If you target an attended object, the creature with the object attempts a Will save. On a success, the object loses half of its maximum charges. On a failure, or if you target an unattended object, the object loses all its remaining charges.

Veil of Privacy.name: 隐私帷幕 Veil of Privacy
Veil of Privacy.description:
你竖起防护结界，使目标难以通过魔法被侦测到。隐私帷幕会在持续时间内尝试反制所有针对目标或目标装备施加的侦测、揭示和探知效果；为此目的，将戏法视为1环法术。若成功反制一个以区域或多个目标为对象的法术，则只会对隐私帷幕的目标免除其效果。

You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. Veil of privacy attempts to counteract all detection, revelation, and scrying effects used against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects for only veil of privacy's target.

Matter Consumption.name: 物质吞噬 Matter Consumption
Matter Consumption.description:
星芒鳐张开嘴，吸入邻接的一个有机生物或物体的分子；目标的体型必须为小型或更大。若目标是一个物体（包括尸体），则星芒鳐恢复 30 点生命值，并在接下来 1 分钟内获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速} 1。若目标是一个生物，则其受到 @Damage[10d8[void]] 伤害（@Check[type:fortitude|dc:32|basic:true] 豁免）。

The asteray opens its mouth to suck in the molecules of an adjacent organic creature or object of Small size or larger. If the target is an object (including a corpse) then the asteray heals 30 Hit Points and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} 1 for the next minute. If the target is a creature, then it takes @Damage[10d8[void]] damage (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:32|basic:true] save).

Sensor Song.name: 传感器之歌 Sensor Song
Sensor Song.description:
星芒鳐能够“歌唱”电子信号，以掩盖或模仿传感器读数。星芒鳐制造出一个物体的虚假影像，如同其施放了一个5环位的 holographic object。该虚假读数只影响电子传感器，但只要此效果持续，区域内的生物就会听到奇怪的回声。多个星芒鳐可以一同歌唱；每有一只星芒鳐同步施放该法术，holographic object 的距离和区域就翻倍。

An asteray can "sing" electronic signals that mask or mimic sensor readings. The asteray creates a false image of an object as if it had cast a 5th-rank holographic object. This false reading affects only electronic sensors, but creatures hear odd echoes in the area so long as the effect persists. Multiple asterays can sing together, doubling the range and area of holographic object for each asteray casting the spell in sync.

Holographic Creature.name: 全息生物 Holographic Creature
Holographic Creature.description:
你将附近的光子编织成一个大型或更小生物的虚幻全息影像。它会发出相应的声音、气味，并且触感也足以以假乱真。如果你与全息影像之间的距离超过500英尺，法术结束。

全息影像不能说话，但你可以用你的动作通过它说话，法术会适当地伪装你的声音。你可能需要进行一次欺瞒或表演检定来模仿该生物，由GM决定。如果你试图模仿某个特定人物的举止，或与认识那个人的人互动，这种情况尤其可能发生。

在战斗中，全息影像每回合可以使用2个动作，这些动作在你维持法术时使用。它可以用任意自己想要的移动类型进行最多20英尺的疾奔，因为它并非真实存在。它的攻击检定使用你的法术攻击检定，它的AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免检定调整值等于你的法术DC – 10。它足够凝实，因此可以夹击其他生物。如果全息影像被一次攻击命中或豁免失败，法术结束。

全息影像可以通过让目标相信它的攻击是真实的来造成伤害，但除此之外，它不能直接影响物理世界。如果全息影像用一次打击命中，目标受到2d6点精神伤害。此伤害是一种精神效果。全息影像的打击是非致命的。如果这伤害与该生物的形象不相符——例如，一个大型龙的全息影像却只造成5点伤害——GM可能会允许目标立即尝试一次察觉检定，以识破该法术。

任何触碰全息影像的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 动作对其进行检查的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻觉。

升阶（+1） 全息影像打击的伤害增加1d4，并且你能创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最大为超巨型）。最长持续时间也增加1分钟。

You weave nearby photons into an illusory hologram of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the hologram are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The hologram can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through it, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person's mannerisms or engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the hologram can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the Spell. It can Stride up to 20 feet using any movement type it wishes, as it's not real. It uses your spell attack roll for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It's substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the hologram is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The hologram can cause damage by making the target believe the hologram's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the hologram hits with a Strike, the target takes 2d6 mental damage. This damage is a mental effect. The hologram's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the creature—for example, if a holographic Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell.

Any creature that touches the hologram or uses the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the hologram's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan). The maximum duration also increases by 1 minute.

Holographic Object (At Will).name: 全息物体（任意） Holographic Object (At Will)
Holographic Object (At Will).description:
你将附近的光子编织成一个静止物体的幻象全息影像。整个影像必须容纳在该法术的区域内。该物体看起来会自然活动，但不会发出声音或产生气味。例如，幻象电脑服务器外部的灯光看起来会闪烁，但它会是无声的，也不会产生热量。任何接触该影像的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 动作进行检视的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。

升阶（2环） 你的全息影像会发出恰当的声音，产生正常的气味，并且触摸起来感觉正确。该法术获得听觉和嗅觉特征。持续时间增加至1小时。

升阶（5环） 如同2环版本，但持续时间无限。

You weave nearby photons into an illusory hologram of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, lights would appear to blink on the exterior of an illusory computer server, but it would be silent and wouldn't produce heat. Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your hologram makes the appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory and olfactory traits. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.

Asteray.publicNotes:
人们原以为星鳐不过是喜欢恶作剧的捣蛋鬼，但事实上，它们是诞生于虚空与第一世界交叠之处的精类。星鳐天生具备在太空中生存的能力，却也因此饱受强烈漂泊欲与难以遏制的厌倦感折磨。对消遣的强烈渴求，是大多数星鳐的首要驱动力。它们会被有趣的恒星现象所吸引，从气态巨行星中的旋涡，到小行星带中恒星残骸的相互作用。星鳐漂浮于太空时，凭借其与生俱来的吞食潜伏太空辐射的能力，便能获取足以维生的养分。然而，星鳐还有一种简单的营养需求，使其成为航天航路上的梦魇：有机物。由于太空中几乎不存在可供食用的有机成分，星鳐便会尾随星舰，常常借着舰船尾流搭便车，并不断折磨船员，直到他们弃守岗位或陷入疯狂。一旦星鳐已将一船成员逼入绝望，它们便会进入船只，吞食死者的尸体。对旅行者来说，幸运——又或许并非如此——的是，星鳐通常觉得吞食活着的生物令人反感；不过，它们异于常理的思维方式，也使它们在战斗中受到威胁时，会对仍在活动的敌人施展自己的虚空吞噬。大多数星鳐会一次冬眠数月甚至数年，漂浮在废弃船只的残骸中，直到过路舰船激起的太空涡流将它们从沉眠中唤醒。

虚空海妖

如同失落的戈拉里昂上的海妖一般，星鳐以全息影像诱引星舰而闻名。这些虚假的景象，加上这种精类天生能够制造传感器“歌声”的能力，已将来自无数文明的星舰引向毁灭。成群结成合唱团的星鳐，常会编织它们的歌声，诱使更大的星舰驶入真正危险的恒星区域，例如小行星带或垂死恒星附近。给这些船员留下充足的逃生时间后，星鳐便会悄无声息地登上这些失事船只，吞食其中所有有机物，然后如来时一般悄然离去。

Thought to be merely mischievous tricksters, asterays are in fact fey born where the void and First World overlap. Gifted with the innate ability to survive in space, asterays suffer from extreme wanderlust and an overwhelming desire to stave off boredom. A desperate thirst for amusement is the prime motivation of most asterays. They find themselves attracted to interesting stellar phenomena, from the swirls in gas giants to the interplay of stellar debris in an asteroid field. Floating through space, asterays gather enough sustenance to survive from their innate ability to consume latent cosmic radiation. However, asterays have one simple nutritional need that makes them a terror of the space lanes: organic matter. As space is all but devoid of organic elements for consumption, asterays resort to trailing starships, often by riding in their wake and tormenting the crew until they either abandon their posts or descend to madness. Once an asteray has sufficiently driven a crew to despair, they enter the vessel and consume the corpses of the fallen. Luckily—or perhaps not—for travelers, asterays typically find the consumption of living creatures to be distasteful, though their alien mindsets open them to using their vacuous consumption on active foes when threatened in combat. Most asterays hibernate for months or even years at a time, floating in the wrecks of abandoned ships until the cosmic eddies of a passing ship stirs them from their torpor.

Void Sirens

Like the sirens of lost Golarion, asterays are known to entice starships with their holographic images. These false sights, along with the fey's natural ability to create sensor "songs," have led starships from countless civilizations to their doom. Groups of asterays, formed into choirs, often weave their songs to entice larger starships to enter truly dangerous stellar regions, such as asteroid belts or close to dying stars. Giving these crews ample time to escape, the asterays silently board the derelicts and consume all organic matter before departing as quietly as they arrived.

A Game of Entropy.name: 熵之游戏 A Game of Entropy
A Game of Entropy.tokenName: 一场熵之游戏 A Game of Entropy

Loading Screen.name: 加载界面 Loading Screen
Loading Screen.description:
触发条件 两个或更多生物进入房间

效果 电脑终端上的屏幕亮起，显示出登录界面。房间内的生物无法离开，因为黑暗的虚空取代了出口。在接下来的4轮内，其他生物仍可进入该区域。该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger Two or more creatures enter the room

Effect The screens on the computer terminals come to life displaying login screens. Creatures within the room can't leave, as dark voids replace the exits. Additional creatures can enter the area for the next 4 rounds. The trap rolls initiative.

A Game of Entropy.disable:
@Check[计算机|dc:35]（专家）或 @Check[Piracy Lore|dc:35]（受训）以获取或制作侵入游戏源代码的黑客手段，从而取得不公平优势；@Check[arcana|dc:36]（专家）、@Check[occultism|dc:36]（专家）或 @Check[religion|dc:36]（专家）以用魔法改变游戏参数；@Check[performance|dc:37]（受训）或 Thievery（受训）以通过游玩来了解游戏；@Check[Vidgame Lore|dc:34]（受训）以按设计意图游玩该游戏；@Check[Gambling Lore|dc:30]（受训）以将游戏内战利品箱的收益最大化，从而获得巨大利益（每次检定花费 250 信用点）；总共需要六次成功才能通关游戏并结束此危害。

@Check[computers|dc:35] (expert) or @Check[Piracy Lore|dc:35] (trained) to acquire or create hacks into the game's source code for an unfair advantage; @Check[arcana|dc:36] (expert), @Check[occultism|dc:36] (expert), or @Check[religion|dc:36] (expert) to magically alter the game's parameters; @Check[performance|dc:37] (trained) or Thievery (trained) to learn the game through play; @Check[Vidgame Lore|dc:34] (trained) to play the game as intended; @Check[Gambling Lore|dc:30] (trained) to maximize in-game loot boxes for massive benefits (costs 250 credits per check); six total successes are required to beat the game and end the hazard.
A Game of Entropy.hazarddescription:
一排八台电脑终端突然亮起，显示出一个引人注目的登录界面。每块屏幕上都显示着一个化身，与刚进入房间的其中一个生物诡异地一模一样。屏幕都设有密码锁，但生物输入的任何单词或代码作为密码都能绕过安全措施并进入游戏。

A row of eight computer terminals spark to life with an eye-catching login screen. Each screen displays an avatar eerily identical to one of the creatures who just entered the room. The screens are password locked, but any word or code a creature enters as a password bypasses security and accesses the game.
A Game of Entropy.reset:
一旦房间内所有生物都死亡，或他们获得击败这场游戏所需次数的成功，该陷阱就会停用。赢得这场游戏会解锁一个小型庆祝画面，在那里，吞噬者红色吸积盘的幻象会消融为虚无。

The trap deactivates once all creatures in the room are dead, or they gain the required number of successes to defeat the game. Victory in the game unlocks a small celebration screen where a vision of the Devourer's red accretion disc dissolves into nothingness.
A Game of Entropy.routine:
（1 动作）随着吞噬者的熵之精华进入该空间，魔法能量开始撕裂现实的结构。房间内的生物受到 @Damage[(3d10+15)[void]] 伤害，且必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:33] 豁免。将难度等级提高 1。当难度等级达到 5 时，伤害提高至 @Damage[(6d10+30)[void]] 伤害，且严重失败效果变为死亡。免疫虚空伤害的生物（例如不死生物）改为受到强酸伤害。被此危险杀死的生物会化为细粉。

严重成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

严重失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

(1 action) Magical energies begin to tear away the fabric of reality as the Devourer's entropic essence enters the space. Creatures within the room take @Damage[(3d10+15)[void]] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save. Increase the Difficulty Level by 1. Once the Difficulty Level reaches 5, the damage increases to @Damage[(6d10+30)[void]] damage, and the critical failure effect results in death. Creatures immune to void damage (such as undead) instead take acid damage. A creature slain by this hazard is reduced to a fine powder.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.
A Game of Entropy.stealthdetails:
（大师）注意到电脑显示器背面的隐藏代码，表明这个房间含有危险的魔法代码。

(master) to notice the hidden code on the back of the computer monitors indicating the room contains dangerous magical code.
A Game of Entropy.prototypeToken: 熵之游戏 A Game of Entropy

Sediya Vrath.name: 塞迪娅·弗拉斯 Sediya Vrath
Sediya Vrath.tokenName: 塞迪娅·弗拉特 Sediya Vrath

Superior Arc Pistol.name: 卓越型电弧手枪 Superior Arc Pistol
Superior Arc Pistol.description:
升级： 1

这把笨重的手枪不使用传统弹药，而是内置一个电容器，能够产生电弧。它的枪托由聚碳酸酯或其他合成绝缘材料制成，通常被染成亮黄色，并刻有代表高压的通用闪电符号。

Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.

Advanced Microcord Armor.name: 先进微绳护甲 Advanced Microcord Armor
Advanced Microcord Armor.description:
升级： 1

这件轻甲由超轻纤维编织而成，能随着穿戴者的动作灵活弯曲，但在受到冲击时会变得如钢铁般坚硬。

Upgrades: 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.

Advanced Zero Knife.name: 先进型零点刀 Advanced Zero Knife
Advanced Zero Knife.description:
升级： 1

如同一把弹簧刀般展开，这把武器握柄内的超冷腔室会瞬间形成一把带有强烈寒冷灵光的冰刃。

Upgrades: 1

Unfolding like a switchblade, a supercooled chamber within this weapon's grip instantly forms a blade of ice with an aura of intense cold.

Cloaking Device (Commercial).name: 隐形装置（商用） Cloaking Device (Commercial)
Cloaking Device (Commercial).description:
内置的柔性面板薄片和光感受器构成了先进等离子伪装，能够使光线绕过你的身体弯曲，并让你变为@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。

激活—适应 1（操控）

频率 每天一次

效果 你隐形1分钟，获得一个2环 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]法术的效果。

Incorporated flexible sheets of panels and light receptors create advanced plasma camouflage to bend light around your body and make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Activate—Adapt 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You become invisible for 1 minute, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB] spell.

Energy Shielding (Commercial) (Fire).name: 能量护盾（商业）（火焰） Energy Shielding (Commercial) (Fire)
Energy Shielding (Commercial) (Fire).description:
这套护甲经过特殊的绝缘处理，可防护特定类型的伤害。你获得对酸蚀、寒冷、电击或火焰的抗性 5。制作者在制作该升级时选择伤害类型。一套护甲可以安装多个能量屏障升级，但每个升级都必须提供对不同伤害类型的抗性。

This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

Guarded Mind.name: 戒备心智 Guarded Mind
Guarded Mind.description:
塞迪娅将所有对精神效果的成功豁免视为重度成功。

Sediya treats all successful saves against mental effects as a critical success instead.

Vitality Network.name: 生命力网络 Vitality Network
Vitality Network.description:
塞迪娅拥有一个活力网络，她可像秘学者一样与至多10名建立了纽带的盟友共享该网络（她目前与房间内吞噬者之牙的其他成员建立了纽带）。该网络最多可储存50点生命值，并在战斗开始时为满额。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{效果：活力网络}

Sediya has a vitality network she shares with up to 10 bonded allies as though she were a mystic (she's currently bonded to the other Fangs of the Devourer in the room). This network can store a maximum of 50 Hit Points and begins combat full.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{Effect: Vitality Network}

Effect: Vitality Network.name: 效果：活力网络 Effect: Vitality Network
Effect: Vitality Network.description:
追踪你当前可用的活力网络。

你的活力网络的最大容量等于 @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] 生命值

Tracks your currently available vitality network.

Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] Hit Points

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Mind Skewer.name: 心灵穿刺 Mind Skewer
Mind Skewer.description:
