你用过量的灵能信息或神圣裁决使一个生物的心智超载。这次精神猛攻造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若重击，目标受到 4d6 点精神伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2} 状态，持续 1 轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgements. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Slice Reality.name: 切裂现实 Slice Reality
Slice Reality.description:
你切开现实，形成一道汲取生命的熵之裂隙，呈一条20英尺高、120英尺长、2英寸厚的直线。该裂隙提供 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{掩护}。裂隙在被创造时，对处于其空间内的每个生物、试图穿过裂隙的每个生物，或在其回合结束时位于裂隙内部的每个生物，造成 7d8 虚空伤害。一次基础反射豁免可以减少此伤害。生物在裂隙被创造时若成功通过此次豁免，则会被推至其所选择一侧最近的空间。生物试图穿过裂隙时，若在该豁免上严重失败，则无法穿过，并在裂隙旁结束其移动。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d8。

You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Cover}. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it is created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm. A basic Reflex save reduces the damage. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Truesight.name: 真视术 Truesight
Truesight.description:
你能看见60尺内事物的真实样貌。GM对区域内任何幻觉、变形或多态效果进行一次秘密对抗检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，如果该检定对一个多态法术成功，你可以看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该多态法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Chrono Push.name: 时流推击 Chrono Push
Chrono Push.description:
你将一个生物猛力推过战场，强到使其滑入时间之中。进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你将目标沿直线击退 15 尺（重击则为 30 尺）。如果被推动的生物接触到坚固障碍物或另一个生物，其移动便会结束。在这次移动结束时，该生物伴随着一阵时间能量爆发重新进入时间流。目标以及现在与目标相邻的生物必须成功通过一次基础反射豁免，否则受到 7d8 点力场伤害。

You push a creature across the battlefield so hard it slides through time. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, you knock the target back 15 feet in a straight line (30 feet on a critical hit). If the pushed creature contacts a solid barrier or another creature, its movement ends. At the end of this movement, the creature reenters the flow of time with a burst of temporal energy. The target and creatures now adjacent to the target must succeed at a basic Reflex save or take 7d8 force damage.

False Vision.name: 虚假幻景 False Vision
False Vision.description:
你制造出一个虚假的影像，足以欺骗任何试图对某个区域进行探知的行为。任何探知法术在该区域内看见、听见、闻到以及以其他方式探测到的，都会是你所希望呈现的内容，而非该区域中实际存在的事物。你可以在每轮维持该法术，以按照你的意愿改变这一幻象，包括演绎一幕复杂的场景。如果探知法术的环阶高于虚假视觉，施术者可以尝试进行一次察觉检定来识破该幻象，不过即使成功，他们也无法得知该区域内真正发生了什么。

You create a false image that fools any attempts to scry on an area. Any scrying spell sees, hears, smells, and otherwise detects whatever you wish within the area, rather than what is actually in the area. You can Sustain the spell each round to change the illusion as you desire, including playing out a complex scene. If the scrying spell is of a higher rank than false vision, the scryer can attempt a Perception check to disbelieve the illusion, though even if they're successful, they can't learn what's truly going on in the area.

Motivating Ringtone.name: 激励铃声 Motivating Ringtone
Motivating Ringtone.description:
你使目标通讯器播放一首为其拥有者量身谱写、带有宇宙韵律的个人主题铃声。当你施放该法术时，拥有目标的生物恢复 1d8+4 点生命值，并在持续时间内获得所有速度 +5 尺的状态加值，以及对抗恐惧效果的豁免检定 +1 状态加值，只要该通讯器继续播放铃声即可。在其回合开始时邻接一名正在播放激活铃声的盟友的生物，获得速度的状态加值和豁免加值，直到其下个回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.HshG8G3NgMJNlu9s]{法术效果：振奋铃声}

强化（+1） 治疗量增加 1d8+4。

You cause the target comm unit to play a cosmically composed personal theme song specific to its owner. The creature who owns the target regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds and a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects for the duration, as long as the comm unit continues to play the ringtone. Creatures beginning their turn adjacent to an ally with an active ringtone gain the status bonus to Speeds and bonus to saves until the start of their next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.HshG8G3NgMJNlu9s]{Spell Effect: Motivating Ringtone}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望之潮 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物所受的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮内，该生物不能使用反应，并且必须在其回合开始时再次进行一次豁免；若失败，则它会因无法控制地抽泣而在该回合中处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动陷入迟缓 1，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域扩大为60英尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Eldritch Wrath.name: 秘法之怒 Eldritch Wrath
Eldritch Wrath.description:
你引导存在于物质宇宙外缘之外的不可名状之力，幻影般的爪击、颚击和触手猛袭区域内的每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成 3d12 点精神伤害。区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次基础意志豁免。对于任何因该法术效果而陷入恶心状态的生物，该区域都属于困难地形。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

You channel the unspeakable powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Selective Invisibility.name: 选择性隐形 Selective Invisibility
Selective Invisibility.description:
作为施放此法术的一部分，你触碰的一名自愿生物会对除法术射程内的第二个目标之外的所有人变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。如果该隐形生物对任何并非能够看见其身形之目标的人使用敌对动作，则此法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（+1） 你可以额外触碰一名生物使其隐形，但他们必须拥有相同的目标。

A willing creature you touch as part of casting this spell becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to everyone except a second target within the spell's range. If the invisible creature uses a hostile action against anyone who is not the target that can see them, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (+1) You may touch an additional creature to make them invisible, but they all must have the same target.

Shifting Surge.name: 位移奔涌 Shifting Surge
Shifting Surge.description:
你释放出一股魔法能量，暂时改变一个目标武器所造成的伤害类型。该武器接下来进行的下一次 Strike 会造成你所选择的酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波伤害，并额外造成 1d6 与该武器通常伤害类型相同的额外伤害。

强化（+2） 额外伤害提高 1d6

You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a target weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6

Sonic Scream.name: 音波尖啸 Sonic Scream
Sonic Scream.description:
你通过发出一声宣泄性的尖啸，释放出一道令人痛苦地迅疾的振动锥形波，对区域内的生物造成1d8点音波伤害。豁免检定失败的生物还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

You unleash a painfully rapid cone of vibrations by letting out a catharctic scream, dealing 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage by 1d8.

Analyze Target.name: 分析目标 Analyze Target
Analyze Target.description:
你专注于目标，在魔法全息影像显示信息的同时收集数据。当施法完成时，你会获知目标的生物特征信息，包括其指纹、医疗状况以及其他基础生理信息。你，或任何接受你关于该分析建议的人，在冒充该生物时、进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} 的医疗检定时，以及针对该生物进行回忆知识动作时，获得+1处境加值。若该生物是幻象，或处于幻术魔法的效果之下，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的分析目标法术的法术环阶时，你才会察觉到这一点。

强化（3环） 处境加值提升至+2，且你最多可以将10个生物作为目标。

强化（6环） 处境加值提升至+3，且你可以将任意数量的生物作为目标。

You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Impersonate the creature, on Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, and to Recall Knowledge actions about the creature. If the creature is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the spell rank of your analyze target spell.

Heightened (3rd) The circumstance bonus increases to +2 and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The circumstance bonus increases to +3 and you can target any number of creatures.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM判定。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的源头。类似于一种不精确感官，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将源头缩小到一个5英尺见方的立方区域内（若其大于该区域，则锁定最近的部分）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Eldritch Lance.name: 魔法长枪 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将一束侵袭心智的诡秘能量从群星之间的黑暗空间中凝聚出来，并将其射向一个目标。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你命中，则造成 2d6 点精神伤害。在重击成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Injury Echo.name: 伤痛回响 Injury Echo
Injury Echo.description:
你将来自未来或过去的一处伤口显现在当下，以伤害一个生物。选择：钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。目标受到 1d6 所选类型的伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免失败，且在你的下个回合结束前受到同类型的伤害，则它还会额外受到 @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加 1d6，失败时的持续伤害增加 1d4。

You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d6 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

Shield.name: 护盾 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾。这视为使用“举起护盾”动作，使你获得 AC +1 的处境加值，直到你的下一回合开始，但使用它不需要占用手。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应。该护盾的硬度为 5。你可以使用该法术的反应来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使其不造成物理伤害也是如此。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾}

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾免疫}

升阶（+2） 护盾的硬度提高 5。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Fill Vitality.name: 填充活力 Fill Vitality
Fill Vitality.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 Sediya 的活力网络恢复 10 点生命值，至多恢复到其最大值。

Frequency once per round

Effect Sediya restores 10 Hit Points to her vitality network up to its maximum.

Transfer Vitality.name: 转移活力 Transfer Vitality
Transfer Vitality.description:
赛迪娅从她的活力网络中恢复任意数量的生命值给一个可见的已建立纽带目标。

Sediya restores any number of Hit Points from her vitality network to a visible bonded target.

Mental Anguish.name: 精神痛苦 Mental Anguish
Mental Anguish.description:
当一个生物未能通过对抗 Sediya 施放的带有心灵特征的法术的豁免检定时，随着物质宇宙走向熵灭的幻象充斥其心智，它会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} 并 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}，直到其下一回合结束。

When a creature fails a saving throw against a spell Sediya casts with the mental trait, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of its next turn as visions of the universe's entropic demise fill its mind.

Sediya Vrath.blurb:
女性达玛雅拉申塔人秘学者
Female damaya lashunta mystic
Sediya Vrath.prototypeToken: 塞迪娅·弗拉斯 Sediya Vrath

Makosa.name: 玛科萨 Makosa

Shimmersight.name: 微光视域 Shimmersight
Shimmersight.description:
当位于希姆-泰克矿井内时，玛科萨能够探测到100英尺内闪晶石附近的任何生物。

While within Shim-Tek mine, Makosa can detect any creatures within 100 feet of shimmerstone.

Physical Science Lore.name: 物理科学知识 Physical Science Lore

Quilted Armor.name: 绗缝护甲 Quilted Armor
Quilted Armor.description:
绗缝护甲被制成一件长外套，设计用于在不搭配其他护甲时提供防护。绗缝护甲覆盖上半身和腿部，这进一步将其与典型的衬垫内衣区分开来。这种护甲常以时髦的颜色或图案制成，以便作为防护性外衣或军装使用。

Quilted armor is built in a long coat intended for defensive use without other armor. Quilted armor protects the upper body and legs, differentiating it further from the typical padded undercoat. This armor is frequently made in stylish colors or patterns to facilitate use as protective outerwear or a military uniform.

Enraging Presence.name: 激怒气场 Enraging Presence
Enraging Presence.description:
30尺。进入或处于该灵光内的非构装生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:35] 豁免。若失败，该生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Conf乱} 1轮，随后在1分钟内获得伤害掷骰+2状态加值。若成功，该生物会在24小时内暂时免疫激怒存在。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YWckateVe6dqPs6M]{效果：激怒存在}

30 feet. Non-construct creatures entering or within the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:35] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round, then gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune to enraging presence for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YWckateVe6dqPs6M]{Effect: Enraging Presence}

Vitality Network.name: 活力网络 Vitality Network
Vitality Network.description:
玛科萨拥有一个活力网络，他们可与至多10名缔结联结的盟友共享该网络，如同他们是一名秘学者（他们当前与房间内其他闪晶石机器人处于联结状态）。该网络最多可储存75点生命值，并在战斗开始时为满值。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{效果：活力网络}

Makosa has a vitality network they share with up to 10 bonded allies as though they were a mystic (they're currently bonded to the other shimmerstone robots in the room). This network can store a maximum of 75 Hit Points and begins combat full.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{Effect: Vitality Network}

Effect: Vitality Network.name: 效果：活力网络 Effect: Vitality Network
Effect: Vitality Network.description:
追踪你当前可用的活力网络。

你的活力网络的最大容量等于 @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] 生命值

Tracks your currently available vitality network.

Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] Hit Points

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Eldritch Wrath.name: 玄秘之怒 Eldritch Wrath
Eldritch Wrath.description:
你引导存在于宇宙外缘之外、难以言喻的力量，幻象般的爪击、颚击和触手猛然抽向区域内的每个目标，对该区域内的每个生物造成 3d12 点精神伤害。区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次基础意志豁免。对于任何因该法术效果而陷入恶心状态的生物，该区域都是困难地形。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

You channel the unspeakable powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Slice Reality.name: 切裂现实 Slice Reality
Slice Reality.description:
你切开现实，形成一道汲取生命的熵之裂隙，呈一条高20英尺、长120英尺、厚2英寸的直线。该裂隙提供@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{掩护}。裂隙对在其被创造时处于裂隙空间内、尝试穿过裂隙，或在裂隙内结束其回合的每个生物造成7d8虚空伤害。一次基础反射豁免可减少伤害。在裂隙被创造时于此次豁免成功的生物会被推至其所选择一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物若在此次豁免中严重失败，则无法穿过，并在裂隙旁结束其移动。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Cover}. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it is created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm. A basic Reflex save reduces the damage. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Telekinetic Tantrum.name: 念动力发作 Telekinetic Tantrum
Telekinetic Tantrum.description:
防御 见正文

你释放出一阵强大的念动力能量弹幕，足以压制生物、抛掷物体并造成伤害。当你施放该法术时，以及此后每轮你第一次维持该法术时，你都可以从以下效果中选择一项。你不能连续两次选择同一种效果。

  • 滚开！ 你可以将至多15个物体或生物朝任意方向抛掷至多40英尺（包括向上或向下）。你最多可以抛掷总重量400磅的物体，或每个生物或物体最多40 Bulk。生物会根据其移动的距离受到钝击伤害，并以如同承受了坠落伤害一样的方式倒地，陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。正在被移动的生物可以尝试进行强韧豁免以忽略该效果。
  • 暴雨倾盆 你用区域内的碎片和物体猛击区域内所有生物，造成5d10点钝击伤害，并可进行一次基础反射豁免。
  • 念动力猛击 你的念动力风暴猛击区域内所有生物。进行一次远程法术攻击检定。你会命中的所有目标受到7d6点力场伤害，并且陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

Defense see text

You launch a barrage of powerful psychokinetic energy that overpower creatures, hurl objects, and deal damage. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of the following effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.

  • Back Off! You hurl up to 15 objects or creatures up to 40 feet in any direction (including up or down). You can hurl up to a total weight of 400 pounds of 40 Bulk per creature or object. Creatures take bludgeoning damage based on the distance they moved and land @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, as though they'd taken falling damage. Creatures being moved can attempt a Fortitude save to ignore the effect.
  • Hard Rain You pummel all creatures in the area with debris and objects in the area, dealing 5d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.
  • Psychokinetic Slam Your psychokinetic storm slams into all creatures in the area. Make a ranged spell attack roll. All targets you would hit take 7d6 force damage and are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Entropy Strike.name: 熵击 Entropy Strike
Entropy Strike.description:
你释放出一道熵射线，使物质迅速且无差别地腐朽。进行一次远程法术攻击。

重击成功 目标受到 10d8 点虚空伤害。如果目标是科技目标，则其受到 4d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

成功 目标受到 5d8 点虚空伤害。如果目标是科技目标，则其受到 2d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}。

升阶（+1） 初始伤害增加 1d8，且持续性伤害增加 1d6。

You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack.

Critical Success The target takes 10d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 4d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target takes 5d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Gravity Field.name: 重力场 Gravity Field
Gravity Field.description:
区域 30英尺半径、100英尺高的圆柱

你强化一个区域内的重力作用。区域内所有飞行中的生物下降40英尺。整个区域对飞行中的生物而言属于高等困难地形，对地面上的生物而言属于困难地形。任何在该区域内以飞行状态结束其回合的生物都会下降20英尺。任何被重力场拖拽到地面的生物都如同坠落一般受到钝击伤害。该区域内的重力提高一级（例如，失重变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，而高重力变为极端重力）。

Area 30-foot radius, 100-foot-tall cylinder

You increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature that ends its turn Flying within the area descends 20 feet. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen. Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).

Mind Skewer.name: 心灵穿刺 Mind Skewer
Mind Skewer.description:
你用过量的灵能信息或神圣裁决使一个生物的心智过载。精神冲击造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若重击，目标受到 4d6 点精神伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgements. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 幻影浩劫 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
区域内每个生物的心智中都充满了末日般毁灭的幻象。该幻象造成 11d6 点精神伤害（基础意志豁免）。若重度失败，该生物还必须成功通过一次反射豁免，否则会认为自己被困住了（卡在裂缝中、漂流在海上，或遭遇其他与其幻象相符的命运）。如果它第二次豁免失败，则还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} 1 分钟。它可以在自己每个回合结束时重新进行一次意志豁免，若成功，则识破该幻觉并从 Stunned 状态中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a Reflex save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the Stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Force Barrage.name: 力场齐射 Force Barrage
Force Barrage.description:
你向一个你能看见的生物发射一枚由凝固魔法形成的碎片。它会自动命中，并造成 1d4+1 点力场伤害。施放该法术时，你每额外使用 1 个动作，你发射的碎片数量便增加 1，至多在使用 3 个动作时发射 3 枚碎片。你分别为每一枚碎片选择目标。如果你向同一目标发射多于一枚碎片，则在应用伤害加值或减值、抗性、弱点等之前，先合并伤害。

升阶（+2） 你每花费 1 个动作，就额外发射 1 枚碎片。

You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的能力。它获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}状态，并且每轮只能将这个额外动作用于打击和疾奔动作。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以 6 个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

Howl.name: 嚎叫 Howl
Howl.description:
你发出一声充满心灵共振的强力嚎叫，迫使其他听到的对象一同加入。你对区域内所有能听见的其他生物造成 7d12 音波伤害和 @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。此法术造成的持续精神伤害，每有一个受此法术影响且仍在嚎叫的生物，就增加 1 点。正在嚎叫的生物在 1 轮内无法使用听觉动作或施放法术，但隐匿法术除外。在所有生物完成其豁免后，再计算持续伤害。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害，且不受到持续精神伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并且只要仍承受持续精神伤害，就会被迫尖叫。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并且只要仍承受持续精神伤害，就会被迫嚎叫

You let out a powerful ululation full of psychic resonance that compels others who hear it to join in. You deal 7d12 sonic damage and @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage to other creatures who can hear within the area. Targets must attempt a Will save. The persistent mental damage from this spell increases by 1 for each creature affected by this spell who remains howling. A howling creature can't use auditory actions or cast spells, except for subtle spells for 1 round. Calculate the persistent damage after all creatures made their saves.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and no persistent mental damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is compelled to scream as long as it takes persistent mental damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is compelled to howl as long as it takes persistent mental damage

Dominate.name: 支配 Dominate
Dominate.description:
你控制目标，强迫其服从你的命令。如果你下达明显会导致其自我毁灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令为止。该效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在奋力抵抗你的命令时，陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 你控制目标。它获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}状态，但它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次意志豁免。若成功，则该法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但只有当你向其下达违背其天性的命令时，例如杀死其盟友，目标才会获得新的豁免。

升阶（10环） 持续时间无限。

You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Share Pain.name: 分担痛苦 Share Pain
Share Pain.description:
你以心灵感应与一个生物共享痛苦难当的感受。目标受到 3d12 点精神伤害，并进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}。

强化（6环） 该法术的目标变为至多四个生物，且造成 6d12 点精神伤害。

You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.

Slow.name: 缓慢】【。 Slow
Slow.description:
你扩张目标周围的时间流动，使其行动变慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2}，持续 1 分钟。

升阶（6环） 你的目标最多可以指定 10 个生物。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Telekinetic Strangulation.name: 念动力扼杀 Telekinetic Strangulation
Telekinetic Strangulation.description:
你以铁钳般的握力，用心灵异能扼住一个生物的喉咙或其他要害部位，强行将其提离地面几英寸，使其在挣扎中难以呼吸。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你造成 6d12 钝击伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}。目标受到 1d12 持续性钝击伤害，在你维持该法术的每一轮中会继续处于定身状态，并且必须持续屏住呼吸。以这种方式被定身时，它必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。目标可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}（挣脱 DC 为你的法术 DC，且此次挣脱尝试会受到失能特征的影响）。

You psychically grasp a creature's throat or other vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The target takes 1d12 persistent bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized and must continue holding its breath for each round you Sustain the Spell. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the escape DC is your spell DC and the escape attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).

Truesight.name: 真视 Truesight
Truesight.description:
你能看见60英尺内事物的真实样貌。GM对区域内任何幻觉、变形或转变效果进行一次秘密反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定对一个转变法术成功，你就能看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该转变法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Chrono Push.name: 时流推击 Chrono Push
Chrono Push.description:
你猛力将一个生物推过战场，强到让它滑入时间之中。进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你将目标沿直线击退15英尺（若为重击，则为30英尺）。如果被推动的生物接触到坚固障碍物或另一个生物，它的移动便结束。在这次移动结束时，该生物随着一阵时间能量爆发重新进入时间流。目标以及现在与目标相邻的生物必须成功通过一次基础反射豁免，否则受到7d8点力场伤害。

You push a creature across the battlefield so hard it slides through time. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, you knock the target back 15 feet in a straight line (30 feet on a critical hit). If the pushed creature contacts a solid barrier or another creature, its movement ends. At the end of this movement, the creature reenters the flow of time with a burst of temporal energy. The target and creatures now adjacent to the target must succeed at a basic Reflex save or take 7d8 force damage.

Command.name: 指挥 Command
Command.description:
你发出一声难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃跑（如同它具有 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 状态）、放开它正拿着的东西、卧倒为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，或站在原地不动。在服从你的命令之前，它不能 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay}，也不能进行任何反应。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下一回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须用一个单一动作来照你的命令行事。

大失败 目标在其下一回合中必须用尽所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你的目标至多可以是10个生物。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Control Machine.name: 控制机械 Control Machine
Control Machine.description:
你控制一个科技生物或物体，并通过心灵感应向其下达命令。如果你向一个有知性目标下达明显会自我毁灭的命令，则该目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令为止。其效果取决于它的意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在抗拒你的命令时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 你控制该目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 状态，但它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试进行一次意志豁免。若成功，则该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当目标具有知性，且你向其下达了违背其天性的新的命令时，例如杀死其盟友，它才会获得一次新的豁免。

升阶（10环） 持续时间变为无限。

You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously selfdestructive order to a sapient target, the target does not act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Synaptic Pulse.name: 心灵脉冲 Synaptic Pulse
Synaptic Pulse.description:
你释放出一阵脉动的精神冲击，穿透区域内所有敌人的心智。区域内的每个敌人都必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入 Stunned，持续 1 轮。

You emit a pulsating mental blast that penetrates the minds of all enemies in the area. Each enemy in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.

Fly.name: 飞行 Fly
Fly.description:
目标可以在空中翱翔，获得等同于其速度或20英尺的飞行速度，以较高者为准。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{法术效果：飞行}

升阶（7环） 持续时间延长至1小时。

The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

Telepathy.name: 心灵感应 Telepathy
Telepathy.description:
你可以与30尺内的生物进行心灵感应交流。一旦你通过与某个生物交流建立连接，该交流就是双向的。你只能与和你共享一种语言的生物交流。

强化（6环） 即使你们不共享语言，你也可以通过共享的心象与生物进行心灵感应交流；telepathy 失去语言（特征）。

You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet. Once you establish a connection by communicating with a creature, the communication is two-way. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you.

Heightened (6th) You can communicate telepathically with creatures using shared mental imagery even if you don't share a language; telepathy loses the linguistic trait.

Translocate.name: 迁移 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你会将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品，立刻从当前位置传送到你视野内射程范围中的一个未被占据的空间。若这会让另一生物随你一同传送——即使你正将其装在一个异次元容器中——该法术即失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你无需能够看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Vibe Check.name: 状态检查 Vibe Check
Vibe Check.description:
你通过将一种强烈情绪以灵能投射进一个生物的心智来共享一种情绪。目标尝试一次意志豁免。若失败，目标会体验你从以下情绪中选择的一种。

  • 愤怒：在其下一回合，目标会将其第一个动作用于攻击最近的生物，即使那是其盟友。
  • 喜悦：目标不能采取任何敌对动作。
  • 恐惧：目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。
  • 悲伤：目标处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，并突然哭了起来。

升阶（4环） 该法术影响 20 尺爆发内的所有生物。每个生物都必须受到相同情绪的影响。

You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions.

  • Anger: On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
  • Joy: The target cannot take any hostile actions.
  • Fear: The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
  • Sorrow: The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and bursts into tears.

Heightened (4th) The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.

Cleanse Affliction.name: 净化苦难 Cleanse Affliction
Cleanse Affliction.description:
温和的恢复性魔法能抵消毒素和更复杂病症的效果。选择目标身上的一种折磨，例如诅咒、疾病或毒药。如果它已经发展到第一阶段之后，将其阶段降低一级。此降低效果对同一例折磨只能生效一次；当该折磨被完全治愈时，此例即告结束。尽管这种降低不能再次发生，此法术的高阶版本在每次施放时都会尝试进行对抗。

高阶化（3环） 若该折磨为疾病或毒药，则尝试进行对抗。

高阶化（4环） 若该折磨为诅咒、疾病或毒药，则尝试进行对抗。

Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

Clear Mind.name: 清明心智 Clear Mind
Clear Mind.description:
你将精神污染从目标的心智中驱散。尝试反制一个由你选择、正在对目标施加以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌}和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝}。如果你反制该效果失败，但若其反制等级降低 2 级你本会成功，则改为压制该效果直到你下个回合开始。该效果被压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。该法术不能反制或压制属于诅咒、疾病或目标自然状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{受控}和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速}加入状态列表。

升阶（6环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{厄运}加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}加入状态列表。

You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Fear.name: 恐惧 Fear
Fear.description:
你将恐惧植入目标心中；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以将五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Sound Body.name: 健全体魄 Sound Body
Sound Body.description:
你释放一股治疗性能量，以恢复目标的身体。尝试反制一个由你选择、使目标陷入以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱}，或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}。如果你未能反制该效果，但若其反制等级低 2 级你本可以成功，则改为使该效果受压制，直到你的下一回合开始。该效果受压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。

这个法术不能反制或压制诅咒、疾病，或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓} 加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑} 加入状态列表。

You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Augury.name: 预兆术 Augury
Augury.description:
你会模糊地瞥见未来。在施放此法术期间，就某个特定行动方案的结果提出询问。该法术可以预测未来最多30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM对以下结果中最可能出现者的最佳判断：好、坏、混合（结果会好坏参半），以及无事（不会有特别好或特别坏的结果）。

GM进行一次秘密的 @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。若失败，结果恒为“无事”。这使得你无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果有人在额外一次施放 预兆术 时询问与第一次施放相同的话题，GM会使用第一次施放时秘密投掷的结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，仍有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Blur.name: 模糊 Blur
Blur.description:
目标的形态显得模糊不清。它变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于此效果的性质仍使目标的位置显而易见，目标不能利用这种隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Invisibility.name: 隐形 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
幻象使目标周围的光发生弯曲，使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态。这使其对所有生物都处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找该目标，从而改为使其对它们处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐蔽}状态。如果目标使用了敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作，也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动力操作 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一阵念动力能量的迸发，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某件物品。你可以尝试以法术攻击检定代替运动检定，对目标进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{调整位置} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Enfeeble.name: 虚弱化 Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description:
你削弱目标的力量，效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1} 状态，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 3} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

Mindlink.name: 心灵链接 Mindlink
Mindlink.description:
你将自己的心灵与目标的心灵相连，并在一瞬间向其心智传递原本需要 10 分钟才能交流的信息量。

You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

Protection.name: 防护 Protection
Protection.description:
你保护一个生物免受伤害。目标获得对护甲等级和豁免检定的 +1 状态加值。

升阶（3环） 你也可以选择让这些增益影响目标周围 @Template[emanation|distance:10] 内的所有盟友。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{法术效果：防护}

You ward a creature against harm. The target gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose to have the benefits also affect all your allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the target.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

Sure Strike.name: 精准打击 Sure Strike
Sure Strike.description:
对未来的一瞥确保你的下一击精准命中。在你的回合结束前，下次你进行攻击检定时，掷两次攻击并采用较好的结果。此次攻击无视攻击检定的处境减值，以及因目标处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐匿}而需要进行的任何平检。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：必定一击}

A glimpse into the future ensures your next blow strikes true. The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll the attack twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在或不存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM判定。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的来源。与不精确感官类似，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5英尺立方体内（若其大于该范围，则为离你最近的那个部分）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Eldritch Lance.name: 奥术长枪 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将来自群星之间黑暗空隙、侵袭心智的诡异能量凝聚成一道光束，并将其射向目标。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你命中，则造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若大成功，则造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Injury Echo.name: 伤势回响 Injury Echo
Injury Echo.description:
你显现出来自未来或过去的伤势，以在当下伤害一个生物。选择：钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。目标受到 1d6 所选类型的伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免失败，且在你的下个回合结束前受到同类型的伤害，则它还会额外受到 @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。

强化（+2） 初始伤害增加 1d6，且失败时的持续伤害增加 1d4。

You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d6 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你创造一个光球，它会在你选择的一种颜色下，于20英尺半径内发出明亮光照（接下来的20英尺为微光）。如果你在一个自愿生物所处的同一空间内创造该光，你可以将该光附着在该生物身上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以通过维持该法术，使光最多移动60英尺；你可以在此次移动中将其附着到某个生物身上或从某个生物身上分离。

你可以解除该法术。如果你在已经有四个光亮术生效时再次施放该法术，你必须选择一个现有法术使其结束。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

强化（4环） 该光球会在60英尺半径内发出光照（接下来的60英尺为微光）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Message.name: 讯息 Message
Message.description:
你轻声默念词句，但这些词并不会从你的口中说出，而是直接传入目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，程度与平常你只是动口不出声时无异，但目标却能像站在你身边一样清楚地听见你的话。目标可以用一个反应作出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在他们下一回合用一个自由动作回应，但他们必须看得见你且位于范围内才能这么做。如果他们作出回应，他们的回应也会像最初的信息一样，直接传入你的耳中。

高阶化（3环） 该法术的范围增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Void Warp.name: 虚空扭曲 Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
你呼唤虚空来伤害生命力。目标受到 2d4 点虚空伤害，并进行一次基础强韧豁免。若目标严重失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{衰弱 1} 状态，直到你下个回合开始。

升阶 (+1) 伤害增加 1d4。

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Fill Vitality.name: 填充活力 Fill Vitality
Fill Vitality.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 马科萨为其活力网络恢复10点生命值，至多恢复至其上限。

Frequency once per round

Effect Makosa restores 10 Hit Points to their vitality network, up to its maximum.

Refract Spell.name: 折射法术 Refract Spell
Refract Spell.description:
如果马克萨接下来使用的动作是施放一个具有区域、射程或目标的法术，则该法术将从其100英尺内的一处闪晶石源头显现，而非从其自身显现。若这块闪晶石是某个生物的一部分（例如闪晶石机器人），则马克萨必须与该生物建立联结。

If the next action Makosa uses is to Cast a Spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one source of shimmerstone within 100 feet of them instead of from themself. If this shimmerstone is part of a creature (such as a shimmerstone robot), Makosa must be bonded with that creature.

Transfer Vitality.name: 转移活力 Transfer Vitality
Transfer Vitality.description:
Makosa 将其活力网络中的任意数量生命值恢复给一个可见的已建立链接目标。

Makosa restores any number of Hit Points from their vitality network to a visible bonded target.

Trample.name: 践踏 Trample
Trample.description:
大型或更小，足部，@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Large or smaller, foot, @Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Makosa.blurb:
无性别科萨玛人秘学者
Agender kothama mystic

Comet Wasp Swarm.name: 彗星黄蜂虫群 Comet Wasp Swarm
Comet Wasp Swarm.tokenName: 彗星黄蜂虫群 Comet Wasp Swarm

Chilling Stings.name: 寒意螫刺 Chilling Stings
Chilling Stings.description:
虫群空间内的每个敌人受到 @Damage[5d8[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。豁免检定失败的生物会暴露于寒刺黄蜂毒素。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[5d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). A creature that fails its saving throw is exposed to chilling wasp toxin.

Chilling Wasp Toxin.name: 寒蜂毒素 Chilling Wasp Toxin
Chilling Wasp Toxin.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

最长持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d8[cold]] 伤害（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d8[cold]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[2d8[cold]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[cold]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d8[cold]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d8[cold]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 round)

Implant Eggs.name: 植入卵 Implant Eggs
Implant Eggs.description:
彗星黄蜂会在其空间内一个处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态的活体生物体内产卵，使其暴露于彗星黄蜂幼虫疾病。

The comet wasps lay eggs in a living creature in its space that is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, exposing it to comet wasp larva disease.

Comet Wasp Larva.name: 彗星黄蜂幼虫 Comet Wasp Larva
Comet Wasp Larva.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

阶段 1 携带者，无效果（1轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 1}（[[/r 1d4]]天）

阶段 3 @Damage[9d8[cold]] 伤害，幼虫破体而出（疾病结束）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

Stage 1 carrier with no effect (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} ([[/r 1d4]] days)

Stage 3 @Damage[9d8[cold]] damage, larva emerges (disease ends)

Comet Wasp Swarm.prototypeToken: 彗星黄蜂虫群 Comet Wasp Swarm

Disintegration Chamber.name: 裂解舱 Disintegration Chamber

Nanite Release.name: 纳米机器人释放 Nanite Release
Nanite Release.description:
触发 一个生物进入房间，或在房间内结束其回合

效果 陷阱对触发该陷阱的生物进行一次纳米机械打击，然后掷先攻。

Trigger A creature enters the room or ends its turn in the room

Effect The trap makes a nanite Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

Nanite Swarm.name: 纳米虫群 Nanite Swarm
Nanite Swarm.description:
触发条件 房间内的一个生物结束其回合

效果 该陷阱对触发该效果的生物进行一次纳米机械打击。

Trigger A creature within the room ends its turn

Effect The trap makes a nanite Strike against the triggering creature.

Nanite.name: 纳米虫 Nanite
Nanite.description:
无多重攻击减值

no multiple attack penalty

Disintegration Chamber.disable:
@Check[type:crafting|dc:22]（受训）以关闭一个孔口，或 @Check[type:computers|dc:24]（专家）以重新编程控制面板

@Check[type:crafting|dc:22] (trained) to close one aperture, or @Check[type:computers|dc:24] (expert) to reprogram the control panel
Disintegration Chamber.hazarddescription:
当传感器探测到被设有陷阱的房间内有动静时，房门会封闭，四个墙壁孔口随之开启，向房间内释放分解纳米机器人。

When sensors detect movement in the trapped room, the doors seal shut, and four wall apertures open, releasing disintegrating nanites into the room.
Disintegration Chamber.reset:
该陷阱在 1 分钟后停用并重置。

The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
Disintegration Chamber.routine:
（1 动作）该陷阱以 1 动作向房间内的每个生物发射纳米机器人。由于它会持续发射纳米机器人，该陷阱还可以使用“纳米机器人虫群”自由动作（见下文），在每个生物的回合中向该生物发射纳米机器人。

(1 action) The trap launches nanites against every creature in the room as 1 action. Because it launches nanites continuously, the trap can also use the Nanite Swarm free action (see below) to launch nanites at each creature during that creature's turn.
Disintegration Chamber.stealthdetails:
（专家）或 @Check[type:perception|dc:31] （专家）以注意到控制面板

(expert) or @Check[type:perception|dc:31] (expert) to notice the control panel

Runesaw.name: 符文锯 Runesaw

Launch Runesaw.name: 发射符文锯 Launch Runesaw
Launch Runesaw.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动进入倒塌尖塔的圆形地基

效果 陷阱发射一把符文锯，对其路径上的每个生物进行一次符文锯打击。

Trigger A creature moves into the circular foundation of the fallen spire

Effect The trap launches a runesaw, making a runesaw Strike against each creature in its path.

Runesaw.name: 符文锯 Runesaw
Runesaw.description:
无多重攻击减值

no multiple attack penalty

Runesaw.disable:
@Check[type:arcana|dc:18] 或 @Check[type:thievery|dc:18]（受训）以停用或抹除该符文，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（1阶；抵消 DC 15）来抵消该符文

@Check[type:arcana|dc:18] or @Check[type:thievery|dc:18] (trained) to deactivate or erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG] (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to counteract the rune
Runesaw.hazarddescription:
一道由闪烁力场构成的锯刃从墙上射出，切穿其路径上的所有生物。

A sawblade of shimmering force launches from the wall and slices through all creatures in its path.

Giant Dust Weevil.name: 巨型尘象鼻虫 Giant Dust Weevil
Giant Dust Weevil.tokenName: 巨型沙尘象鼻虫 Giant Dust Weevil

Dust Weevil Venom.name: 尘象鼻虫毒液 Dust Weevil Venom
Dust Weevil Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:14]

最长持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[1d12[poison]] 伤害、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}和措手不及（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:14]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d12[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and off-guard (1 round)

Giant Dust Weevil.prototypeToken: 巨型尘象鼻虫 Giant Dust Weevil

Gnaw.name: 啃咬 Gnaw
Gnaw.description:
需求 本轮中，jeskraal的上一动作必须是一次成功的颚击Strike

效果 jeskraal抓住其攻击的目标不放。目标在1轮内获得AC和反射豁免 –1的处境减值。

Requirements The jeskraal's last action this round was a successful jaws Strike

Effect The jeskraal holds onto the target of its attack. The target takes a –1 circumstance penalty to AC and Reflex saves for 1 round.

Arcing Strikes.name: 弧光打击 Arcing Strikes
Arcing Strikes.description:
等离子飞蛾以火花打击造成重击时，电弧会跃向距初始目标 10 英尺内最近的生物，对该生物造成等同于对原始目标所造成电击伤害一半的伤害。

A plasma moth's critical hits with spark Strikes arc to the closest creature within 10 feet of the initial target, dealing damage to that creature equal to half the amount of electricity damage dealt to the original target.

Jolting Console.name: 电击控制台 Jolting Console

Jolt.name: 电击 Jolt
Jolt.description:
触发条件 一个生物直接或借助工具抓住控制台

效果 陷阱对触发的生物以及位于该触发生物5英尺内的生物造成 @Damage[4d8[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true] 豁免）。

Trigger A creature grasps the console directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals @Damage[4d8[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature and creatures within 5 feet of the triggering creature (@Check[type:reflex|dc:25|basic:true] save).

Jolting Console.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:16] （受训）以禁用控制台的程序，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:18] （受训）以重新接线电击栅格

@Check[type:computers|dc:16] (trained) to disable the console's programming, or @Check[type:crafting|dc:18] (trained) to rewire the shock grid
Jolting Console.hazarddescription:
嵌入计算机控制台或门板中的电击网格会释放出强大的电流。

A shock grid built into a computer console or door panel releases a powerful electric charge.

Animated Vesk Statue.name: 活化的维斯克蜥人雕像 Animated Vesk Statue
Animated Vesk Statue.tokenName: 活化维斯克蜥人雕像 Animated Vesk Statue

Construct Armor (Hardness 6).name: 构装护甲（硬度 6） Construct Armor (Hardness 6)
Construct Armor (Hardness 6).description:
像普通物体一样，活化维斯克蜥人雕像具有硬度。该硬度会使它受到的任何伤害减少一个等同于硬度值的数值。一旦活化维斯克蜥人雕像的生命值降至低于其生命值上限的一半，或在受到重击伤害时立即，其构装体护甲就会破裂，移除其硬度，并使其护甲等级降至15。

Like normal objects, the animated vesk statue has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once the animated vesk statue is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing the Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 15.

Animated Vesk Statue.prototypeToken: 活化的维斯克蜥人雕像 Animated Vesk Statue

Newborn Cult Lore.name: 新诞者邪教知识 Newborn Cult Lore

Laser Pistol.name: 激光手枪 Laser Pistol
Laser Pistol.description:
升级： 1

这把袖珍能量手枪凭借其可靠性、耐用性和价格实惠，成为协约世界最受欢迎的随身武器。大多数常见的激光手枪都采用经过热处理的轻质聚碳材料枪身，末端连接着细长的枪管。

Upgrades: 1

This compact energy pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a heat-treated lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.

Aucturnite Chakram.name: 奥克腾岩环刃 Aucturnite Chakram
Aucturnite Chakram.description:
升级： 1

这个带刃圆环由一块奥克腾材料雕刻而成，被塑造成类似行星环带的模样。这种材料在整个协约世界及更遥远的地方都有发现，会神秘地出现在距离奥克腾原始轨道数光年之外的地方。

Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of Aucturn and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has been found throughout the Pact Worlds and beyond, mysteriously appearing lightyears from Aucturn's original orbit.

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Eldritch Lance.name: 奥术长枪 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将来自群星之间黑暗空间、侵袭心智的诡异能量凝聚成一道光束，并将其射向一个目标。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若命中，你造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若为严重成功，则造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Recharge Weapon.name: 武器充能 Recharge Weapon
Recharge Weapon.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，并用魔法能量为其充能。目标获得等同于其用量的弹药或充能，直到你的下个回合结束，使任何持握该目标的人都能用该武器进行一次打击。这个法术只能为使用单次成本为10信用点或更低的弹药的武器充能

You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its usage until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less

Stumble.name: 踉跄 Stumble
Stumble.description:
一阵微重力爆发在目标周围引发震颤，将其拉向地面。目标必须进行一次反射豁免。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态，持续1轮。如果目标当时正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则其向下坠落10英尺。

重度失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。如果目标当时正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则其向下坠落20英尺。

强化（+1） 如果目标正在飞行，则其在失败时额外向下坠落10英尺，在重度失败时额外向下坠落20英尺。

A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target attempts a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, they fall 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, they fall 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target is flying, they fall an additional 10 feet on a failure and 20 feet on a critical failure.

Grave Whispers.name: 墓穴低语 Grave Whispers

Crawling Shadows.name: 匍匐阴影 Crawling Shadows
Crawling Shadows.description:
触发条件 一个生物触碰石棺，或在其 10 英尺内施放法术

效果 阴影般的手爬向触发的生物，造成 @Damage[2d6[void]] 伤害（@Check[type:fortitude|dc:17|basic:true] 豁免）；若失败，该生物还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 1}。

Trigger A creature touches the sarcophagus or Casts a Spell within 10 feet of it

Effect Shadowy hands crawl toward the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[2d6[void]] damage (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:17|basic:true] save); on a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Grave Whispers.disable:
@Check[type:occultism|dc:16]（受训）以念出反制咒语，或 @Check[type:religion|dc:19]（受训）以用仪式祈祷驱散坟墓低语

@Check[type:occultism|dc:16] (trained) to speak the counter spell, or @Check[type:religion|dc:19] (trained) to banish the grave whispers with ritual prayers
Grave Whispers.hazarddescription:
一个衰朽的声音用一种被遗忘的语言低声吟诵祷文，阴影般的形体沿着墙壁缓缓流淌。

A decrepit voice whispers invocations in a forgotten language as shadowy shapes trickle over the walls.

Malfunctioning Projector.name: 故障投影仪 Malfunctioning Projector

Buy! Buy! Buy!.name: 买！买！买！ Buy! Buy! Buy!
Buy! Buy! Buy!.description:
触发条件 区域内的一个生物完成一个动作

效果 陷阱发射一则定向广告，诱使观看者花费信用点购买某种产品或服务。30英尺内所有能看见、听见或感知到该广告的生物都必须进行一次 @Check[type:will|dc:14] 豁免。然后，投影仪掷先攻。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。

失败 目标陷入目眩，并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}，持续1轮，且除了接入最近的计算机以访问信息圈并按广告指示进行购买外，不能采取任何动作。

Trigger A creature within the area finishes an action

Effect The trap launches a targeted ad enticing viewers to spend credits on a product or service. All creatures within 30 feet who can see, hear, or sense the ad must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:14] save. The projector then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.

Failure The target is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round and can't take any actions except to access the nearest computer to visit the infosphere and make purchases as directed by the ad.

Malfunctioning Projector.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:17]（受训）以关闭广告，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:17]（受训）以修理故障电线

@Check[type:computers|dc:17] (trained) to deactivate the ad or @Check[type:crafting|dc:17] (trained) to fix the faulty wires
Malfunctioning Projector.hazarddescription:
色彩缤纷、栩栩如生的人影在全息广告中来回穿梭，伴随着一连串愉悦的声响与感官刺激，诱使路人花费他们的信用点。故障的电线向附近的生物迸射出火花。

Colorful, lifelike figures flit in and out of a holographic advertisement in a barrage of pleasant sounds and sensations, enticing passersby to spend their credits. Faulty wires shower sparks on nearby creatures.
Malfunctioning Projector.reset:
陷阱会在1分钟后重置。

The trap resets after 1 minute.
Malfunctioning Projector.routine:
(2 个动作) 该陷阱对射程内至多两个生物进行一次远程火花打击；如果没有其他目标，则可对射程内一个生物进行两次打击。

(2 actions) The trap makes a ranged sparks Strike against up to two creatures in range, or two Strikes against one creature in range if it has no additional targets.
Malfunctioning Projector.prototypeToken: 故障中的投影仪 Malfunctioning Projector

Fang of the Devourer.name: 吞噬者之牙 Fang of the Devourer
Fang of the Devourer.tokenName: 吞噬者之牙 Fang of the Devourer

Advanced Disintegration Lash.name: 先进解离鞭 Advanced Disintegration Lash
Advanced Disintegration Lash.description:
升级： 1

当启动时，这条鞭子会呈现为一条起伏扭动的黑蛇，并噼啪作响地迸发出带有红色辉光的能量，在原子层面上撕裂其所击中的一切。

Upgrades: 1

Appearing as an undulating black snake when powered, this whip crackles with red-tinged energy that sunders whatever it strikes at the atomic level.

Advanced Freebooter Armor.name: 先进掠夺者护甲 Advanced Freebooter Armor
Advanced Freebooter Armor.description:
升级： 1

掠夺者护甲因经常穿着这类装备的海盗与亡命之徒而得名。掠夺者护甲通常由穿在夹克或飞行服内侧的胸甲、厚重的靴子和手套、头盔，以及用于隐藏武器的隐蔽束带和枪套组成。

Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

Advanced Laser Pistol.name: 先进激光手枪 Advanced Laser Pistol
Advanced Laser Pistol.description:
升级： 1

这把袖珍能量手枪凭借其可靠、耐用且价格实惠，成为协约世界最受欢迎的副武器。大多数常见的激光手枪都采用经热处理的轻质聚碳机身，末端连接着一根细长的枪管。

Upgrades: 1

This compact energy pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a heat-treated lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.

Apocalypse Smite.name: 末日重击 Apocalypse Smite
Apocalypse Smite.description:
獠牙指定一个其能看见且位于30英尺内的目标。在其本回合的剩余时间里，獠牙对该目标的攻击额外造成 2d8 点虚空伤害。

The Fang designates a target they can see within 30 feet. For the rest of their turn, the Fang's attacks deal an additional 2d8 void damage to that target.

Devourer's Teeth.name: 吞噬者之牙 Devourer's Teeth
Devourer's Teeth.description:
尖牙投掷出一个空瓶，赞颂吞噬者；吞噬者在其飞行途中将灾变能量注入其中，在 20 尺范围内制造一个 @Template[type:burst|distance:5]。区域内的生物受到 @Damage[6d6[void]] 伤害，且必须进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:28] 豁免。

重度成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并在 1 轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。

重度失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并在 1 轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2}。

The Fang throws an empty phial, giving praise to the Devourer who fills it mid-flight with cataclysmic energy, creating a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] within a range of 20 feet. Creatures in the area take @Damage[6d6[void]] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:28] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

Fang of the Devourer.prototypeToken: 吞噬者之牙 Fang of the Devourer

Space Station Gremlin.name: 空间站小魔怪 Space Station Gremlin
Space Station Gremlin.tokenName: 空间站小魔怪 Space Station Gremlin

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原始本能法术 Primal Innate Spells

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
幻象使光线绕过目标，令其处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形} 状态。这使其对所有生物而言都处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找该目标，从而使其改为对它们处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐匿} 状态。如果目标使用了敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作，它也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Electric Arc.name: 电弧术 Electric Arc
Electric Arc.description:
一道电弧从一个目标跃向另一个目标。每个目标受到2d4点电击伤害，并进行一次基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4。

An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Figment.name: 虚构幻象 Figment
Figment.description:
你制造一个简单的幻象声音或影像。声音会为该法术添加听觉（特征），且该声音不能包含可理解的词语或复杂的音乐。影像会添加视觉（特征），其大小不能超过一个5英尺立方体，且若从15英尺内观看，会明显显得粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你可以尝试用该幻象进行@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{声东击西}，并在你的欺瞒检定中获得+2处境加值。若此次尝试对某个生物失败，则该生物识破这个幻景。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：幻景}

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

Adhere.name: 遵命 Adhere
Adhere.description:
你在你所触碰的一个物体与该物体所接触的另一个物体或表面之间建立分子键。要将该物体从该表面上扯开，必须成功进行一次 Athletics 检定，对抗你的法术 DC，以@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{强行打开}。如果你改为触碰一个无人占据的 5 尺方格，则该表面会充满黏附魔法。该空间变为高等困难地形。

You create a molecular bond between an object you touch and another object or surface that object is touching. Pulling the object free of that surface requires a successful Athletics check against your spell DC to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}. If you instead touch one unoccupied 5-foot square, that surface becomes charged with adhering magic. That space becomes greater difficult terrain.

Recharge Weapon.name: 充能武器 Recharge Weapon
Recharge Weapon.description:
你触碰一把已无剩余弹药的武器，并用魔法能量为其充能。目标获得等同于其用量的弹药或充能，持续到你下个回合结束，使任何持握该目标的人都能用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为所用弹药成本为10信用点或以下的武器充能

You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its usage until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less

Overheat.name: 过热 Overheat
Overheat.description:
你收集附近生物体与科技装置产生的热量，并将其导向附近的一个目标。你对目标造成 2d6 点火焰伤害。若豁免失败，目标手持的装备在下一轮内会变得触手灼热。除非目标在其回合开始时丢下当前手持的装备，否则它会受到 @Damage[((@item.level) * 3)[fire]] 伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 2d4。接触受影响物体时造成的伤害提高 3。

You collect heat generated by nearby bodies and technological devices and vent it toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its round, it takes @Damage[((@item.level) * 3)[fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.

Mechanical Trickery.name: 机械诡计 Mechanical Trickery
Mechanical Trickery.description:
当太空站小魔怪花费至少1小时探索一艘飞船或太空站后，它会对其内部运作产生一种天生的感知，并且能够远程控制60英尺内的机械基础设施，执行诸如开启和关闭气闸与舱门、打开散热通风口、启动警报、开关灯光，或篡改重力控制等简单操作。

When a space station gremlin has spent at least 1 hour exploring a ship or space station, the gremlin gains an innate sense of its inner workings and can remotely control mechanical infrastructure within 60 feet, performing simple actions such as opening and shutting airlocks and doors, opening heat vents, activating alarms, turning lights on and off, or tampering with gravity controls.

Tech Travel.name: 科技旅行 Tech Travel
Tech Travel.description:
太空站小魔怪进入相邻的机械基础设施，例如控制面板或管道网络，并立刻从100英尺内的另一处此类设施中出现。

The space station gremlin enters adjacent mechanical infrastructure such as a control panel or pipe network and instantly emerges from another within 100 feet.

Illusory Object.name: 幻象造物 Illusory Object
Illusory Object.description:
你创造出一个静止物体的幻象视觉影像。整个影像必须适合该法术的区域内。该物体看起来会自然地活动，但不会发出声音或产生气味。比如，水看起来会从幻象瀑布上倾泻而下，但不会有任何声音。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} 动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。

强化（2环） 你的影像会发出合适的声音，产生正常的气味，并且触感真实。该法术获得听觉和嗅觉（特征）特征。持续时间增加至1小时。

强化（5环） 如同2环版本，但持续时间无限。

You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.
