Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory and olfactory traits. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.

Space Station Gremlin.publicNotes:
和它们那些故障小魔怪近亲一样，空间站小魔怪痴迷于科技，也喜欢摆弄各种东西，而这往往会给与它们同住在空间站上的人们带来混沌。空间站小魔怪对自己家园空间站内部运作的一切都了如指掌，并乐于惩罚或捉弄那些懂得还不如它们多的空间站大型居民。那些“闹鬼”的空间站和飞船——会神秘地电力闪烁、舱门随机开合、装备偏偏在最糟糕的时机发生故障，以及频繁出现无法解释的事故——很可能就是一只或多只空间站小魔怪的巢穴。

在不搞恶作剧的时候，有些小魔怪会监控并修理那些让许多老旧空间站维持运转的精密机械——这一事实大概让它们在像艾巴萨罗姆空间站这样的大型聚居地中免于被彻底消灭。

大多数空间站小魔怪身高约2英尺，体重约7磅——这是它们穿过通风管道、挤进维修隧道的绝佳体型。小魔怪有时会从空间站上体型较大的船员那里偷衣服，再给自己改成连体工作服或飞行服。它们也对工具十分着迷；一些空间站小魔怪会像给宠物起名一样给自己最喜欢的工具命名，收集数十件某一类工具，或把它们像战利品一样陈列起来。

小魔怪伙伴

偶尔，空间站小魔怪会与空间站上的机械师或船员交朋友，传授他们精类工程学的秘密，甚至屈尊帮助他们工作。想和空间站小魔怪交朋友极其困难，而试图引起它们的注意还可能适得其反，让该生物成为更多恶作剧和更致命事故的目标。这个过程要从摆出几口小魔怪最爱的食物和一些酒类开始。每只小魔怪都不一样，但许多都偏爱陈年奶酪、肉类，以及熟到近乎腐烂的水果——气味越冲越好。大声称赞小魔怪高超的手艺，并对它们的恶作剧表示欣赏，也有助于赢得大多数小魔怪的好感。

Like their glitch gremlin cousins, space station gremlins are obsessed with technology and prone to tinkering that causes chaos for people living on space stations with them. Space station gremlins know everything about the inner workings of their home stations and enjoy punishing or pranking the station's larger inhabitants who know less than they do. "Haunted" space stations and ships with mysterious power flickers, doors that randomly open and shut, equipment that malfunctions at just the wrong time, and frequent unexplainable accidents are probably the home of one or more space station gremlins.

When they're not playing pranks, some gremlins monitor and repair the sensitive machinery keeping many older space stations afloat—a fact that has probably saved them from eradication on larger settlements like Absalom Station.

Most space station gremlins stand about 2 feet tall and weigh around 7 pounds—the perfect size for slipping through vents and squeezing down maintenance tunnels. Gremlins sometimes steal clothing from larger space station crew and fashion coveralls or flight suits for themselves. They're also fascinated by tools; some space station gremlins name their favorite tools like one would name a pet, collect dozens of a certain type of tool, or display them like trophies.

Gremlin Companions

Occasionally, a space station gremlin might befriend a mechanic or crew member aboard a space station and teach them fey secrets of engineering, or even deign to help them with their work. Befriending a space station gremlin is incredibly difficult, and getting their attention might backfire, with the creature becoming a target for more pranks and deadlier accidents. The process begins with leaving out morsels of the gremlin's favorite foods and portions of intoxicants. Each gremlin is different, but many prefer aged cheeses, meats, and fruits ripe to the point of rotting—the more pungent the better. Loudly praising the gremlin's masterful work and expressing appreciation for their pranks also help win most gremlins over.
Space Station Gremlin.prototypeToken: 太空站小魔怪 Space Station Gremlin

Shock Grid.name: 电击网格 Shock Grid

Jolt.name: 电击术 Jolt
Jolt.description:
触发条件 一个生物直接或借助工具抓住控制台

效果 该陷阱对触发生物造成 @Damage[2d6[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:13|basic:true] 豁免）；若失败，电流会弧射至任何相邻生物，它们也必须进行一次基础反射豁免。电流不会从这些生物身上继续弧射。

Trigger A creature grasps the console directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[type:reflex|dc:13|basic:true] save); on a failure, electricity arcs to any adjacent creatures, who must also attempt a basic Reflex save. The electricity doesn't arc from these creatures.

Shock Grid.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:14]（受训）以绕过代码，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:14]（受训）以重新接线控制台

@Check[type:computers|dc:14] (trained) to bypass the code or @Check[type:crafting|dc:14] (trained) to rewire the console
Shock Grid.hazarddescription:
嵌入计算机控制台或门板中的电击网格会释放出强大的电流。

A shock grid built into a computer console or door panel releases a powerful electric charge.

Heliacal Maw Ferocitum.name: 天日之颚 Ferocitum Heliacal Maw Ferocitum
Heliacal Maw Ferocitum.tokenName: 日出前之巨口 凶怒虫群 Heliacal Maw Ferocitum

Advanced Kyokor Plating.name: 先进型 Kyokor 镀板 Advanced Kyokor Plating
Advanced Kyokor Plating.description:
升级： 1

这套重甲整合了一件全覆盖式聚碳防护服，其上布满了接口和插槽，并覆有取自戴马尔科臭名昭著的巨像的装甲板。Kyokor 镀层包含靴子、手套，以及一顶带透明面罩的头盔。

Upgrade: 1

This heavy armor incorporates a full-coverage polycarbon suit studded with ports and sockets and layered with plates from Daimalko's infamous colossi. Kyokor plating comes with boots, gloves, and a helmet with a clear visor.

Advanced Phase Shield.name: 先进（型）相位盾 Advanced Phase Shield
Advanced Phase Shield.description:
相位盾是一种精密却耐用的科技装置，佩戴时绑在肢体上，展开后会投射出一道由硬光构成的防护屏障。相位盾呈半透明并带有色调，其颜色和图像投影器都可以完全自定义。许多使用者会选择名人的形象、所爱之人的影像，或令人愉悦的风景，以便在危急情况下振奋精神。

A phase shield is an intricate but durable technological device worn strapped to a limb that projects a protective hardlight barrier when deployed. Phase shields are translucent and tinted, with fully customizable colors and image projectors. Many wielders choose an image of a celebrity, a loved one, or pleasant scenery to bolster their spirits in dire situations.

Attunement.name: 调谐 Attunement
Attunement.description:
凶暴兽在战斗开始时处于引力调谐状态。当它们使用带有循环特征的能力时，会切换为光子调谐或引力调谐。它们的某些能力会根据当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

A ferocitum begins combat graviton attuned. They shift between photon or graviton attuned when they use an ability with the cycle trait. Some of their abilities gain additional benefits depending on their current attunement state.

Solar Weapon.name: 星辰武器 Solar Weapon
Solar Weapon.description:
引力子调谐：此次打击使目标将所有相邻方格视为困难地形，直到其下个回合结束。

光子调谐：此次打击额外造成 5 点火焰伤害。

Graviton Attuned: The Strike causes the target to treat all adjacent squares as difficult terrain until the end of its next turn.

Photon Attuned: The Strike deals an additional 5 fire damage.

Solar Shot.name: 太阳射击 Solar Shot
Solar Shot.description:
引力子调谐：将伤害提高至 3d8+10，并将伤害类型改为钝击。此次射击的射程为 15 英尺。

光子调谐：在重击时，目标还会受到 1d6 持续火焰伤害。

Graviton Attuned: Increase the damage to 3d8+10 and change the damage to bludgeoning. The shot has a range of 15 feet.

Photon Attuned: On a critical hit, the target also takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Attune.name: 调谐 Attune
Attune.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 如果 ferocitum 处于未调谐或光子调谐状态，则其变为引力子调谐状态。若其星辰武器已被摧毁或缴械，则其在一只空闲手中重塑该武器。

Frequency once per round

Effect If the ferocitum is unattuned or photon attuned, they become graviton attuned. They recreate their stellar weapon in a free hand if it has been destroyed or disarmed.

Blood Accretion.name: 血液增生 Blood Accretion
Blood Accretion.description:
频率 每 10 分钟一次

需求 ferocitum 处于引力子调谐状态

效果 ferocitum 引导吞噬者的熵性本质，制造出一个带有红色光晕的微型黑洞。ferocitum 选择 30 英尺半径内的任意数量生物。每个受影响的生物受到 @Damage[5d8[void]] 伤害，且必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:29] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受伤害且不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害，并被朝 ferocitum 方向拖拽 5 英尺。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，被朝 ferocitum 方向拖拽 15 英尺，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，被朝 ferocitum 方向拖拽 30 英尺，并成为 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} 1 轮。

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements The ferocitum is graviton attuned

Effect The ferocitum channels the entropic nature of the Devourer, creating a miniature black hole with a red tinge. The ferocitum selects any number of creatures within a 30-foot radius. Each affected creature takes @Damage[5d8[void]] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pulled 5 feet toward the ferocitum.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pulled 15 feet toward the ferocitum, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pulled 30 feet toward the ferocitum, and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} for 1 round.

Shattering Impact.name: 碎裂冲击 Shattering Impact
Shattering Impact.description:
费罗西图姆用其太阳武器进行一次打击。若成功，则将伤害骰提高一个等级（至 2d12+14）。随后太阳武器破碎。

引力调谐：若费罗西图姆命中，其目标的速度在费罗西图姆下个回合开始前受到 –10 尺的状态减值。

光子调谐：若费罗西图姆命中，其目标额外受到 5 点持续火焰伤害。

The ferocitum makes a Strike with their solar weapon. If successful, increase the damage die by one step (to 2d12+14). The solar weapon then shatters.

Graviton Attuned: If the ferocitum hits, their target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed until the start of the ferocitum's next turn.

Photon Attuned: If the ferocitum hits, their target takes an additional 5 persistent fire damage.

Heliacal Maw Ferocitum.prototypeToken: 日升凶兽·巨口猛兽 Heliacal Maw Ferocitum

Stellar Bombardment Engine.name: 恒星轰击引擎 Stellar Bombardment Engine
Stellar Bombardment Engine.tokenName: 恒星轰炸引擎 Stellar Bombardment Engine

Power Build-Up.name: 强化构筑 Power Build-Up
Power Build-Up.description:
触发 一个生物开始尝试阻止该仪式，或在 atrocite 被击败 10 分钟后

效果 红色闪电在该区域内的反应堆和控制台中噼啪作响。位于 B11 区域第二层或第三层的生物受到 @Damage[(2d10+10)[electricity]] 伤害，并进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] 豁免。若重度失败，目标还会额外受到 @Damage[2d10[void]] 伤害。该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger A creature begins trying to stop the ritual, or 10 minutes after the atrocite is defeated

Effect Red lightning crackles within the reactor and consoles in the area. Creatures on the second or third levels of area B11 take @Damage[(2d10+10)[electricity]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save. On a critical failure, the target also takes an additional @Damage[2d10[void]] damage. The trap rolls initiative.

Vent Energy.name: 释放能量 Vent Energy
Vent Energy.description:
改装过的引擎会向试图篡改它的对象释放其能量。若区域内没有生物可承受伤害，则这些能量会改为完全导入引擎，使已获得的成功次数减少 1。若没有成功次数，则该陷阱改为获得 1 点不稳定点。否则，房间内的生物受到 @Damage[(4d10+15)[void]] 伤害，且必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:33] 豁免。对虚空伤害免疫的生物（例如不死生物）改为承受酸蚀伤害。被此危险杀死的生物会化为细粉。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，外加 @Damage[2d10[electricity]] 伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，外加 @Damage[4d10[electricity]] 伤害，且变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。

The modified engine releases its energy against those attempting to tamper with it. If there are no creatures in the area to take damage, then the power instead redirects fully into the engine, reducing the number of successes earned by 1. If there are no successes, the trap instead gains 1 instability point. Otherwise, creatures within the room take @Damage[(4d10+15)[void]] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save. Creatures immune to void damage (such as undead) instead take acid damage. A creature slain by this hazard is reduced to a fine powder.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and an additional @Damage[2d10[electricity]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and an additional @Damage[4d10[electricity]] damage, and it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Stellar Bombardment Engine.disable:
@Check[computers|dc:36]（专家）以覆盖该装置的程序并排放邪秽能量，@Check[arcana|dc:35] 或 @Check[religion|dc:35] 以控制或扰乱该装置中不断积聚的邪秽能量流，@Check[crafting|dc:34] 或 @Check[thievery|dc:34] 以手动调整电缆并将动力从反应堆引开；总共需要六次成功，才能阻止空间站的反应堆点燃并毁灭科塔瑞亚的太阳。

@Check[computers|dc:36] (expert) to override the device's programming and vent the unholy energy, @Check[arcana|dc:35] or @Check[religion|dc:35] to control or subvert the flow of the unholy energies building in the device, @Check[crafting|dc:34] or @Check[thievery|dc:34] to manually adjust the cables and divert power away from the reactor; six total successes are required to prevent the station's reactor from igniting the destruction of Kehtaria's sun.
Stellar Bombardment Engine.hazarddescription:
一台魔法科技装置将邪秽魔法的流动引导至整个反应堆之中。该过程已被设定为引爆并摧毁科塔瑞亚的恒星，从而引发一种恒星级效果，并可能沿着附近的一条漂流域航道级联蔓延，影响数颗恒星。

A magitech device channels the flow of unholy magic throughout the reactor. This process is set to detonate and destroy Kehtaria's sun, leading to a stellar effect that could cascade along a nearby Drift lane to affect several stars.
Stellar Bombardment Engine.reset:
陷阱会在PC获得所需数量的成功后停用。

The trap deactivates once the PCs gain the requisite number of successes.
Stellar Bombardment Engine.routine:
(2个动作) 该陷阱用它的第一个动作来释放能量。然后它用第二个动作尝试过载。若该陷阱有任何不稳定点数，则进行一次DC等于20减去其所拥有不稳定点数的平检。若成功，这台魔法科技装置会引爆，摧毁空间站和科塔瑞亚的太阳，并造成巨大的银河级后果（见“冒险结局”）。空间站上的PC会被不可挽回地杀死。

(2 actions) The trap uses its first action to Vent Energy. It then uses its second action to attempt an overload. If the trap has any instability points, roll a flat check with a DC equal to 20 minus the number of instability points it has. On a success, the magitech device detonates, destroying the station and Kehtaria's sun and creating massive galactic repercussions (see Concluding the Adventure). The PCs on the station are irrevocably slain.
Stellar Bombardment Engine.stealthdetails:
（大师）注意到反应堆内微妙的电能与魔法能量正在增强。

(master) to notice the subtle electrical and magical energies within the reactor gaining power.
Stellar Bombardment Engine.prototypeToken: 星辰轰击引擎 Stellar Bombardment Engine

Crashed Mauler.name: 坠毁的重击者 Crashed Mauler

Countdown to Destruction.name: 毁灭倒计时 Countdown to Destruction
Countdown to Destruction.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到残骸20英尺内

效果 一股火焰从残骸中喷涌而出，预示着即将发生爆炸。坠毁的BMC Mauler掷先攻。

Trigger A creature moves within 20 feet of the wreck

Effect A gout of flame spews from the wreck, signaling an imminent explosion. The crashed BMC Mauler rolls initiative.

Crashed Mauler.disable:
@Check[athletics|dc:24] 将副驾驶员从残骸中救出，@Check[medicine|dc:30]（专家）使受伤的副驾驶员伤势稳定；@Check[piloting|dc:30] 或 @Check[Warfare Lore|dc:30] 识别出这些伤害与阿兹兰蒂星舰武器的效果相似；@Check[computers|dc:32]（受训）从飞船的机载计算机中检索数据（最多三次）；@Check[crafting|dc:34]（专家）将 mauler 的过载值降低 1（最多只能进行两次）

@Check[athletics|dc:24] pulls the copilot from the wreckage, and @Check[medicine|dc:30] (expert) stabilizes the wounded copilot; @Check[piloting|dc:30] or @Check[Warfare Lore|dc:30] identifies the damage as similar to effects of Azlanti starship weaponry; @Check[computers|dc:32] (trained) retrieves data from the ship's onboard computer (up to three times); @Check[crafting|dc:34] (expert) reduces the overload value of the mauler by 1 (can only be done a maximum of two times)
Crashed Mauler.hazarddescription:
这架坠毁战斗机的残骸破损不堪，半掩埋在地里。其船体上可见电火花与火焰迸发，而一具维斯克蜥人尸体被其破碎飞船的碎片刺穿，钉在那里。

The broken wreck of the crashed fighter craft is half-buried in the ground. Bursts of electricity and flame are visible along its hull, while a vesk corpse lies impaled by shards of their shattered craft.
Crashed Mauler.reset:
当这台重击者的过载值达到 5 时，它会爆炸。

The mauler explodes once its overload value reaches 5.
Crashed Mauler.routine:
（3个动作）位于飞船船体附近的生物（那些试图进行“停用”检定的生物）会受到 @Damage[(2d12+13)[piercing]] 伤害，且需进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] 豁免，因为爆炸会喷射出锋利的弹片。随后，飞船会以一次电流放电攻击射程内的两个生物。在其例行程序结束时，飞船的过载值增加1。当过载值达到2和4时，其中一个引擎模块会爆炸（见第26页的“蹂躏者引擎过载”）。当过载值达到5时，该障碍会爆炸成一个巨大的火球，对坠毁飞船20英尺内的所有生物造成 @Damage[(6d10+30)[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] 豁免）。

(3 actions) Creatures near the hull of the vessel (those attempting checks to Disable) take @Damage[(2d12+13)[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save as explosions hurl out jagged shrapnel. The ship then targets two creatures in range with an electric discharge. At the end of its routine, the ship's overload value goes up by 1. When the overload value reaches 2 and 4, one of the engine modules explodes (see the Mauler Engine Overload on page 26). When the overload value reaches 5, the hazard explodes in a massive fireball dealing @Damage[(6d10+30)[fire]] damage to all creatures within 20 feet of the crashed ship (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save).

Advanced Skyfire Armor.name: 先进型天火护甲 Advanced Skyfire Armor
Advanced Skyfire Armor.description:
升级： 1

这些装饰性的中型护甲配有夸张的肩甲、风格化的龙翼，以及遍布胸甲前后和胸口的天火标志，而且通常镀有黄金或其他美观的金属。典型的天火护甲为了风格牺牲了升级空间。

Upgrades: 1

These decorative suits of medium armor feature exaggerated shoulder guards, stylized dragon wings, and Skyfire logos across the breastplate's back and chest, and are often plated with gold or other attractive metals. Typical Skyfire armor sacrifices upgrade space for style.

Darkvision Visor.name: 黑暗视觉护目镜 Darkvision Visor
Darkvision Visor.description:
这个面罩包覆住你的视觉器官，强化你的天生感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.

Sonic Scream Spell Gem (3rd-rank spell).description:
@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QpP30fcEl4NGjHwo]{Sonic Scream}

这些网格状的宝石悬浮在硅制外壳中，并被编码了施放某个特定法术所需的魔法符文。要从法术宝石中施放法术，你需要用一只手握持宝石，并使用“施放法术”活动，以该法术通常所需的动作数来激活它。该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。由于是你在施放该法术，因此使用你的法术攻击调整值和法术DC。该法术属于你的施法传承。法术宝石中的法术只能被施放一次，并且法术宝石会作为施法的一部分被摧毁。法术宝石不能容纳戏法或仪式。此物品的特征会根据其所含法术而变化。

效果 你以所示的

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QpP30fcEl4NGjHwo]{Sonic Scream}

These latticed gemstones are suspended in a silicon casing and encoded with the magical script necessary to cast a single, specific spell. Casting a spell from a spell gem requires holding the gem in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell is of your spellcasting tradition. The spell in a spell gem can be cast only once, and the spell gem is destroyed as part of the casting. Spell gems can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

Double Tap.name: 双重射击 Double Tap
Double Tap.description:
指挥官艾兰以他的永劫步枪迅速连续进行两次远程打击。照常施加多重攻击减值。如果两次攻击均命中，则合并其伤害。艾兰的任何精准伤害只添加一次，由他选择加到其中一次攻击上。抗性和弱点也只结算一次。在计算艾兰的多重攻击减值时，这视为两次攻击。

Commander Eiran makes two ranged Strikes with his aeon rifle in quick succession. Apply the multiple attack penalty normally. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. Eiran adds any precision damage only once, to the attack of his choice. Apply resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as two attacks when calculating Eiran's multiple attack penalty.

Mobile Aim.name: 移动瞄准 Mobile Aim
Mobile Aim.description:
指挥官艾兰先大步移动，然后用他的近战或远程武器进行瞄准（选择一种），目标必须位于60尺内。在他本回合剩余时间内，使用该武器发动的成功攻击会额外造成2d6精准伤害，并使目标对AC的掩护加值减少1。

Commander Eiran Strides and then aims with his melee or ranged weapon (choose one) against a target within 60 feet. For the rest of his turn, successful attacks made with that weapon deal an additional 2d6 precision damage and reduce the target's cover bonus to AC by 1.

Tactical Tutelage.name: 战术指导 Tactical Tutelage
Tactical Tutelage.description:
指挥官艾兰选择一个15英尺内的盟友，并指示其如何瞄准60英尺内的一个目标。直到该盟友下个回合结束前，其用自己持用的近战或远程武器作出的下一次成功攻击，对该目标额外造成 2d4 精准伤害，并使该目标对AC的掩护加值减少1。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.n33jAVZDDWQ7ifvl]{效果：战术指导}

Commander Eiran selects an ally within 15 feet and instructs them how to aim against one target within 60 feet. Until the end of that ally's next turn, the next successful attack made with a melee or ranged weapon they wield deals an additional 2d4 precision damage against the target and reduces the target's cover bonus to AC by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.n33jAVZDDWQ7ifvl]{Effect: Tactical Tutelage}

Wilderness Advance.name: 荒野推进 Wilderness Advance
Wilderness Advance.description:
指挥官艾兰将自然困难地形视为普通地形，并将自然高等困难地形视为困难地形。

Commander Eiran treats natural difficult terrain as normal terrain and natural greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain.

Commander Eiran.blurb:
男性阿兹兰蒂军官
Male Azlanti military officer

Thane Hacher.name: 塞恩·哈彻 Thane Hacher

Newborn Cult Lore.name: 新诞者邪教传说 Newborn Cult Lore

Cultist Garb.name: 邪教徒服饰 Cultist Garb
Cultist Garb.description:
普通服装具有基本剪裁、功能性实用，例如农民服饰、僧侣长袍或工作服。

Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

Aucturnite Chakram.name: 奥克腾岩环刃 Aucturnite Chakram
Aucturnite Chakram.description:
升级： 1

这个带刃的环由一块奥克腾的物质雕刻而成，并被塑造成类似行星环的样子。这种材料在整个协约世界及更遥远的地方都有发现，神秘地出现在距离奥克腾原始轨道数光年之外的地方。

Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of Aucturn and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has been found throughout the Pact Worlds and beyond, mysteriously appearing lightyears from Aucturn's original orbit.

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开一个法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标尝试一次反制检定。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品会在10分钟内变为其同类型的凡俗物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标是神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Noise Blast.name: 噪音爆破 Noise Blast
Noise Blast.description:
一阵刺耳的噪音猛然爆发，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 状态 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，耳聋 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1} 状态。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10 点。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Soul Surge.name: 灵魂涌动 Soul Surge
Soul Surge.description:
对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你造成 6d6 点灵魂伤害。若重击，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 1}。你失去 @Damage[@item.level * 2 + 2] 生命值；或者，如果你处于一个至少拥有 6 点生命值的活力网络链接中，则你可以改为使该活力链接的 HP 减少 6。

升阶（+1） 造成的伤害提高 2d6，失去的生命值提高 2。

Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double the damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. You lose @Damage[@item.level * 2 + 2] Hit Points or, if you are in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 6 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's HP by 6 instead.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2.

Eldritch Lance.name: 奥术长矛 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将一道能侵袭心智的诡异能量光束从群星之间的黑暗空间中凝聚出来，并将其射向一个目标。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你命中，则造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若为重击成功，则造成双倍伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ricochet.name: 跳弹 Ricochet
Ricochet.description:
一张旋转的闪烁力场圆盘从一个目标跃向另一个目标。你造成2d4点力场伤害，目标进行一次基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4。

A spinning disc of shimmering force leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 force damage, with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Stumble.name: 踉跄 Stumble
Stumble.description:
一阵微重力爆发在目标周围引发震颤，将其拉向地面。目标必须进行一次反射豁免。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态，持续 1 轮。如果目标当时正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则其向下坠落 10 尺。

大失败 目标倒地 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧}。如果目标当时正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则其向下坠落 20 尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标正在飞行，则其在失败时额外下坠 10 尺，在大失败时额外下坠 20 尺。

A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target attempts a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, they fall 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, they fall 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target is flying, they fall an additional 10 feet on a failure and 20 feet on a critical failure.

Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol.name: 先进型半自动手枪 Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol
Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol.description:
升级： 1

这把基础手枪会在每次射击后自动弹出用过的弹壳并装填新的弹药。

Upgrades: 1

This basic pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

Tashtari.name: 塔什塔里 Tashtari

Bristle Flash.name: 刚刺闪光 Bristle Flash
Bristle Flash.description:
塔什塔里使其丝状体发出强烈的光。位于 @Template[type:emanation|distance:40] 内的非塔什塔里必须进行一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:19] 豁免。尝试过此次豁免的生物会对所有“刚毛闪光”免疫 1 分钟。塔什塔里的毛发失去光辉，并且在至少晒太阳 10 分钟之前无法使用此能力。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 1 轮。

失败 该生物目眩 1 分钟。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{失明} 1 轮，并且目眩 1 分钟。

The tashtari causes its filaments to glow with intense light. Non-tashtaris within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:40] must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:19] save. A creature that attempts this save is immune to all Bristle Flashes for 1 minute. The tashtari's fur loses its glow, and it can't use this ability until it basks in sunlight for at least 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute.

Tashtari.publicNotes:
原产于卡斯卓韦这颗绿色世界的塔什塔里，如今在更广阔的银河中以“激光狼”闻名。这些狼形的群居猎手体表覆盖着一层柔韧的丝状体，能够发出磷光，让它们可以通过一种独特的视觉语言进行无声交流。每只塔什塔里的喉部内都具有一个结点，使其能够引导储存的太阳能量并释放出一道聚焦的光束，因此这个物种得名“激光狼”。由一对交配伴侣——其中包含一只或两只阿尔法个体——领导塔什塔里狼群；它们通常会成为包含一片或多片森林区域的广大地带中的顶级掠食者。树木的存在对夜行性的塔什塔里十分重要；它们会在白天栖睡于树上，沐浴阳光，为自身的太阳能量充能。

激光狼平均体长为4到5英尺，尾巴长2英尺。它们平均重120磅。阿尔法个体体型略宽、体重也更高，但更显著的特征是它们扩大的吻部，其中含有更高密度的丝状体，能够形成更复杂的光纹图案。

Native to the green world of Castrovel, the tashtari has become known throughout the wider galaxy as the laser wolf. These wolflike pack hunters have a layer of flexible filaments that emit phosphorescent lights, which allow them to silently communicate through a bespoke visual language. Each tashtari possesses a node within its throat that allows it to channel its stored solar energy and unleash a beam of focused light, giving the species their moniker of laser wolves. A mating pair, comprising one or two alphas, lead packs of tashtaris, who generally become the apex predators of large areas that include one or more forested regions. The presence of trees is important for the nocturnal tashtaris; they use them to sleep atop during the day, basking in sunlight to recharge their solar energies.

Laser wolves have an average length of 4 to 5 feet, with a 2-foot-long tail. They weigh an average of 120 pounds. Alpha specimens are slightly broader and weigh more but are more notable for their expanded muzzle that contains a higher concentration of filaments to create more elaborate light patterns.

Crimson Queen Sniper.name: 猩红女王狙击手 Crimson Queen Sniper
Crimson Queen Sniper.tokenName: 猩红女王狙击手 Crimson Queen Sniper

Freebooter Armor.name: 掠夺者护甲 Freebooter Armor
Freebooter Armor.description:
掠夺者护甲因常穿着这类装备的海盗与亡命之徒而得名。掠夺者护甲通常由穿在夹克或飞行服内的胸甲、厚重的靴子与手套、一顶头盔，以及用于隐藏武器的隐蔽束带与枪套组成。

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

Commercial Knife.name: 商用刀 Commercial Knife
Commercial Knife.description:
刀具既是武器也是工具，价值非凡，其形状、样式和材质多种多样，从碳钢到陶瓷不一而足。使用过时材料、早于现代制造工艺的古旧刀具，有时会经过防腐蚀处理，以保存这些传统武器。

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from carbon steel to ceramics. Archaic knives made with outdated materials that predate modern crafting methods are sometimes treated against corrosion to preserve these traditional armaments.

Tactical Shirren-eye Rifle.name: 战术型希灵复眼步枪 Tactical Shirren-eye Rifle
Tactical Shirren-eye Rifle.description:
这把狙击步枪配备了一个复合式科技瞄准镜，使狙击手能够通过自然的眼球运动来调整焦距和放大倍率，而不是使用可能扰乱其瞄准的活动部件。

This sniper rifle equips a compound technological scope that allows snipers to adjust focus and magnification with natural eye movements instead of using moving parts that might disrupt their aim.

Got Your Back!.name: 我罩你！ Got Your Back!
Got Your Back!.description:
触发条件 一个生物对赤红女王的盟友造成伤害

效果 赤红女王对触发该反应的生物进行一次远程打击。这次打击不计入她的多重攻击减值，且她的多重攻击减值也不适用于这次打击。

Trigger A creature damages a crimson queen's ally

Effect The crimson queen attempts a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward her multiple attack penalty, and her multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Shirren-eye Rifle.name: 希伦人眼步枪 Shirren-eye Rifle

Sniper's Aim.name: 狙击手的瞄准 Sniper's Aim
Sniper's Aim.description:
狙击手仔细瞄准一个目标。直到她的回合结束前，她的远程打击额外造成 1d4 精准伤害，并无视次级掩护。

The sniper takes careful aim at a target. Until the end of her turn, her ranged Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and ignore lesser cover.

Shield and Shoot.name: 举盾射击 Shield and Shoot

效果 真菌守卫举起护盾，并用其孢子炮进行一次远程打击。

Frequency once per round

Effect The fungal warden Raises a Shield and makes a ranged Strike with its spore cannon.

Psychic Wail.name: 灵能哀号 Psychic Wail
Psychic Wail.description:
触发条件 一个生物攻击或触碰孕育之丘

效果 该陷阱发出一阵灵能哀嚎，对100英尺内每个非奥克腾岩虫群生物造成 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害（@Check[type:will|dc:21|basic:true] 豁免），然后掷先攻。

Trigger A creature attacks or touches the gravid mound

Effect The trap lets out a psychic wail, dealing @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage to each non-aucturnite swarm creature within 100 feet (@Check[type:will|dc:21|basic:true] save), then rolls initiative.

Spawn Swarm.name: 产卵虫群 Spawn Swarm

A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

Holospark.name: 全息火花 Holospark
Holospark.description:
硬光小恶魔向 60 尺内的一名生物发射全息火花。目标必须进行一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17] 豁免，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 状态，持续 1 轮（若严重失败则为 1 分钟）。无论其豁免结果如何，该生物在 24 小时内对任何硬光小恶魔的全息火花免疫。

The hardlight scamp shoots holographic sparks at a creature within 60 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). Regardless of its save result, the creature is immune to any hardlight scamp's holospark for 24 hours.

Hardlight Scamp.publicNotes:
硬光是构成全息影像之物质的通用名称。随着现代文明学会将光与等离子体弯塑为具有实体的形态，他们的尝试使活生生的硬光生物显现于现实之中。大多数活体硬光生物都必须停留在赋予它们生命的投影仪附近，但也有少数找到了脱离投影仪而存在的方法。硬光小鬼是这类存在中最弱小的一类。

这些生物起初只是硬光火花，随后往往会重塑自身，使外形隐约类似于它们诞生所源自的广告或媒体形象，不过它们通常也像蝙蝠般的小鬼元素生物，因此得名。大多数硬光小鬼和真正的小鬼一样，都会在做广告时表现得顽皮又惹人厌烦，但它们诞生所源自的广告也会影响其行为。一个为毛绒玩具打广告的硬光小鬼，可能会比一个为光合皮肤电控机械强化打广告的硬光小鬼更爱玩闹。

活体硬光

硬光小鬼只是可能在物质宇宙中遭遇到的一种活体硬光。硬光火花是短暂却活跃的显现体；它们如同被点燃般迅速诞生，也会像熄灭一般迅速消散，或者进化成如硬光小鬼这类更具实体的存在。活体全息影像源自获得灵魂的人工智能，尽管它们需要投影仪才能与世界互动，但和其他任何有智能的存在一样，它们也有自己的希望与梦想。在适当条件下，硬光甚至还能呈现出更为奇异且更加强大的形态。

Hardlight is the common name for the substance that forms holograms. As modern cultures learned to bend light and plasma into substantial shapes, their efforts caused living hardlight beings to emerge into reality. Most living hardlight creatures must remain near the projector that gives them life, but a few have found ways to exist without their projectors. Hardlight scamps are among the least of these beings.

Beginning as hardlight sparks, these creatures often reshape themselves to vaguely resemble the ad or media they were born from, though they often also resemble bat-like elemental scamps, thus earning their name. Most hardlight scamps, like true scamps, are mischievous and annoying in their efforts to advertise, but the ad they were born from also influences their behavior. A hardlight scamp advertising plushies might be more playful than one advertising a cybernetic augmentation for photosynthetic skin.

Living Hardlight

Hardlight scamps are just one type of living hardlight that might be encountered in the Universe. Hardlight sparks are short-lived but lively manifestations that fade as quickly as they burn to life or evolve into more substantial beings like hardlight scamps. Living holograms form from artificial intelligences that gain souls, and though they need a projector to interact with the world, they have their own hopes and dreams like any other sapient being. In the right conditions, hardlight can take even stranger and more powerful shapes.

Physical Science Lore.name: 物理科学学识 Physical Science Lore

Radiation Sense.name: 辐射感知 Radiation Sense
Radiation Sense.description:
赫斯珀能感知最远 1 英里外的辐射源，例如飞船的动力核心或反应堆。

The hesper can sense radiation sources, such as ships' power cores or reactors, from up to 1 mile away.

Reactor Sprite.name: 反应堆精灵 Reactor Sprite
Reactor Sprite.description:
如果赫斯珀与一艘星舰的动力核心或其他大型动力源（例如聚变反应堆）进行 1 小时的密切接触，它就能形成一种长期联结。赫斯珀可以与其已联结的反应堆融合，并在保持融合期间获得再生 5。处于融合状态的赫斯珀能够察觉反应堆附近发生的事情，但如果反应堆损坏，赫斯珀会立即被弹出并受到 @Damage[3d6[untyped]] 伤害。如果反应堆在赫斯珀与其融合时被摧毁，赫斯珀会立刻被杀死（@Check[type:fortitude|dc:15] 则无效）。赫斯珀一次只能与一个反应堆联结，而形成新的联结会切断它先前的联结。

If a hesper spends 1 hour in close contact with a starship's power core or other large power source (such as a fusion reactor), it can form a long-term bond. A hesper can merge with its bonded reactor, gaining regeneration 5 while it remains merged. A merged hesper is aware of what happens in the reactor's immediate vicinity, but if the reactor is broken, the hesper is immediately expelled and takes @Damage[3d6[untyped]] damage. If the reactor is destroyed while the hesper is merged with it, the hesper is slain instantly (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:15] negates). A hesper can bond with only one reactor at a time, and forming a new bond severs its previous bond.

Energy Ray.name: 能量射线 Energy Ray
Energy Ray.description:
赫斯珀的远程攻击可以造成其条目中列出的任一种伤害类型。赫斯珀可以以一个自由动作改变其能量射线打击所造成的伤害类型。

A hesper's ranged attacks can deal any of the damage types listed in its entry. A hesper can change the type of damage it deals with its energy ray Strikes as a free action.

Mutating Touch.name: 突变之触 Mutating Touch

大成功 该生物不受影响。该生物在24小时内对赫斯珀的变异之触免疫。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物从表中获得一种随机变异。其效果持续1小时。

大失败 该生物从表中获得一种随机变异。其效果持续24小时。

d8变异
1额外眼睛 目标在强光下处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 状态，并且基于视觉的察觉检定获得+2状态加值。
2生物电细胞 目标持有的科技物品和电池会在该生物回合结束时自动恢复所有已消耗的充能。科技物品处于故障
3额外的爪、棘刺或牙齿 目标获得一次徒手近战攻击，造成1d6电击伤害，但其使用双手武器进行攻击时承受–2减值。
4发光肿瘤 目标如提灯般发出光，并且隐匿检定承受–2状态减值。
5鳃 目标获得两栖特征，并且强韧豁免承受–1状态减值
6麝香腺 目标获得一个30尺灵光，使其中的活体生物感到恶心；除非它们成功通过一次对抗目标职业DC的强韧豁免，否则会变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

A hesper can deliver an enormous dose of radiation with a touch, triggering sudden mutations in living creatures. With a successful attack, a hesper causes the target to sprout tumors that erupt at the beginning of its next turn, causing a random mutation (roll 1d8 on the table below). The target must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected. The creature is immune to the hesper's mutating touch for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature gains a random mutation from the table. Its effects last for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature gains a random mutation from the table. Its effects last for 24 hours.

d8Mutation
1Extra eyes Target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} in bright light and gains +2 status bonus to sight-based Perception checks.
2Bioelectric cells Tech items and batteries held by the target automatically regain all spent charges at the end of the creature's turn. Tech items are glitching
3Extra claws, spines, or teeth Target gains an unarmed melee attack that deals 1d6 electricity damage but it takes a –2 penalty to attacks with two-handed weapons.
4Glowing tumors Target sheds light as a lantern and takes a –2 status penalty to Stealth checks.
5Gills Target gains the amphibious trait and takes a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves
6Musk gland Target gains a 30-foot aura that nauseates living creatures within it, making them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} unless they succeed at a Fortitude save against the target's class DC.

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原始天生法术 Primal Innate Spells

Charm.name: 魅惑 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语如蜜，你的面容仿佛沐浴在梦幻般的朦胧之中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近威胁过它，或对它采取过敌对行动，则此次豁免获得+4处境加值。

你可以撤销该法术。如果你对目标采取敌对行动，该法术结束。当法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑，除非它与你之间的友谊，或你说服它去做的行为，与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你有可能通过普通手段说服目标继续把你当作朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且察觉到你曾试图魅惑它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑，除非它识别出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友好}。如果它原本就是友好，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于助人}。它不能对你使用敌对行动。

大失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，且它不能对你使用敌对行动。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延长至你下一次进行每日准备时。

升阶（8环） 持续时间延长至你下一次进行每日准备时，且你最多可以将10个生物作为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Thunderstrike.name: 雷霆打击 Thunderstrike
Thunderstrike.description:
你召下一束伴随着雷鸣炸裂的闪电触须，对目标造成1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害，目标进行一次基础反射豁免。穿着金属护甲或由金属构成的目标，其豁免获得–1处境加值，若受到此法术的伤害，则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1} 1轮。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害。

You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你创造出一个光球，在你选择的颜色下于20尺半径内发出明亮光照（接下来的20尺为微光）。如果你在一个自愿生物所在的同一空间内创造此光，你可以将这道光附着在该生物身上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以通过维持法术将这道光移动至多60尺；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将其附着到一个生物身上或使其脱离。

你可以解散该法术。如果你在已经有四个light法术生效时施放该法术，你必须选择一个现有法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光}

升阶（4环） 该光球在60尺半径内发出光照（接下来的60尺为微光）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Prestidigitation.name: 戏法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法听从你的差遣。只要你维持该法术，你就可以施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，都可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹调 使1磅非生物材料变冷、变暖，或带上味道。
  • 举起 将一个无人持用、体积为轻或更小的物体缓慢抬离地面1英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其体积可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体外观看起来粗糙且人为，并且极其脆弱——不能用作工具、武器，也不能作为法术的媒介或代价。
  • 整理 为一个体积为轻或更小的物体着色、清洁或弄脏。你可以通过专注10轮来影响一个1体积的物体，而更大的物体则需要每体积1分钟。

魔术伎俩不能造成伤害，也不能导致不利状态。对物体造成的任何实际改变（除上述内容外）只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Hesper.publicNotes:
赫斯珀是与辐射协调共鸣的精类。它们会与星舰动力核心、空间站反应堆以及其他类型的机械建立联系。有些赫斯珀胆怯易惊，更喜欢在独处中度过一生；但也有一些会主动寻求非精类的陪伴，甚至会与那些在星舰和空间站上与它们共存的船员建立友谊。

赫斯珀看起来像空灵而古怪的人形生物，通常呈现中性或男性外貌，拥有绿色或带蓝色调的皮肤、优雅的四肢和长发。赫斯珀有时会与凡人幽会。借助变异辐射的力量，赫斯珀可以用魔法帮助任何族裔或性别的个体孕育子嗣。这些孩子会作为新的赫斯珀诞生，或作为继承其另一方父母族裔的受精类影响者出生。

Hespers are fey attuned to radiation. They bond with starship power cores, space station reactors, and other types of machinery. Some hespers are skittish and prefer to live out their lives in solitude, but others seek the company of non-fey, even becoming friendly with the crews who coexist with them on starships and space stations.

Hespers appear as ethereal, odd humanoids, usually androgynous or male in form, with green or bluish skin, elegant limbs, and long hair. Hespers sometimes tryst with mortals. A hesper can magically assist individuals of any ancestry or gender to carry their children with the help of transformative radiation. Such children are born as new hespers or fey-touched individuals of their other parent's ancestry.

Protection-Class Security Robot.name: 防护级安保机器人 Protection-Class Security Robot
Protection-Class Security Robot.tokenName: 防护级安保机器人 Protection-Class Security Robot

Nanite Surge.name: 纳米激涌 Nanite Surge
Nanite Surge.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 该安保机器人使一个科技生物或物品恢复 @Damage[6*@actor.level[healing]]{每级 6 点生命值}。

Frequency once per day

Effect The security robot restores @Damage[6*@actor.level[healing]]{6 Hit Points per level} to one technological creature or item.

Covering Posture.name: 掩护姿态 Covering Posture
Covering Posture.description:
防护型安保机器人进入一个姿势，使与其相邻的盟友获得轻度掩护的益处，直到其下一回合开始。一个因该机器人姿势而受益的中型或更小体型的生物，在与机器人相邻时可以 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩护}，并获得标准掩护的益处。

The protection-class security robot enters a position that grants adjacent allies the benefits of lesser cover until the start of its next turn. A creature of Medium or smaller size benefiting from the robot's position can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} while adjacent to the robot and gains the benefits of standard cover.

Integrated Tactical Laser Rifle (Advance.name: 集成式战术激光步枪（先进电池） Integrated Tactical Laser Rifle (Advanced Battery)
Integrated Tactical Laser Rifle (Advance.description:
升级： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪从方形枪管中发射集中的能量光束。协约世界通用标准型号具有极高的可改装性，并被设计为可搭配各种配件和升级部件使用；使用者可以根据自己的偏好调整这把激光步枪，甚至通过拼改把它改造成一把几乎认不出来的武器。

Upgrades: 1

These dependable mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

Protection-Class Security Robot.prototypeToken: 防护级安保机器人 Protection-Class Security Robot

Laser Pistol (Commercial, Integrated).name: 激光手枪（商用，集成） Laser Pistol (Commercial, Integrated)
Laser Pistol (Commercial, Integrated).description:
作为大多数星际旅行者可靠的随身武器，激光手枪在整个银河系中拥有数不清的品牌和型号。这些小型武器与袖珍电池协同运作，向预定目标发射定向能量的精准射击。低端型号往往会迅速耗尽电池电量，而高端型号则常常以牺牲总体容量为代价来提高伤害。

The trusty sidearm of most interstellar travelers, the laser pistol has an untold number of makes and models across the galaxy. These small arms work in tandem with compact batteries to unleash pinpoint shots of directed energy at their intended targets. Lower-end models tend to gobble up battery charges, while higher- end models often trade overall capacity for increased damage.

Repair Toolkit (Integrated).name: 维修工具包（集成） Repair Toolkit (Integrated)
Repair Toolkit (Integrated).description:
修理工具包让你能够在旅行途中进行简单修理。它包含便携式铁砧、铁钳、木工工具、磨刀石，以及用于养护皮革和木材的油。你可以使用修理工具包通过制作技能来修理物品。你可以在使用它的动作中，作为该动作的一部分，取出并收起一套已穿戴的修理工具包。

A repair kit allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. It contains a portable anvil, tongs, woodworking tools, a whetstone, and oils for conditioning leather and wood. You can use a repair kit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.

Fire Suppressor.name: 灭火器 Fire Suppressor
Fire Suppressor.description:
维修无人机会喷射一股激流，其效果如同1环 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{液压冲击}。无人机必须先重新注满其水箱，才能再次使用灭火喷射。

The repair drone sprays a torrent of water that functions as 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{hydraulic push}. The drone must refill its water tanks before it can use Fire Suppressor again.

Space Goblin Shuffle.name: 太空地精乱舞 Space Goblin Shuffle
Space Goblin Shuffle.description:
触发条件 一名地精盟友以区域效果将香辣甜心作为目标

效果 香辣甜心进行一步移位。若她仍在该效果的区域内，则她对抗该效果的豁免获得 +2 处境加值。

Trigger A goblin ally targets Spicy Sweet with an area effect

Effect Spicy Sweet Steps. If she is still in the effect's area, she gains a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against the effect.

Area Fire.name: 区域火力 Area Fire
Area Fire.description:
星陨手枪 (@Template[type:line|distance:20], 笨重)

伤害 @Damage[1d6[fire]] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] 豁免)

导弹发射器（使用上方的打击）

Starfall Pistol (@Template[type:line|distance:20], unwieldy)

Damage @Damage[1d6[fire]] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] save)

Missile Launcher (Use Strike above)

Missile Launcher.name: 导弹发射器 Missile Launcher
Missile Launcher.description:
激活 1 区域射击

这种方形发射器常安装在飞船、三脚架上，或架设在装甲精良的士兵宽阔的肩膀上，可容纳4枚导弹，其设计旨在尽量减少后坐力，同时让持用者免受可能灼伤人的尾焰回喷伤害。导弹发射器是一种军用远程武器，装填值为2，射程为60英尺。

Activate 1 Area Fire

Often mounted on a ship, tripod, or the broad shoulders of a well-armored soldier, this square-shaped launcher can hold 4 missiles and is designed to minimize recoil while keeping its wielder safe from potentially scalding backblast. A missile launcher is a martial ranged weapon, has a reload of 2, and a range of 60 feet.

Starfall Pistol.name: 星坠手枪 Starfall Pistol
Starfall Pistol.description:
升级： 1

虽然最初的流星手枪只是拼装出来的等离子投射器，但商业型号能够稳定地射出致命的超高温等离子流。阿基通的狂欢者们喜欢在户外庆典中发射这些手枪。

Upgrades: 1

While the original shooting star pistol was a kit-bashed plasma caster, the commercial models reliably fire deadly streams of superheated plasma. Akitonian revelers enjoy discharging these pistols at outdoor celebrations.

Freebooter Armor.name: 自由掠夺者护甲 Freebooter Armor
Freebooter Armor.description:
升级： 1

掠夺者护甲因经常穿着这类装备的海盗与亡命之徒而得名。掠夺者护甲通常由穿在夹克或飞行服内侧的胸甲、厚重的靴子和手套、头盔，以及用于隐藏武器的暗藏绑带与枪套组成。

Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial).name: 神射手血清（商业） Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial)
Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial).description:
激活 1 (manipulate)

这种烟雾缭绕的橙色液体可使你的枪械打击在 5 分钟内将目标因掩护获得的 AC 处境加值降低 1。

Activate 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid allows your gun Strikes to reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 1 for 5 minutes.

Ballistic Missile (Commercial).name: 弹道导弹（商用） Ballistic Missile (Commercial)
Ballistic Missile (Commercial).description:
弹药 导弹发射器

这枚导弹携带一枚爆炸弹头，对其目标造成 @Damage[1d8[bludgeoning]] 伤害，并在随后的爆炸中造成 @Damage[1[fire]] 伤害，需进行一次基础反射豁免。

Ammunition missile launcher

This missile carries an explosive warhead that deals @Damage[1d8[bludgeoning]] damage to its target and @Damage[1[fire]] damage in the subsequent explosion with a basic Reflex save.

Medpatch (Commercial).name: 医疗贴片（商业级） Medpatch (Commercial)
Medpatch (Commercial).description:
医疗贴片会加速身体的自然愈合过程和免疫系统。

激活—贴用 1 (manipulate)

你恢复 @Damage[1d6[healing]] 生命值，并在10分钟内对抗疾病和毒素的豁免检定获得+1物品加值。

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing processes and immune system.

Activate—Apply 1 (manipulate)

You regain @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against disease and poisons for 10 minutes.

Azlanti Dissident.name: 阿兹兰提异见者 Azlanti Dissident
Azlanti Dissident.tokenName: 阿兹兰提异议者 Azlanti Dissident

Advanced Lattice Armor.name: 先进晶格护甲 Advanced Lattice Armor
Advanced Lattice Armor.description:
细金属缆线编织成交错格纹，构成了这件护甲。这件护甲像链甲的环扣一样能够分散打击力，但结构要紧密得多，因此更安静。

Fine metal cables woven into latticework patterns form this armor. This armor disperses blows much like rings of chain mail, but is much tighter in construction, making it quieter.

Advanced Seeker Rifle.name: 先进搜寻者步枪 Advanced Seeker Rifle

Arcane Innate Spells.name: 奥术先天法术 Arcane Innate Spells

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的能力。它获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}状态，且每轮只能将这个额外动作用于Strike和Stride动作。

强化（7环） 你的目标至多可以为6个生物。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

Gravity Tether.name: 引力天索 Gravity Tether
Gravity Tether.description:
你操纵作用于一个生物的电磁力。进行一次远程法术攻击。目标受到4d8点电击伤害，并被拖拽至离你更近5英尺，若重击则更近10英尺。若将目标移动到屏障、生物或障碍物中，目标会在进入该空间前停下。

强化（+1） 你可以用重力天索以两个生物为目标。命中时，你可以使这些生物彼此靠近，或更靠近你。伤害增加1d8。

You manipulate the electromagnetic forces acting on a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. The target takes 4d8 electricity damage and is pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. Moving the target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) You can target two creatures with gravity tether. On a hit, you can move the creatures closer to each other or closer to you. The damage increases by 1d8.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友身上的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

强化（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

强化（4环） 如3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的来源。与不精确感官类似，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体内（若其大于此范围，则为最近的那个）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Aeon Throne Aggrandizement.name: 万古王座的壮大 Aeon Throne Aggrandizement
Aeon Throne Aggrandizement.description:
异议者试图对一个生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{恫吓}。若成功，异议者随后对其恫吓目标进行一次追猎步枪远程打击。

The dissident attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a creature. On a success, the dissident then makes a seeker rifle ranged Strike against the target of their Demoralize.

Azlanti Dissident.prototypeToken: 阿兹兰提异议者 Azlanti Dissident

Frost Turret.name: 寒霜炮塔 Frost Turret

Targets Detected.name: 已探测到目标 Targets Detected
Targets Detected.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到炮塔30尺内

效果 陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the turret

Effect The trap rolls initiative.

Frost Blast.name: 寒霜爆裂 Frost Blast
Frost Blast.description:
炮塔向一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 发射寒冰爆风，对区域内的每个生物造成 @Damage[(1d4+1)[cold]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] 豁免）。

The turret shoots an icy blast in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[(1d4+1)[cold]] damage to each creature within the area (@Check[type:reflex|dc:16|basic:true] save).

Frost Turret.disable:
@Check[type:arcana|dc:15] 和 @Check[type:computers|dc:15] 以重新编程炮塔，@Check[type:thievery|dc:15] 两次以停用炮塔的传感器开关

@Check[type:arcana|dc:15] and @Check[type:computers|dc:15] to reprogram the turret, @Check[type:thievery|dc:15] twice to disable the turret's sensor switches
Frost Turret.hazarddescription:
一台刻有符文并镶嵌着蓝色宝石的微型机器会释放寒冰冲击。

A tiny machine engraved with runes and blue gems releases icy blasts.
Frost Turret.routine:
（3个动作）炮塔先用它的第一个动作【Stride】最多20尺，移动到能用其“寒霜爆破”以瞄准尽可能多敌方生物的位置，然后用其剩余动作对那些生物使用“寒霜爆破”。

(3 actions) The turret uses its first action to Stride up to 20 feet to the location where it can target the most enemy creatures possible with its Frost Blast, then uses its remaining actions to use Frost Blast on those creatures.

Slamming Door.name: 猛撞的门 Slamming Door

Slam Shut.name: 猛然关闭 Slam Shut
Slam Shut.description:
触发条件 太空站小魔怪激活这扇门

效果 门关闭，封住走廊。金属门扉在关闭时会对受影响方格内的任何生物造成 @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]] 伤害，并将其以随机方向推出其空间。若生物在 @Check[type:reflex|dc:17] 豁免中成功，则不受伤害，并以随机方向翻滚躲开。若为大成功，则其可以选择方向。强行打开这扇关闭的门需要一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:25] 检定。关闭的门使用与该陷阱相同的 AC 和豁免，但其硬度为 12，且有 48 HP（BT 24）。

Trigger The space station gremlin activates the door

Effect The door shuts, closing off the hallway. The metal portal deals @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]] damage to anyone in the affected square when it shuts and pushes them out of its space in a random direction. A creature that succeeds at a @Check[type:reflex|dc:17] save takes no damage and rolls out of the way in a random direction. On a critical success, they can choose the direction. Forcing open the shut door requires a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:25] check. The shut door uses the same AC and saves as the trap, but it has Hardness 12 and 48 HP (BT 24).

Slamming Door.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:15]（受训）以手动覆盖控制面板，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:13] 以卡住门

@Check[type:computers|dc:15] (trained) to manually override the control panel, or @Check[type:crafting|dc:13] to jam the doors
Slamming Door.hazarddescription:
当太空站小魔怪远程激活控制面板时，打开着的门会猛然关上。

Open doors slam shut when the space station gremlin remotely activates the control panel.

Corpse Fleet Infantry.name: 尸骸舰队步兵 Corpse Fleet Infantry
Corpse Fleet Infantry.tokenName: 尸骸舰队步兵 Corpse Fleet Infantry

Corpse Fleet Lore.name: 尸骸舰队学识 Corpse Fleet Lore

Laser Pistol (Commercial).name: 激光手枪（商用） Laser Pistol (Commercial)
Laser Pistol (Commercial).description:
作为大多数星际旅行者可靠的副武器，激光手枪在整个银河系中拥有数不清的厂牌与型号。这些小型武器与袖珍电池协同运作，向预定目标发射定向能量的精准射击。低端型号往往会迅速耗尽电池电量，而高端型号则常常以牺牲总体容量为代价来提高伤害。

The trusty sidearm of most interstellar travelers, the laser pistol has an untold number of makes and models across the galaxy. These small arms work in tandem with compact batteries to unleash pinpoint shots of directed energy at their intended targets. Lower-end models tend to gobble up battery charges, while higher- end models often trade overall capacity for increased damage.

Phase Cutlass (Commercial).name: 相位弯刀（商用） Phase Cutlass (Commercial)

Coordinated Shuffle.name: 协同换位 Coordinated Shuffle
Coordinated Shuffle.description:
触发条件 一个相邻的盟友从尸骸舰队步兵身边移开

效果 尸骸舰队步兵跟随其盟友的带领，并立即以其速度的一半进行Stride。他们必须与触发该反应的盟友朝相同方向移动。

Trigger An adjacent ally moves away from the Corpse Fleet infantry

Effect The Corpse Fleet infantry follows their ally's lead, and immediately Strides up to half their Speed. They must move in the same direction as the triggering ally.

Autotarget Rifle.name: 自动瞄准步枪 Autotarget Rifle

Fusillade.name: 扫射 Fusillade
Fusillade.description:
当至少有另一名持用远程武器的尸骸舰队步兵处于其触及范围内时，该尸骸舰队步兵的远程打击造成额外 1d4 精准伤害。

The Corpse Fleet infantry's ranged Strikes deal 1d4 extra precision damage when the Corpse Fleet infantry is within reach of at least one other Corpse Fleet infantry wielding a ranged weapon.

Corpse Fleet Infantry.prototypeToken: 尸骸舰队步兵 Corpse Fleet Infantry

Ferrofluid Ooze.name: 铁磁流体软泥怪 Ferrofluid Ooze
Ferrofluid Ooze.tokenName: 铁磁流体软泥怪 Ferrofluid Ooze

Magnetic Sense.name: 磁性感知 Magnetic Sense
Magnetic Sense.description:
铁磁流体软泥怪能够感知磁场，使其能够将大型磁性金属源（1体积或更高）作为精确感知来探测。

A ferrofluid ooze can feel magnetic fields, allowing it to detect large sources of magnetic metal (Bulk 1 or greater) as a precise sense.

Demagnetization.name: 去磁化 Demagnetization
Demagnetization.description:
铁磁流体软泥怪受到火焰伤害时，其磁场会被停用，直到该软泥怪的下一回合结束。它会从任何其所附着的生物身上脱离，丢下任何持握中的科技物品，并且在其磁场恢复之前无法使用“磁跃”或“附着”。

A ferrofluid ooze that takes fire damage has its magnetic field deactivated until the end of the ooze's next turn. It releases itself from any creature it was attached to, drops any held technological items, and cannot use Magnetic Leap or Attach until its magnetic field returns.

Magnetic Field.name: 磁场 Magnetic Field
Magnetic Field.description:
30尺。铁磁流体软泥被一个恒定的磁场环绕，该磁场会干扰附近的科技装备。在其灵光内使用的具有科技特征的物品，使用它们进行的所有检定都会受到–1的情境减值。灵光内体积为1 Bulk或以下的无人照管金属物体会被拖拽至邻近该软泥的位置。

30 feet. A ferrofluid ooze is surrounded by a constant magnetic field that interferes with nearby technological equipment. Items with the tech trait used within the aura take a –1 circumstance penalty to all checks made using them. Unattended metal objects in the aura of 1 Bulk or less are pulled adjacent to the ooze.

Attach.name: 附加 Attach
Attach.description:
铁磁流体软泥怪可以将自己附着在任何与其体型相同或更大的生物身上，前提是该生物是构装体，或正穿戴或持用科技装备。这个效果类似于对该生物进行“抓取”，但软泥怪会随着该生物移动，而不是将其固定在原地。只要软泥怪处于附着状态，它就会处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，而它所附着的生物在抓取或抽出无人持有或收纳中的科技物品时，必须成功通过一次 @Check[type:flat|dc:10]。若失败，该物品会附着到软泥怪身上（视为由软泥怪持有）。如果软泥怪在附着于某个生物时被杀死或被推开，该生物会掉落任何持有中或未固定的科技物品。

A ferrofluid ooze can attach itself to any creature its size or larger that is a construct or wearing or wielding technological equipment. This is similar to Grabbing the creature, but the ooze moves with that creature rather than holding it in place. As long as the ooze is attached, it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and the creature it's attached to must succeed at a @Check[type:flat|dc:10] to grab or draw an unattended or stored technological item. On a failure, the item becomes attached to the ooze (treat it as being held by the ooze). If the ooze is killed or pushed away while attached to a creature, that creature drops any held or unsecured technological items.

Magnetic Leap.name: 磁跃步 Magnetic Leap
Magnetic Leap.description:
铁磁流体软泥怪立即移动到其磁场内一个它能够附着的生物 adjacent。随后，该软泥怪自动附着到该生物身上。铁磁流体软泥怪在[[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用此能力。

The ferrofluid ooze instantly moves adjacent to a creature within its magnetic field it can Attach to. The ooze then automatically Attaches to that creature. A ferrofluid ooze cannot use this ability again for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Ferrofluid Ooze.prototypeToken: 铁磁流体软泥 Ferrofluid Ooze

Blossoming Interference.name: 绽放干扰 Blossoming Interference

Awaken.name: 觉醒 Awaken
Awaken.description:
触发条件 样本62掷先攻

效果 该危险掷先攻。

Trigger Sample 62 rolls initiative

Effect The hazard rolls initiative.

Shielding Fronds.name: 护盾叶丛 Shielding Fronds
Shielding Fronds.description:
频率 每轮一次

触发 一个生物攻击样本62

效果 花丛调整其叶状枝条来为样本62抵挡攻击，使样本62获得掩护，直到该陷阱下个回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{效果：掩护}

Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature attacks Sample 62

Effect The Bloom adjusts its leaf fronds to shield Sample 62 from attacks, granting Sample 62 cover until the beginning of the hazard's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Effect: Cover}

Vine.name: 蔓藤 Vine
Vine.description:
无多重攻击减值

no multiple attack penalty

Bolstering Biopod.name: 强化生物舱 Bolstering Biopod
Bolstering Biopod.description:
绽放用一个恢复性的生物舱包裹样本62，赋予样本62 5点临时生命值，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.CPdQCYtHoWVLLUWn]{效果：强化生物舱}

The Bloom surrounds Sample 62 with a rejuvenating biopod, granting Sample 62 5 temporary Hit Points which last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.CPdQCYtHoWVLLUWn]{Effect: Bolstering Biopod}

Blossoming Interference.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:23]（受训）以扰乱Bloom的传感器，@Check[type:crafting|dc:23]（受训）以扰乱Bloom的传感器，@Check[type:arcana|dc:23]（受训）或 @Check[type:nature|dc:23]（受训）以操纵Bloom的魔法或自然构件，@Check[type:occultism|dc:20]（专家）以在灵能上与Bloom建立联结并催促其停止攻击（算作两次成功）；总共需要三次成功才能停用该陷阱

@Check[type:computers|dc:23] (trained) or @Check[type:crafting|dc:23] (trained) to scramble the Bloom's sensors, @Check[type:arcana|dc:23] (trained) or @Check[type:nature|dc:23] (trained) to manipulate the Bloom's magical or natural components, @Check[type:occultism|dc:20] (expert) to psychically bond with the Bloom and urge it to stop its assault (counts as two successes); three total successes are required to disable the trap
Blossoming Interference.hazarddescription:
绽放体会行动起来保卫样本62，用抽打的藤蔓发动攻击，并释放生物荚囊来治疗该怪物的伤口。

The Bloom acts to defend Sample 62, attacking with lashing vines and releasing biopods to heal the monster's wounds.
Blossoming Interference.reset:
一旦样本 62 被击败，该危险就会被解除，且不会重置。

Once Sample 62 is defeated, the hazard is disabled and doesn't reset.
Blossoming Interference.routine:
（3个动作）该陷阱使用3个动作，其中2个动作以藤蔓进行打击来攻击船体上的PC（相较于@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{未束缚的}目标，会优先选择已固定或稳定的目标），并用1个动作以一个生物舱强化样本62

(3 actions) The trap uses 3 actions, 2 actions to attack PCs on the hull with a vine Strikes (favoring anchored or stable targets over @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} targets), and 1 action to bolster Sample 62 with a biopod

Metema the Eternal.name: 永恒者梅忒玛 Metema the Eternal
Metema the Eternal.tokenName: 永恒者墨忒玛 Metema the Eternal

Vial of Blood.name: 一小瓶血液 Vial of Blood

Create Servitor.name: 创造仆从 Create Servitor
Create Servitor.description:
如果一个生物在被“饮血”将生命值降至 0 HP 后死亡，梅特玛可以通过向该受害者献出自己的一些血液，并将其埋入地中 3 个夜晚，把这名受害者变成吸血鬼。如果这名新吸血鬼的等级低于梅特玛，它就处于梅特玛的控制之下。如果梅特玛同时控制了过多仆从，意志坚定的仆从可以通过成功通过一次对抗梅特玛意志 DC 的意志豁免检定来摆脱控制（@Check[type:will|dc:24]）。

If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Drink Blood, Metema can turn this victim into a vampire by donating some of his own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights. If the new vampire is lower level than Metema, it is under Metema's control. If Metema controls too many servitors at once, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a Will saving throw against Metema's Will DC (@Check[type:will|dc:24]).

Dominate.name: 支配 Dominate
Dominate.description:
梅特玛可以随意施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]（DC 19），作为一种神圣先天法术。施放该法术需要直视目标的眼睛，因此该法术具有视觉（特征）。成功豁免的生物会在24小时内暂时免疫梅特玛的支配。彻底摧毁梅特玛会终止该支配效果，但仅仅将他降至0 HP并不足以打破该法术。

Metema can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P] (DC 19) at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to Metema's Dominate for 24 hours. Fully destroying Metema ends the domination, but merely reducing him to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

Drink Blood.name: 饮血 Drink Blood
Drink Blood.description:
需求 一个处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}状态的生物，或一个自愿的生物，位于梅特玛的触及范围内

效果 梅特玛将獠牙刺入该生物体内，吸饮其血液。若受害者处于被擒抱状态，则这需要进行一次对抗受害者强韧DC的 @Check[type:athletics|defense:fortitude] 检定；若受害者处于其他任一上述状态，则自动成功。受害者陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭 2}，而梅特玛恢复10点生命值，任何超出的生命值都会转化为临时生命值。从一个已经处于力竭状态的生物身上饮血不会为梅特玛恢复任何生命值，但会使受害者的力竭值增加1。梅特玛也可以饮用被放入容器中的血液来维持生存，但无法因此恢复生命值。受害者的力竭状态每周减少1。输血需要一次 @Check[type:medicine|dc:20] 检定，以及足量的血液或一名献血者，并会在10分钟后使该吸取值减少1。

Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing creature is within Metema's reach

Effect Metema sinks his fangs into that creature to drink its blood. This requires an @Check[type:athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and Metema regains 10 HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to Metema but increases the victim's drained value by 1. Metema can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but gains no HP from doing so. A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a @Check[type:medicine|dc:20] check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

Divine Innate Spells.name: 天生神圣法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dominate (At Will).name: 支配（随意） Dominate (At Will)
Dominate (At Will).description:
你夺取目标的控制权，强迫其服从你的命令。如果你下达一个明显会自我毁灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令。其效果取决于它的意志豁免。

重度成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在奋力抵抗你的命令时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 你控制目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 状态，但它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试进行一次意志豁免。若成功，则该法术结束。

重度失败 如同失败，但只有当你向其下达一个违背其本性的全新命令时，例如杀死它的盟友，目标才会获得一次新的豁免。

升阶（10环） 持续时间无限。

You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Turn to Mist.name: 化为迷雾 Turn to Mist
Turn to Mist.description:
梅忒玛化为一团蒸汽云，如同 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG] 法术一般，或变回他的正常形态。梅忒玛在蒸汽形态下失去快速愈合。梅忒玛可以无限期地保持这种形态。

Metema turns into a cloud of vapor, as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG] spell, or back to his normal form. Metema loses fast healing while in vapor form. Metema can remain in this form indefinitely.

Bolts.name: 螺栓 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但构造相似，是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Tactical Crossbolter.name: 战术弩弹枪 Tactical Crossbolter
Tactical Crossbolter.description:
升级： 1

这种高科技弩使用一系列活塞沿着枪管推进弩箭。这种安静发射的半自动武器在人口稠密的定居点很受欢迎，因为在那里枪声可能会引发恐慌。

Upgrades: 1

This high-tech crossbow uses a series of pistons to propel bolts along its barrel. These quietfiring semiautomatic weapons are popular in high-density settlements where gunfire might cause a panic.

Second Skin.name: 第二层皮肤 Second Skin
Second Skin.description:
升级： 0

柔软却坚韧的织物能够完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适性的情况下提供基础防护。第二层皮肤通常穿在便服下面。

Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.

Metema the Eternal.prototypeToken: 永恒者梅忒玛 Metema the Eternal

Squox.name: 松鼠狐 Squox

Squox Tricks.name: 松鼠狐把戏 Squox Tricks
Squox Tricks.description:
松鼠狐可以用其尾巴对生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，以特技代替运动，即使它没有空闲手也可以。松鼠狐可以尝试对处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态、且体型比它大至多两级的生物进行缴械或绊摔，并且对措手不及的目标进行缴械或绊摔时获得 +2 处境加值。

A squox can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures with its tail using Acrobatics instead of Athletics, even if it doesn't have a free hand. A squox can attempt to Disarm or Trip @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures up to two sizes larger than it and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Disarm or Trip an off-guard target.

Squox.publicNotes:
小型的vulkarikis是协约世界中常见的动物，原产于卡斯卓韦星球。来自古老戈拉里昂的人类探险者给它们起了“松鼠狐”这个名字，因为他们认为这种生物像是狐狸与松鼠的混合体。它们聪明到近乎狡诈的地步，并会运用恫吓手段，时常在旅行中把发现的闪亮物品顺手偷走。它们展现出复杂的社会行为，包括一群潜行队中个体之间明确的等级结构，并拥有庞大的发声 repertoire，用来为不同的松鼠狐个体赋予标志性的声音。

松鼠狐早已从协约世界被输出到各地，如今在整个银河中都能见到，近宇中的许多文明都维持着这些毛茸茸小生物日益壮大的群落，这也让异星卫士愈发忧心，因为他们担心适应力极强的松鼠狐已经在数个生物群系中成为入侵物种。尽管有些人主张扑杀这些种群，但由于这种动物作为宠物非常受欢迎，这一立场极不受欢迎。

年幼的松鼠狐被称作幼崽，在大多数协约世界的公开市场上都可以买到。松鼠狐的寿命通常约为10年。典型的松鼠狐重约10磅，体长约3英尺，其中很大一部分长度来自它的尾巴。松鼠狐拥有各种各样的毛色，许多个体甚至会针对特定气候形成独特的环境适应，例如生活在沙漠中的松鼠狐会长出更长的耳朵来帮助散热。

The tiny vulkarikis are a common animal in the Pact Worlds, originating from the planet Castrovel. Human explorers from old Golarion gave them the name squox, as they interpreted the creatures as being a mix of fox and squirrel. They're cunning to the point of being devious and employ scare tactics to routinely abscond with shiny items they uncover on their travels. They exhibit complex social behaviors, including a distinct hierarchy between individuals in a skulk and have a vast vocal repertoire used to assign signature sounds to different individual squoxes.

Having long since been exported from the Pact Worlds, squoxes are found throughout the galaxy, with many civilizations in Near Space maintaining growing communities of these tiny furry creatures, much to the growing consternation of the Xenowardens who worry that the highly adaptable squox has become an intrusive species in several biomes. While some advocate for culling these populations, the popularity of the animal as a pet has made this an incredibly unpopular stance.

Young squoxes are referred to as kits and can be purchased from the open market on most Pact Worlds. A squox tends to live for about 10 years. A typical squox weighs about 10 pounds and is about 3 feet long, with much of its length being its tail. Squoxes come in all colorations, and many even take on unique environmental adaptations to specific climates, such as desert-dwelling squoxes growing longer ears to help disperse heat.

Integrated Welding Torch.name: 集成式焊炬 Integrated Welding Torch

Exigency.name: 危急情况 Exigency
Exigency.description:
频率 每10分钟一次

触发 一个生物以一次攻击将该机器人作为目标

效果 该机器人使其处理能力超频，以试图避开一次攻击，在针对该触发攻击的AC上获得+2处境加值。

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature targets the robot with an attack

Effect The robot overclocks its processing power to attempt to avoid an attack, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack.

Trained Squox.name: 受过训练的松鼠狐 Trained Squox

Squox Tricks.name: 松鼠狐把戏 Squox Tricks
Squox Tricks.description:
松鼠狐可以用其尾巴对生物执行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，并以特技替代运动，即使它没有空闲手也可以。松鼠狐可以尝试对比它大至多两个体型的 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 生物进行缴械或绊摔，并且对措手不及的目标进行缴械或绊摔时获得 +2 处境加值。

A squox can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} creatures with its tail using Acrobatics instead of Athletics, even if it doesn't have a free hand. A squox can attempt to Disarm or Trip @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures up to two sizes larger than it and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Disarm or Trip an off-guard target.

Go for the Eyes!.name: 攻它们的眼睛！ Go for the Eyes!
Go for the Eyes!.description:
松鼠狐进行一次Stride，尝试进行一次 @Check[type:acrobatics|defense:perception] 检定，对抗一名相邻生物的察觉 DC，然后进行一次颚击 Strike。

大成功 由于松鼠狐的突然飞扑，目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，直到松鼠狐下个回合结束。

成功 目标只是暂时受惊，陷入措手不及，直到松鼠狐当前回合结束。

大失败 松鼠狐误判了与目标面部的距离，并 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

The squox Strides, attempts an @Check[type:acrobatics|defense:perception] check against an adjacent creature's Perception DC, and then makes a jaws Strike.

Critical Success Thrown by the squox's sudden leap, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the squox's next turn.

Success The target is only momentarily startled and is off-guard until the end of the squox's current turn.

Critical Failure The squox misjudges the distance to its target's face and falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Trained Squox.prototypeToken: 受过训练的松鼠狐 Trained Squox

Motion Sense.name: 运动感知 Motion Sense
Motion Sense.description:
聚合软泥怪可以通过振动和空气流动感知附近的移动。

An assembly ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

Assemble.name: 组装 Assemble
Assemble.description:
在一个耗时 1 分钟的过程中，组装软泥怪使用其储存的通用聚合物制造一件随机装备。组装软泥怪可以制造一件总体积不超过 5 Bulk、花费等于其所使用通用聚合物数量、且等级不高于 5 的装备。

In a process that takes 1 minute, an assembly ooze crafts a random piece of gear using its store of UPBs. An assembly ooze can craft a piece of gear of no more than 5 Bulk with a cost equal to the number of UPBs it uses, but with a level no greater than 5.

Disassemble.name: 拆解 Disassemble
Disassemble.description:
装配软泥吞没一件无人持用或已被缴械的装备，且其体积值不超过5 Bulk，并将其分解为组成部件。装配软泥获得数量等同于该物品价格（以信用点计）的通用聚合物。装配软泥一次最多可储存500通用聚合物。

The assembly ooze engulfs an unattended or disarmed piece of gear of no more than 5 Bulk, deconstructing it into its component parts. The assembly ooze gains a number of UPBs equal to the item's price in credits. An assembly ooze can hold up to 500 UPBs at a time.

Kehtaria Fungal Bloom.name: 科塔瑞亚真菌盛放 Kehtaria Fungal Bloom
Kehtaria Fungal Bloom.tokenName: 科塔瑞亚真菌绽放 Kehtaria Fungal Bloom

Spore Bloom.name: 孢子绽放 Spore Bloom
Spore Bloom.description:
触发条件 一个生物进入该花簇的空间

效果 该花簇爆发出一次次声爆发，并猛然喷射出孢子囊。处于该花簇区域内或邻接空间内的任何生物都会受到 @Damage[(2d12+10)[bludgeoning],(2d12+10)[sonic]]{2d12+10 钝击伤害和 2d12+10 音波伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] 豁免）伤害。未通过此次豁免的生物还会受到 @Damage[2d8[persistent,poison]] 伤害。

Trigger A creature enters the bloom's space

Effect The bloom erupts with a subsonic burst and a sudden ejection of spore pods. Any creatures within the bloom's area or an adjacent space take @Damage[(2d12+10)[bludgeoning],(2d12+10)[sonic]]{2d12+10 bludgeoning and 2d12+10 sonic} damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). A creature who fails this save also takes @Damage[2d8[persistent,poison]] damage.

Spontaneous Combustion.name: 自发燃烧 Spontaneous Combustion
Spontaneous Combustion.description:
触发条件 绽放区域的任意部分受到火焰伤害

效果 绽放区域爆发出火焰。区域内的每个生物受到 @Damage[(2d10+15)[fire]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。未通过此次豁免的生物还会受到 @Damage[2d8[persistent,fire]] 伤害。

Trigger Any area of the bloom takes fire damage

Effect The area of the bloom bursts into flame. Every creature in the area takes @Damage[(2d10+15)[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). A creature who fails this save also takes @Damage[2d8[persistent,fire]] damage.

Kehtaria Fungal Bloom.disable:
@Check[nature|dc:32]（专家）使用当地草药和少量现有药用品来清除真菌团块，或 @Check[survival|dc:30]（专家）来遏制菌华。

@Check[nature|dc:32] (expert) to use local herbs and minor held medicinal goods to purge the fungal mass or @Check[survival|dc:30] (expert) to contain the bloom.
Kehtaria Fungal Bloom.hazarddescription:
一大片紫灰色的真菌质覆盖着广阔区域，其边界每时每刻都在以肉眼可见的速度扩张。

A sheet of purple-gray fungal matter grows over a wide area, its borders visibly expanding with every passing moment.
Kehtaria Fungal Bloom.reset:
真菌繁花会收集足够的水分，使其在24小时后能够再次使用孢子绽放。若真菌繁花使用了自发燃烧，通常需要一周时间新的生长才会回到被摧毁的区域，而这些新生长会从灰烬中吸取养分，实际上相当于将这一危害重置。

The fungal bloom collects enough moisture to use Spore Bloom again after 24 hours. If the fungal bloom used Spontaneous Combustion, it typically takes a week for new growth to return to a destroyed patch with the new growth leeching nutrients from the ashes, effectively acting as a reset for this hazard.
Kehtaria Fungal Bloom.prototypeToken: 科塔瑞亚真菌繁花 Kehtaria Fungal Bloom

Scattershard.name: 散射碎片 Scattershard
Scattershard.description:
微光裔发射一阵水晶碎片，对一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 内的每个非微光裔造成 @Damage[14d6[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。豁免严重失败的生物还会受到 @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。微光裔在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Scattershard]]{1d4 轮} 内无法再次使用散晶射击。

The shimmerspawn launches a spray of crystal shards, dealing @Damage[14d6[piercing]] damage to each non-shimmerspawn in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). A creature that critically fails its save is also dealt @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. The shimmerspawn can't use Scattershard again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Scattershard]]{1d4 rounds}.

Jungle Flash Fire.name: 丛林闪燃火 Jungle Flash Fire
Jungle Flash Fire.tokenName: 丛林闪燃 Jungle Flash Fire

Blazing Curtain.name: 炽焰帷幕 Blazing Curtain
Blazing Curtain.description:
触发 一个生物进入该区域

效果 一道火焰之墙环绕该区域内的所有生物。丛林闪燃掷先攻。

Trigger A creature enters the area

Effect A wall of flames surrounds all creatures in the area. The jungle flash fire rolls initiative.

Jungle Flash Fire.disable:
@Check[survival|dc:26]（专家）以扑灭火灾的关键区域，或进行 @Check[nature|dc:28] 或 @Check[thievery|dc:28] 检定以砍除植被或挖掘壕沟来切断火势路径；总共需要三次成功才能停用该隐患。一轮内总计造成 @Damage[45[cold]] 伤害视为一次成功。

@Check[survival|dc:26] (expert) to extinguish critical areas of the fire, or @Check[nature|dc:28] or @Check[thievery|dc:28] check to cut back foliage or dig trenches to cut off the fire's path; three total successes are required to disable the hazard. A total of @Damage[45[cold]] damage dealt in one round counts as a success.
Jungle Flash Fire.hazarddescription:
顶篷迸发出一道火焰帷幕，向前汹涌而出，将路径上的一切都点燃成熊熊烈火。火焰向上升腾 60 英尺，直抵顶篷，并被有毒的黑色浓烟云团所遮蔽。

The canopy erupts in a curtain of flame that surges forward and sets everything in its path ablaze. The flames rise 60 feet up to the canopy, hidden by clouds of noxious black smoke.
Jungle Flash Fire.routine:
（2 个动作）丛林闪燃用它的第一个动作对区域内的生物喷发出一道火焰洪流。遭遇中的每个生物都受到 @Damage[(2d12+15)[fire]] 伤害（进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。飞行中的生物若豁免失败，会被坠落的碎片击中，额外受到 @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]] 伤害，并坠落 20 尺。

丛林闪燃在先攻计数 10 时使用它的第二个动作。此时，丛林中充满了一团布满孢子的烟雾。区域内的生物必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2} 且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。
