大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 3} 且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 2}。

(2 actions) The jungle flash fire uses its first action to unleash a torrent of flames on creatures within the area. Every creature in the encounter takes @Damage[(2d12+15)[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Flying creatures who fail their save are struck by falling debris and take an additional @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]] damage and fall 20 feet.

The jungle flash fire uses its second action on initiative count 10. At this point, the jungle fills with a cloud of spore-filled smoke. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.
Jungle Flash Fire.stealthdetails:
隐匿 DC 10，先攻为 +23

Stealth DC 10, initiative is +23
Jungle Flash Fire.prototypeToken: 丛林闪燃 Jungle Flash Fire

Scamp-Spawning Projector.name: 恶棍生成投影器 Scamp-Spawning Projector
Scamp-Spawning Projector.tokenName: 小捣蛋生成投影器 Scamp-Spawning Projector

Spawn Scamp.name: 生成捣蛋小鬼 Spawn Scamp
Spawn Scamp.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到投影器下方，或者一个小恶魔被击败

效果 陷阱会在距离投影器30英尺处生成两个硬光小恶魔（如果已经存在另一个小恶魔，则只生成一个；该陷阱同一时间无法维持超过两个硬光小恶魔）。这些小恶魔掷先攻。小恶魔在被杀死时消失，或者当投影器停用或被摧毁时消失。

Trigger A creature moves under the projector or a scamp is defeated

Effect The trap spawns two hardlight scamps 30 feet away from the projector (or only one scamp if another one already exists; the trap can't support more than two hardlight scamps at a time). The scamps roll initiative. The scamps disappear when slain, or if the projector deactivates or is destroyed.

Scamp-Spawning Projector.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:20]（受训）以重新编程投影仪，或 @Check[type:athletics|dc:20]（受训）将其从墙上扯下来

@Check[type:computers|dc:20] (trained) to reprogram the projector or @Check[type:athletics|dc:20] (trained) to rip it from the wall
Scamp-Spawning Projector.hazarddescription:
硬光小鬼从这台损坏的投影仪中现身，并攻击附近的生物。

Hardlight scamps step out from this corrupted projector and attack nearby creatures.
Scamp-Spawning Projector.reset:
该陷阱在 7 轮后解除，并在 1 小时后重置。

The trap deactivates after 7 rounds and resets after 1 hour.
Scamp-Spawning Projector.prototypeToken: 小恶棍孳生投射器 Scamp-Spawning Projector

Shooting Starknife.name: 投掷星刃 Shooting Starknife
Shooting Starknife.description:
升级： 1

这种来自失落的戈拉里昂的传统星形刀刃通常由强化碳钢锻造而成，并经过化学处理，呈现出虹彩光泽。经过恰当平衡与打磨后，投掷型星辰刀在划破空气时会发出鸣响

Upgrades: 1

This traditional star-shaped blade of lost Golarion is often forged from reinforced carbon steel and treated with chemicals that create an iridescent sheen. When properly balanced and honed, a shooting starknife sings as it slices through the air

Laser Rifle.name: 激光步枪 Laser Rifle
Laser Rifle.description:
升级： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪从方形枪管中射出集中的能量光束。协约世界通用标准型号具有极高的可改装性，设计上可搭配各种配件和升级使用，使用者会根据自己的偏好调整这把激光步枪，甚至将其拼改成一把几乎认不出来的武器。

Upgrades: 1

These dependable mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

Carbon Skin.name: 碳化皮肤 Carbon Skin
Carbon Skin.description:
升级： 1

这套贴身的碳纤维服装包裹全身。批量生产的版本通常是暗灰色的实用服装，而价格更高的定制款则如钻石般耀眼夺目。

Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Mass-produced versions are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.

Hypopen (Commercial).name: 低压笔（商业） Hypopen (Commercial)
Hypopen (Commercial).description:
激活—注射 1 (manipulate)

该装置含有特制的纳米机器人，能够治疗多种精神与肉体层面的损伤，或暂时提升身体性能。

移除 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏} 状态，或将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心} 状态的值降低 1。

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

This device contains specialized nanites that heal many sorts of mental and physical energies or temporarily boost the body's performance.

Remove the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition or decrease the value of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition by 1.

Medpatch (Commercial).name: 医疗贴片（商业） Medpatch (Commercial)
Medpatch (Commercial).description:
医疗贴片可加速身体的自然愈合过程与免疫系统。

激活—贴用 1 (manipulate)

你恢复 @Damage[1d6[healing]] 生命值，并在10分钟内对抗疾病和毒素的豁免检定获得+1物品加值。

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing processes and immune system.

Activate—Apply 1 (manipulate)

You regain @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against disease and poisons for 10 minutes.

Feeding Time.name: 进食时间 Feeding Time
Feeding Time.description:
触手将一个@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱}的生物朝诡异巨口拖拽，移动距离最多为该触手移动速度的两倍。若被擒抱的生物与巨口相邻，触手会将该生物强行塞入巨口，使巨口能够在其下一回合对该生物使用“整吞”。

The tentacle drags a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} creature up to twice its movement toward the eldritch maw. If a grabbed creature is adjacent to the maw, the tentacle forces the creature into the maw, allowing the maw to use Swallow Whole against that creature on its next turn.

Voice of Destruction.name: 毁灭之声 Voice of Destruction
Voice of Destruction.tokenName: 毁灭之声 Voice of Destruction

Advanced Arc Pistol.name: 先进电弧手枪 Advanced Arc Pistol

Tactical Carbon Skin.name: 战术型碳化皮肤 Tactical Carbon Skin
Tactical Carbon Skin.description:
升级： 1

这套贴身的碳纤维服包覆全身。量产版通常是暗灰色、注重实用的服装，而更昂贵的定制款则如钻石般璀璨夺目。

Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Mass-produced versions are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.

Entropy's Grasp.name: 熵之攫取 Entropy's Grasp
Entropy's Grasp.description:
触发 毁灭之声被击杀或陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}

效果 这个声音的身体溶解为一个张开的虚空，对 @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] 内的所有生物造成 @Damage[6d6[void]] 伤害，并可进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] 豁免。

Trigger The voice of destruction is slain or rendered @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}

Effect The voice's body dissolves into a yawning void that deals @Damage[6d6[void]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save.

Divine Spontaneous Spells.name: 神圣自发法术 Divine Spontaneous Spells

Eldritch Wrath.name: 异能震怒 Eldritch Wrath
Eldritch Wrath.description:
你引导来自物质宇宙外缘彼方那些难以言喻的力量，幻象般的爪击、颚击和触手猛击区域内的每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成 3d12 点精神伤害。区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次基础意志豁免。对于任何因该法术效果而陷入恶心状态的生物，该区域均为困难地形。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

You channel the unspeakable powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Genetic Regeneration.name: 基因再生 Genetic Regeneration
Genetic Regeneration.description:
你将受术者的基因编码灌注上受刺激的再生特性，开始治疗其伤口。目标暂时获得再生 8，使其在自己每个回合开始时恢复 8 点生命值。只要它具有再生，目标就不会因受到生命值伤害而死亡，且其濒死状态不会增加到足以杀死它的数值（这会使大多数生物的濒死状态最多停在濒死 3）；不过，如果其受创值变为 4 或更高，它将保持 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，直到其伤势得到治疗。若目标受到酸蚀或火焰伤害，它的再生会失效，直到其下个回合结束后才会恢复。在该法术持续时间内，该生物可以有一次放弃该轮恢复生命值，改为通过花费一个互动动作，将被切断的身体部位贴回原本断离的位置，从而使一个受损或毁坏的器官重新长成，或重新接上一处被切断的身体部位。

升阶（+1） 再生数值提高 2。

You imbue the target's genetic code with a stimulated regenerative property that begins healing their wounds. The target temporarily gains regeneration 8, which restores 8 Hit Points to it at the start of each of its turn. While it has regeneration, the target can't die from taking Hit Points damage and its dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill it (this stops most creatures' dying condition at dying 3), though if its wounded value becomes 4 or higher, it stays @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until its wounds are treated. If the target takes acid or fire damage, its regeneration deactivates until after the end of its next turn. Once during the spell's duration, the creature can forgo healing Hit Points that round to regrow one damaged or ruined organ or reattach a severed body part by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

Heightened (+1) Increase the regeneration value by 2.

Unfettered Movement.name: 无拘行动 Unfettered Movement
Unfettered Movement.description:
你排斥会妨碍生物或减缓其移动的效果。在此法术效果持续期间，目标无视会使其速度承受境况减值的效果。当其尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} 一个使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} 的效果时，会自动成功，除非该效果是魔法的，且其环阶高于unfettered movement法术。

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗不死生物。如果目标是活体生物，你对其造成 1d8 点虚空伤害，且它进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿的不死生物，你恢复等量的生命值。施放此法术时你花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (专注) 该法术的射程为 30 尺。如果你是在治疗一个不死生物，恢复的生命值增加 8。

3 (专注) 你在一个 @Template[emanation|distance:30] 中散播虚空能量。这会以区域内所有活体生物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗量或伤害提高 1d8，且双动作版本的额外治疗提高 8。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Crisis of Faith.name: 信仰危机 Crisis of Faith
Crisis of Faith.description:
你攻击目标的信仰，使该生物充满怀疑与精神上的动荡，造成 6d6 点精神伤害；如果它能够施放神术法术，则造成 6d8 点精神伤害。其效果由它的意志豁免决定。

对许多神祇而言，若无重大理由就对你所信奉神祇的追随者施放此法术，是一种渎神之举。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全额伤害；如果目标能够施放神术法术，则其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} 1 轮。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} 1 轮，并且 1 轮内无法施放神术法术。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6（若目标为神术施法者，则增加 2d8）。

You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

Share Pain.name: 分担痛苦 Share Pain
Share Pain.description:
你通过心灵感应与一个生物共享极度痛苦的感觉。目标受到 3d12 点精神伤害，并进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1} 状态。

大失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2} 状态。

升阶（6环） 该法术的目标至多为四个生物，且造成 6d12 点精神伤害。

You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.

Void Whispers.name: 虚空低语 Void Whispers
Void Whispers.description:
目标听见来自群星彼端的黑暗奥秘，使其心智陷入迷乱。目标进行一次意志豁免检定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 目标听见这些诡异的低语，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每轮用每个动作进行一次Step。当其移动时，目标会采取最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标受到攻击或以其他任何方式被直接威胁为止。

大失败：如失败，但目标会语无伦次地胡言乱语。任何在其回合开始时位于目标20尺内的生物，都必须如同成为该法术目标一般尝试一次意志豁免检定。若失败，其会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}，持续1轮，并在24小时内对此法术免疫。这是一个失能效果。

The target hears dark mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient their mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for one round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step once per round. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target is attacked or otherwise directly threatened in any way.

Critical Failure: As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins their turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw as if they were targeted by this spell. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.

Doom Scroll.name: 末日卷轴 Doom Scroll
Doom Scroll.description:
你以魔法将不祥的消息广播到附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示装置上（包括护甲上的通讯单元）。区域内能看见一个或多个显示装置的生物必须尝试进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物被某个显示装置所 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}。

失败 该生物被该显示装置所吸引，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}（即使这种着迷效果结束也是如此）。

大失败 该生物被该显示装置所吸引，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}（即使这种着迷效果结束也是如此）。

You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by a display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).

Noise Blast.name: 噪音爆破 Noise Blast
Noise Blast.description:
刺耳的噪音猛然爆发，造成 2d10 点音波伤害。每个生物都必须进行一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 1 轮。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，耳聋 1 分钟，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Share Life.name: 分担生命 Share Life
Share Life.description:
你在目标的生命精华与你自己的生命精华之间建立起一条临时链接。目标从所有造成生命值伤害的效果中只承受一半伤害，而你承受剩余的伤害。当你通过这条链接受到伤害时，你不会将自己的任何抗性、弱点或其他能力应用于该伤害；你只是承受该数值的伤害。如果目标在任何时候离你超过30英尺远，该法术便会结束。如果你或目标任一方的生命值降至0，则先结算该法术造成的任何伤害，然后该法术结束。

You forge a temporary link between the target's life essence and your own. The target takes half damage from all effects that deal Hit Point damage, and you take the remainder of the damage. When you take damage through this link, you don't apply any resistances, weaknesses, or other abilities you have to that damage; you simply take that amount of damage. The spell ends if the target is ever more than 30 feet away from you. If either you or the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, any damage from this spell is resolved and then the spell ends.

Soul Surge.name: 灵魂涌动 Soul Surge
Soul Surge.description:
对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你造成 6d6 点灵魂伤害。若重击，目标承受双倍伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{力竭 1}。你失去 @Damage[@item.level * 2 + 2] 生命值；或者，如果你与一个至少拥有 6 生命值的活力网络处于联结中，你可以改为使该活力联结的 HP 减少 6。

强化（+1） 造成的伤害增加 2d6，失去的生命值增加 2。

Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double the damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. You lose @Damage[@item.level * 2 + 2] Hit Points or, if you are in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 6 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's HP by 6 instead.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2.

Enfeeble.name: 虚弱化 Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description:
你削弱目标的力量，效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1} 状态，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 3} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

Grim Tendrils.name: 凶兆触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的卷须从你的指尖蜷曲而出，飞掠穿过空气。你对分界线内的活体生物造成 2d4 点虚空伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] 伤害。分界线内的每个活体生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半的虚空伤害，且不受持续性流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续性流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加 2d4，且持续性流血伤害增加 1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Mind Skewer.name: 心灵穿刺 Mind Skewer
Mind Skewer.description:
你以过量的灵能信息或神圣裁决冲击一个生物的心智。此次精神猛攻造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若重击，目标受到 4d6 点精神伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2} 状态，持续 1 轮。

强化（+1） 伤害提高 2d6。

You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgements. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Motivating Ringtone.name: 激励铃声 Motivating Ringtone
Motivating Ringtone.description:
你使目标通讯装置播放一首由宇宙谱写、专属于其拥有者的个人主题铃声。你施放该法术时，拥有该目标的生物恢复 1d8+4 生命值，并在持续时间内获得对所有速度的 +5 尺状态加值，以及对抗恐惧效果的豁免检定获得 +1 状态加值，前提是该通讯装置持续播放该铃声。回合开始时邻接某个正在播放有效铃声的盟友的生物，会获得该速度状态加值和豁免加值，直到其下个回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.HshG8G3NgMJNlu9s]{法术效果：激励铃声}

强化（+1） 治疗量增加 1d8+4。

You cause the target comm unit to play a cosmically composed personal theme song specific to its owner. The creature who owns the target regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds and a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects for the duration, as long as the comm unit continues to play the ringtone. Creatures beginning their turn adjacent to an ally with an active ringtone gain the status bonus to Speeds and bonus to saves until the start of their next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.HshG8G3NgMJNlu9s]{Spell Effect: Motivating Ringtone}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.

Analyze Target.name: 分析目标 Analyze Target
Analyze Target.description:
你专注于目标，在魔法全息影像显示信息的同时收集数据。施法完成时，你会获知关于目标的生物特征信息，包括其指纹、医疗状况以及其他基础生理信息。你，或任何你向其说明该分析的人，在冒充该生物时、进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤口} 的 Medicine 检定时，以及针对该生物进行回忆知识动作时，获得 +1 处境加值。若该生物是虚幻的，或处于幻术魔法效果之下，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的分析目标法术的法术环阶时，你才能察觉这一点。

强化（3环） 处境加值提高至 +2，且你的目标最多可为 10 个生物。

强化（6环） 处境加值提高至 +3，且你可以将任意数量的生物作为目标。

You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Impersonate the creature, on Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, and to Recall Knowledge actions about the creature. If the creature is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the spell rank of your analyze target spell.

Heightened (3rd) The circumstance bonus increases to +2 and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The circumstance bonus increases to +3 and you can target any number of creatures.

Detect Thoughts.name: 侦测思想 Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
你能感知周围具有智能的生物的表层思维。揭示的信息量取决于你在某一区域或目标上集中注意的时间长短。该法术可以穿透某些障碍，但3英尺厚的泥土或木材、1英尺厚的石头、1英寸厚的金属、一层薄铅片，或任何力场屏障都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物也免疫此法术的侦测。

1 你能侦测到具有意识且智力属性调整值为 –3 或更高的生物是否存在思维。

2 你能侦测到思考中的心智数量，以及这些生物是否具有心灵感应。具有心灵感应的生物，其思维比不具有心灵感应的生物更响亮，并且可能会察觉到你的侵入，由GM酌情决定。

3 在维持该法术期间，你在通过“感知动机”判断目标动机时，感知获得 +1 状态加值。若目标的意志豁免成功，则可阻止此效果。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.F6GYZA5UwDN5zusb]{法术效果：侦测思想}

强化（5环） 你获得 +2 状态加值。

强化（7环） 你获得 +3 状态加值。

You sense the surface thoughts of intelligent creatures around you. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you concentrate on an area or target. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

1 You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence attribute modifiers of –3 or higher.

2 You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creature who don't have telepathy, and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.

3 You gain a +1 status bonus to Perception to Sense the target's Motives while the spell is sustained. A target who succeeds at its Will save prevents this.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.F6GYZA5UwDN5zusb]{Spell Effect: Detect Thoughts}

Heightened (5th) You gain a +2 status bonus.

Heightened (7th) You gain a +3 status bonus.

Eldritch Lance.name: 奥术长枪 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将一道由群星之间黑暗空隙中凝聚而成、侵袭心智的邪异能量光束压缩并射向一个目标。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若命中，你造成2d6点精神伤害。若大成功，则造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Injury Echo.name: 伤痛回响 Injury Echo
Injury Echo.description:
你将来自未来或过去的一处伤势显现在当下，以伤害一个生物。选择：钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。目标受到 1d6 所选类型的伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免失败，且在你的下个回合结束前受到同类型的伤害，则它还会额外受到 @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加 1d6，且豁免失败时的持续伤害增加 1d4。

You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d6 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

Shield.name: 护盾 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一个魔法力场护盾。这视为使用“举起护盾”动作，使你获得对 AC 的 +1 处境加值，直到你下个回合开始，但使用它不需要手。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡} 反应。该护盾的硬度为 5。你可以使用该法术的反应来减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使它不造成物理伤害也可以。你在使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾}

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾免疫}

升阶（+2） 该护盾的硬度提高 5。

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Revitalizing Surge.name: 复苏涌流 Revitalizing Surge
Revitalizing Surge.description:
频率 每回合一次

效果 毁灭之声以30英尺内一个可见的盟友为目标。其令目标恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] 生命值。

Frequency once per turn

Effect The voice of destruction targets a visible ally within 30 feet. They restore @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points to the target.

Voice of Destruction.prototypeToken: 毁灭之声 Voice of Destruction

Orbital Bombardment.name: 轨道轰炸 Orbital Bombardment

Opening Salvo.name: 开场齐射 Opening Salvo
Opening Salvo.description:
触发 遭遇开始时

效果 轨道上的七芒星卫队星舰开始向行星表面倾泻致命的弹幕。轨道轰炸进行先攻检定。

Trigger The encounter begins

Effect Sihedron Guard starships in orbit begin unleashing a deadly barrage onto the planet's surface. The orbital bombardment rolls initiative.

Orbital Bombardment.disable:
@Check[acrobatics|dc:35] 或 @Check[athletics|dc:35] 强行进入或找到某种在轰炸中岌岌可危的临时掩护手段，@Check[crafting|dc:34]（大师）在该区域构筑快速掩护，@Check[piloting|dc:34]（受训）或 Survival（专家）以迅速导航到更好的位置，@Check[religion|dc:38]（受训）祈求平安；总共需要八次成功才能结束该危害。任何在这些检定中任意一项成功的生物，对抗该危害攻击时进行的豁免获得 +2 处境加值。

@Check[acrobatics|dc:35] or @Check[athletics|dc:35] to force your way into or access some precarious means of temporary cover from the bombardment, @Check[crafting|dc:34] (master) to construct quick cover in the area, @Check[piloting|dc:34] (trained) or Survival (expert) to navigate to a better position quickly, @Check[religion|dc:38] (trained) to pray for safety; eight total successes are required to end the hazard. A creature who succeeds at any of these checks gains a +2 circumstance bonus on their saves against the hazard's attacks.
Orbital Bombardment.hazarddescription:
一阵武器火力自天空倾泻而下，将死亡之雨洒向地面。

A surge of weapons fire cascades from the sky, raining death on the ground.
Orbital Bombardment.reset:
轰炸在 6 轮后结束。

The bombardment ends after 6 rounds.
Orbital Bombardment.routine:
（1 动作）能量长矛与导弹爆炸横扫整片丛林。第一轮以及此后每个奇数轮，冲击以明亮的能量光束形式出现，对区域内所有生物造成 @Damage[(2d10+5)[electricity],(2d10+5)[fire]]{2d10+5 点电击伤害和 2d10+5 点火焰伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] 豁免）。重度失败的生物会 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 1 分钟。

第二轮以及此后每个偶数轮，冲击则是巨大的炮弹，对所有生物造成 @Damage[(2d10+5)[piercing],(2d10+5)[slashing]]{2d10+5 点穿刺伤害和 2d10+5 点挥砍伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] 豁免）。重度失败的生物会 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋} 1 分钟。

(1 action) Lances of energy and missile detonations impact across the jungle. On the first round and every odd round after, the impacts come in the form of bright energy beams that deal @Damage[(2d10+5)[electricity],(2d10+5)[fire]]{2d10+5 electricity and 2d10+5 fire} damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save) to all creatures in the area. A creature that critically fails is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

On the second round and every even round after, the impacts are massive shells that deal @Damage[(2d10+5)[piercing],(2d10+5)[slashing]]{2d10+5 piercing and 2d10+5 slashing} damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save) to all creatures. A creature that critically fails is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute.

Cybernetic Shuln.name: 电控机械舒伦 Cybernetic Shuln
Cybernetic Shuln.tokenName: 电控机械舒伦 Cybernetic Shuln

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 震动感知（不精确）60尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet

Tech-Rending Strikes.name: 裂科猛击 Tech-Rending Strikes
Tech-Rending Strikes.description:
每当舒伦以近战打击造成一次重击时，目标穿着或持有的一件科技物品会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}，持续 2 轮。

Any time the shuln scores a critical hit with a melee Strike, one tech item worn or held by the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} for 2 rounds.

Shuln Saliva.name: 舒尔恩唾液 Shuln Saliva
Shuln Saliva.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

最长持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害并且迟缓 1（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害，并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续 1 小时。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:30]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 hour.

Unstoppable Burrow.name: 势不可挡的掘进 Unstoppable Burrow
Unstoppable Burrow.description:
舒尔恩可以钻入坚硬岩石，以及任何硬度低于精金的金属，就像钻入泥土或松散瓦砾一样，并留下一个直径10英尺的隧道。

Shulns can burrow into solid rock and any metal with a hardness less than that of adamantine as though it were soil or loose rubble, leaving a tunnel 10 feet in diameter.

Cybernetics.name: 电控机械 Cybernetics
Cybernetics.description:
电控机械休尔恩的电控机械可通过一次成功的 @Check[thievery|dc:27] 来 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{停用装置}，或通过一次成功的 @Check[computers|dc:27] 来停用一个系统，使其失效 1 小时。若休尔恩受到任何电击伤害，其电控机械会失效 1 轮。电控机械已失效的电控机械休尔恩无法使用科技撕裂打击。

The cybernetics of a cybernetic shuln can be disabled for 1 hour with a successful @Check[thievery|dc:27] to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Device} or @Check[computers|dc:27] to Disable a System. A shuln's cybernetics are disabled for 1 round if it takes any electricity damage. A cybernetic shuln with disabled cybernetics can't use tech-rending strike.

Cybernetic Shuln.prototypeToken: 电控机械舒尔恩 Cybernetic Shuln

Fiendish Ellicoth.name: 邪魔艾利科斯 Fiendish Ellicoth
Fiendish Ellicoth.tokenName: 邪魔艾利科斯 Fiendish Ellicoth

Radiation Aura.name: 辐射灵光 Radiation Aura
Radiation Aura.description:
15尺。生物进入该灵光或在其回合开始时处于该灵光内，必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:25] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}（若严重失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}），并暴露于极端辐射病。

15 feet. A creature entering the aura or beginning their turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure) and is exposed to extreme radiation sickness.

Soul Drain.name: 灵魂汲取 Soul Drain
Soul Drain.description:
被艾利科斯长鼻击中的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免。若失败，其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸 drained 1}（若严重失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{吸 drained 2}），且艾利科斯获得 10 点临时生命值。

A creature hit by the ellicoth's trunk must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure), and the ellicoth gains 10 temporary Hit Points.

Extreme Radiation Sickness.name: 极度辐射病 Extreme Radiation Sickness
Extreme Radiation Sickness.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

发作时间 2小时

阶段 1 @Damage[3d8[poison]]伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}（1小时）

阶段 2 @Damage[4d8[poison]]伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}（1小时）

阶段 3 @Damage[5d8[poison]]伤害并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 3}（1小时）

阶段 4 死亡

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Onset 2 hours

Stage 1 @Damage[3d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 hour)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 hour)

Stage 3 @Damage[5d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} (1 hour)

Stage 4 death

Fiendish Ellicoth.prototypeToken: 邪魔厄利科斯 Fiendish Ellicoth

Shimmerstone Robot.name: 闪晶石机器人 Shimmerstone Robot
Shimmerstone Robot.tokenName: 闪晶石机器人 Shimmerstone Robot

Shimmerstone Network.name: 闪晶石网络 Shimmerstone Network
Shimmerstone Network.description:
彼此相距 1 英里以内的所有闪晶石机器人都可以远程通信，并共享彼此的视觉画面。

All shimmerstone robots within 1 mile of each other can communicate remotely and share each other's visual feeds.

Proximity Alert.name: 接近警报 Proximity Alert
Proximity Alert.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到闪晶石机器人 adjacent 的位置

效果 闪晶石机器人闪耀其水晶，迸发出一道致盲的强光，同时发出接近警报。触发该效果的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:30] 豁免，否则将处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 状态，直到其回合结束。

Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the shimmerstone robot

Effect The shimmerstone robot flares its crystals in a blinding flash as it sounds a proximity alarm. The triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} end of their turn.

Area Fire.name: 区域火力 Area Fire
Area Fire.description:
火焰喷射 (@Template[type:cone|distance:30], 消耗 2, 一体化, mag 64, 科技, 笨重)

伤害 @Damage[4d10[fire]] (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic])

flame jet (@Template[type:cone|distance:30], expend 2, integrated, mag 64, tech, unwieldy)

Damage @Damage[4d10[fire]] (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic])

Disrupting Pulse.name: 扰乱脉冲 Disrupting Pulse
Disrupting Pulse.description:
闪晶石机器人发出一道干扰脉冲，作用于一个 @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]。区域内所有科技生物和物体都会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2}，除非它们通过一次 @Check[will|dc:30] 豁免。

The shimmerstone robot emits a disrupting pulse in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]. All tech creatures and objects in the area become @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save.

Drilling Charge.name: 钻孔炸药 Drilling Charge
Drilling Charge.description:
闪晶石机器人以其速度沿直线行进或飞行，然后对触及范围内的一个目标进行一次钻头打击。

The shimmerstone robot Strides or Flies up to their speed in a straight line, then makes a drill Strike against a target in reach.

Shimmerstone Robot.prototypeToken: 闪晶石机器人 Shimmerstone Robot

Turret Defenses.name: 炮塔防御 Turret Defenses
Turret Defenses.description:
你的炮塔等级等于你的等级，其 AC 等于你的技师职业 DC，且它的硬度等于你等级的一半（向上取整）。

它在反射和强韧豁免上具有受训熟练等级，并使用你的智力调整值来计算这些加值。

它具有 6 点生命值，外加你每拥有 1 个等级便获得等于 2 + 你的智力调整值的生命值。它的损坏阈值等于其生命值总数的一半（向下取整）。

在你的每日准备期间，你会自动修理你的炮塔，使其恢复至最大生命值。如果你的炮塔被摧毁，则你下次 Deploy Turret 时，会部署一个已修复且具有最大生命值的炮塔。

在 5 级时，你的炮塔硬度提高至 10。在 10 级时，它提高至 15，且其反射和强韧豁免的熟练等级提升为专家。在 15 级时，其硬度提高至 20，且其反射和强韧豁免的熟练等级提升为大师。

Your turret's level is equal to your level, its AC is equal to your mechanic class DC, and it has Hardness equal to half your level (rounded up).

It has trained proficiency in Reflex and Fortitude saves, using your Intelligence modifier to calculate these bonuses.

It has 6 Hit Points, plus a number of Hit Points equal to 2 plus your Intelligence modifier for each level you have. Its Broken Threshold is equal to half its total Hit Points (rounded down).

During your daily preparations, you automatically repair your turret, restoring it to maximum Hit Points. If your turret is destroyed, the next time you Deploy Turret, you deploy a repaired turret with maximum Hit Points.

At 5th level, your turret's Hardness increases to 10. At 10th level, it increases to 15 and its proficiency rank in Reflex and Fortitude saves increases to expert. At 15th level, its Hardness increases to 20, and its proficiency rank in Reflex and Fortitude saves increases to master.

Kurshudi.name: 库尔舒迪 Kurshudi

Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Acid).name: 再生 10（被酸停用） Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Acid)

Accept Your Fate.name: 接受你的命运 Accept Your Fate
Accept Your Fate.description:
触发 距离库尔舒迪30英尺内的一个生物使用了一个允许重掷的幸运效果

效果 库尔舒迪可以选择将哪个已掷出的骰子用于结果，即使该生物的能力允许其选择重掷后的结果也是如此。如果此效果导致目标的掷骰严重失败，则库尔舒迪获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速} 1，持续1分钟。

Trigger A creature within 30 feet of the kurshudi uses a fortune effect that allows for a reroll

Effect The kurshudi can select which of the rolled dice is used for the result, even if the creature's ability allows it to select a rerolled result. If this effect causes a target's roll to critically fail, then the kurshudi becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} 1 for 1 minute.

Rocket Launcher.name: 火箭发射器 Rocket Launcher
Rocket Launcher.description:
库什鲁迪通过信仰为这把火箭发射器显现弹药，且永远无需重新装填。对这把火箭发射器的区域射击进行豁免时严重失败的生物，还会受到 @Damage[1d10[persistent,spirit]] 伤害。

The kurshudi manifests ammo for this rocket launcher through faith, and never needs to reload. A creature that critically fails its save against Area Fire from this rocket launcher also takes @Damage[1d10[persistent,spirit]] damage.

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神性先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Telekinetic Strangulation.name: 念动力扼杀 Telekinetic Strangulation
Telekinetic Strangulation.description:
你用心灵力量以如虎钳般的握力扼住一个生物的喉咙或其他要害部位，强行将其抬离地面几英寸，使其在挣扎中难以呼吸。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你造成 6d12 点钝击伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}。目标受到 1d12 点持续性钝击伤害，在你每轮维持法术时继续保持定身，并且必须继续屏住呼吸。以这种方式被定身时，它必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。目标可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}（挣脱 DC 为你的法术 DC，且此次挣脱尝试受失能特征影响）。

You psychically grasp a creature's throat or other vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The target takes 1d12 persistent bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized and must continue holding its breath for each round you Sustain the Spell. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the escape DC is your spell DC and the escape attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).

X-Ray Vision.name: X射线视觉 X-Ray Vision
X-Ray Vision.description:
你可以看穿60英尺内的大多数材料和墙壁。你的视线会被2英尺厚的木材或塑料、1英尺厚的石头、2英寸厚的普通金属、或任意厚度的铅或任何星铁阻挡，而且你只能看见黑白景象。

You see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white.

Divine Immolation.name: 神圣焚化 Divine Immolation
Divine Immolation.description:
神圣火焰灼烧区域内的生物。生物受到 6d6 火焰伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level -3)d6[persistent,fire]] 伤害。火焰中的神圣力量也会灼伤灵魂；如果对于该生物而言更为不利（由 GM 决定），则其受到 divine immolation 造成的灵魂伤害，而非火焰伤害。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害，且不受持续伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害和持续伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害和双倍持续伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 1d6，持续伤害增加 1d6。

Divine flames scour creatures within the area. Creatures take 6d6 fire damage and @Damage[(@item.level -3)d6[persistent,fire]] damage. The divine power within the flames scorches the spirit as well; a creature takes spirit damage instead of fire damage from divine immolation if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and persistent damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and double persistent damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Scouting Eye (At Will).name: 侦察之眼（随意） Scouting Eye (At Will)
Scouting Eye (At Will).description:
你在500英尺内一个你看得见的位置创造出一只@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}、漂浮的眼球，直径为1英寸。

它以你的正常视觉感官向所有方向视物，并将它所见的一切持续传送给你。

每轮中你第一次维持该法术时，你可以选择将眼球移动最多30英尺，此时只能看见眼球前方的事物；或者将其移动最多10英尺，此时可以看见其周围所有方向的一切。眼球能移动到离你多远没有限制，但如果你和眼球不再处于同一存在位面，该法术会立刻结束。如果你想用它进行感知检定，可以通过眼球尝试执行搜索动作。对眼球造成的任何伤害都会将其摧毁并结束该法术。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you.

The first time you Sustain the spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望波涛 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你向区域内的生物施加绝望。每个生物所受的影响由其意志豁免决定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应，并且必须在其回合开始时再次进行一次豁免；若失败，则它会因无法控制地抽泣而在该回合内处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败 同失败，且该生物自动迟缓 1，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环） 区域增大为60英尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Divine Wrath.name: 神之愤怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你将神性的怒火引导向敌人。区域内的敌人根据其强韧豁免，受到 4d10 精神伤害。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害，且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}；当其处于恶心状态时，还会同时处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Unfettered Movement (At Will).name: 无拘行动（随意） Unfettered Movement (At Will)
Unfettered Movement (At Will).description:
你可以排斥那些会妨碍生物或减缓其移动的效果。在此法术效果持续期间，目标无视会使其速度受到处境减值的效果。当其尝试对使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱} 的效果进行挣脱，且该效果使其 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{动弹不得}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{被束缚} 时，它会自动成功，除非该效果具有魔法性质，且其环阶高于行动无拘法术。

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

Weight of Ages.name: 万古重压 Weight of Ages
Weight of Ages.description:
你将一生中所有的酸痛、苦楚与悲伤凝聚成一道压缩的箭矢，施加于一个生物身上。进行一次远程法术攻击检定。该箭矢造成 6d8 点精神伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{负重}。

重度成功 目标受到 12d8 点伤害，并陷入负重 1 分钟。

成功 目标受到 6d8 点伤害，并陷入负重 1 轮。

You burden a creature with all the aches, pains, and sorrows of a lifetime in a condensed bolt. Make a ranged spell attack roll. The bolt deals 6d8 mental damage and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered}.

Critical Success target takes 12d8 damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Success The target takes 6d8 damage and is encumbered for 1 round.

Truespeech (Constant).name: 真言（恒常城） Truespeech (Constant)
Truespeech (Constant).description:
目标无论语言为何都能理解所有词语，并且还能说出其他生物的语言。处于由多种生物组成的群体中时，每次目标说话，它都可以选择一个生物，并以该生物能够理解的语言说话，即使目标不知道那是什么语言也可以。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Spell Sanction.name: 法术制裁 Spell Sanction
Spell Sanction.description:
需求 kurshudi 在本轮的上一个动作是施放一个法术

效果 kurshudi 选择一个受该已施放法术影响的目标，该目标要么未能通过其豁免，要么被 kurshudi 的法术攻击检定成功命中。该目标额外受到 @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] 伤害，且 kurshudi 以该法术的射程对其尝试进行威吓。当其如此做时，@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} 失去听觉特征并获得视觉特征，且如果目标不理解其语言，kurshudi 不会受到减值。

Requirements The kurshudi's last action this round was to cast a spell

Effect The kurshudi chooses one target affected by the cast spell that failed its save or that the kurshudi successfully hit with a spell attack roll. That target takes an additional @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage and the kurshudi attempts to Demoralizes them using the spell's range. When it does, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and the kurshudi does not take a penalty if the target doesn't understand their language.

War Sanction.name: 战争制裁 War Sanction
War Sanction.description:
需求 库尔舒迪本回合上一动作是使用其火箭发射器进行一次区域射击

效果 库尔舒迪从受该次区域射击影响且豁免失败的目标中选择一个。该目标额外受到 @Damage[1d10[persistent,fire]] 伤害，并且只要该持续性伤害继续，就会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}。

Requirements The kurshudi's last action this round was an Area Fire with its rocket launcher

Effect The kurshudi chooses one target affected by the Area Fire that failed its save. That target takes an additional @Damage[1d10[persistent,fire]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} as long as the persistent damage continues.

Kurshudi.publicNotes:
侍从是莉莎拉——这位阿兹兰提关于服从与通过服务获得奖赏的神祇——的仆从。每一位侍从都代表着忠诚服务可能如何获得莉莎拉奖赏的不同方式，而有些侍从最初是凡人仆从，他们因生前的服从而赢得了神圣蜕变的赐福。库尔舒迪代表着永世侍奉的奖赏。库尔舒迪会惩罚那些试图逃避自身命运，或使用魔法操纵本应发生之事的人。它们以在战斗中宣读告令、施展魔法、操使一具受神圣附魔的火箭发射器，并经常进一步对目标实施制裁为傲。

不朽者库尔舒

库尔舒曾是莉莎拉的一名传令官，在久远过去的失落戈拉里昂上被一群冒险者击败。莉莎拉按照她那位被杀传令官的形象创造了库尔舒迪侍从，并以她的名字为其命名。就这样，库尔舒的忠诚得到了奖赏，而她的遗泽也通过永恒延续下去。

Attendants are servants of Lissala, the Azlanti deity of obedience and rewards through service. Each attendant represents the ways in which loyal service might be rewarded by Lissala, and some attendants began existence as mortal servants who earned the blessing of divine transformation through their obedience in life. Kurshudis represent the reward of eternal life in service. A kurshudi punishes those who try to shirk their fates or use magic to manipulate events that should occur. They pride themselves on handing out proclamations in combat, casting magic, wielding a divinely enchanted rocket launcher, and regularly following up with sanctions against their targets.

Kurshu The Undying

Once a herald of Lissala, Kurshu was defeated by a group of adventurers on Lost Golarion in ages past. Lissala created the kurshudi attendants in her slain herald's image and named them in her honor. In this way, Kurshu's loyalty was rewarded and her legacy persists through eternity.

Malfunctioning Elevator.name: 故障电梯 Malfunctioning Elevator

Going Down.name: 下坠 Going Down
Going Down.description:
触发条件 一个生物摆弄电梯

效果 电梯沿着井道坠落。电梯中的每个生物都必须进行一次 @Check[type:reflex|dc:14] 豁免。随后该陷阱掷先攻。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1} 状态，持续 1 轮。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2} 状态，持续 1 轮。

大失败 该生物陷入笨拙 2 状态，持续 1 轮，并且倒地 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧}。

Trigger A creature tampers with the elevator

Effect it plummets down the shaft. Each creature in the elevator must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:14] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is clumsy 2 for 1 round and falls @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Malfunctioning Elevator.disable:
@Check[type:crafting|dc:15]（受训）以修复控制台和线路，或进行 @Check[type:thievery|dc:15]（受训）来 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{禁用装置} 并重新接通电梯的安全机制

@Check[type:crafting|dc:15] (trained) to repair the console and wiring or @Check[type:thievery|dc:15] (trained) to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} and re-engage the elevator's safety mechanisms
Malfunctioning Elevator.hazarddescription:
电梯失控下坠，控制面板上火花四溅。

The elevator drops uncontrollably, and sparks fly from the control panel.
Malfunctioning Elevator.reset:
该陷阱在 2 轮后停用。它不会重置。

The trap deactivates after 2 rounds. It does not reset.
Malfunctioning Elevator.routine:
(1 action) 电梯迸射出火花并沿井道坠落。在第一个回合，这没有任何效果。在第二个回合，除非该陷阱已被解除，否则电梯会撞到井道底部，对电梯内的每个生物造成 @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（位于顶部者受到一半伤害）。

(1 action) The elevator shoots sparks and plummets down the shaft. On the first round, this has no effect. On the second round, unless the trap has been disabled, the elevator crashes to the bottom of the shaft, dealing @Damage[(1d6+3)[bludgeoning]] damage to each creature inside the elevator (half damage to those on top).

Bastorox.name: 巴斯托洛克斯 Bastorox

Motion Sense.name: 运动感知 Motion Sense
Motion Sense.description:
巴斯托罗克斯可以通过振动以及空气或水流的运动感知附近的生物。

A bastorox can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

Shield Arm.name: 持盾手臂 Shield Arm
Shield Arm.description:
巴斯托罗克斯的攻城手臂也可以作为护盾使用（硬度 5，30 HP，BT 15）。如果该护盾被摧毁，巴斯托罗克斯用其攻城手臂进行打击时的攻击检定承受 –2 情境减值。被摧毁的护盾手臂会在 24 小时内再生。

A bastorox's battering arm can also be used as a shield (Hardness 5, 30 HP, BT 15). If the shield is destroyed, the bastorox takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls made with its battering arm Strike. A destroyed shield arm regenerates over the course of 24 hours.

Swarm Mind.name: 虫群心智 Swarm Mind
Swarm Mind.description:
30尺。所有彼此处于所列范围内且拥有虫群思维的盟友都会保持恒常的心灵感应交流，并知晓彼此所知道的所有威胁。当处于至少一个拥有虫群思维的盟友范围内时，若巴斯托罗克斯对一个精神效果的豁免掷出成功，则改为获得重成功。

30 feet. All allies with Swarm mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats they know about. While within range of at least one ally with Swarm mind, when a bastorox rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

Bioelectric Jolt.name: 生物电震击 Bioelectric Jolt
Bioelectric Jolt.description:
巴斯托罗克斯从其臂刃中释放出一道生物电能量箭。该能量箭对一条 @Template[type:line|distance:30] 内的所有生物造成 @Damage[6d8[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:22|basic:true] 豁免）。巴斯托罗克斯在 [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Bioelectric Jolt]]{1d4 轮} 内不能再次使用生物电震击。

The bastorox unleashes a bolt of bioelectric energy from its arm blade. The bolt deals @Damage[6d8[electricity]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:30] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:22|basic:true] save). The bastorox can't use Bioelectric Jolt again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Bioelectric Jolt]]{1d4 rounds}.

Bastorox.publicNotes:
由一种远在浩界、被称为虫族的虫形物种发展而来，虫群被若干文明视为现存最重大的威胁。虫群由无数子群体构成，而每个子群体又包含无数不同的组成亚种；这是一个以灵能联合行动的庞大群体，其目的在于吞噬宇宙间的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群拥有同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA的能力。由于在Gap前便已发展出星际航行，虫群在历史中断之前就已吞噬了无数星系，而在获得了对“信号”以及被称为“漂流”的超空间维度的利用后，它的扩张速度更是有增无减。

被虫群染指的世界会被抽干自然资源，沦为被称作“空壳世界”的荒芜之地。外界所谓的“虫群空间”，不过是一大片被虫群在其鲁莽推进中吞噬后的无生命世界带。虫群对这些世界的剥夺极其彻底，以至于勘测者甚至难以找到哪怕微量的无机资源痕迹，例如稀有矿物和水。这些空壳世界中，鲜少有被彻底探索过的，因为探索往往会唤醒休眠的无人个体；理论认为，它们被留在原地，是为了防备那些已遭吞噬的星系日后再度被殖民并恢复生机。在这片空域之外，还存在着零星的虫群活动区域，因为在Gap之前的漫长年代里，虫群派出了无数子群体，而即便到了现在，也只有其中一部分抵达了预定目的地。

在当代，虫群最广为人知的或许有两件重要事实。其一，它们对协约世界和维斯卡里姆发动的进攻，促成了这两大势力停止敌对并结成脆弱联盟。其二，虫群是什伦这一物种的直接祖先。什伦人在Gap期间的某个时期脱离了虫群，并在神祇海拉克斯处获得庇护；人们认为海拉克斯是由某种前虫群时代的虫族进化而来，并背弃了虫群后来演变成的那个贪婪实体。

近年来，虫群一直被视作不过是遥远的梦魇，几乎没有什么活动，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系中那些机密行动。然而，最近对失踪的塞赞迪特世界克雷西斯卡的发现，意外唤醒了一个曾负责吞噬该世界的休眠子群体。自那以后，这个新近被命名为“克雷西斯卡子群体”的存在，已成为近宇的一大灾祸，正积极入侵桑迪特联合体的诸世界，并且势头直指维斯卡里姆、协约世界等其他势力。这支被重新发现的子群体已经开始让其组成部分迅速进化，并依然与更广大的虫群隔绝，但它仍明确构成了近宇的重大威胁。令人胆寒的巴斯托罗克斯是一种生物有机壁垒，能以巨大的几丁质盾牌偏转伤害，同时向敌人射出生物电流。它为克雷西斯卡子群体推进中的组成单位固守阵地，例如大量敏捷的战斗虫。这些生物巨兽只是克雷西斯卡子群体队列中新型演化之一；在罗德纳斯围城战期间，它们也曾投入行动，毫不动摇地穿过那颗世界危机四伏的沼泽地带向前推进。

战斗虫最早是在克雷西斯卡子群体突然现身并首次袭击桑迪特联合体空域时被发现的。这些狼般大小的组成单位能够掘地潜行，以极高速度移动到适合设伏的位置。随后，一旦侦测到威胁，战斗虫便会破土而出，用位于口中的酸液炮猛攻敌人。向敌人倾泻生物酸液的战斗虫越多，这种物质溶解目标的速度就越快，场面也越发痛苦可怖。

克雷西斯卡子群体

克雷西斯卡子群体最初由一名过于急切的什伦星探员发现；在Gap前时代抵达后，它一直蛰伏在已被吞噬、沦为空壳世界的克雷西斯卡之中。子群体一经暴露便迅速苏醒，但由于一连串涉及与灵能调谐的塞赞迪特水晶的事件，这个子群体与那名到来的星探员形成了强大的精神链接。如今，这名前星探员已被虫群彻底同化，成为克雷西斯卡子群体的活体化身；而这个子群体不同于庞大的虫群整体，已成为近宇一个明确且迫在眉睫的威胁。

Developing from an insectile species far out in the Vast known as kucharns, the Swarm are considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of countless different component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and its pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in their reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, their assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm are the direct ancestors of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn, and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman, with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and being poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space. The dreaded bastorox is a bio-organic bulwark that uses an immense chitinous shield to deflect damage while loosing bolts of bioelectricity at foes. It holds positions for advancing Krethiskar subcolony components, such as the multitudes of agile emganats. These biohulks are but one of the new innovations found within the ranks of the Krethiskar subcolony, and they were active during the siege of Rodnarth, where they implacably advanced through that world's treacherous swamps.

Emganats were first encountered during the Krethiskar subcolony's sudden emergence and the first attacks on Szandite Collective space. These wolf-sized components can burrow beneath the ground, moving at great speeds to reach a location where they can set up an ambush. Then, once a threat is detected, the emganat springs forth and lays into its foes with an acidic cannon located in its mouth. The more emganats that unleash their bio-acid on foes, the faster the substance dissolves their targets in an agonizing display.

Krethiskar Subcolony

First discovered by an overeager shirren Starfinder, the Krethiskar subcolony rested in torpor within the consumed huskworld of Krethiskar following its arrival during the pre-Gap era. Once uncovered, the subcolony quickly sprung to life, but thanks to a series of events involved in the psychically attuned Szandite crystals, the subcolony formed a powerful mental link with the Starfinder who had arrived. Now completely subsumed by the Swarm, the former Starfinder has become a living avatar for the Krethiskar subcolony, which unlike the great Swarm, has become a clear and present danger in Near Space.

Makosa (6 Players Easier).name: 马科萨（6名玩家，较简单） Makosa (6 Players Easier)

Shimmersight.name: 微光视觉 Shimmersight
Shimmersight.description:
当位于Shim-Tek矿井内时，Makosa可以感知到100英尺内所有靠近闪晶石的生物。

While within Shim-Tek mine, Makosa can detect any creatures within 100 feet of shimmerstone.

Physical Science Lore.name: 物理科学学识 Physical Science Lore

Quilted Armor.name: 绗缝护甲 Quilted Armor
Quilted Armor.description:
绗缝护甲被制成长外套样式，旨在不搭配其他护甲时用于防护。绗缝护甲覆盖上半身和腿部，使其进一步区别于典型的衬垫内衣。这种护甲常以时尚的颜色或图案制成，以便作为防护性外衣或军装使用。

Quilted armor is built in a long coat intended for defensive use without other armor. Quilted armor protects the upper body and legs, differentiating it further from the typical padded undercoat. This armor is frequently made in stylish colors or patterns to facilitate use as protective outerwear or a military uniform.

Enraging Presence.name: 激怒气场 Enraging Presence
Enraging Presence.description:
30尺。进入或处于该灵光内的非构装生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:35] 豁免。失败时，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑} 1轮，然后在1分钟内获得伤害掷骰的+2状态加值。成功时，该生物在24小时内暂时免疫狂怒威仪。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YWckateVe6dqPs6M]{效果：狂怒威仪}

30 feet. Non-construct creatures entering or within the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:35] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round, then gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune to enraging presence for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YWckateVe6dqPs6M]{Effect: Enraging Presence}

Vitality Network.name: 活力网络 Vitality Network
Vitality Network.description:
马科萨拥有一个生命力网络，可与至多10名已缔结联结的盟友共享，如同他们是一名秘学者（他们当前与房间里的其他闪晶石机器人处于联结状态）。该网络最多可储存75点生命值，并且在战斗开始时为满值。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{效果：生命力网络}

Makosa has a vitality network they share with up to 10 bonded allies as though they were a mystic (they're currently bonded to the other shimmerstone robots in the room). This network can store a maximum of 75 Hit Points and begins combat full.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{Effect: Vitality Network}

Effect: Vitality Network.name: 效果：活力网络 Effect: Vitality Network
Effect: Vitality Network.description:
追踪你当前可用的活力网络。

你的活力网络的最大容量等于 @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] 生命值

Tracks your currently available vitality network.

Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] Hit Points

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Entropy Strike.name: 熵击 Entropy Strike
Entropy Strike.description:
你释放出一道熵射线，使物质迅速且不加区分地衰变。进行一次远程法术攻击。

大成功 目标受到 10d8 点虚空伤害。如果目标具有科技属性，则其还会受到 4d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{目眩 1}。

成功 目标受到 5d8 点虚空伤害。如果目标具有科技属性，则其还会受到 2d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}。

升阶（+1） 初始伤害增加 1d8，且持续性伤害增加 1d6。

You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack.

Critical Success The target takes 10d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 4d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target takes 5d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Gravity Field.name: 重力场 Gravity Field
Gravity Field.description:
区域 30英尺半径、100英尺高的圆柱体

你增强一个区域内的重力作用。区域内所有飞行中的生物下降40英尺。对于飞行中的生物而言，整个区域都是更高难度地形；对于地面上的生物而言，则是困难地形。任何在该区域内以飞行状态结束其回合的生物都会下降20英尺。任何被重力场拖拽到地面的生物都会像坠落了一样受到钝击伤害。该区域内的重力提高一个等级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，而高重力变为极端重力）。

Area 30-foot radius, 100-foot-tall cylinder

You increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature that ends its turn Flying within the area descends 20 feet. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen. Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).

Mind Skewer.name: 心灵串刺 Mind Skewer
Mind Skewer.description:
你用过量的灵能信息或神圣裁决压垮一个生物的心智。这次精神猛攻造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若重击，目标受到 4d6 点精神伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2} 状态，持续 1 轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgements. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 幻影灾厄 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
区域内每个生物的心智中都充满了末日毁灭的幻象。该幻象造成 11d6 点精神伤害（基础意志豁免）。若生物严重失败，它还必须通过一次反射豁免，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂缝中、漂流在海上，或其他与其幻象相符的命运）。如果它第二次豁免失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} 状态，持续 1 分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时再次尝试一次意志豁免；若成功，它便看破该幻觉，并从 Stunned 状态中恢复。

高环阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a Reflex save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the Stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Force Barrage.name: 力场齐射 Force Barrage
Force Barrage.description:
你向一个你看得见的生物发射一枚由凝固魔法形成的碎片。它会自动命中，并造成 1d4+1 点力场伤害。施放该法术时，你每额外使用 1 个动作，发射的碎片数量便增加 1，最多可在花费 3 个动作时发射 3 枚碎片。你分别为每枚碎片选择目标。如果你向同一目标发射多于一枚碎片，则在应用伤害加值或减值、抗性、弱点等之前，先合并伤害。

升阶（+2） 你每花费 1 个动作，便额外发射 1 枚碎片。

You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的能力。它获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}状态，且每轮只能将该额外动作用于进行 Strike 和 Stride 动作。

升阶（7环） 你的目标最多可以是 6 个生物。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

Howl.name: 嚎叫 Howl
Howl.description:
你发出一声充满灵能共振的强力尖啸，迫使其他听到它的人也一同加入。你对区域内其他能听见的生物造成 7d12 音波伤害和 @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。此法术造成的持续精神伤害会因每个受此法术影响且仍在嚎叫的生物而增加 1。正在嚎叫的生物在 1 轮内不能使用听觉动作或施放法术，但隐秘法术除外。请在所有生物都完成豁免后计算持续伤害。

重度成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害，且不受持续精神伤害。

失败 目标受到全额伤害，并且只要其受到持续精神伤害，就会被迫尖叫。

重度失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并且只要其受到持续精神伤害，就会被迫嚎叫

You let out a powerful ululation full of psychic resonance that compels others who hear it to join in. You deal 7d12 sonic damage and @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage to other creatures who can hear within the area. Targets must attempt a Will save. The persistent mental damage from this spell increases by 1 for each creature affected by this spell who remains howling. A howling creature can't use auditory actions or cast spells, except for subtle spells for 1 round. Calculate the persistent damage after all creatures made their saves.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and no persistent mental damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is compelled to scream as long as it takes persistent mental damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is compelled to howl as long as it takes persistent mental damage

Dominate.name: 支配 Dominate
Dominate.description:
你夺取目标的控制权，迫使其服从你的命令。如果你下达明显会导致其自我毁灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令为止。其效果取决于它的意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在奋力抵抗你的命令时，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 你控制目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 状态，但它可以在自己每个回合结束时尝试一次意志豁免。若成功，此法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当你向其下达违背其天性的全新命令时，例如命令它杀死自己的盟友，它才会获得新的豁免。

升阶（10环） 持续时间不限。

You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Share Pain.name: 分担痛苦 Share Pain
Share Pain.description:
你以心灵感应与一个生物共享痛苦折磨的感受。目标受到 3d12 点精神伤害，并进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}。

升阶（6环） 该法术的目标至多变为四个生物，且造成 6d12 点精神伤害。

You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.

Slow.name: 缓慢 Slow
Slow.description:
你使目标周围的时间流膨胀，减缓其动作。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Telekinetic Strangulation.name: 念动力扼杀 Telekinetic Strangulation
Telekinetic Strangulation.description:
你用精神力以铁钳般的紧握攫住一个生物的喉咙或其他要害部位，强行将其抬离地面几英寸，使其在挣扎中难以呼吸。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你造成6d12点钝击伤害，且目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{定身}。目标受到1d12点持续性钝击伤害，在你每轮维持该法术时持续处于定身状态，并且必须继续屏住呼吸。以这种方式被定身时，它必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。目标可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱}（挣脱DC等于你的法术DC，且该挣脱尝试受失能特征影响）。

You psychically grasp a creature's throat or other vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The target takes 1d12 persistent bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized and must continue holding its breath for each round you Sustain the Spell. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the escape DC is your spell DC and the escape attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).

Truesight.name: 真视 Truesight
Truesight.description:
你能看见60英尺内事物的真实样貌。GM会对区域内任何幻觉、变化形态或变形效果进行一次秘密反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功对抗一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的真实形态，但你并不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Chrono Push.name: 时流推击 Chrono Push
Chrono Push.description:
你猛力将一个生物推过战场，强到它会在时间中滑行。进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你将目标沿直线击退 15 尺（若重击，则为 30 尺）。如果被推动的生物接触到坚固障碍物或另一个生物，它的移动便结束。在这次移动结束时，该生物伴随着一阵时间能量的爆发重新进入时间流。目标以及现在与目标相邻的生物必须成功通过一次基础反射豁免，否则受到 7d8 点力场伤害。

You push a creature across the battlefield so hard it slides through time. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, you knock the target back 15 feet in a straight line (30 feet on a critical hit). If the pushed creature contacts a solid barrier or another creature, its movement ends. At the end of this movement, the creature reenters the flow of time with a burst of temporal energy. The target and creatures now adjacent to the target must succeed at a basic Reflex save or take 7d8 force damage.

Command.name: 指挥】【。 Command
Command.description:
你大声下达一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标靠近你、逃跑（仿佛它处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 状态）、放开它正拿着的东西、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} 倒地，或站在原地不动。在服从你的命令之前，它不能 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay}，也不能进行任何反应。效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下一回合中的第一个动作时，该生物必须用一个单动作来按你的命令行事。

大失败 目标在其下一回合中必须用掉其所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你的目标至多可以为 10 个生物。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Control Machine.name: 控制机械 Control Machine
Control Machine.description:
你夺取一个科技生物或物体的控制权，并以心灵感应向其下达命令。如果你向一个有智能的目标下达明显会导致其自我毁灭的命令，则该目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令为止。其效果取决于它的意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} 状态，因为它在奋力抗拒你的命令。

失败 你控制该目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 状态，但它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次意志豁免。若成功，则该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当目标具有智能，且你向其下达了违背其天性的全新命令时，它才会获得一次新的豁免，例如让它杀死自己的盟友。

强化（10环） 持续时间变为无限。

You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously selfdestructive order to a sapient target, the target does not act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Synaptic Pulse.name: 突触脉冲 Synaptic Pulse
Synaptic Pulse.description:
你释放出一阵脉动的精神冲击，穿透区域内所有敌人的心智。区域内的每个敌人都必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入 Stunned，持续 1 轮。

You emit a pulsating mental blast that penetrates the minds of all enemies in the area. Each enemy in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.

Fly.name: 飞行 Fly
Fly.description:
目标可以在空中翱翔，获得等同于其速度或20英尺（取较大者）的飞行速度。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{法术效果：飞行}

升阶（7环） 持续时间增加至1小时。

The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

Telepathy.name: 心灵感应 Telepathy
Telepathy.description:
你可以与30尺内的生物进行心灵感应交流。一旦你通过与某个生物沟通建立了连接，这种交流就是双向的。你只能与和你共享一种语言的生物交流。

升阶（6环） 即使你们不共享语言，你也可以通过共享的心象与生物进行心灵感应交流；心灵感应失去语言特征。

You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet. Once you establish a connection by communicating with a creature, the communication is two-way. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you.

Heightened (6th) You can communicate telepathically with creatures using shared mental imagery even if you don't share a language; telepathy loses the linguistic trait.

Translocate.name: 转位 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你会瞬间将自己，以及你所穿戴和手持的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你视线范围内射程中的一个未被占据的空间。若这会让另一名生物与你一同被带走——即使你是将其装在一个异次元容器中携带——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提高至 1 英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫 1 小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.
