Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Vibe Check.name: 氛围检查 Vibe Check
Vibe Check.description:
你通过将强烈情绪以心灵感应投射到一个生物的心智中，来分享一种情绪。目标进行一次意志豁免。若失败，目标会体验你从以下情绪中选择的一种。

  • 愤怒：在其下一回合，目标将其第一个动作用于攻击最近的生物，即使那是其盟友。
  • 喜悦：目标不能采取任何敌对动作。
  • 恐惧：目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。
  • 悲伤：目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，并突然泪流满面。

强化（4环） 该法术影响20英尺爆发范围内的所有生物。每个生物都必须受到相同情绪的影响。

You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions.

  • Anger: On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
  • Joy: The target cannot take any hostile actions.
  • Fear: The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
  • Sorrow: The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and bursts into tears.

Heightened (4th) The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.

Cleanse Affliction.name: 净除苦难 Cleanse Affliction
Cleanse Affliction.description:
温和的恢复性魔法能够抵消毒素和更复杂病患的效果。选择目标身上的一个折磨，例如诅咒、疾病或毒药。如果其已进展到第一阶段之后，则将其阶段降低一级。此降低效果对于某一特定折磨病例只能应用一次；当其被完全治愈时，该病例结束。尽管该降低效果不能再次发生，但此法术的升阶版本每次施放时都会尝试反制。

升阶（3环） 若该折磨为疾病或毒药，则尝试反制该折磨。

升阶（4环） 若该折磨为诅咒、疾病或毒药，则尝试反制该折磨。

Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

Clear Mind.name: 澄明心智 Clear Mind
Clear Mind.description:
你将精神污染从目标的心智中驱散。尝试反制一个由你选择的、对目标施加以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃离}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌}和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝}。如果你反制该效果失败，但若其反制等级低 2 级你本会成功，则改为将该效果压制至你下个回合开始。该效果被压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。这个法术不能反制或压制作为诅咒、疾病或目标自然状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{受控}和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速}加入状态列表。

升阶（6环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{厄运}加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}加入状态列表。

You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Fear.name: 恐惧 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标心中植入恐惧；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你的目标至多可以为五个生物。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Sound Body.name: 健全体魄 Sound Body
Sound Body.description:
你送出一股治疗能量的激流，以修复目标的身体。尝试反制一个由你选择、对目标施加以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱}，或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}。如果你未能反制该效果，但若其反制等级降低 2 级你本会成功，则改为使该效果受到压制，直到你下一回合开始。该效果在受到压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。

该法术不能反制或压制诅咒、疾病，或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{衰竭} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓} 加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑} 加入状态列表。

You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Augury.name: 占卜术 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放这个法术期间，询问某一特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测最多未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM对以下结果中最合理的判断：好、坏、混合（结果会是好坏参半）和无事（不会有特别好或坏的结果）。

GM进行一次秘密 @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。若失败，结果总是“无事”。这使得人无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果有人在额外一次施放预兆术时询问与第一次施放相同的话题，GM使用第一次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Blur.name: 模糊 Blur
Blur.description:
目标的形体看起来模糊不清。它变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于此效果的性质仍会使目标的位置显而易见，目标不能利用此隐蔽进行躲藏或潜行。

The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Invisibility.name: 隐形 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
幻象使目标周围的光发生弯曲，使其处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态。这使其对所有生物而言都处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉}状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找该目标，从而使其改为对它们处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏}状态。如果目标使用了敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作，它也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动力机动 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一阵念动力的激涌，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某件物品。你可以尝试使用法术攻击检定而非运动检定，对目标执行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{重新定位} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Enfeeble.name: 虚弱化 Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description:
你削弱目标的力量，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1} 状态，直到你下个回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2} 状态，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 3} 状态，持续1分钟。

You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

Mindlink.name: 心灵链结 Mindlink
Mindlink.description:
你将自己的心智与目标的心智相连，并在一瞬间以心灵方式向该目标传达原本需要 10 分钟才能交流的信息量。

You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

Protection.name: 防护 Protection
Protection.description:
你为一个生物施加防护，使其免受伤害。目标获得对护甲等级和豁免检定的 +1 状态加值。

升阶（3环） 你可以选择让这些增益也影响目标周围 @Template[emanation|distance:10] 内的所有盟友。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{法术效果：防护}

You ward a creature against harm. The target gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose to have the benefits also affect all your allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the target.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

Sure Strike.name: 精准强袭 Sure Strike
Sure Strike.description:
对未来的一瞥可确保你的下一击命中无误。在你的回合结束前，你下一次进行攻击检定时，掷两次攻击并取较好的结果。此次攻击无视攻击检定的处境减值，以及因目标处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏}而需要进行的任何平检。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：百发百中}

A glimpse into the future ensures your next blow strikes true. The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll the attack twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一阵脉冲，以探知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM判定。

升阶（4环） 如3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的来源。与模糊感知类似，你不会得知其精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体内（若其大于此范围，则为最近的一个5尺立方体）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Eldritch Lance.name: 奥术长矛 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将一束源自群星之间黑暗空隙、侵袭心智的诡异能量凝聚起来，并将其射向目标。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你命中，则造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若为重击成功，则造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Injury Echo.name: 伤痛回响 Injury Echo
Injury Echo.description:
你将来自未来或过去的一处伤势显现出来，以在当下伤害一个生物。选择：钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。目标受到所选类型的 1d6 伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免失败，并在你的下个回合结束前受到同类型的伤害，则它还会额外受到 @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加 1d6，且失败时的持续伤害增加 1d4。

You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d6 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你制造出一个光球，在你选择的颜色下，于20尺半径内发出明亮光照（接下来的20尺为微光）。如果你在一个自愿生物所处的同一空间内制造该光，你可以将这道光附着在该生物身上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以通过维持该法术将这道光移动最多60尺；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将其附着到一个生物身上或使其脱离。

你可以解散该法术。如果你在已经有四个光亮法术生效时再次施放该法术，你必须选择一个现有法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮}

升阶（4环） 该光球在60尺半径内发出光照（接下来的60尺为微光）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Message.name: 消息 Message
Message.description:
你轻声默念话语，但这些话并不会从你的口中说出，而是直接传送到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话，就像你平常只是动嘴不出声一样，但目标听见你的话时，就仿佛正站在你身旁。若其愿意，目标可以用一个反应作出简短回应，或在其下个回合以一个自由动作回应，但其必须能够看见你且位于射程内才能这样做。若其作出回应，其回应会像最初的信息一样，直接传入你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Void Warp.name: 虚空扭曲 Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
你呼唤虚空来伤害生命力。目标受到 2d4 点虚空伤害，并进行一次基础强韧豁免。若严重失败，目标还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1} 状态，直到你下个回合开始。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Fill Vitality.name: 填充活力 Fill Vitality
Fill Vitality.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 玛科萨使其活力网络恢复 10 点生命值，最多恢复至其上限。

Frequency once per round

Effect Makosa restores 10 Hit Points to their vitality network, up to its maximum.

Refract Spell.name: 折射法术 Refract Spell
Refract Spell.description:
如果马科萨接下来使用的动作是施放一个具有区域、射程或目标的法术，则该法术会从其100英尺内的一处闪晶石源头显现，而非从其自身显现。如果这块闪晶石是某个生物的一部分（例如闪晶石机器人），马科萨必须与该生物建立了纽带。

If the next action Makosa uses is to Cast a Spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one source of shimmerstone within 100 feet of them instead of from themself. If this shimmerstone is part of a creature (such as a shimmerstone robot), Makosa must be bonded with that creature.

Transfer Vitality.name: 转移活力 Transfer Vitality
Transfer Vitality.description:
Makosa 将其生命力网络中的任意数量生命值恢复给一个可见的连结目标。

Makosa restores any number of Hit Points from their vitality network to a visible bonded target.

Trample.name: 践踏 Trample
Trample.description:
大型或更小，足部，@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Large or smaller, foot, @Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Makosa (6 Players Easier).blurb:
无性别科萨玛人秘学者
Agender kothama mystic

Shimmerstone Mech (Easier).name: 闪晶石机甲（较简单） Shimmerstone Mech (Easier)

Power Up.name: 充能 Power Up
Power Up.description:
触发条件 战斗开始

效果 机甲在启动时发出低鸣。随后，该陷阱进行先攻检定。

Trigger Combat begins

Effect The mech hums as it powers up. The trap then rolls initiative.

Missile Barrage.name: 导弹齐射 Missile Barrage
Missile Barrage.description:
陷阱发射一阵导弹，对其 200 英尺内一个 @Template[type:burst|distance:30] 中的所有生物造成 @Damage[4d12[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] 豁免）。若豁免失败，目标还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 1 轮（若严重失败，则改为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 1 轮）。

The trap fires a barrage of missiles, dealing @Damage[4d12[piercing]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] within 200 feet of it (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save). On a failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure).

Shimmerstone Mech (Easier).disable:
@Check[arcana|dc:38] 或 @Check[occultism|dc:38]（专家）以从马科萨手中夺取机甲的控制权，@Check[computers|dc:36]（专家）以重新编程机甲，或 @Check[crafting|dc:34] 或 @Check[thievery|dc:34]（专家）以使其失效；总共需要两次成功才能停用该陷阱。

@Check[arcana|dc:38] or @Check[occultism|dc:38] (expert) to wrest control of the mech from Makosa, @Check[computers|dc:36] (expert) to reprogram the mech, or @Check[crafting|dc:34] or @Check[thievery|dc:34] (expert) to disable it; two total successes are required to disable the trap.
Shimmerstone Mech (Easier).hazarddescription:
一个由闪晶石和钢铁构成的巨型构装体已被部分从地底挖掘出来。

A gargantuan construct of shimmerstone and steel has been partially excavated from the ground.
Shimmerstone Mech (Easier).routine:
（2个动作）该陷阱要么用2个动作发射一次飞弹齐射，要么用2个动作以其激光束或剑鞭进行打击。它会专注于攻击玛科萨的目标。

(2 actions) The trap either uses 2 actions to fire a Missile Barrage or uses 2 actions to make Strikes with its laser beam or sword whip. It focuses on targets that attack Makosa.

Heliacal Maw Stellar Hulk.name: 太阳初升之巨口恒星巨兽 Heliacal Maw Stellar Hulk
Heliacal Maw Stellar Hulk.tokenName: 赫利阿卡尔巨口星辰残骸 Heliacal Maw Stellar Hulk

Fused Gatling Gun Bash.name: 融合加特林枪猛击 Fused Gatling Gun Bash

Fused Gatling Gun.name: 融合加特林炮 Fused Gatling Gun

Bash Fire.name: 猛击火焰 Bash Fire
Bash Fire.description:
恒星巨械对一个目标进行一次枪托猛击打击，然后立刻对同一目标进行一次融合加特林机枪远程打击。这些攻击会正常计入其多重攻击减值，但在“猛击开火”完成之前，该减值不会增加。

The stellar hulk makes a gun bash Strike against a target and then immediately makes a fused gatling gun ranged Strike against the same target. The attacks count toward its multiple attack penalty normally, but the penalty doesn't increase until after Bash Fire is complete.

Chain Fire.name: 连锁火力 Chain Fire
Chain Fire.description:
星际巨兽用它的两挺加特林枪进行自动射击。照常结算自动射击，但伤害为 @Damage[(5d8+18)[piercing]]。星际巨兽必须先重新装填，才能再次发射它的加特林枪。

The stellar hulk Auto-Fires with both of its gatling guns. Resolve Auto-Fire as normal, but the damage is @Damage[(5d8+18)[piercing]]. The stellar hulk must reload before it can fire its gatling guns again.

Heliacal Maw Stellar Hulk.prototypeToken: 太阳升起时之巨口 恒星巨舰 Heliacal Maw Stellar Hulk

Makosa (4-5 Players Easier).name: 马科萨（4-5名玩家，更简单） Makosa (4-5 Players Easier)

Shimmersight.name: 微光视觉 Shimmersight
Shimmersight.description:
在位于Shim-Tek矿井内时，马科萨可以侦测到100英尺内任何靠近闪晶石的生物。

While within Shim-Tek mine, Makosa can detect any creatures within 100 feet of shimmerstone.

Physical Science Lore.name: 物理科学知识 Physical Science Lore

Quilted Armor.name: 绗缝护甲 Quilted Armor
Quilted Armor.description:
绗缝护甲制成长外套样式，旨在无需搭配其他护甲也可用于防御。绗缝护甲覆盖上半身和腿部，这使其进一步区别于典型的衬垫内衣。此护甲常以时尚的颜色或图案制成，以便作为防护外衣或军装使用。

Quilted armor is built in a long coat intended for defensive use without other armor. Quilted armor protects the upper body and legs, differentiating it further from the typical padded undercoat. This armor is frequently made in stylish colors or patterns to facilitate use as protective outerwear or a military uniform.

Enraging Presence.name: 激怒气场 Enraging Presence
Enraging Presence.description:
30英尺。进入或处于该灵光内的非构装生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:35] 豁免。若失败，该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑} 1轮，然后在1分钟内获得伤害掷骰的+2状态加值。若成功，该生物在24小时内暂时免疫激怒存在。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YWckateVe6dqPs6M]{效果：激怒存在}

30 feet. Non-construct creatures entering or within the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:35] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round, then gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune to enraging presence for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YWckateVe6dqPs6M]{Effect: Enraging Presence}

Vitality Network.name: 活力网络 Vitality Network
Vitality Network.description:
Makosa拥有一个生命力网络，他们可与最多10名缔结联结的盟友共享，如同他们是一名秘学者（他们目前与房间里的其他闪晶石机器人缔结了联结）。该网络最多可储存75点生命值，并在战斗开始时为满值。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{效果：生命力网络}

Makosa has a vitality network they share with up to 10 bonded allies as though they were a mystic (they're currently bonded to the other shimmerstone robots in the room). This network can store a maximum of 75 Hit Points and begins combat full.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.R0mn1iC3nYvDVKhd]{Effect: Vitality Network}

Effect: Vitality Network.name: 效果：活力网络 Effect: Vitality Network
Effect: Vitality Network.description:
追踪你当前可用的活力网络。

你的活力网络的最大容量等于 @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] 生命值

Tracks your currently available vitality network.

Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to @Damage[(6+(4*(@actor.level)))] Hit Points

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Entropy Strike.name: 熵击 Entropy Strike
Entropy Strike.description:
你释放出一道熵射线，使物质迅速且不加区分地衰变。进行一次远程法术攻击。

重击成功 目标受到 10d8 点虚空伤害。若目标是科技类，它还会受到 4d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

成功 目标受到 5d8 点虚空伤害。若目标是科技类，它还会受到 2d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}。

升阶（+1） 初始伤害增加 1d8，持续性伤害增加 1d6。

You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack.

Critical Success The target takes 10d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 4d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target takes 5d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Gravity Field.name: 重力场 Gravity Field
Gravity Field.description:
区域 30 英尺半径、100 英尺高的圆柱

你增强一个区域内的重力作用。区域内所有飞行中的生物下降 40 英尺。对飞行中的生物而言，整个区域都是更强困难地形；对地面上的生物而言，则是困难地形。任何在该区域内以飞行状态结束其回合的生物都会下降 20 英尺。任何被重力场拖拽到地面的生物都会受到钝击伤害，如同其曾经坠落一样。该区域内的重力提高一级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，而高重力变为极端重力）。

Area 30-foot radius, 100-foot-tall cylinder

You increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature that ends its turn Flying within the area descends 20 feet. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen. Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).

Mind Skewer.name: 心灵穿刺 Mind Skewer
Mind Skewer.description:
你用过量的灵能信息或神圣裁决令一个生物的心智超载。这次精神冲击造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若重击成功，目标受到 4d6 点精神伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2} 1 轮。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgements. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 幻影灾劫 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日般毁灭的幻象充斥区域内每个生物的心灵。该幻象造成 11d6 点精神伤害（基础意志豁免）。若重度失败，该生物还必须成功通过一次反射豁免，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂缝中、漂流在海上，或其他与其幻象相符的命运）。如果第二次豁免失败，它还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} 状态，持续 1 分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时再次尝试一次新的意志豁免，若成功，则看破该幻觉并从 Stunned 状态中恢复。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高 2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a Reflex save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the Stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Force Barrage.name: 原力连射 Force Barrage
Force Barrage.description:
你朝一个你能看见的生物发射一枚由凝固魔法构成的碎片。它会自动命中，并造成 1d4+1 点力场伤害。施放该法术时，你每额外使用 1 个动作，发射的碎片数量便增加 1，至多在使用 3 个动作时发射 3 枚碎片。你可以分别为每枚碎片选择目标。如果你将多于一枚碎片射向同一目标，则在应用伤害加值或减值、抗性、弱点等之前，先合并这些伤害。

强化（+2） 你每花费 1 个动作，便额外发射 1 枚碎片。

You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的能力。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}状态，并且每轮获得的额外动作只能用于Strike和Stride动作。

升阶（7环） 你的目标最多可以指定6个生物。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

Howl.name: 嚎叫 Howl
Howl.description:
你发出一声充满灵能共振的强力长嚎，迫使听到它的其他人也一同嚎叫。你对区域内其他能够听见的生物造成 7d12 音波伤害 和 @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] 伤害。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。此法术造成的持续精神伤害会因每个受此法术影响且仍在嚎叫的生物而增加 1。嚎叫中的生物在 1 轮内无法使用听觉动作或施放法术，除非是隐秘法术。在所有生物完成豁免后，再计算持续伤害。

重度成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害，且不受持续精神伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并且只要其承受持续精神伤害，就会被迫尖叫。

重度失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并且只要其承受持续精神伤害，就会被迫嚎叫。

You let out a powerful ululation full of psychic resonance that compels others who hear it to join in. You deal 7d12 sonic damage and @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage to other creatures who can hear within the area. Targets must attempt a Will save. The persistent mental damage from this spell increases by 1 for each creature affected by this spell who remains howling. A howling creature can't use auditory actions or cast spells, except for subtle spells for 1 round. Calculate the persistent damage after all creatures made their saves.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and no persistent mental damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is compelled to scream as long as it takes persistent mental damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is compelled to howl as long as it takes persistent mental damage

Dominate.name: 支配 Dominate
Dominate.description:
你控制目标，迫使其服从你的命令。如果你下达一个明显会自我毁灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令。其效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在奋力抵抗你的命令时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 你控制目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 状态，但它可以在其每个回合结束时进行一次意志豁免。若成功，该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当你给它下达一个违背其本性的全新命令时，它才会获得一次新的豁免，例如杀死它的盟友。

升阶（10环） 持续时间无限。

You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Share Pain.name: 分担痛楚 Share Pain
Share Pain.description:
你以心灵感应与一个生物分享极度痛苦的感觉。目标受到 3d12 点精神伤害，并进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}。

大失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 2}。

升阶（6环） 该法术的目标改为至多四个生物，且造成 6d12 点精神伤害。

You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.

Slow.name: 缓慢 Slow
Slow.description:
你扭曲目标周围的时间流动，减缓其动作。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1} 状态，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 2} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

升阶（6环） 你的目标至多可以为 10 个生物。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Telekinetic Strangulation.name: 念动力扼杀 Telekinetic Strangulation
Telekinetic Strangulation.description:
你用心灵力量以虎钳般的紧握扼住一个生物的喉咙或其他要害部位，强行将其抬离地面几英寸，使其在挣扎中难以呼吸。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，你造成 6d12 钝击伤害，且目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{无法移动}。目标受到 1d12 持续性钝击伤害，在你每轮维持该法术时继续处于无法移动状态，并且必须持续屏住呼吸。以这种方式无法移动时，它必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。目标可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{脱身}（脱身 DC 等于你的法术 DC，且此次脱身尝试受失能特征影响）。

You psychically grasp a creature's throat or other vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage and the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The target takes 1d12 persistent bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized and must continue holding its breath for each round you Sustain the Spell. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the escape DC is your spell DC and the escape attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).

Truesight.name: 真视术 Truesight
Truesight.description:
你能看见60英尺内事物的真实样貌。GM对区域内任何幻觉、变形或变身效果进行一次秘密反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若此次检定成功对抗一个变身法术，你可以看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变身法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Chrono Push.name: 时流推压 Chrono Push
Chrono Push.description:
你将一个生物猛力推过战场，强到让它滑穿时间。进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你将目标沿直线击退15英尺（重击命中时为30英尺）。如果被推动的生物接触到坚固的障碍物或另一生物，它的移动便会结束。在这段移动结束时，该生物会伴随着一阵时间能量重新进入时间流。目标以及现在与目标相邻的生物必须成功通过一次基础反射豁免，否则受到7d8点力场伤害。

You push a creature across the battlefield so hard it slides through time. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, you knock the target back 15 feet in a straight line (30 feet on a critical hit). If the pushed creature contacts a solid barrier or another creature, its movement ends. At the end of this movement, the creature reenters the flow of time with a burst of temporal energy. The target and creatures now adjacent to the target must succeed at a basic Reflex save or take 7d8 force damage.

Command.name: 指挥### Command
Command.description:
你发出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标靠近你、逃跑（如同它处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 状态）、放开它手中的物品、卧倒为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，或原地不动。在它服从你的命令之前，它不能 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay}，也不能进行任何反应。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在它下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单独动作来照你的命令行事。

大失败 目标在它的下个回合中必须用尽其所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你的目标最多可以为10个生物。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Control Machine.name: 控制机械 Control Machine
Control Machine.description:
你控制一个科技生物或物体，并以心灵感应向其下达命令。如果你向一个有智能的目标下达明显自我毁灭的命令，则该目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令。该效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}，因为它在奋力抵抗你的命令。

失败 你控制目标。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 状态，但它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次意志豁免。若成功，则该法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当目标具有智能且你向它下达了违背其天性的新的命令时，它才会获得一次新的豁免，例如杀死它的盟友。

强化（10环） 持续时间无限。

You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously selfdestructive order to a sapient target, the target does not act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

Synaptic Pulse.name: 突触脉冲 Synaptic Pulse
Synaptic Pulse.description:
你释放出一道脉动的精神爆破，穿透区域内所有敌人的心智。区域内的每个敌人都必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入 Stunned，持续 1 轮。

You emit a pulsating mental blast that penetrates the minds of all enemies in the area. Each enemy in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.

Fly.name: 飞行 Fly
Fly.description:
目标能够在空中翱翔，获得等同于其速度或 20 英尺的飞行速度，以较高者为准。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{法术效果：飞行}

升阶（7环） 持续时间增加至 1 小时。

The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

Telepathy.name: 心灵感应 Telepathy
Telepathy.description:
你可以与30尺内的生物进行心灵感应交流。一旦你通过与某个生物交流建立连接，这种交流就是双向的。你只能与和你共享一种语言的生物交流。

强化（6环） 即使你们不共享语言，你也可以通过共享的心象与生物进行心灵感应交流；telepathy 失去语言特征。

You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet. Once you establish a connection by communicating with a creature, the communication is two-way. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you.

Heightened (6th) You can communicate telepathically with creatures using shared mental imagery even if you don't share a language; telepathy loses the linguistic trait.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你会立即将自己，以及你正穿戴和持持有的任何物品，从你当前所处的空间传送到你视野内、位于射程之内的一处未被占据的空间。若这会让另一名生物与你一同传送——即使你是将其装在异次元容器中携带——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提升至1英里。你不需要能够看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后，你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Vibe Check.name: 状态检查 Vibe Check
Vibe Check.description:
你通过将强烈的情绪以心灵感应投射进一个生物的心智，来分享一种情绪。目标尝试一次意志豁免。若失败，目标会体验你从以下情绪中选择的一种。

  • 愤怒：在其下一回合中，目标将其第一个动作用于攻击最近的生物，即使那是其盟友。
  • 喜悦：目标不能采取任何敌对动作。
  • 恐惧：目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。
  • 悲伤：目标处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，并且泪流满面。

升阶（4环） 该法术影响20尺爆发内的所有生物。每个生物都必须受到相同情绪的影响。

You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions.

  • Anger: On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
  • Joy: The target cannot take any hostile actions.
  • Fear: The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
  • Sorrow: The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and bursts into tears.

Heightened (4th) The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.

Cleanse Affliction.name: 净化苦难 Cleanse Affliction
Cleanse Affliction.description:
柔和的恢复性魔法会击退毒素和更复杂病患的效果。选择目标身上的一种折磨，例如诅咒、疾病或毒药。如果它已进展超过第一阶段，则将其阶段降低一级。此降低对于某一特定案例的折磨只能应用一次，而该案例会在其被完全治愈时结束。尽管这种降低不能再次发生，但此法术的升阶版本每次施放时都会尝试进行反制。

升阶（3环） 如果该折磨是疾病或毒药，则尝试反制该折磨。

升阶（4环） 如果该折磨是诅咒、疾病或毒药，则尝试反制该折磨。

Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.

Clear Mind.name: 澄明心智 Clear Mind
Clear Mind.description:
你将精神污染从目标的心智中驱散。尝试反制一个由你选择的、正在对目标施加以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌}和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝}。如果你反制该效果失败了，但若其反制等级低 2 级你本会成功，则改为将该效果压制，直到你下一回合开始。该效果被压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。这个法术不能反制或压制作为诅咒、疾病或目标自然状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{混乱}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{受控}和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{减速}加入状态列表。

升阶（6环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{厄运}加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}加入状态列表。

You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Fear.name: 恐惧 Fear
Fear.description:
你向目标心中植入恐惧；它必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 1轮。

升阶（3环） 你的目标至多可以是五个生物。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Sound Body.name: 健全之躯 Sound Body
Sound Body.description:
你释放出一股治疗性能量，以修复目标的身体。尝试对消一个由你选择的、使目标陷入以下状态之一的效果：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱}，或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}。如果你未能对消该效果，但若其对消环阶低 2 环你本会成功，则改为使该效果受到压制，直到你的下个回合开始为止。该效果在受到压制期间，其持续时间不会流逝。

该法术不能对消或压制诅咒、疾病，或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{汲取} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓} 加入状态列表。

升阶（8环） 将 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑} 加入状态列表。

You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (8th) Add @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} to the list of conditions.

Augury.name: 占卜预兆 Augury
Augury.description:
你对未来有了模糊的一瞥。在施放此法术期间，询问某一特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测至多未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM对以下结果中最可能情况的最佳判断：好、坏、好坏参半（结果将是好与坏的混合），以及无事（不会有特别好或特别坏的结果）。

GM进行一次秘密的 @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。若失败，结果总是“无事”。这使得人们无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果在额外一次施放中，有人询问与第一次施放预兆术相同的话题，GM使用第一次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Blur.name: 模糊 Blur
Blur.description:
目标的形体显得模糊。它变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于该效果的本质仍会让目标的位置显而易见，目标不能利用这种隐蔽来进行躲藏或潜行。

The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
幻象使光线绕过目标，从而使其变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这使其对所有生物都处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{未察觉} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其改为对它们处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐蔽} 状态。若目标使用了敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作，它不会因此结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动力操弄 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一阵念动力的爆发，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某件物品。你可以尝试对目标进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{重新定位} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}，并使用法术攻击检定代替 Athletics 检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Enfeeble.name: 虚弱化 Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description:
你削弱目标的力量，效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1} 状态，直到你下个回合开始。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 2} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 3} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

Mindlink.name: 心灵链接 Mindlink
Mindlink.description:
你将自己的心智与目标的心智相连，并在一瞬间以心灵方式向该目标传达原本需要 10 分钟才能沟通的信息量。

You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

Protection.name: 防护 Protection
Protection.description:
你保护一个生物免受伤害。目标获得对护甲等级和豁免检定的 +1 状态加值。

升阶（3环） 你也可以选择让这些增益同时影响目标周围 @Template[emanation|distance:10] 内的所有盟友。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{法术效果：防护}

You ward a creature against harm. The target gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose to have the benefits also affect all your allies in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around the target.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

Sure Strike.name: 强袭确保 Sure Strike
Sure Strike.description:
对未来的惊鸿一瞥确保你的下一击精准命中。你下次在你的回合结束前进行攻击检定时，进行两次攻击检定并采用较好的结果。此次攻击无视对此次攻击检定的环境减值，以及因目标处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐藏}而需要进行的任何平检。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：必胜打击}

A glimpse into the future ensures your next blow strikes true. The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll the attack twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

强化（3环） 你会得知该法术侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM判定。

强化（4环） 如3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的源头。与用于一种不精确感官时相同，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将源头缩小到一个5尺立方体内（若其大于此范围，则为距离最近的那个5尺立方体）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Eldritch Lance.name: 奥术长枪 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将来自群星之间黑暗空间的、侵袭心智的异界能量凝聚成一道光束，并向一个目标发射。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你命中，则造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若你获得重击成功，则造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Injury Echo.name: 伤痛回响 Injury Echo
Injury Echo.description:
你将来自未来或过去的一处伤势显现于现在，以伤害一个生物。选择：钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。目标受到 1d6 所选类型的伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免失败，且在你下个回合结束前受到同类型的伤害，则它还会额外受到 @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。

强化（+2） 初始伤害增加 1d6，且失败时的持续伤害增加 1d4。

You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d6 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

Light.name: 光 Light
Light.description:
你创造一个光球，在你选择的颜色中，于20英尺半径内发出明亮光照（接下来的20英尺为微光）。如果你在一个自愿生物的同一空间内创造这道光，你可以将其附着在该生物身上，使其在该生物移动时漂浮在其附近。你可以维持该法术，将这道光移动至多60英尺；你可以将其附着到一个生物身上或使其脱离，作为此次移动的一部分。

你可以解消该法术。如果你在已经有四个光亮法术生效时施放该法术，你必须选择一个现有法术使其结束。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮}

升阶（4环） 该光球在60英尺半径内发光（接下来的60英尺为微光）。

You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Message.name: 讯息 Message
Message.description:
你轻声做出口型，但这些话并不会从你口中说出，而是直接传送到目标的耳中。对其他人而言，你的话并不比你平常只做口型时更容易听见；但对目标而言，他们能听见你的话，就像站在你身边一样。目标可以用一个反应作出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在其下一回合中以一个自由动作回应，但他们必须能够看见你且位于范围内才能这么做。如果他们回应，他们的回答会像原始讯息一样，直接传送到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的范围增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Void Warp.name: 虚空扭曲 Void Warp
Void Warp.description:
你呼唤虚空来伤害生命力。目标受到 2d4 点虚空伤害，并进行一次基础强韧豁免。若严重失败，目标还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 1} 状态，直到你的下一回合开始。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Fill Vitality.name: 充盈活力 Fill Vitality
Fill Vitality.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 玛科萨为其活力网络恢复 10 点生命值，最高恢复至其上限。

Frequency once per round

Effect Makosa restores 10 Hit Points to their vitality network, up to its maximum.

Refract Spell.name: 折射法术 Refract Spell
Refract Spell.description:
如果玛科萨接下来使用的动作是施放一个具有区域、射程或目标的法术，则该法术会从100英尺内的一处闪晶石源头显现，而非从其自身显现。若这块闪晶石是某个生物的一部分（例如闪晶石机器人），玛科萨必须与该生物建立了联结。

If the next action Makosa uses is to Cast a Spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one source of shimmerstone within 100 feet of them instead of from themself. If this shimmerstone is part of a creature (such as a shimmerstone robot), Makosa must be bonded with that creature.

Transfer Vitality.name: 转移活力 Transfer Vitality
Transfer Vitality.description:
马科萨从其活力网络中恢复任意数量的生命值给一个可见的联结目标。

Makosa restores any number of Hit Points from their vitality network to a visible bonded target.

Trample.name: 践踏 Trample
Trample.description:
大型或更小，足部，@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Large or smaller, foot, @Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Makosa (4-5 Players Easier).blurb:
无性别科萨玛人秘学者
Agender kothama mystic

Sihedron Guard Trooper.name: 七芒星卫队士兵 Sihedron Guard Trooper
Sihedron Guard Trooper.tokenName: 七芒星卫队士兵 Sihedron Guard Troopers

Sihedron Guard Armor.name: 七芒星卫队护甲 Sihedron Guard Armor
Sihedron Guard Armor.description:
升级： 1

这种传统护甲由层层叠加、既灵活又坚固的甲片构成，由卡斯卓韦上的拉申塔人骑兵穿戴。过去，shotalashu骑兵会用其坐骑蜕下的皮革锻造自己的护甲；更少见的情况下，则会使用阵亡坐骑的皮革，以在未来的战斗中向它们致敬。

Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles.

Darkvision Visor.name: 黑暗视觉护目镜 Darkvision Visor
Darkvision Visor.description:
这款面罩包覆着你的视觉器官，增强你的天生感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.

Aeon Stone (Consumed).name: 永劫石（已消耗） Aeon Stone (Consumed)
Aeon Stone (Consumed).description:
数千年来，这些神秘而切工精巧的宝石一直被秘学者与狂热者珍藏，希望揭开它们的秘密。尽管它们形态各异、功能不一，但据称这些石头全都是异界实体在太古时代用来构筑物质宇宙的水晶工具碎片。

当你为这些经过精确塑形的水晶之一进行共鸣灌注时，这颗石头会环绕你的头部旋转，而非佩戴在身体上。你可以用一个交互动作收起一枚永世石，而一枚正在环绕的石头可以被他人通过对你成功施展的缴械动作从空中夺走。被收起或移除的石头仍保持已灌注状态，但其效果会受到压制，直到你再次让它环绕在你的头部周围。

永世石有多种类型，各自拥有不同的外观和魔法效果。每一枚永世石在嵌入一种名为寻路仪的特殊魔法物品时，还会获得一种共鸣能力。

一枚已耗尽的永世石是一块失去了魔法属性的黯淡石块。它仍会像其他永世石一样绕着你的头旋转，因此也可以作为某些以物体为目标的法术的一种时髦且免手持的选择。

这枚永世石没有共鸣能力。

Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a wayfinder.

A consumed aeon stone is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object.

This aeon stone has no resonant power.

Elusive Maneuver.name: 难以捉摸的机动 Elusive Maneuver
Elusive Maneuver.description:
触发 士兵受到一次远程打击或法术造成的伤害

效果士兵@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Steps}或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{掩护}。

Trigger The trooper takes damage from a ranged Strike or spell

EffectThe trooper @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Steps} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Takes Cover}.

Coordinated Fire.name: 协同火力 Coordinated Fire
Coordinated Fire.description:
在士兵对一个目标尝试进行一次Strike之后（无论成功还是失败），该士兵的一名盟友随后对同一目标进行的下一次Strike，其攻击检定获得+2处境加值。若一次因协同火力而获得加值的Strike命中，则目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}，直到进行攻击的盟友的下一回合结束。

After the trooper attempts a Strike against a target (regardless of success or failure), the next Strike one of the trooper's allies makes against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. If a Strike with a bonus from coordinated fire hits, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{suppressed} until the end of the attacking ally's next turn.

Sharpshooter.name: 神射手 Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.description:
当士兵对因次等掩护或标准掩护而获得 AC 加值的目标进行一次远程打击时，该目标的 AC 加值对此次打击减少 1。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.fO2TefkI6oundpRm]{效果：神射手}

When the trooper makes a ranged Strike against a target with an AC bonus from lesser or standard cover, they reduce that AC bonus by 1 for that Strike.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.fO2TefkI6oundpRm]{Effect: Sharpshooter}

Show No Mercy.name: 绝不留情 Show No Mercy
Show No Mercy.description:
士兵对受压制目标的伤害掷骰获得 +2 处境加值。

The trooper gains a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against suppressed targets.

Sihedron Guard Trooper.prototypeToken: 七芒星卫队士兵 Sihedron Guard Troopers

Ravenous Invisibility.name: 贪婪隐形术 Ravenous Invisibility
Ravenous Invisibility.description:
玻璃蛇天生处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0qyML]{隐形}状态。 当玻璃蛇进行任何一种敌对动作时，在其身体部分短暂变得可触及的情况下，直到其下一回合开始前，它变为@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{隐蔽}而非未被察觉。吞下一个生物的玻璃蛇会在接下来的一天内显形，因为它正在消化猎物。若被吞下的生物逃脱或以其他方式被移除，玻璃蛇会立即恢复为隐形。

The glass serpent is naturally @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. When a glass serpent takes a hostile action of any kind, it is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} instead of undetected until the start of its next turn, as parts of its body become momentarily tangible. A glass serpent that has swallowed a creature becomes visible for the next day as its meal is digested. If the swallowed creature escapes or is otherwise removed, the glass serpent immediately returns to being invisible.

Ambush.name: 伏击 Ambush
Ambush.description:
触发条件 一个生物进入玻璃蛇 20 尺内，且尚未察觉到玻璃蛇

效果 玻璃蛇猛然从藏身处扑出。它直接朝触发的生物疾奔，并对其进行一次颚击打击。目标对此次攻击处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} 状态。

Trigger A creature passes within 20 feet of the glass serpent and has not detected the glass serpent

Effect The glass serpent lunges out of hiding. It Strides directly toward the triggering creature and makes a jaws Strike against it. The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to this attack.

Concealing Coil.name: 隐匿线圈 Concealing Coil
Concealing Coil.description:
需求 玻璃巨蛇的上一个动作是一次以尾鞭进行的成功打击

效果 被玻璃巨蛇命中的生物，对除玻璃巨蛇之外的所有生物而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，直到该生物移出玻璃巨蛇的触及范围，或直到玻璃巨蛇下个回合开始。

Requirements The glass serpent's last action was a successful Strike with a tail whip

Effect The creature the glass serpent hit is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from all creatures except the glass serpent until that creature moves out of the glass serpent's reach or until the start of the glass serpent's next turn.

Captain Phaedra Firestorm.name: 菲德拉·火风暴船长 Captain Phaedra Firestorm
Captain Phaedra Firestorm.tokenName: 菲德拉·火风暴船长 Captain Phaedra Firestorm

Magazine (Semi-Auto Pistol).name: 弹匣（半自动手枪） Magazine (Semi-Auto Pistol)

Armored Coat.name: 装甲外套 Armored Coat
Armored Coat.description:
升级： 1

这件大衣由真皮或合成皮革制成，并以装甲板加固。装甲外套通常会量身定制，以符合穿戴者的个人风格。标准版本则作为制服的一部分配发给军官。

Upgrades: 1

This overcoat is made of real or synthetic leather and reinforced with armored plates. Armored coats are often tailor-made to match the wearer's personal style. Standard versions are issued to military officers as part of their uniforms.

Kill Steal.name: 抢尾刀 Kill Steal
Kill Steal.description:
触发条件 一名盟友成功对一个菲德拉能看见且位于她30英尺内的敌人进行一次打击

效果 菲德拉对被该触发性打击伤害到的敌人进行一次远程打击。

Trigger An ally successfully Strikes a foe who Phaedra can see and is within 30 feet of her

Effect Phaedra makes a ranged Strike against the foe damaged by the triggering Strike.

Vitriolic Swing.name: 酸蚀挥击 Vitriolic Swing
Vitriolic Swing.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 火暴船长对邻近的一个敌人吐出一句尖刻的辱骂，尝试进行一次欺骗检定以 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{佯攻}，或进行一次威吓检定以 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{威吓} 该敌人。然后，她对该生物进行一次近战打击。若此次佯攻或威吓成功，她的打击额外造成 1d4 点精神伤害。

Frequency once per round

Effect Captain Firestorm spits a cutting insult at an adjacent foe, attempting either a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} or an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} them. Then, she makes a melee Strike against that creature. If the Feint or Demoralize was successful, her Strike deals an additional 1d4 mental damage.

Darkvision Visor.name: 黑暗视觉面罩 Darkvision Visor
Darkvision Visor.description:
这副面罩环绕你的视觉器官，增强你天生的感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.

Captain Phaedra Firestorm.prototypeToken: 菲德拉·火风暴船长 Captain Phaedra Firestorm

Corpse Fleet Officer.name: 尸骸舰队军官 Corpse Fleet Officer
Corpse Fleet Officer.tokenName: 尸骸舰队军官 Corpse Fleet Officer

Corpse Fleet Lore.name: 尸骸舰队知识 Corpse Fleet Lore

Bolstering Aura.name: 强化灵光 Bolstering Aura
Bolstering Aura.description:
仅仅是一名尸骸舰队军官的存在，就会强化其指挥下的不死生物。回合开始时位于该灵光内的不死生物（包括该军官）获得等同于其等级两倍的临时生命值，最多为 8 点。获得此增益的不死生物随后会在 1 小时内暂时免疫强化灵光。

The mere presence of a Corpse Fleet officer bolsters the undead under their command. Undead that begin their turn in the aura (including the officer) gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to twice their level, to a maximum of 8. Undead who gain this benefit then become temporarily immune to bolstering aura for 1 hour

Reactive Strike.name: 借机攻击 Reactive Strike
Reactive Strike.description:
触发条件 你触及范围内的一个生物进行一个操纵动作或一个移动动作、进行一次远程攻击，或在其正在使用的移动动作中离开一个方格。

你猛然攻击露出破绽的敌人。对触发该反应的生物进行一次近战打击。若你的攻击造成重击，且触发条件是一个操纵动作，则你打断该动作。此次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，且你的多重攻击减值也不适用于此次打击。

Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Decimate the Living.name: 屠戮活体 Decimate the Living
Decimate the Living.description:
尸骸舰队军官受过训练，专门屠戮生者。其打击额外造成1d6虚空伤害（已计入上方）。

The Corpse Fleet officer has trained to decimate the living. Their Strikes deal an additional 1d6 void damage (already included above).

Lead Salvo.name: 铅弹齐射 Lead Salvo
Lead Salvo.description:
尸骸舰队军官对一名敌人发起攻击，命令其下属一同进行齐射。他们对一个生物进行一次远程或近战打击。尸骸舰队军官100英尺内的每个不死生物都可以立即使用反应，从其正持握的远程武器中消耗等同于该武器 expend 数值的弹药。每有一个不死生物如此做，Lead Salvo 造成的伤害便增加 1d4，最多额外增加 4d4 伤害

The Corpse Fleet officer leads an attack against an enemy, ordering their subordinates to join the salvo. They make a ranged or melee Strike against a creature. Each undead within 100 feet of the Corpse Fleet officer can immediately use a reaction to expend ammunition from a ranged weapon they're wielding equal to that weapon's expend. For each undead that does, the damage dealt by Lead Salvo increases by 1d4, to a maximum of 4d4 additional damage

Unrelenting Flurry.name: 无情连击 Unrelenting Flurry
Unrelenting Flurry.description:
伴随着一阵充满威胁的笑声，尸骸舰队军官发动一阵猛烈攻击。他们以任意顺序进行一次远程打击和一次近战打击。这些打击会如常增加多重攻击减值，但要在两次攻击都完成后才会增加。

With a menacing laugh, the Corpse Fleet officer unleashes a flurry of attacks. They make one ranged Strike and one melee Strike in any order. These Strikes increase the multiple attack penalty normally, except they don't increase until after both attacks are made.

Laser Pistol (Commercial).name: 激光手枪（商用） Laser Pistol (Commercial)
Laser Pistol (Commercial).description:
作为大多数星际旅行者可靠的随身武器，激光手枪在整个银河系中有着数不清的品牌与型号。这些小型武器与袖珍电池协同工作，向预定目标发射由定向能量构成的精准射击。低端型号往往会迅速耗尽电池电量，而高端型号则常常以牺牲总体容量为代价来换取更高的伤害。

The trusty sidearm of most interstellar travelers, the laser pistol has an untold number of makes and models across the galaxy. These small arms work in tandem with compact batteries to unleash pinpoint shots of directed energy at their intended targets. Lower-end models tend to gobble up battery charges, while higher- end models often trade overall capacity for increased damage.

Phase Cutlass (Commercial).name: 切相弯刀（商业） Phase Cutlass (Commercial)

Defiance Armor (Commercial).name: 抗命护甲（商用） Defiance Armor (Commercial)

Corpse Fleet Officer.prototypeToken: 尸骸舰队军官 Corpse Fleet Officer

Kehtarian Mulch Muncher.name: 啃腐壤的凯萨瑞安虫兽 Kehtarian Mulch Muncher
Kehtarian Mulch Muncher.tokenName: 啃食腐殖土的凯赫塔里安人 Kehtarian Mulch Muncher

Sonic Breath.name: 音波吐息 Sonic Breath
Sonic Breath.description:
覆盖粉碎者喷吐出一个@Template[type:cone|distance:20]的音波震荡。锥形范围内的生物受到 @Damage[8d8[sonic]] 伤害，且必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免。覆盖粉碎者在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Sonic Breath]]{1d4 轮}内不能再次使用音波吐息。如果覆盖粉碎者将受到音波伤害或成为音波效果的目标，其音波吐息充能。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}。

The mulch muncher breathes out a @Template[type:cone|distance:20] of sonic reverberations. Creatures in the cone take @Damage[8d8[sonic]] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save. The mulch muncher can't use Sonic Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Sonic Breath]]{1d4 rounds}. If the mulch muncher would take sonic damage or be targeted by a sonic effect, its Sonic Breath recharges.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Take Root.name: 扎根 Take Root
Take Root.description:
腐植吞噬者从它的蹄子中伸出细小的摄食器，探入附近的植被之中。直到其下个回合开始前，它无法自愿移动，且其蹄击失去长触及特征。直到其下个回合结束时，它获得快速愈合 10。若腐植吞噬者在其下个回合开始前受到任何形式的强制移动影响，此效果结束。

The mulch muncher sends small feeders out from its hooves and into the nearby vegetation. It cannot voluntarily move until the start of its next turn and its hoof Strikes lose the reach trait. It gains fast healing 10 until the end of its next turn. This effect ends if the mulch muncher is affected by any form of forced movement before the start of its next turn.

Kehtarian Mulch Muncher.prototypeToken: 克赫塔里安覆盖物咀嚼者 Kehtarian Mulch Muncher

Distracting Holo Ad.name: 分心全息广告 Distracting Holo Ad
Distracting Holo Ad.tokenName: 分心全息广告 Distracting Holo Ad

Buy! Buy! Buy!.name: 买！买！买！ Buy! Buy! Buy!
Buy! Buy! Buy!.description:
触发条件 区域内的一个生物完成一个动作

效果 陷阱会投放一则定向广告，引诱观众花费信用点购买某种商品或服务。30尺内所有能看见、听见或感知到该广告的生物都必须进行一次 @Check[type:will|dc:14] 豁免。陷阱掷先攻。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。

失败 目标目眩，且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}。

大失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{着迷}，持续1轮，并且不能采取任何动作，除了接入最近的电脑并按广告指示进行购买。

Trigger A creature within the area finishes an action

Effect The trap launches a targeted ad enticing viewers to spend credits on a product or service. All creatures within 30 feet who can see, hear, or sense the ad must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:14] save. The trap rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.

Failure The target is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round and can't take any actions except to access the nearest computer and make purchases as directed by the ad.

Distracting Holo Ad.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:17]（受训）以停用该广告

@Check[type:computers|dc:17] (trained) to deactivate the ad
Distracting Holo Ad.hazarddescription:
色彩斑斓、栩栩如生的人影在全息广告中穿梭闪现，伴随着一连串令人愉悦的声音与感官刺激，诱使路人花掉他们的信用点。

Colorful, lifelike figures flit in and out of a holographic advertisement in a barrage of pleasant sounds and sensations, enticing passersby to spend their credits.
Distracting Holo Ad.reset:
该陷阱会在 1 分钟后停用并重置。

The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
Distracting Holo Ad.routine:
（1 个动作）该危害每轮播放一个新的广告，迫使所有能感知到它的生物进行一次新的豁免。

(1 action) The hazard plays a new ad each round, forcing all creatures who can sense it to attempt a new save.
Distracting Holo Ad.prototypeToken: 分散注意的全息广告 Distracting Holo Ad

Spiritual Sinkwell.name: 灵力汇井 Spiritual Sinkwell

Soul-Draining Wave.name: 噬魂波 Soul-Draining Wave
Soul-Draining Wave.description:
触发条件 一门死灵能量炮击中了Nova Rush

效果 灵性能量冲击货舱，对B1区域内的生物造成 @Damage[(1d6+3)[spirit]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] 基础豁免）。该闹鬼现象长出数条类似触手的虚空鞭须，并掷先攻。

Trigger A necromantic energy cannon hits Nova Rush

Effect Spiritual energy assails the cargo hold, dealing @Damage[(1d6+3)[spirit]] damage to creatures in area B1 (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save). The haunt sprouts several tentacle-like void lashes and rolls initiative.

Spiritual Sinkwell.disable:
@Check[arcana|dc:16]、@Check[occultism|dc:16]或@Check[religion|dc:16]（受训）以安全驱散虚空能量，@Check[athletics|dc:18]或@Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以破坏沉降井；总共需要三次成功。

@Check[arcana|dc:16], @Check[occultism|dc:16], or @Check[religion|dc:16] (trained) to safely disperse the void energy, @Check[athletics|dc:18] or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to sabotage the sinkwell; three total successes are required.
Spiritual Sinkwell.hazarddescription:
一个死灵能量的陷坑会虹吸生物的生命精华。

A necromantic sinkwell siphons creatures' life essence.
Spiritual Sinkwell.reset:
这个灵异现象会在 1 分钟后停用，且不会再次激活。

The haunt deactivates after 1 minute and does not reactivate.
Spiritual Sinkwell.routine:
（5 个动作）该邪祟对尚未被其 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{抓取} 的目标进行两次虚空鞭笞打击，然后抓取它命中的每个生物，且不受多重攻击减值。它会自动将被抓取的生物向其中心拉近 5 英尺，然后对其中心 10 英尺内的生物造成 @Damage[(1d6+3)[spirit]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] 豁免）。严重失败的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{衰竭 1}。

(5 actions) The haunt makes two void lash Strikes against targets it hasn't yet @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, then Grabs each creature it hit, with no multiple attack penalty. It automatically pulls grabbed creatures 5 feet toward its center, then deals @Damage[(1d6+3)[spirit]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save) to creatures within 10 feet of its center. Creatures that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Memento Mold.name: 纪念霉菌 Memento Mold

Spore Explosion.name: 孢子爆炸 Spore Explosion
Spore Explosion.description:
触发 一个生物移动到霉菌的空间内，或对霉菌造成伤害

效果 触发该反应的生物以及所有 10 英尺内的生物都会暴露于纪念霉菌的孢子之下。

Trigger A creature moves into the mold's space or damages the mold

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within 10 feet are exposed to memento mold spores.

Memento Mold Spores.name: 纪念霉菌孢子 Memento Mold Spores
Memento Mold Spores.description:
该生物会产生幻觉，觉得自己正挣扎着想从一个温暖却令人窒息的茧中挣脱出来，并在逃脱的瞬间看见一颗爆炸中的行星

豁免检定 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17]

最长持续时间 4 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d4[mental]] 伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[mental]] 伤害且困惑（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[1d6[mental]] 伤害且困惑（1 轮）

The creature hallucinates struggling to break free from a warm but suffocating cocoon, then visualizes an exploding planet at the moment it escapes

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|dc:17]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[mental]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage and confused (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage and confused (1 round)

Memento Mold.disable:
@Check[type:occultism|dc:14]（受训）可在不触发孢子的情况下移除霉菌

@Check[type:occultism|dc:14] (trained) to remove the mold without triggering the spores
Memento Mold.hazarddescription:
虹彩霉菌会吸收某个情绪事件的心灵印记，并在生物惊扰它时爆炸成一团带有灵能充能的孢子云。

Iridescent mold absorbs a psychic imprint of an emotional event and explodes into a cloud of psychically charged spores when a creature disturbs it.

商业 Phase Cutlass.name: 商业 Phase Cutlass
商业 Phase Cutlass.description:
升级： 1

相位弯刀在启动前看起来像一把传统的弧形剑。启动后，它的剑刃会变形成一片闪烁的虚空，而它每终结一个生命，虚空中便会多出一颗微小的新星。

Upgrades: 1

A phase cutlass resembles a traditional curved sword until it is powered. Then its blade morphs into a shimmering void, dotted with a tiny new star for each life it ends.

商业 Estex Suit.name: 商业 Estex Suit
商业 Estex Suit.description:
升级： 1

这套厚重的飞行服在战术织物层之间缝入了薄薄的聚碳板加固。

Upgrades: 1
