This bulky flight suit is reinforced with thin polycarbon panels sewn between layers of tactical fabric.

Frag Grenade (Commercial).name: 破片手榴弹（商用） Frag Grenade (Commercial)
Frag Grenade (Commercial).description:
激活 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{区域射击}

这些破片手雷会在一团弹片云中爆炸，并在一个 @Template[type:burst|distance:5] 内造成 @Damage[1d8[piercing]] 穿刺伤害，附带一次 @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true] 豁免。

重击 @Damage[1[persistent,bleed]] 伤害

Activate 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire}

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deals @Damage[1d8[piercing]] piercing damage in a @Template[type:burst|distance:5] with a @Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.system.attributes.classDC.value)|basic:true] save.

Critical @Damage[1[persistent,bleed]] damage

Area Fire.name: 区域射击 Area Fire
Area Fire.description:
破片手雷 (@Template[type:burst|distance:5], 射程 30 英尺), 伤害 @Damage[1d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] 伤害 (@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic] 豁免)

Frag grenade (@Template[type:burst|distance:5], range 30 feet), Damage @Damage[1d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic] save)

Traumatic Moment.name: 创伤时刻 Traumatic Moment

Jump Scare.name: 惊吓突袭 Jump Scare
Jump Scare.description:
触发 一个生物移动到闹鬼区域 10 英尺内

效果 该闹鬼重现了造就它的创伤时刻，如同该生物正在亲身经历这一事件般，生动地冲击该生物的感官。该生物必须进行一次 @Check[type:will|dc:24] 豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[2d8[mental]] 伤害；目标还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到 @Damage[4d8[mental]] 伤害；目标还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标受到 @Damage[8d8[mental]] 伤害；目标还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}。

Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the haunted area

Effect The haunt replays the traumatic moment that created it, vividly assaulting the creature's senses as though the creature was experiencing the event. The creature must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[2d8[mental]] damage; the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes @Damage[4d8[mental]] damage; the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[8d8[mental]] damage; the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Traumatic Moment.disable:
@Check[type:religion|dc:28]（专家）以净化该区域

@Check[type:religion|dc:28] (expert) to cleanse the area
Traumatic Moment.hazarddescription:
一起可怕事件的灵能残痕以鲜明的细节重演。

A psychic imprint of a horrific event replays in vivid detail.

Intimidation Vulnerability.name: 威吓易伤性 Intimidation Vulnerability
Intimidation Vulnerability.description:
斯科雷什害怕那些敢于反抗它的其他生物。尝试对斯科雷什施展 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{威吓} 的生物，不会因缺乏共同语言而承受 –4 的环境减值。每当斯科雷什获得恐慌状态时，它还会额外变为 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}，并持续到其恐慌结束为止。

The skorresh is afraid of other creatures that stand up to it. Creatures attempting to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a skorresh don't take the –4 circumstance penalty caused by lacking a shared language. Whenever the skorresh gains the frightened condition, it additionally becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} for as long as it is frightened.

Immunity to Skorrfern Poison.name: 免疫斯科尔芬毒素 Immunity to Skorrfern Poison

Raise Protective Shell.name: 升起防护外壳 Raise Protective Shell
Raise Protective Shell.description:
斯科雷什展开其坚固的甲壳状翅膀来偏转攻击。这视为举起护盾。斯科雷什的甲壳具有3点硬度。由于它是斯科雷什身体的一部分，所有超过甲壳硬度的伤害都只会施加给斯科雷什（而非它的甲壳）。

The skorresh unfolds its sturdy shell-like wings to deflect attacks. This counts as Raising a Shield. A skorresh's shell has Hardness 3. Because it's a part of the skorresh, all damage in excess of the shell's Hardness is dealt only to the skorresh (not to its shell).

Shell Display.name: 壳体显示屏 Shell Display
Shell Display.description:
skorresh张开它折叠的甲壳，如同一对翅膀，做出威吓性的展示。skorresh施展其 Protective Shell，随后 90 尺内的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:18] 豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响，并在 1 分钟内暂时免疫 Shell Display。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制}，持续 1 轮。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} 且受压制，持续 2 轮。

The skorresh opens its folded shell, like a pair of wings, in an intimidating display. The skorresh Raises its Protective Shell, then creatures within 90 feet must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:18] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is and temporarily immune to Shell Display for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and suppressed for 2 rounds.

Agent of Chaos.name: 混沌特工 Agent of Chaos
Agent of Chaos.tokenName: 混沌特工 Agent of Chaos

Advanced Doshko.name: 先进型多什科 Advanced Doshko
Advanced Doshko.description:
升级： 1

这种动力长柄战斧是维斯卡里姆的传统武器，带有一到三片三角形斧刃，既适合大开大合的过顶劈砍，也适合战术招架。

Upgrades: 1

The traditional weapon of the Veskarium, this powered poleaxe features one to three triangular blades forged for both wide overhead swings and tactical parrying.

Tactical Freebooter Armor.name: 战术海盗甲胄 Tactical Freebooter Armor
Tactical Freebooter Armor.description:
升级： 1

掠夺者护甲以经常穿戴这类装备的海盗与亡命之徒而得名。掠夺者护甲通常由穿在夹克或飞行服内的胸甲、厚重的靴子和手套、一顶头盔，以及用于隐藏携带武器的暗藏绑带与枪套组成。

Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol.name: 先进型半自动手枪 Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol
Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol.description:
升级： 1

这把基础手枪会在每次射击后自动退出用过的弹壳并装填新的弹药。

Upgrades: 1

This basic pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

Earthshattering Strike.name: 裂地猛击 Earthshattering Strike
Earthshattering Strike.description:
混沌区的代理者将其多什科猛砸向地面，并在一条 @Template[type:line|distance:20] 上震裂地面。该线区域在接下来 1 分钟内视为困难地形，且受影响区域内的所有生物都必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:23] 豁免，否则将倒地并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧} 状态。

The agent of chaos smashes their doshko down and cracks the ground in a @Template[type:line|distance:20]. The line is treated as difficult terrain for the next minute, and all creatures in the affected area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save or fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Frenzied Jaws.name: 狂乱颚击 Frenzied Jaws
Frenzied Jaws.description:
混沌特使进行一次多什科攻击，以及两次对一个或两个目标的颚击攻击（可按其意愿任意分配这些攻击）。其多重攻击减值在这三次攻击全部完成后才会增加。

The agent of chaos makes a doshko strike and two jaws Strikes against one or two targets (splitting up the attacks any way they wish). Their multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all three attacks.

Agent of Chaos.prototypeToken: 混沌区特工 Agent of Chaos

Goblin Mine.name: 地精矿井 Goblin Mine

Topple Over.name: 推倒 Topple Over
Topple Over.description:
触发条件 一个生物走到地雷所在的方格上

效果 地雷爆炸，对触发该地雷的生物造成 @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:15|basic:true] 豁免）。

Trigger A creature walks on the mine's square

Effect The mine explodes, dealing @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[type:reflex|dc:15|basic:true] save).

Goblin Mine.disable:
@Check[type:crafting|dc:15] 或 @Check[type:thievery|dc:15] 来拆除每个地雷

@Check[type:crafting|dc:15] or @Check[type:thievery|dc:15] to defuse each mine
Goblin Mine.hazarddescription:
一捆电线、锯齿状的金属碎片，以及熔接在一起并固定于某个表面的爆炸物，会在有生物踩到它时引爆。

A bundle of wires, jagged metal scraps, and fused-together explosives attached to a surface detonates when a creature steps on it.

Freebooter Armor.name: 掠夺者护甲 Freebooter Armor
Freebooter Armor.description:
自由掠夺者护甲因经常穿着这类装备的海盗和亡命之徒而得名。自由掠夺者护甲通常由穿在夹克或飞行服内侧的胸甲、厚重的靴子和手套、头盔，以及用于隐藏武器的隐蔽束带和枪套组成。

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

Commercial Semi-Auto Pistol.name: 商用半自动手枪 Commercial Semi-Auto Pistol
Commercial Semi-Auto Pistol.description:
这把基础手枪会在每次射击后自动弹出用过的弹壳并装填新的弹药。

This basic pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

Commercial Knife.name: 商用刀 Commercial Knife
Commercial Knife.description:
刀具既是武器也是工具，价值非凡，其形状、样式和材质多种多样，从碳钢到陶瓷不一而足。使用过时材料、早于现代制造工艺出现的古旧刀具，有时会经过防腐蚀处理，以保存这些传统兵器。

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from carbon steel to ceramics. Archaic knives made with outdated materials that predate modern crafting methods are sometimes treated against corrosion to preserve these traditional armaments.

Magazine (Semi-Auto Pistol).name: 弹匣（半自动手枪） Magazine (Semi-Auto Pistol)

Armed Defrex.name: 武装德弗雷克斯 Armed Defrex
Armed Defrex.tokenName: 武装德弗雷克斯 Armed Defrex

Integrated Superior Laser Rifle.name: 集成式卓越激光步枪 Integrated Superior Laser Rifle
Integrated Superior Laser Rifle.description:
升级： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪会从方形枪管中射出集中的能量光束。协约世界的通用标准型号具有极高的可改装性，设计时便可搭配各种配件和升级使用，使用者会根据自己的偏好来调整这把激光步枪，甚至把它拼改成一把几乎认不出来的武器。

Upgrades: 1

These dependable mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

Body Shield.name: 肉盾 Body Shield
Body Shield.description:
触发 defrex 成为一次远程打击的目标，且其还抓住了另一名处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{被擒抱} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{（被）束缚} 状态的敌人

效果 defrex 将该名被擒抱或（被）束缚的敌人当作护盾使用，将触发此次反应的打击转而导向该敌人。

Trigger The defrex is the target of a ranged Strike and has another enemy @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The defrex uses the grabbed or restrained enemy as a shield, redirecting the triggering Strike against them.

Laser Barrage.name: 激光齐射 Laser Barrage
Laser Barrage.description:
defrex 对同一目标进行两次远程打击。两次攻击都计入其多重攻击减值，但在两次攻击都完成之前，该减值不会增加。

The defrex makes two ranged Strikes at the same target. Both attacks count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks have been made.

Menacing Display.name: 威吓展示 Menacing Display
Menacing Display.description:
defrex 猛然直立，发出一声震耳欲聋的咆哮。100尺内的每个生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:27] 豁免。无论结果如何，这些生物随后都会在1分钟内暂时免疫“威吓展示”。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌 3}。

The defrex rears up and makes a bellowing roar. Each creature within 100 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:27] save. No matter the result, the creatures are then temporarily immune to Menacing Display for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Prey on Fear.name: 以恐惧为食 Prey on Fear
Prey on Fear.description:
恶蝾对陷入恐慌的生物额外造成 1d6 伤害。

The defrex deals an additional 1d6 damage against frightened creatures.

Sudden Rush.name: 骤然冲锋 Sudden Rush
Sudden Rush.description:
defrex先疾走两次，然后在该移动结束时进行一次近战打击。

The defrex Strides twice then makes a melee Strike at the end of that movement.

Armed Defrex.prototypeToken: 武装迪弗雷克斯 Armed Defrex

Desperate Final Moments.name: 绝望的最终时刻 Desperate Final Moments
Desperate Final Moments.tokenName: 绝望的最后时刻 Desperate Final Moments

Ambush.name: 伏击 Ambush
Ambush.description:
触发条件 一个活着的生物进入舰桥

效果 触发该陷灵的生物感知到一个可怖的形体从黑暗中跃出扑向自己，并将其撞倒在地。触发该陷灵的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:26] 豁免。若失败，其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}（若严重失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}）。随后，该陷灵掷先攻。

Trigger A living creature enters the bridge

Effect The triggering creature senses a monstrous form leaping on them, emerging from the dark and knocking them to the ground. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:26] save. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

Desperate Final Moments.disable:
@Check[type:diplomacy|dc:24] 以安抚伊玛兹船长，@Check[type:occultism|dc:20] 或 @Check[type:religion|dc:20] （受训）以削弱该游荡灵，或 @Check[type:society|dc:22] （受训）以让伊玛兹船长立足于当下；总共需要两次成功才能将该游荡灵解除。

@Check[type:diplomacy|dc:24] to calm Captain Imaaz, @Check[type:occultism|dc:20] or @Check[type:religion|dc:20] (trained) to weaken the haunt, or @Check[type:society|dc:22] (trained) to ground Captain Imaaz in the present moment; two total successes are required to disable the haunt.
Desperate Final Moments.hazarddescription:
伊玛兹船长重温了她生命中最后那段可怖的时刻——她被一个可怕且无法阻挡的怪物吞噬。

Captain Imaaz relives the last gruesome moments of her life, as she's devoured by a terrifying and unstoppable monster.
Desperate Final Moments.reset:
1小时后，伊玛兹船长又陷入了她痛苦死亡的回忆中，使此萦扰重置。

After 1 hour, Captain Imaaz slips back into memories of her painful death, resetting the haunt.
Desperate Final Moments.routine:
（3个动作）该游荡灵使用3个动作来攻击舰桥上的生物，每轮分别以一次颚击、爪击和尾巴攻击进行打击，且对房间内每个生物的目标指定不超过一次。

(3 actions) The haunt uses 3 actions to attack creatures in the bridge, Striking with a jaws, claw, and tail attack each round, and targeting each creature in the room no more than once.
Desperate Final Moments.prototypeToken: 绝望的最后时刻 Desperate Final Moments

Drift Calliphor Swarm.name: 漂流域丽蝇虫群 Drift Calliphor Swarm
Drift Calliphor Swarm.tokenName: 漂流域丽蝇虫群 Drift Calliphor Swarm

Ceaseless Buzzing.name: 无休止的嗡嗡声 Ceaseless Buzzing
Ceaseless Buzzing.description:
60尺。漂流域食腐蝇虫群在跨越位面时嗡嗡作响。进入该灵光或在其中开始其回合的生物必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:30]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1轮。成功豁免的生物会在24小时内免疫该虫群的无休止嗡鸣。虫群可以以一个自由动作停止或恢复此能力。

60 feet. The Drift calliphor swarm buzzes as it phases across the planes. A creature entering or beginning its turn within the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that swarm's Ceaseless Buzzing for 24 hours. The swarm can stop or resume this ability as a free action.

Phase Shift.name: 相位转移 Phase Shift
Phase Shift.description:
虫群变为虚体，直到其下个回合开始。它还获得对所有伤害的抗性 10（力场、幽灵触碰或灵魂除外；对非魔法伤害的抗性加倍）。处于虚体状态时，虫群对未能通过其“虫群噬咬”豁免的生物额外造成 1d10 精确伤害。

The swarm becomes incorporeal until the start of its next turn. It also gains resistance 10 to all damage (except force, ghost touch, or spirit; double resistance vs non-magical). While incorporeal, the swarm deals an additional 1d10 precision damage to creatures that fail its save against Swarming Bites.

Swarming Bites.name: 蜂群啃咬 Swarming Bites
Swarming Bites.description:
虫群空间内的每个敌人受到 @Damage[4d10[piercing]] 伤害（进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。

Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[4d10[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save).

Drift Calliphor Swarm.prototypeToken: 漂流域丽蝇虫群 Drift Calliphor Swarm

Arcane Seal.name: 奥术封印 Arcane Seal

Lockdown Protocol.name: 封锁协议 Lockdown Protocol
Lockdown Protocol.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到与任意一个气闸门相邻的方格内

效果 警报响起，随后该陷阱对设施内任意位置至多四个生物进行激光打击，优先以触发生物为目标。然后该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger A creature moves into a square adjacent to any of the airlock doors

Effect An alarm sounds, and the trap makes laser Strikes against up to four creatures anywhere in the facility, targeting the triggering creature first. The trap then rolls initiative.

laser.name: 激光 laser
laser.description:
没有多重攻击减值

No multiple attack penalty

Arcane Seal.disable:
@Check[type:arcana|dc:16] （受训）四次以解开奥术认证谜题，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:19] （受训）或 @Check[type:thievery|dc:19] （受训）四次以禁用锁定机制（使用这些技能中的任意一种成功通过四次检定即可解除安全封印）

@Check[type:arcana|dc:16] (trained) four times to solve arcane authentication puzzles, or @Check[type:crafting|dc:19] (trained) or @Check[type:thievery|dc:19] (trained) four times to disable the locking mechanism (succeeding at four checks using any of these skills disables the security seal)
Arcane Seal.hazarddescription:
上锁并设有防护的气闸门连接到一个安保网络，设施的每个角落都隐藏着激光射口。

Locked and warded airlock doors connect to a security network with laser ports hidden in every part of the facility.
Arcane Seal.routine:
（4个动作）每轮，该陷阱会对射程内至多四个生物各进行一次激光打击。若目标数量不足，该陷阱会对随机决定的目标进行多次攻击。

(4 actions) Each round, the trap makes a laser Strike against up to four creatures in range. If there aren't enough targets, the trap attacks a randomly determined target multiple times.

Bonded with the Bloom.name: 与绽蕊联结 Bonded with the Bloom
Bonded with the Bloom.description:
只要62号样本与绽放体保持物理接触，该生物便获得宇宙（特征），并无视失重的效果，转而将失重视为低重力。

As long as Sample 62 is in physical contact with the Bloom, the creature gains the cosmic trait and ignores the effects of zero-g, instead treating zero-g as low gravity.

Adaptation.name: 适应 Adaptation
Adaptation.description:
每当样本62以一次颚击打击对一个活体生物造成伤害时，他们可以选择吸收该生物的一项特征，从而获得以下能力之一（且只能从目标拥有的能力中选择）：任意一种精确或非精确感官；对一种伤害类型的抗性（最高5）；任意一种速度（最高20英尺）；理解任意一种语言（但不能说）的能力；快速治疗（最高为样本62等级的一半）。该适应持续1分钟，或直到样本62获得另一种适应为止。若为重击，则该适应改为永久。

Whenever Sample 62 damages a living creature with a jaws Strike, they can choose to absorb one of the creature's characteristics, gaining any one of the following abilities (and selecting only from the abilities the target has): any precise or imprecise sense, resistance (up to 5) to one type of damage, any Speed (up to 20 feet), the ability to understand (but not speak) any language, fast healing (up to half Sample 62's level). The adaptation lasts 1 minute or until Sample 62 gains another adaptation. On a critical hit, the adaptation is permanent instead.

Canny Assault.name: 精明突击 Canny Assault
Canny Assault.description:
样本 62 进行攀爬或大步，然后进行两次爪击攻击，接着催使绽放体用护盾保护它免受伤害，使其获得掩护，直到其下一回合开始。

Sample 62 Climbs or Strides, makes two claw Strikes, then urges the Bloom to shield it from harm, gaining Cover until the beginning of their next turn.

Dislodge.name: 撬落 Dislodge
Dislodge.description:
Requirements Sample 62 用尾巴使一个中型或更小的生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 状态

Effect Sample 62 对该生物的强韧 DC 进行一次 @Check[type:athletics|defense:fortitude] 检定。

Critical Success Sample 62 将该生物击倒至 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} 状态并把其抛入太空，使其移动到距离 Sample 62 20 英尺远处。即使目标穿着磁力靴、抓着梯子，或固定在舰体上，此移动依然会发生。

Success Sample 62 将该生物击倒并把其抛入太空，使其移动到距离 Sample 62 10 英尺远处。即使目标穿着磁力靴、抓着梯子，或固定在舰体上，此移动依然会发生。

Failure 该生物不受影响。

Critical Failure Sample 62 不再抓握该生物。

Requirements Sample 62 has a Medium or smaller creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with their tail

Effect Sample 62 attempts an @Check[type:athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC.

Critical Success Sample 62 knocks the creature @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and hurls them into space, moving them 20 feet away from Sample 62. This movement occurs even if the target is wearing magboots, hanging onto a ladder, or secured to the hull.

Success Sample 62 knocks the creature prone and hurls them into space, moving them 10 feet away from Sample 62. This movement occurs even if the target is wearing magboots, hanging onto a ladder, or secured to the hull.

Failure The creature is unaffected.

Critical Failure Sample 62 no longer has the creature grabbed.

Amnieka Midwife.name: 阿姆涅卡接生圣者 Amnieka Midwife
Amnieka Midwife.tokenName: 阿姆涅卡接生圣者 Amnieka Midwife

Static Sense.name: 静态感知 Static Sense
Static Sense.description:
阿姆涅卡能够感知到心灵静电区域内任何具有心智的生物的存在（见下文）。这如同一种不精确感官。阿姆涅卡将那些对心灵静电的豁免失败的生物视为自己始终能够看见它们，从而无视任何掩护或隐形效果的影响。

Amnieka can sense the presence of any creature with a mind inside mental static's area (see below). This functions as an imprecise sense. Amnieka treats creatures that fail their save against mental static as though it can always see them, ignoring the effects of any cover or invisibility effects.

Regeneration 12 (Deactivated by Mental O.name: 再生 12（受精神或圣洁影响时失效） Regeneration 12 (Deactivated by Mental Or Holy)

Mental Static.name: 心灵噪讯 Mental Static
Mental Static.description:
100英尺。阿姆涅卡的存在会增加能够感知其静电心灵放射的生物的压力。生物可以尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:19] 豁免，以在其中枢神经系统经历增强的焦虑反应时清空思绪。若失败，生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} 状态，持续1轮；若重度失败，则其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 状态，持续1轮。

100 feet. Amnieka's presence increases stress for creatures able to perceive its static psychic emanations. Creatures can attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:19] save to clear their minds as their central nervous system experiences a heightened anxiety response. On a failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} for 1 round; on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Reactive Tentacles.name: 反应性触手 Reactive Tentacles
Reactive Tentacles.description:
触发条件 阿姆涅卡触及范围内的一个生物进行了一次攻击

效果 阿姆涅卡的触手从其兜帽中猛然张开，露出一颗畸形的头骨，呈现出流动鲜血般的粉红色。阿姆涅卡对触发该反应的生物进行一次触手螫刺打击。此次打击不计入阿姆涅卡的多重攻击减值，且阿姆涅卡的多重攻击减值也不适用于此次打击。

Trigger A creature within Amnieka's reach makes an attack

Effect Amnieka's tentacles flare out from its hood, exposing a misshapen skull pink with living blood. Amnieka makes a tentacle sting Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward Amnieka's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Return to Aucturn.name: 返回奥克腾 Return to Aucturn
Return to Aucturn.description:
阿姆涅卡可以传送至行星范围内任意一块奥克腾岩碎片所在的位置。如果阿姆涅卡的生命值降至0，除非奥克腾破碎质量的每一块碎片都被摧毁，否则它会在24小时后重塑。

Amnieka teleports to the location of any Aucturnite fragment within a planetary range. If Amnieka is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it reforms 24 hours later unless every piece of Aucturn's shattered mass is destroyed.

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Eldritch Wrath.name: 奥秘之怒 Eldritch Wrath
Eldritch Wrath.description:
你引导来自物质宇宙最外缘之外的、不可名状的力量，对区域内每个生物造成 3d12 点精神伤害；幻影般的爪击、颚击和触手猛袭每个目标。区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次基础意志豁免。对于任何因该法术效果而陷入恶心状态的生物来说，该区域视为困难地形。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

You channel the unspeakable powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Entropy Strike.name: 熵击 Entropy Strike
Entropy Strike.description:
你释放出一道熵能射线，使物质迅速且不加区分地腐朽瓦解。进行一次远程法术攻击。

大成功 目标受到 10d8 虚空伤害。如果目标具有科技属性，则其受到 4d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

成功 目标受到 5d8 虚空伤害。如果目标具有科技属性，则其受到 2d6 持续性强酸伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}。

升阶（+1） 初始伤害增加 1d8，且持续性伤害增加 1d6。

You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack.

Critical Success The target takes 10d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 4d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target takes 5d8 void damage. If the target is technological, it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Void Whispers.name: 虚空低语 Void Whispers
Void Whispers.description:
目标听见来自群星彼岸的黑暗奥秘，使其心智陷入迷乱。目标进行一次意志豁免检定。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 目标听见了诡异的低语，陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 1} 1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每轮用其每个动作进行一次Step。当其移动时，目标会采取最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标受到攻击或以任何方式直接受到威胁为止。

大失败：如失败，但目标会语无伦次地胡言乱语。任何在其回合开始时位于目标20尺内的生物，都必须如同成为该法术目标一般尝试一次意志豁免检定。若失败，其会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑} 1轮，并在24小时内免疫此法术。这是一个失能效果。

The target hears dark mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient their mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for one round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step once per round. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target is attacked or otherwise directly threatened in any way.

Critical Failure: As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins their turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw as if they were targeted by this spell. On a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动力战技 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
伴随着一阵念动力的激涌，你移动一个敌人或其所携带的某件物品。你可以尝试使用法术攻击检定而非运动技能检定，对目标执行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{重新定位} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔}。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Sonic Scream.name: 音波尖啸 Sonic Scream
Sonic Scream.description:
你发出一声足以震裂头颅的尖啸。你对区域内的生物造成1d8点音波伤害。豁免检定失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

You unleash a head-bursting scream. You deal 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage by 1d8.

Detect Thoughts (Constant).name: 侦测思想（恒常城） Detect Thoughts (Constant)
Detect Thoughts (Constant).description:
你能感知周围具有智能的生物的表层思绪。显露出的信息量取决于你在一个区域或目标上专注的时间长短。该法术可以穿透某些障碍物，但3英尺厚的泥土或木材、1英尺厚的石头、1英寸厚的金属、一层薄铅片，或任何力场屏障都会阻挡它。对精神效果免疫的生物也免疫此法术的侦测。

1 你能侦测到拥有智力属性调整值为–3或更高的清醒生物，其思绪的存在或不存在。

2 你能侦测到正在思考的心智数量，以及这些生物是否具有心灵感应。具有心灵感应的生物，其思绪比不具备心灵感应的生物更响亮，并且可能在GM裁定下察觉到你的侵入。

3 在维持该法术期间，你在感知目标动机的察觉检定上获得+1状态加值。若目标的意志豁免成功，则可阻止此效果。

强化（5环） 你获得+2状态加值。

强化（7环） 你获得+3状态加值。

You sense the surface thoughts of intelligent creatures around you. The amount of information revealed depends on how long you concentrate on an area or target. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

1 You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence attribute modifiers of –3 or higher.

2 You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creature who don't have telepathy, and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.

3 You gain a +1 status bonus to Perception to Sense the target's Motives while the spell is sustained. A target who succeeds at its Will save prevents this.

Heightened (5th) You gain a +2 status bonus.

Heightened (7th) You gain a +3 status bonus.

Eldritch Lance.name: 秘法长枪 Eldritch Lance
Eldritch Lance.description:
你将一道由群星之间黑暗空间中凝聚而成、侵袭心智的异界能量光束压缩并射向一个目标。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击检定。若你命中，则造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若为重击成功，则造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d6。

You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Psychic Doula.name: 灵能助产师 Psychic Doula
Psychic Doula.description:
触发条件 阿姆涅卡的回合开始

效果 阿姆涅卡持续将不可知实体的碎片引导入其当前现实。每轮都会有一个半透明的血肉气泡出现在阿姆涅卡所在的空间内。该气泡在阿姆涅卡的回合中以每轮 10 尺的速度飘向最近的生物。当气泡进入与某个生物相同的方格时，便会爆裂，在以该生物为中心的 @Template[type:burst|distance:10] 内爆炸，造成 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害（@Check[type:fortitude|dc:21|basic:true] 豁免）。生物可以在气泡进入某个生物的方格前将其作为目标并攻击。气泡使用以下数据：AC 12，HP 6；强韧 +2，反射 +8。阿姆涅卡同时存在的活跃气泡数量，最多只能等于它同一时间正在与之战斗的敌人数量。

Trigger Amnieka's turn begins

Effect Amnieka constantly shepherds fragments of unknowable entities into its current reality. A translucent, fleshy bubble appears in Amnieka's space each round. The bubble floats toward the nearest creature at a Speed of 10 feet per round on Amnieka's turn. A bubble bursts when it enters the same square as a creature, exploding in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on the creature that deals @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage (@Check[type:fortitude|dc:21|basic:true] save). Creatures can target and attack a bubble before it enters a creature's square. A bubble uses the following statistics: AC 12, HP 6; Fort +2, Ref +8. Amnieka can only have a number of active bubbles equal to the number of enemies it's fighting at one time.

Supercharged Eldritch Ray.name: 超载秘法射线 Supercharged Eldritch Ray
Supercharged Eldritch Ray.description:
阿姆涅卡为它的邪术射线超载充能并发射，对 @Template[type:cone|distance:20] 内的每个生物造成 @Damage[3d10[untyped]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:21|basic:true] 豁免）。掷 1d4 以随机决定该超载邪术射线造成的是寒冷、火焰、电击或虚空伤害。

Amnieka supercharges its eldritch ray and fires, dealing @Damage[3d10[untyped]] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20] (@Check[type:reflex|dc:21|basic:true] save). Roll 1d4 to randomly determine whether the supercharged eldritch ray deals cold, fire, electricity, or void damage.

Mind Skewer.name: 心灵穿刺 Mind Skewer
Mind Skewer.description:
你以过量的灵能信息或神圣裁决压垮一个生物的心智。此次精神猛攻造成 2d6 点精神伤害。若为重击，目标受到 4d6 点精神伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{迟钝 2}，持续 1 轮。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgements. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical hit, the target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Amnieka Midwife.publicNotes:
阿姆涅卡是曾出席新诞者降生的十三位凡人接生圣者之一，并在这位新生的外神苏醒时，被转化为诡异实体。只要此位面上仍存在哪怕一粒奥克腾岩——也就是曾环绕新诞者、由“planetcenta”冻结形成的碎块之名——接生圣者就总能再生出一个完全相同的新形体。

阿姆涅卡是十三种接生圣者类型之一，不过，每种类型究竟只有一位接生圣者，还是有许多位，尚不得而知。它们的名字究竟源自那些灵魂被用作创造接生圣者引火的凡人仆从，还是对新诞者另有某种意义，仍是个谜。阿姆涅卡与它或许曾栖居过的类人生物躯体之间，唯一的相似之处，就是其面容周围那圈不断扭动的触须兜帽。

每位接生圣者都以自己曾如何照料新诞者来表明身份。阿姆涅卡曾将新诞者裹入襁褓，而其他接生圣者则曾为这位外神喂食、抱持、看护、守卫、赐福，或施行其他养育之举。

Amnieka is one of thirteen mortal Midwives who attended the Newborn's birth and were transformed into eldritch entities by the nascent outer god's awakening. A Midwife always regenerates an identical new form so long as even a single speck of aucturnite—the name for the frozen chunks of planetcenta that once surrounded the Newborn—exists on this plane.

Amnieka is one of the thirteen types of Midwives, though whether there is only one Midwife of each type, or many, is unknown. Whether their names come from the mortal servants whose souls were the kindling for the Midwives' creation, or if they have some other significance to the Newborn, is a mystery. The only resemblance Amnieka bears to the humanoid body it may have once inhabited is the hood of writhing tentacles around its visage.

Each Midwife identifies itself by how it cared for the Newborn. Amnieka swaddled the Newborn, but others fed, carried, held, watched, warded, blessed, or performed other acts of nurturing for the outer god.
Amnieka Midwife.prototypeToken: 阿姆涅卡接生圣者 Amnieka Midwife

Atrocite.name: 暴行 Atrocite

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Entropic Decay.name: 熵蚀衰朽 Entropic Decay
Entropic Decay.description:
被 atrocyte 的虚空箭击中的生物必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:33] 豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} 和 stunned 1。以此方式 drained 期间，该生物每当因任何来源受到虚空伤害时，都会额外受到 @Damage[1d10[void]] 伤害。

A creature hit by the atrocite's void bolt attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and stunned 1. While drained in this way, the creature takes an additional @Damage[1d10[void]] damage whenever taking void damage from any source.

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Teleport.name: 传送 Teleport
Teleport.description:
你和目标会被瞬间传送到范围内的任意地点，只要你能精确辨明该地点——既包括它相对于你起始位置的方位，也包括它的外观（或其他识别特征）。对地点外观的错误认知通常会导致该法术失败，但也可能改为传送到一个不想去的位置，或发生其他由GM决定的异常事故。Teleport 在长距离传送时并不精确。目标会出现在距离预定目的地有一定偏差的位置，偏差大约等于总旅行距离的1%，方向由GM决定。对于短途旅行，这种不精确无关紧要，但对于长距离，这一偏差最高可达1英里。

强化（7环） 你和其他目标可以前往1,000英里内的任意地点。

强化（8环） 你和其他目标可以前往同一星球上的任意地点。如果你旅行超过1,000英里，你抵达时只会偏离目标10英里。

强化（9环） 你和其他目标可以前往同一恒星系内另一颗星球上的任意地点。假设你对该地点的位置和外观有准确的认知，你会在新星球上偏离目标100英里的位置抵达。

强化（10环） 如9环版本，但你和其他目标可以前往同一星系内的任意星球。

You and the targets are instantly transported to any location within range, as long as you can identify the location precisely both by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location's appearance usually causes the spell to fail, but it could instead lead to teleporting to an unwanted location or some other unusual mishap determined by the GM. Teleport is not precise over great distances. The targets appear at a distance from the intended destination equal to roughly 1 percent of the total distance traveled, in a direction determined by the GM. For short journeys, this lack of precision is irrelevant, but for long distances this could be up to 1 mile.

Heightened (7th) You and the other targets can travel to any location within 1,000 miles.

Heightened (8th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on the same planet. If you travel more than 1,000 miles, you arrive only 10 miles off target.

Heightened (9th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on another planet within the same solar system. Assuming you have accurate knowledge of the location's position and appearance, you arrive on the new planet 100 miles off target.

Heightened (10th) As the 9th-rank version, but you and the other targets can travel to any planet within the same galaxy.

Void Scour.name: 虚空灾厄 Void Scour
Void Scour.description:
一股荒芜的黑暗之井从区域内抹除一切生命，对区域内所有活着的生物造成 10d10 虚空伤害。区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次反射豁免。若虚空洗劫与魔法光区域重叠，或影响了受魔法光影响的生物，虚空洗劫会尝试反制该光效果。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害和 @Damage[(@item.level - 6)d6[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 1}。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害、@Damage[((@item.level - 6) * 2)d6[persistent,void]] 伤害，并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drain 2}。

升阶（+1） 初始虚空伤害增加 2d10。持续负能量伤害在失败时增加 1d6，或在大失败时增加 2d6。

A well of desolate darkness scours all life from the area, dealing 10d10 void damage to all living creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save. If void scour overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, void scour attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and @Damage[(@item.level - 6)d6[persistent,void]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, @Damage[((@item.level - 6) * 2)d6[persistent,void]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the initial void damage by 2d10. The persistent negative damage increases by 1d6 on a failure, or by 2d6 on critical failure.

Warp Mind.name: 扭曲心智 Warp Mind
Warp Mind.description:
你扰乱一个生物的心智能力与感官输入。目标必须进行一次意志豁免检定。无论此次豁免的结果如何，目标随后都会获得持续10分钟的暂时免疫。扭曲心智的效果会瞬间发生，因此 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} 和其他能够反制法术的效果都无法反制这些效果。然而，@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} 仪式以及能够移除非魔法效果的能力，仍然可以反制这些效果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在其下一回合中，第一个动作是在具有 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 状态下度过的。

失败 目标陷入 Confused 状态，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标永久陷入 Confused 状态。

You scramble a creature's mental faculties and sensory input. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result of that save, the target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes. Warp mind's effects happen instantly, so @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} and other effects that counteract spells can't counteract them. However, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} rituals and abilities that can remove non-magical effects can still counteract the effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target spends the first action on its next turn with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Confused permanently.

Disintegrate.name: 分解术 Disintegrate
Disintegrate.description:
一道黑色示踪弹飞向你的目标，并在接触时增强为一道强大的毁灭性光束。对目标进行一次法术攻击。若你击中一个物体或力场构装体（例如力墙），它会在无需豁免的情况下被摧毁，除非它是神器或具有类似强大力量的存在。单次施放至多只能摧毁一个10英尺立方的物质。若你击中一个生物，它受到12d10伤害（无伤害类型），并进行一次基础强韧豁免。若你重击成功，目标的结果会比其强韧豁免的结果差一级成功度。生命值降至0的生物会被轰成细粉；其装备会保留下来。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高2d10。

A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.

Spellwrack.name: 法术残灭 Spellwrack
Spellwrack.description:
你使施加在目标身上的任何法术都将其能量以有害的激涌形式外泄。目标必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 每当目标受到一个具有持续时间的法术影响时，目标就会受到 @Damage[2d12[persistent,force]] 伤害。每次它因法术折磨而受到持续力场伤害时，影响它的法术的剩余持续时间都会减少 1 轮。只有对抗你的法术 DC 的一次成功 @Check[arcana] 检定才能帮助目标从该持续伤害中恢复；该诅咒和持续伤害会在 1 分钟后结束。

失败 如同成功，但该诅咒和持续伤害不会自行结束。

大失败 如同失败，但持续力场伤害变为 @Damage[4d12[persistent,force]]。

You cause any spells cast on the target to spill out their energy in harmful surges. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success Whenever the target becomes affected by a spell with a duration, the target takes @Damage[2d12[persistent,force]] damage. Each time it takes persistent force damage from spellwrack, it reduces the remaining duration of spells affecting it by 1 round. Only a successful @Check[arcana] check against your spell DC can help the target recover from the persistent damage; the curse and the persistent damage end after 1 minute.

Failure As success, but the curse and persistent damage do not end on their own.

Critical Failure As failure, but the persistent force damage is @Damage[4d12[persistent,force]].

Translocate (At Will).name: 传送（随意） Translocate (At Will)
Translocate (At Will).description:
你将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的所有物品，从你当前所处的空间瞬间传送到你视线内射程范围内一个未被占据的空间。若这会让另一名生物与你一同被带走——即使你是将其装在异次元容器中携带——该法术失效。

高阶化（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你曾经到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。之后，你会暂时获得1小时的免疫。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Truesight (Constant).name: 真视（恒常） Truesight (Constant)
Truesight (Constant).description:
你会如其本来面目般看见 60 尺内的事物。GM 会对区域内任何幻觉、变形或变化效果进行一次秘密反制检定，但仅用于判定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功对抗一个变化法术，你可以看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变化法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Void Barrage.name: 虚空弹幕 Void Barrage
Void Barrage.description:
阿特罗西特伸出双臂，释放出一股虚空能量的漩涡，在一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 内溶解物质。这会造成 @Damage[6d10[void]] 伤害，并允许进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] 豁免。豁免失败的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

The atrocite thrusts out both arms and unleashes a swirl of void energy that dissolves matter in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. This deals @Damage[6d10[void]] damage, with a @Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save. Creatures who fail their save become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Words of Destruction.name: 毁灭之言 Words of Destruction
Words of Destruction.description:
邪魔使会将60英尺内的一名敌人选定为毁灭目标。该生物的AC承受–2处境减值，直到邪魔使下个回合开始时为止。当目标被此能力标记时，邪魔使对该目标进行的成功打击在判定是否为重击时，若骰面结果为19，则视为20。以此方式被标记的生物在进行所有豁免检定时，若骰面结果为2，则在判定是否为重度失败时视为1。

The atrocite singles out an enemy within 60 feet as a target for destruction. That creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to AC until the beginning of the atrocite's next turn. While the target is marked by this ability, successful Strikes the atrocite makes against the target count a 19 on the die roll as a 20 for purposes of being a critical hit. Creatures marked in this manner also count a 2 on the die roll as being a 1 for the purposes of being a critical failure when rolling all saves.

Atrocite.publicNotes:
凶暴使是吞噬者的先兆，总会在最不吉利的时刻降临，监督为这位太空湮灭之神所实施的毁灭。有些凶暴使会从这类毁灭中自发诞生，也可能由吞噬者的狂热邪教徒召来。凶暴使通常会将自己塑造成与凡人别无二致的模样，只是他们的双眼是空无一物的虚空，而他们的手掌（或其他附肢）会张开成布满利齿的巨口。

An atrocite is a harbinger of the Devourer, always arriving at the most inauspicious moment to oversee destruction committed for the god of cosmic annihilation. Some atrocites are spontaneously born of such destruction, or might be summoned by fanatical cultists of the Devourer. Atrocites usually shape themselves to look just like mortals, except their eyes are blank voids and the palms of their hands (or other appendages) open up into gnashing maws.
Atrocite.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Observer-Class Security Robot.name: 观察者级安保机器人 Observer-Class Security Robot
Observer-Class Security Robot.tokenName: 观察者级安保机器人 Observer-Class Security Robot

Pulsecaster Pistol.name: 脉冲发射手枪 Pulsecaster Pistol

Exigency.name: 紧急关头 Exigency
Exigency.description:
频率 每10分钟一次

触发 一个生物以一次攻击将该机器人作为目标

效果 该机器人让其处理能力超频以尝试避开一次攻击，对抗此次触发攻击的 AC 获得 +2 处境加值。

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature targets the robot with an attack

Effect The robot overclocks its processing power to attempt to avoid an attack, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack.

Integrated Pulsecaster Pistol.name: 集成式脉冲投射手枪 Integrated Pulsecaster Pistol
Integrated Pulsecaster Pistol.description:
升级： 1

这把气势逼人的手枪会从枪管中射出一道能使人麻痹的电流。其剩余充能会以发光的能量线条显示出来，自枪身向下辐射。脉冲发射手枪常被赏金猎人和执法人员使用，因为他们需要让目标活着。

Upgrades: 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.

Observer-Class Security Robot.prototypeToken: 观察者级安保机器人 Observer-Class Security Robot

Laser Turret.name: 激光炮塔 Laser Turret

Laser Blast.name: 激光爆破 Laser Blast
Laser Blast.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到炮塔30英尺范围内

效果 该陷阱对该生物进行一次激光打击；该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the turret

Effect The trap makes a laser Strike against the creature; the trap rolls initiative.

Laser.name: 激光 Laser
Laser.description:
没有多重攻击减值

no multiple attack penalty

Laser Turret.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:18]（受训）以重新编程炮塔，或 @Check[type:crafting|dc:16]（受训）以干扰传感器

@Check[type:computers|dc:18] (trained) to reprogram the turret, or @Check[type:crafting|dc:16] (trained) to jam the sensor
Laser Turret.hazarddescription:
当入侵者进入安全区域时，一座隐藏式炮塔会升起并发射激光。

A concealed turret pops up and fires a laser when intruders enter a secure area.
Laser Turret.reset:
该陷阱会在 1 分钟后重置。

The trap resets after 1 minute.
Laser Turret.routine:
（3 个动作）该陷阱对射程内至多三个生物进行一次激光打击；如果没有其他目标，则可对射程内一个生物进行多次打击。

(3 actions) The trap makes a laser Strike against up to three creatures in range, or multiple Strikes against one creature in range if it has no additional targets.

Memory Crystals.name: 记忆水晶 Memory Crystals

Leech Memories.name: 榨取记忆 Leech Memories
Leech Memories.description:
触发 一个具有智力调整值的生物进入记忆水晶 5 尺内

效果 记忆水晶扩展到其空间内所有相邻的方格。随着它们生长，它们会吸收周围环境中的记忆与游离思绪，在扩展后对 10 尺内的生物造成 @Damage[8d10[mental]] 伤害（@Check[type:will|dc:38|basic:true] 豁免）。

Trigger A creature with an Intelligence modifier comes within 5 feet of the memory crystals

Effect The memory crystals expand into every square adjacent to its space. As they grow, they absorb memories and ambient thought from their surroundings, dealing @Damage[8d10[mental]] damage (@Check[type:will|dc:38|basic:true] save) to creatures within 10 feet after they expand.

Memory Field.name: 记忆场域 Memory Field
Memory Field.description:
5尺。记忆水晶对附近的生物造成 @Damage[8d10[mental]] 伤害。

5 feet. Memory crystals deal @Damage[8d10[mental]] damage to nearby creatures.

Memory Crystals.disable:
@Check[type:occultism|dc:48]（传奇）以将表层思绪无害地喂给这些水晶

@Check[type:occultism|dc:48] (legendary) to harmlessly feed surface thoughts to the crystals
Memory Crystals.hazarddescription:
发光的黄色水晶在其刻面中折射出被盗记忆的模糊印痕。

Glowing yellow crystals refract the blurred imprints of stolen memories within their facets.
Memory Crystals.reset:
扩展后，这些记忆水晶在 1 天内无法再次生长。

After expanding, the memory crystals can't grow again for 1 day.

Nihili.name: 虚无者 Nihili

Tactical Laser Rifle.name: 战术激光步枪 Tactical Laser Rifle

Decompressing Glance.name: 减压一瞥 Decompressing Glance
Decompressing Glance.description:
触发条件 虚无体能看见的 30 英尺内一名生物开始其回合。

效果 目标必须进行一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:20] 豁免。若其失败，则会因挣扎着喘息而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

Trigger A creature within 30 feet that the nihili can see starts its turn.

Effect The target must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:20] save. If it fails, it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute as it struggles to catch its breath.

Decompressing Gaze.name: 解压凝视 Decompressing Gaze
Decompressing Gaze.description:
nihili 凝视其 30 尺内一个它能看见的生物，并向其灌输其先前因减压而死亡的鲜明幻象。受此凝视影响的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:20] 豁免。若其失败，且此前未曾因减压一瞥或此能力而被施加 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}，则其陷入疲乏。若该生物已经疲乏，则豁免失败会使该生物开始窒息，直到 nihili 的下个回合结束。该生物仍保持清醒，并且可以在自己的回合中执行动作，例如施放法术或寻找空气来源。该生物可以如常屏住呼吸。

生物可以在其回合结束时尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:20] 豁免，以摆脱被投射进其心智中的这段经历；若成功，减压凝视的效果结束。nihili 可以在其回合中维持减压凝视，或以一个自由动作结束它。当 nihili 以其减压凝视将新目标指定为另一个生物时，或当该生物成功抵抗这些效果时，目标生物获得空气的能力会恢复。除此之外，这遵循窒息规则。

The nihili stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet and imparts vivid visions of its prior death by decompression. A creature affected by this gaze must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:20] save. If it fails and has not already been @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} by Decompressing Glance or this ability, it becomes fatigued. If the creature is already fatigued, a failed save causes the creature to begin suffocating until the end of the nihili's next turn. The creature remains conscious and can take actions on its turn, such as casting a spell or searching for a source of air. The creature can hold its breath as normal.

A creature can attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:20] save at the end of its turn to break free from the experience being projected into its mind; on a success, the effect of Decompressing Gaze ends. The nihili can Sustain Decompressing Gaze on its turn or end it as a free action. The targeted creature's access to air is restored when the nihili targets a new creature with its Decompressing Gaze or the creature successfully resists the effects. This otherwise follows the rules for suffocation.

Gravity Grab.name: 重力抓取 Gravity Grab
Gravity Grab.description:
虚无体生成一片重力场，将所有生物和未固定的物体拉向自身。位于 @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] 内的每个生物都必须进行一次 @Check[type:reflex|dc:20] 豁免，以抵抗该效果。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物向虚无体移动5尺。

失败 该生物向虚无体移动15尺。

大失败 该生物向虚无体移动30尺。

The nihili generates a field of gravity that pulls all creatures and unsecured objects towards it. Each creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:20] save to resist the effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature moves 5 feet toward the nihili.

Failure The creature moves 15 feet toward the nihili.

Critical Failure The creature moves 30 feet toward the nihili.

Nihili.publicNotes:
暴露在真空中死去的恐怖，促使大多数星舰船员对船体和护甲完整性进行近乎偏执的检查。这也是可憎的不死生物“nihili”诞生的原因。当一个人在真空中因窒息痛苦挣扎时死去，随着体内气体逸散、肺部因试图屏息而塌陷，nihili便由此形成。传说中，第一个以这种可怖方式死去的人，遇见了不死女神厄加图娅的幻象；她献上的一个吻，将其变成了第一个nihili。同样的传说还说，这个nihili至今仍在太空中漫无目的地漂浮，等待着攀附上一艘毫无防备的星舰。

由于它们可能属于任何物种，某个nihili的外貌也各不相同。大多数看起来像是其所属物种的僵尸化版本，不过身上带有骇人的裂纹状痕迹和肿胀鼓包，象征着其死时逸散出的气体。nihili保留着生前的智力，但其心智已完全扭曲，只想着把自己死时承受的同样痛苦施加给生者。通过将目光集中在一个目标身上，nihili能够把自己死亡时的片刻体验灌输给那个生物，使目标有可能在它自身死亡的映照中窒息而亡。

最后一息

一些较老的空间站仍会在用于固定太空行走的天索上再系一根额外的绳线。这根绳线被阴森地称作“最后一息”，原本是作为备用措施，以防通讯中断，而空间站方面怀疑执行任务的人已经死亡。现代护甲、通讯装备和太空行走流程，使得宇航员在维修飞船或空间站外部时变成nihili的可能性极低。但人们对nihili的恐惧如此之深，以至于曾发生过将尸体直接送入太空漂流的情况，也不愿冒险把一个可能变成nihili的尸体带上站内，让它通过使整个空间站失压来传播自身。

The horror of dying when exposed to a vacuum is something that inspires most starship crews to perform obsessive checks on hull and armor integrity. It's also what causes the creation of the foul undead known as nihilis. A nihili comes about when an individual dies while in the throes of asphyxiation within a vacuum, as the gasses within their body exit and their lungs collapse from attempts to hold their breath. Legends say that the first person to die in such a horrific way was met by a vision of the goddess of undeath, Urgathoa, who provided them with a single kiss that changed them into the first nihili. The same legends state that this same nihili still floats aimlessly through space, waiting to cling to an unsuspecting starship.

As they can belong to any species, the physical appearance of a given nihili varies. Most appear as zombie-like version of their respective species, though with gruesome stretch marks and pockets of bloat representing escaping gases from their death. A nihili maintains its prior intellect, subverted entirely to inflicting the same suffering on the living that it endured in death. By focusing their gaze on a target, a nihili can impart moments of its own death onto that creature, potentially suffocating the target in a mirror of its own demise.

The Last Gasp

Some older space stations still use an extra wire tied to the tethers used to secure spacewalks. Grimly called "the last gasp," this wire was intended as a backup in the event that communications were severed and the station suspected they were dead. Modern armor, communication equipment, and spacewalk procedures make it very unlikely that an astronaut will become a nihili while repairing the outside of a ship or station. But nihili are so feared that there have been cases of bodies sent floating into space rather than risking a nihili being brought on board and propagating itself by decompressing an entire station.

Earworm.name: 耳虫 Earworm

Irresistible Refrain.name: 无法抗拒的叠句 Irresistible Refrain
Irresistible Refrain.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到正在播放歌曲的装置30英尺内

效果 这首歌转为循环播放，迫使30英尺内能听见它的、距离最近的10个生物执行一个被建议的行动方案。这是一个9环的@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.GP3wewkQXEPrLxYj]法术（@Check[type:will|dc:35]豁免）。

Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the device playing the song

Effect The song shifts into a loop that compels the 10 closest creatures who can hear it within 30 feet to perform a suggested course of action. This is a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.GP3wewkQXEPrLxYj] spell (@Check[type:will|dc:35] save).

Earworm.disable:
@Check[type:performance|dc:39]（受训）以用另一首曲调扰乱这首歌，@Check[type:computers|dc:38]（受训）以重新编程该装置，@Check[type:crafting|dc:38]（受训）以停用该装置，或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]（9环；反制 DC 45）以反制该法术

@Check[type:performance|dc:39] (trained) to disrupt the song with another tune, @Check[type:computers|dc:38] (trained) to reprogram the device, @Check[type:crafting|dc:38] (trained) to disable the device, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG] (9th rank; counteract DC 45) to counteract the spell
Earworm.hazarddescription:
一段朗朗上口的广告歌谣或流行音乐副歌变得阴森可怖，悄然钻进听者的脑海。

A catchy commercial jingle or popular music refrain turns sinister, worming its way into the listener's mind.

Ad Twist.name: 广告扭转 Ad Twist

A Word from our Sponsors.name: 来自我们的赞助商的一句话 A Word from our Sponsors
A Word from our Sponsors.description:
触发 战斗开始

效果 无人机发出色彩缤纷的广告，并掷先攻。

Trigger The combat begins

Effect The drone emits colorful advertisements and rolls initiative.

Ad Twist.disable:
@Check[computers|dc:28]（受训）以关闭无人机，@Check[crafting|dc:27]（受训）以破坏无人机的投影仪，@Check[thievery|dc:26]（受训）以停用无人机

@Check[computers|dc:28] (trained) to shut down the drone, @Check[crafting|dc:27] (trained) to sabotage the drone's projector, @Check[thievery|dc:26] (trained) to disable the drone
Ad Twist.hazarddescription:
一架悬浮无人机投射出能够以物理方式推挤目标的硬光广告。

A hover drone projects hardlight ads that can physically push targets.
Ad Twist.routine:
（1 动作）该无人机向一名随机 PC 发射一则硬光广告，该目标必须进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:30] 豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到 @Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]] 伤害，并被向后推开 10 英尺。

失败 目标受到 @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]] 伤害，并被向后推开 15 英尺。

大失败 目标受到 @Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]] 伤害，并被向后推开 20 英尺；若处于高重力环境中，则被击倒为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧}；若处于零重力环境中，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{未束缚的}。

(1 action) The drone emits a hardlight advertisement at a random PC who must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:30] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]] damage and is pushed back 10 feet.

Failure The target takes @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]] damage and is pushed back 15 feet.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]] damage, is pushed back 20 feet, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if in high gravity, or becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} if in zero-g.

Mauler Engine Overload.name: 粉碎者引擎过载 Mauler Engine Overload
Mauler Engine Overload.tokenName: 粉碎者引擎过载 Mauler Engine Overload

Detonate.name: 引爆 Detonate
Detonate.description:
触发条件 坠毁的重击者的过载值为 2。第二次过载发生在该重击者的过载值达到 4 时

效果 引擎在毁灭性的爆炸中炸裂。重击者 10 尺内的任何生物受到 @Damage[(2d12+15)[piercing],(2d12+15)[fire]]{2d12+15 点穿刺伤害和 2d12+15 点火焰伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。

Trigger The crashed mauler has an overload value of 2. The second overload occurs when the mauler has an overload value of 4

Effect The engine explodes in a devastating blast. Any creatures within 10 feet of the mauler take @Damage[(2d12+15)[piercing],(2d12+15)[fire]]{2d12+15 piercing and 2d12+15 fire} damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save).

Mauler Engine Overload.disable:
@Check[computers|dc:30]（专家）或 @Check[crafting|dc:30]（受训）以将能量流重新导离引擎，或 @Check[thievery|dc:32]（专家）以切断线路，防止引爆。

@Check[computers|dc:30] (expert) or @Check[crafting|dc:30] (trained) to reroute power flow away from the engines, or @Check[thievery|dc:32] (expert) to cut wiring in a way that prevents detonation.
Mauler Engine Overload.hazarddescription:
坠毁飞船受损的引擎舱不断渗漏液体，并噼啪作响地迸发着能量，看起来极不稳定。

The damaged engine pods of the crashed vessel leak with fluids and crackle with energy, appearing extremely unstable.
Mauler Engine Overload.prototypeToken: 重击者引擎过载 Mauler Engine Overload

Deadly Collapse.name: 致命坍塌 Deadly Collapse

Cave-In.name: 塌方 Cave-In
Cave-In.description:
触发条件 A5 区域内有一个生物的隐匿检定失败，或发出巨大声响

效果 天花板坍塌，对 A5 区域内所有生物造成 @Damage[(4d12+30)[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会被压在岩石下方（@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱} DC 30）。这次坍塌会杀死该区域内的所有员工，并将此处地面变为高等困难地形。

Trigger A creature in area A5 fails a Stealth check or makes a loud noise

Effect The ceiling collapses, dealing @Damage[(4d12+30)[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures in area A5 (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Creatures that fail are additionally pinned beneath the rock (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC 30). This collapse kills all employees in the area and transforms the floor here into greater difficult terrain.

Deadly Collapse.disable:
@Check[crafting|dc:33] 或 @Check[survival|dc:33]（专家）以加固天花板支撑而不引发坍塌。

@Check[crafting|dc:33] or @Check[survival|dc:33] (expert) to reinforce the ceiling supports without causing a collapse.
Deadly Collapse.hazarddescription:
不稳定的天花板坍塌，令房间内充满了岩石和碎石。

An unstable ceiling collapses, filling the room with rock and debris.

Criticism Vulnerability.name: 易受批评 Criticism Vulnerability
Criticism Vulnerability.description:
由于名缚者是由试图成为名人的失败参赛者的自我所构成，忽视并批评名缚者会使其瓦解，因为它会剥离那些在它看来最缺乏才华的尸体。当一个生物成功通过针对名缚者惊怖威压的豁免时，名缚者受到 @Damage[4d6[mental]] 伤害。以这种方式对名缚者造成精神伤害后的 1 小时内，生物可以通过对抗名缚者意志 DC 的成功 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{威吓}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{表演}，或回忆知识动作（使用与娱乐相关的学识），对名缚者造成 @Damage[4d6[mental]] 伤害。

As famesworn are composed of the egos of failed contestants attempting to reach celebrity status, ignoring and criticizing the famesworn causes it to break apart as it sheds its perceivably least talented corpses. When a creature succeeds at its save against a famesworn's frightful presence, the famesworn takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage. For 1 hour after causing mental damage to a famesworn in this way, a creature can deal @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage to the famesworn with a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}, or Recall Knowledge action (using entertainment-related Lore) against the famesworn's Will DC.

Corpse Flash Mob.name: 尸闪暴民 Corpse Flash Mob

Stagecraft.name: 舞台技艺 Stagecraft
Stagecraft.description:
被焰誓者的装备处置打击命中的生物必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:30] 豁免，否则会根据它投掷了什么装备而受到以下效果之一。

  • 扩音器 失败时，目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{失聪} 状态，持续1轮（若为重度失败则为1分钟）。
  • 相机 失败时，目标被击倒并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{俯卧} 状态。

  • 灯光 失败时，目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 状态，持续1轮（若为重度失败则为1分钟）。

A creature hit by a famesworn's equipment disposal Strike must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save or is subject to one of the following effects based on what equipment it threw.

  • Amp On a failure the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).
  • Camera On a failure the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

  • Lights On a failure the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure).

Energy Drain.name: 能量吸取 Energy Drain
Energy Drain.description:
当以尸波打击命中时，墓名者的目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:30] 豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{衰竭 1} 状态。若重度成功，则该目标在 24 小时内暂时免疫墓名者的能量汲取。

When a famesworn hits with a corpse wave Strike, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. On a critical success, the target becomes temporarily immune to the famesworn's energy drain for 24 hours.

Absorb.name: 吸收 Absorb
Absorb.description:
触发条件 誓焰者移动到一个濒死生物的空间内

效果 誓焰者将该濒死生物吸收进自身，立即杀死该生物，并使誓焰者恢复等同于该生物等级数值的生命值。只要誓焰者仍然存在，被吸收的生物就无法被复活，除非通过祈愿术或类似的强大效果。

Trigger The famesworn moves into a dying creature's space

Effect The famesworn absorbs the dying creature into itself, instantly killing the creature and healing the famesworn for a number of Hit Points equal to the creature's level. As long as the famesworn exists, absorbed creatures can't be resurrected except by wish or a similarly powerful effect.

Media Flurry.name: 媒介连击 Media Flurry
Media Flurry.description:
名誓者以相机、通讯装置和其他设备形成的旋风环绕自身，对100英尺放射内的所有生物造成 @Damage[9d8[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] 基础豁免）。名誓者在 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Media Flurry]]{1d4轮} 内无法再次使用“媒体乱袭”。

The famesworn surrounds itself in a cyclone of cameras, comm units, and other devices, dealing @Damage[9d8[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures in a 100 foot emanation (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). The famesworn can't use Media Flurry again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Media Flurry]]{1d4 rounds}.

Plasma Network.name: 等离子网络 Plasma Network

Plasma Shock.name: 等离子震击 Plasma Shock
Plasma Shock.description:
触发 一个生物接触屏障

效果 陷阱对触发该陷阱的生物造成 @Damage[(3d10+14)[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic] 豁免）。

Trigger A creature touches the barrier

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(3d10+14)[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic] save).

Plasma Network.disable:
@Check[arcana|dc:32] or @Check[occultism|dc:32]（专家）以触发魔法防护措施，@Check[computers|dc:32]（专家）以入侵控制台，@Check[crafting|dc:34] or @Check[thievery|dc:34]（大师）以重新接线控制台，或 @Check[Vidgaming Lore|dc:30]（受训）以通关游戏；每次成功都会关闭两道等离子屏障中的一道。

@Check[arcana|dc:32] or @Check[occultism|dc:32] (expert) to trigger magical safeguards, @Check[computers|dc:32] (expert) to Hack the console, @Check[crafting|dc:34] or @Check[thievery|dc:34] (master) to rewire the console, or @Check[Vidgaming Lore|dc:30] (trained) to beat the game; each success disables one of the two plasma barriers.
Plasma Network.hazarddescription:
一道无法穿透的等离子体屏障封锁了房间北侧和西侧的出口。这些屏障由附近的一台控制台操控。

An impenetrable plasma barrier blocks the room's north and west exits. These barriers are controlled at a nearby console.
Plasma Network.reset:
陷阱会自动重置。被禁用或摧毁的屏障不会重置。

The trap resets automatically. A disabled or destroyed barrier does not reset.

Haunted Cockpit.name: 闹鬼的驾驶舱 Haunted Cockpit

Constrict Safety Straps.name: 束缚安全带 Constrict Safety Straps
Constrict Safety Straps.description:
触发条件 一个生物在该灵异区域内激活驾驶站

效果 安全带试图对正在驾驶飞船的生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{擒抱}（运动 +23）。该灵异现象掷先攻。

Trigger A creature activates the piloting station in the area of the haunt

Effect Safety straps attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} the creature piloting the ship (+23 to Athletics). The haunt rolls initiative.

Haunted Cockpit.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:32]（大师）以重新入侵舰船计算机并覆写自动驾驶，或 @Check[type:religion|dc:27]（专家）以削弱作祟，@Check[type:athletics|dc:25] 以 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{挣脱} 或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{强行打开} 安全带；需要四次成功才能将其禁用

@Check[type:computers|dc:32] (master) to hack back into the ship computer and override autopilot, or @Check[type:religion|dc:27] (expert) to weaken the haunt, @Check[type:athletics|dc:25] to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the safety straps; four successes are required to disable it
Haunted Cockpit.hazarddescription:
一名依附于这艘星舰的飞行员幽灵会夺取控制权，并迫使活着的飞行员让飞船坠毁。

The ghost of a pilot attached to the starship overrides controls and forces the living pilot to crash the ship.
Haunted Cockpit.reset:
幽魂飞行员会在 1 小时内返回其驾驶舱，此后它便能再次被触发。

The ghostly pilot returns to its cockpit over the course of an hour, after which it can trigger again.
Haunted Cockpit.routine:
(3 个动作) 这个怨灵使用 3 个动作来驾驶星舰，沿着朝向最近的行星、飞船或其他物体的碰撞航线移动，移动距离最多等于飞船的速度。坠毁造成 @Damage[4d12[bludgeoning]] 伤害。若这个怨灵成功使飞船坠毁，船上的所有生物都必须尝试一次 @Check[type:reflex|dc:33] 豁免。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害。

严重失败 该生物受到双倍伤害。它还会变为 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{受伤 1}（如果它已经处于受伤状态，则其受伤值提高 1）。

每次成功停用这个险境的检定都会使怨灵的移动距离减少四分之一，而第 4 次成功会将其彻底停用。

(3 actions) The haunt uses 3 actions to pilot the starship, traveling up to the ship's speed on a collision course toward the nearest planet, ship, or other object. The crash deals @Damage[4d12[bludgeoning]] damage. If the haunt successfully crashes the ship, all creatures on board must attempt a @Check[type:reflex|dc:33] save.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 1} (or increases its wounded value by 1, if it's already wounded).

Each successful check to disable this hazard reduces the haunt's movement by a quarter, and the fourth success disables it completely.

Laser Web.name: 激光网 Laser Web
激光网 Laser Web
Laser Web.description:
触发条件 一个生物移动到某个传感器 5 尺以内

效果 激光会发射，每一道都会对走廊中的一个生物进行打击。若生物数量多于激光数量，激光会优先攻击触发该效应的生物；若生物数量少于激光数量，激光会优先对触发该效应的生物进行多次打击。

Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of a sensor

Effect The lasers fire, each one Striking a creature in the hallway. If there are more creatures than lasers, the lasers prioritize the triggering creature or creatures; if there are fewer creatures than lasers, the lasers prioritize Striking the triggering creature or creatures multiple times.

Laser.name: 激光 Laser
Laser.description:
无多重攻击减值

no multiple attack penalty

Laser Web.disable:
@Check[type:computers|dc:15]（受训）以禁用每个传感器，或 @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:23]（专家）以悄悄绕过每个传感器

@Check[type:computers|dc:15] (trained) to disable each sensor, or @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:23] (expert) to slip past each sensor
Laser Web.hazarddescription:
隐藏在一条 15 英尺长走廊中的六个传感器在探测到移动时会发射激光。

Six sensors concealed in a 15-foot-long corridor fire lasers when they detect movement.
Laser Web.reset:
该陷阱会在 15 分钟后重置。

The trap resets after 15 minutes.

Quantum Clone.name: 量子克隆 Quantum Clone

Materialize.name: 实体化 Materialize
Materialize.description:
触发条件 一个生物接触到量子粒子

效果 量子粒子实体化出触发生物的一个完美复制体。量子克隆在外观上与该生物完全一致，并会模仿该生物的动作和言语，直到它有时间观察并学习该生物的行为模式，充分到能够完全独立行动为止，这一过程需要 1 分钟。量子克隆实体化时不带有任何武器或装备，但如果该生物拥有徒手打击和天生武器，它可以模仿这些攻击。量子克隆掷先攻。

Trigger A creature touches the quantum particles

Effect The quantum particles materialize a perfect copy of the triggering creature. The quantum clone is visually identical to the creature and mimics the creature's actions and speech until it has time to observe and learn the creature's patterns well enough to act entirely on its own, a process that takes 1 minute. The quantum clone materializes with no weapons or equipment but can mimic unarmed Strikes and natural weapons if the creature has them. The quantum clone rolls initiative.

Mimic.name: 拟态生物 Mimic
Mimic.description:
1 至 3

量子复制体会模仿它所观察到的触发生物采取的一个动作，包括职业能力、移动、法术和言语。它在自己的先攻顺序上行动，使用与原始生物相同的属性值。

1 to 3

The quantum clone mimics an action it has observed the triggering creature take, including class abilities, movements, spells, and speech. It attacks on its initiative, using the same statistics as the original creature.

Quantum Clone.disable:
@Check[type:intimidation|dc:45] （大师）三次以威吓克隆体离开，或 @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:42] （大师）三次以与克隆体达成协议。

@Check[type:intimidation|dc:45] (master) three times to frighten the clone away, or @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:42] (master) three times to reach an accord with the clone.
Quantum Clone.hazarddescription:
量子粒子形成了一个生物的精确复制体，能够以诡异得近乎完美的程度模仿其动作、言语和思想。

Quantum particles form an exact copy of a creature that can mimic its actions, speech, and thoughts with eerie perfection.
Quantum Clone.routine:
（3个动作）量子克隆体会观察触发该反应的生物，并模仿该生物的行为；一旦它受到伤害，便会立即采取敌对行动。在前两轮中，量子克隆体会完全按照触发该反应的生物先前行动的确切顺序来行动；但在之后的轮次中，它会运用战术，以任意顺序使用它观察到该生物曾使用过的动作与反应来行动。

(3 actions) The quantum clone observes the triggering creature and mimics the creature's behavior, taking hostile actions as soon as it takes damage. For the first two rounds, the quantum clone takes actions in the exact order the triggering creature did, but in the following rounds, it acts tactically using actions and reactions it observed the creature using in any order.

Strider Leap.name: 跨行跃步 Strider Leap
Strider Leap.description:
烬蛛族先移动，然后进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{跳远}。它的移动距离可以少于 10 尺，且其跳远检定不会自动失败。

The jinsul Strides and then performs a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}. It can Stride less than 10 feet and not automatically fail its Long Jump check.

Sihedron Guard Commander.name: 七芒星卫队指挥官 Sihedron Guard Commander
Sihedron Guard Commander.tokenName: 七芒星卫队指挥官 Sihedron Guard Commander

Sihedron Guard Armor.name: 七芒星卫队护甲 Sihedron Guard Armor
Sihedron Guard Armor.description:
升级： 1

这款传统护甲由柔韧而坚固的甲片层叠而成，是卡斯卓韦的拉申塔人骑兵所穿戴的装备。过去，shotalashu 骑兵会用其坐骑蜕下的皮来打造自己的护甲；更罕见的情况下，也会用阵亡坐骑的皮制成，以在未来的战斗中表达对它们的敬意。

Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles.

Darkvision Visor.name: 黑暗视觉面罩 Darkvision Visor
Darkvision Visor.description:
这个面罩环绕着你的视觉器官，增强你的天生感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.

Advanced Dueling Sword.name: 先进型决斗剑 Advanced Dueling Sword

Reactive Strike.name: 借机攻击 Reactive Strike
Reactive Strike.description:
触发条件 你触及范围内的一个生物进行具有操纵特质的动作或移动动作、进行一次远程攻击，或在其正在进行的移动动作中离开一个方格

效果 你向露出破绽的敌人猛然出手。对触发该反应的生物进行一次近战Strike。若你的攻击为重击，且触发条件是具有操纵特质的动作，则你打断该动作。此次Strike不计入你的多重攻击减值，且你的多重攻击减值不适用于此次Strike。

Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Terrifying Takedown.name: 骇人击倒 Terrifying Takedown
Terrifying Takedown.description:
触发条件 指挥官用一次打击使一名敌人的生命值降至 0，或用一次打击对一名敌人造成重击

效果 指挥官将自己残暴的一击变成骇人的场面。他们尝试进行一次 @Check[intimidation] 检定，以对 30 尺内的所有敌人 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{威吓}。

Trigger The commander reduces an enemy to 0 Hit Points or critically hits an enemy with a Strike

Effect The commander makes a gruesome spectacle of their brutal hit. They attempt an @Check[intimidation] check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} all enemies within 30 feet.

Lead the Charge.name: 冲锋在前 Lead the Charge
Lead the Charge.description:
指挥官两次【Stride】。如果他们在此次移动结束时位于至少一个敌人的近战触及范围内，他们便会对该敌人进行一次近战【Strike】。指挥官的盟友对这次【Strike】的目标进行攻击时获得+1处境加值，并忽略指挥官为该目标提供的任何掩护。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YJ3BHkDXXxsBcRnP]{效果：率先冲锋}

The commander Strides twice. If they end this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they make a melee Strike against that enemy. The commander's allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack the target of this Strike and ignore any cover the commander provides the target.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.YJ3BHkDXXxsBcRnP]{Effect: Lead the Charge}

Rally the Troops.name: 鼓舞部队 Rally the Troops
Rally the Troops.description:
指挥官下令让其盟友重新集结。所有位于指挥官120英尺内的七芒星卫队盟友都可以使用一个反应动作，以其速度进行一次Stride。任何在移动结束时邻接另一名七芒星卫队的七芒星卫队获得5点临时生命值，持续1分钟；若其在移动结束时邻接指挥官，则获得双倍数量的临时生命值。指挥官在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rally the Troops]]{1d4轮}之前不能再次发动“集结部队”。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6lT9d0YrRkdWOJ7u]{效果：集结部队}

The commander issues an order for their allies to regroup. All Sihedron guard allies within 120 feet of the commander can use a reaction to Stride up to their Speed. Any Sihedron guards who end their movement adjacent to another Sihedron guard gain 5 temporary Hit Points that last 1 minute, or double that number of temporary Hit Points if they end their movement adjacent to the commander. The commander can't Rally the Troops again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rally the Troops]]{1d4 rounds}.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6lT9d0YrRkdWOJ7u]{Effect: Rally the Troops}

Tactical Strike.name: 战术打击 Tactical Strike
Tactical Strike.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 指挥官呼喝一名位于 60 英尺内的敌人，然后对该敌人进行一次打击；若命中，则额外造成 1d6 精准伤害。若此次命中成功，指挥官便会扭转战局，激励盟友展现更高超的军事才能。所有位于指挥官 60 英尺内的七芒星卫队，在指挥官下个回合开始前，攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得 +1 状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.ppKeWbPcSaVqD1Cj]{效果：战术打击}

Frequency once per round

Effect The commander calls out an enemy within 60 feet then makes a Strike against that enemy, dealing an additional 1d6 precision damage on a hit. If the hit is successful, the commander changes the tide of the battle, inspiring their allies to greater feats of military prowess. All sihedron guards within 60 feet of the commander gain a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls until the beginning of the commander's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.ppKeWbPcSaVqD1Cj]{Effect: Tactical Strike}

Sihedron Guard Commander.prototypeToken: 七芒星卫队指挥官 Sihedron Guard Commander

Cybernetic Zombie.name: 电控机械僵尸 Cybernetic Zombie
Cybernetic Zombie.tokenName: 电控机械丧尸 Cybernetic Zombie

Cybernetics.name: 电控机械 Cybernetics
Cybernetics.description:
只要成功通过一次 DC 15 的 [[/act disable-device dc=15]]{禁用装置} 检定，这只丧尸的电控机械就会失效 1 小时。如果它受到任何电击伤害，这只丧尸的电控机械也会失效 1 小时。电控机械失效的机械改造丧尸会处于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{迟缓 1}，且不能使用反应（包括自爆）。

The zombie's cybernetics can be disabled for 1 hour with a successful DC 15 check to [[/act disable-device dc=15]]{Disable a Device}. The zombie's cybernetics are disabled for 1 hour if it takes any electricity damage. A cybernetic zombie with disabled cybernetics is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions (including Self Destruct).

Self Destruct.name: 自毁 Self Destruct
Self Destruct.description:
需求 电控机械僵尸在满足触发条件时必须使用此反应，除非其义体被停用

触发条件 电控机械僵尸的生命值降至 0

效果 僵尸受损的义体发生爆炸，在一个 @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]{10 英尺半径}内造成 @Damage[1d8[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:15|basic:true] 豁免）。此能力会摧毁僵尸身上的任何科技物品。

Requirements A cybernetic zombie must use this reaction when the trigger is met unless its cybernetics are disabled

Trigger The cybernetic zombie is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The zombie's damaged cybernetics explode, dealing @Damage[1d8[electricity]] damage in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]{10-foot radius} (@Check[type:reflex|dc:15|basic:true] save). This ability destroys any technological items on the zombie.

Integrated Commercial Laser Pistol.name: 集成式商用激光手枪 Integrated Commercial Laser Pistol

Cybernetic Zombie.prototypeToken: 电控机械僵尸 Cybernetic Zombie

Cosmic Blood Scent.name: 太空血腥气息 Cosmic Blood Scent
Cosmic Blood Scent.description:
虚空鲨能够在太空真空中嗅闻，并且能够在行星尺度的范围内于太空真空中嗅到血腥味。

The void shark can smell in the vacuum of space and can smell blood in the vacuum of space at planetary range.

Strafing Kerplunk.name: 扫射式扑通坠落 Strafing Kerplunk
Strafing Kerplunk.description:
鲨鱼先飞行至多相当于其飞行速度一半的距离，进行一次尾巴打击，然后再飞行至多相当于其速度一半的距离。若命中，目标获得@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{未束缚的}状态。

The shark Flies up to half its fly Speed, makes a tail Strike, and then Flies up to half its Speed further. On a hit the target gains the @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} condition.

Savage.name: 野蛮的 Savage
Savage.description:
需求 虚空鲨在本回合中其最近一个动作以颚击Strike命中

效果 被虚空鲨命中的生物受到 @Damage[2d10[slashing]] 伤害。

Requirements The void shark hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn

Effect The creature the void shark hit takes @Damage[2d10[slashing]] damage.

Corpse Fleet Screamer.name: 尸骸舰队尖啸者 Corpse Fleet Screamer
Corpse Fleet Screamer.tokenName: 尸骸舰队尖啸者 Corpse Fleet Screamer

Jetpack (Commercial).name: 喷气背包（商用） Jetpack (Commercial)
Jetpack (Commercial).description:
大小如背包的推进器安装在你的护甲背部，让你能够飞行。

激活—飞行 1 (manipulate)

效果 你激活喷气背包以获得 20 尺的飞行速度。此效果持续 1 分钟，或直到你将其解除。你可以用一个动作飞行 0 尺来悬浮在原地，但在这样做时，你处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。如果你处于负重状态，喷气背包无法将你抬起。

Boosters the size of a backpack attach to the back of your armor and allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

Defrex Hide (Advanced).name: 德弗雷克斯兽皮（先进型） Defrex Hide (Advanced)
Defrex Hide (Advanced).description:
升级： 1+1

这种轻甲由维斯克二号上一种凶猛哺乳动物的兽皮制成，在维斯克蜥人中尤其受欢迎。经过鞣制的厚实皮块用金属丝缝合在一起，关节处则用金属饰钉或鳞片加固。

Upgrades: 1+1

Made from the hide of a ferocious mammal native to Vesk-2, this light armor is especially popular among vesk. Tanned slabs of the creature's thick hide are stitched together with metal wires, and the joints are reinforced with metal studs or scales.

Advanced Screamer.name: 先进尖啸者 Advanced Screamer
Advanced Screamer.description:
升级： 2

尖啸器外形类似一个需要双手持握的大型定向扬声器，能够发出震耳欲聋的声浪，音量大到足以震碎玻璃并震裂耳膜。调低音量时，尖啸器可以作为便携式扩音器使用

Upgrades: 2

Resembling a large directional speaker held in two hands, a screamer produces a deafening rush of sound loud enough to shatter glass and rupture eardrums. At lower volumes, a screamer functions as a portable loudspeaker

Area Fire.name: 区域射击 Area Fire
Area Fire.description:
