尖啸者 (@Template[type:cone|distance:15], 消耗 2, mag 40, 装填 1, 科技, 笨重)

伤害 @Damage[(2d12+6)[son波]] (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]) 外加压制射击

Screamer (@Template[type:cone|distance:15], expend 2, mag 40, reload 1, tech, unwieldy)

Damage @Damage[(2d12+6)[sonic]] (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]) plus suppressing fire

Suppressing Fire.name: 压制射击 Suppressing Fire
Suppressing Fire.description:
对尖啸者的区域射击进行豁免失败的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制} 状态，直到尸骸舰队尖啸者的下个回合开始。

Creatures who fail their save against a screamer's Area Fire become @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the start of the Corpse Fleet screamer's next turn.

Pump up the Volume.name: 提高音量 Pump up the Volume
Pump up the Volume.description:
尸骸舰队尖啸者使其尖啸器过载，增强其效能。如果其下一动作是用其尖啸器使用区域射击，其消耗增加至4，区域增加为一个 @Template[type:cone|distance:30]，且造成的伤害增加至 @Damage[(3d12+6)[sonic]]。

The Corpse Fleet screamer overcharges their screamer, increasing its potency. If their next action is to use Area Fire with their screamer, its expend increases to 4, the area increases to a @Template[type:cone|distance:30], and the damage dealt increases to @Damage[(3d12+6)[sonic]].

Corpse Fleet Screamer.prototypeToken: 尸骸舰队尖啸者 Corpse Fleet Screamer

Psychic Composition.name: 心灵谱曲 Psychic Composition

Eerie Scream.name: 诡异尖啸 Eerie Scream
Eerie Scream.description:
触发条件 PC们阻止一名员工刻下乐谱记号

效果 员工们尖声大叫，对A3区域内的所有生物造成 @Damage[(3d10+16)[sonic]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:33|basic] 豁免）。该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger The PCs prevent an employee from carving the musical notations

Effect The employees scream, dealing @Damage[(3d10+16)[sonic]] damage to all creatures in area A3 (@Check[will|dc:33|basic] save). The trap rolls initiative.

Psychic Composition.disable:
@Check[音乐学识|dc:29]（专家）以与该乐曲协调一致，@Check[performance|dc:31]（专家）以即兴发挥或重新诠释该乐曲，或 @Check[arcana|dc:33] 或 @Check[occultism|dc:33]（大师）以解开为该乐曲提供动力的灵能共振；需要两次成功才能停用该陷阱。

@Check[Music Lore|dc:29] (expert) to harmonize with the composition, @Check[performance|dc:31] (expert) to improvise or reinterpret the composition, or @Check[arcana|dc:33] or @Check[occultism|dc:33] (master) to untangle the psychic resonance powering the composition; two successes are required to disable the trap.
Psychic Composition.hazarddescription:
诡异的音乐雕刻发出灵能的刺耳喧嚣。

Eerie musical carvings emit a psychic cacophony.
Psychic Composition.routine:
（2 动作）该陷阱对 A3 区域内的所有生物造成 @Damage[(2d8+8)[mental]] 伤害 和 @Damage[(2d8+8)[sonic]] 伤害（@Check[will|dc:33|basic] 豁免）。豁免严重失败的生物还会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{虚弱 2} 状态，持续 10 分钟。

(2 actions) The trap deals @Damage[(2d8+8)[mental]] damage and @Damage[(2d8+8)[sonic]] damage to all creatures in area A3 (@Check[will|dc:33|basic] save). Creatures that critically fail their save are also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 10 minutes.

Reactor Security Seal.name: 反应堆安保封印 Reactor Security Seal
Reactor Security Seal.tokenName: 反应堆安全封印 Reactor Security Seal

Electrical Surge.name: 电涌 Electrical Surge
Electrical Surge.description:
触发条件 一个生物试图手动覆盖门的控制失败，或一个生物触碰了一扇密封的门

效果 门内的电路发出光芒并噼啪作响，充满电能，使区域内所有生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩} 1轮（@Check[fortitude|dc:35] 豁免）。该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger A creature fails an attempt to manually override the door, or a creature touches a sealed door

Effect Circuitry inside the door glows and crackles with electrical energy, causing all creatures in the area to be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|dc:35] save). The trap rolls initiative.

Reactor Security Seal.disable:
@Check[computers|dc:44]（大师）或 @Check[thievery|dc:44]（大师）可以在不使用相应安保封印的远程覆写终端的情况下，手动覆写一扇门。门的远程覆写终端位于B5、B8和B9区域；Whiskers 的覆写序列可使一个生物无需进行检定即可成功。

@Check[computers|dc:44] (master) or @Check[thievery|dc:44] (master) to manually override one door without using the associated security seal's remote override terminal. The remote override terminals for the doors are in areas B5, B8, and B9; Whiskers's override sequence allows a creature to succeed without needing to attempt a check.
Reactor Security Seal.hazarddescription:
一系列三个已密封的气闸受到一道强力电场的保护。

A series of three sealed airlocks is protected by a potent electrical field.
Reactor Security Seal.reset:
陷阱在被触发后，如果 1 分钟内没有任何生物在B7区域内移动，就会解除激活并重置。

The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature moving in area B7 after the trap was triggered.
Reactor Security Seal.routine:
（1 动作）电弧从门中迸发而出，对 B7 区域内的所有生物造成 @Damage[(3d10+16)[electricity]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] 豁免）。

(1 action) Arcs of electricity surge out from the door, dealing @Damage[(3d10+16)[electricity]] damage to all creatures in area B7 (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] save).
Reactor Security Seal.prototypeToken: 反应堆安全封印 Reactor Security Seal

Easily Misled.name: 容易受骗 Easily Misled
Easily Misled.description:
巨魔重炮手对抗欺瞒检定时，其感知 DC 会受到 –4 的境况减值。

The troll bombard gets a –4 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC against Deception checks.

Freebooter Armor (Advanced).name: 自由掠夺者护甲（先进型） Freebooter Armor (Advanced)
Freebooter Armor (Advanced).description:
升级： 1

掠夺者护甲因经常穿戴这类装备的海盗与亡命之徒而得名。掠夺者护甲通常由穿在夹克或飞行服内侧的胸甲、厚重的靴子和手套、头盔，以及用于隐藏携带武器的隐蔽束带和枪套组成。

Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.

Frag Grenade (Superior).name: 破片手榴弹（卓越型） Frag Grenade (Superior)
Frag Grenade (Superior).description:
激活 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{区域射击}

这些破片手雷会在一团弹片云中爆炸，并在一个 @Template[type:burst|distance:15] 内造成 @Damage[2d8[piercing]] 穿刺伤害，附带一次 @Check[type:reflex|against:class|basic:true] 豁免。

重击 @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] 伤害

Activate 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire}

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deals @Damage[2d8[piercing]] piercing damage in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] with a @Check[type:reflex|against:class|basic:true] save.

Critical @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage

Incendiary Grenade (Superior).name: 燃烧手雷（卓越型） Incendiary Grenade (Superior)
Incendiary Grenade (Superior).description:
激活 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire}

这些手雷使用被点燃的化学物质爆炸，形成一阵强烈高温的爆炸，并造成 @Damage[2d8[fire]] 伤害，进行一次 @Check[type:reflex|against:class|basic:true] 豁免检定。若你拥有手雷的武器致命专精，则对燃烧手雷的豁免检定大失败的生物会被从手雷处击退。

半径 15 英尺 重击 10 英尺

Activate 1 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire}

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage with a @Check[type:reflex|against:class|basic:true] save. If you have the critical weapon specialization of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.

Radius 15 ft Critical 10 feet

Superior Machine Gun.name: 卓越型机枪 Superior Machine Gun
Superior Machine Gun.description:
升级： 3

这些久经考验且可靠的自动武器既能进行短点射，也能将弹匣彻底打空，以清扫战场。

Upgrades: 3

These proven and reliable automatic weapons are capable of firing in short bursts or completely emptying their magazines to clear a battlefield.

Jetpack (Commercial).name: 喷气背包（商用） Jetpack (Commercial)
Jetpack (Commercial).description:
大小如背包的推进器安装在你护甲的背部，让你能够飞行。

激活—飞行 1 (manipulate)

效果 你激活喷气背包，获得20尺的飞行速度。该效果持续1分钟，或直到你将其解除。你可以用一个动作飞行0尺以悬浮在原地，但在这样做时，你处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。如果你处于负重状态，喷气背包无法将你抬起。

Boosters the size of a backpack attach to the back of your armor and allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

Area Fire.name: 区域射击 Area Fire
Area Fire.description:
破片手雷 (@Template[type:burst|distance:15]，射程 30 尺)

伤害 @Damage[(2d8+6)[piercing]] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic])

燃烧手雷 (@Template[type:burst|distance:15]，射程 30 尺)

伤害 @Damage[(2d8+6)[fire]] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic])

Frag grenade (@Template[type:burst|distance:15], range 30 feet)

Damage @Damage[(2d8+6)[piercing]] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic])

Incendiary grenade (@Template[type:burst|distance:15], range 30 feet)

Damage @Damage[(2d8+6)[fire]] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic])

Auto-Fire.name: 自动射击 Auto-Fire
Auto-Fire.description:
机枪 (@Template[type:cone|distance:20])

伤害 @Damage[(2d8+6)[piercing]] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic])，外加压制射击

machine gun (@Template[type:cone|distance:20])

Damage @Damage[(2d8+6)[piercing]] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic]) plus suppressing fire

Primordial Roar.name: 太初咆哮 Primordial Roar
Primordial Roar.description:
巨魔战首领发出野兽般的咆哮。@Template[type:emanation|distance:100]内的每个非巨魔生物都必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:29] 豁免。随后，该生物在10分钟内会暂时免疫。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌 1}。

失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌 2}。

大失败 该生物陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{恐慌 3}。

The troll warleader unleashes a bestial roar. Each non-troll creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:100] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Strafing Bombard.name: 扫射轰炸 Strafing Bombard
Strafing Bombard.description:
巨魔轰炸手疾行，移动距离最多等同于其速度。在此次移动过程中的任意时点，巨魔都可以进行一次交互动作来抽出一枚手雷，并立刻进行区域射击来投掷该手雷。它们可以在以这种方式移动时，总共抽出并投掷两枚手雷。

The troll bombard Strides up to their Speed. At any point during this movement, the troll can Interact to draw a grenade and immediately Area Fire to throw that grenade. They can draw and throw a total of two grenades during their movement in this way.

Vital Spray.name: 活力喷射 Vital Spray
Vital Spray.description:
轰炸巨魔撕开自己的胸膛，扯裂自身的护甲，同时在痛苦的嚎叫中喷洒出一锥形的内脏。巨魔可以尝试对@Template[type:cone|distance:30]内的每个非巨魔生物进行@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{恐吓}。它们随即在一阵再生激涌中立即恢复 @Damage[60[healing]] 生命值。失去护甲后，轰炸巨魔的 AC 降至 25。该能力在 1 小时内无法再次使用。

The bombard cuts open their chest, ripping apart their own armor as they spray a cone of viscera in a howl of pain. The troll can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} each non-troll creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30]. They immediately heal @Damage[60[healing]] Hit Points in a surge of regeneration. Without their armor, the bombard's AC drops to 25. This ability can't be used again for 1 hour.

Regeneration 20 (Deactivated by Electric.name: 再生 20（被电击或火焰停用） Regeneration 20 (Deactivated by Electricity Or Fire)

Furious Roar.name: 狂暴咆哮 Furious Roar
Furious Roar.description:
触发条件 巨魔轰击者受到电击或火焰伤害

效果 巨魔轰击者使用其原初咆哮，并且如果其知晓该伤害的来源，则可以向其进行 Stride。若该轰击者具有持续性火焰伤害，则其尝试一次 @Check[flat|dc:15] 以将其移除。

Trigger The troll bombard takes electricity or fire damage

Effect The troll bombard uses their Primordial Roar and, if they're aware of the damage's source, can Stride towards it. If the bombard has persistent fire damage, they attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15] to remove it.

Suppressing Fire.name: 压制射击 Suppressing Fire
Suppressing Fire.description:
对巨魔炮击手的区域火力豁免失败的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制} 状态，直到巨魔炮击手下个回合开始。

Creatures who fail their save against a Troll Bombard's Area Fire become @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the start of the Troll Bombard's next turn.

Sihedron Guard Specialist.name: 七芒星卫队专家 Sihedron Guard Specialist
Sihedron Guard Specialist.tokenName: 七芒星卫队专家 Sihedron Guard Specialist

Advanced Aeon Rifle.name: 先进型永恒步枪 Advanced Aeon Rifle
Advanced Aeon Rifle.description:
升级： 0

作为阿兹兰特星际帝国的制式装备，这把流线型激光步枪设有一个用于镶嵌艾恩石的槽位，以增强并聚焦其光束的强度。

Upgrades: 0

A mainstay of the Azlanti Star Empire, this sleek laser rifle includes a slot for aeon stones to enhance and focus the intensity of its beams.

Shock Module (Commercial).name: 电击模块（商用） Shock Module (Commercial)
Shock Module (Commercial).description:
这项看似简单的升级会让电流安全地流经你的武器，使其在命中时额外造成 @Damage[1d6[electricity]] 伤害。若造成重击，电流会迸射而出，对目标10英尺内由你选择的至多两个其他生物造成等量的电击伤害。

This deceptively simple upgrade safely courses electricity through your weapon, dealing an extra @Damage[1d6[electricity]] damage on a hit. On a critical hit, electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.

Advanced Skyfire Armor.name: 先进型天火护甲 Advanced Skyfire Armor
Advanced Skyfire Armor.description:
升级： 0

这些装饰性的中型护甲配有夸张的肩甲、风格化的龙翼，以及遍布胸甲前后与背部的天火标志，并且常镀有黄金或其他美观的金属。典型的天火护甲会为了风格而牺牲升级空间。

Upgrades: 0

These decorative suits of medium armor feature exaggerated shoulder guards, stylized dragon wings, and Skyfire logos across the breastplate's back and chest, and are often plated with gold or other attractive metals. Typical Skyfire armor sacrifices upgrade space for style.

Darkvision Visor.name: 黑暗视觉面罩 Darkvision Visor
Darkvision Visor.description:
这副面罩环绕包覆你的视觉器官，增强你的天然感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.

Aeon Stone (Cloudy Blue Rhomboid).name: 万象石（混浊蓝色菱形） Aeon Stone (Cloudy Blue Rhomboid)
Aeon Stone (Cloudy Blue Rhomboid).description:
这些石头是阿兹兰特星际帝国的常见物品，因其与已知宇宙构筑的关联而在整个宇宙中广受追捧。尽管它们的形态与功能千差万别，据称这些石头全都是异界实体在太古时期用来构建宇宙的水晶工具碎片。

当你灌注其中一枚这种经精密切割的水晶时，这块石头会绕着你的头部运转（如果你没有头部，则绕着你身体上其他可见的部位运转），而不是佩戴在身上。你可以用一个交互动作收起一枚万古石，而一枚正在环绕的石头可以被他人对你成功施展一次@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械}动作，从空中夺走。被收起或移除的石头仍然保持灌注，但其效果会受到压制，直到你再次让它绕着头部运转为止。

万古石有多种类型，各自具有不同的外观与魔法效果。每一枚万古石在嵌入特定物品时还会获得一种共鸣力量，例如带有万古特征的武器，或称为寻路仪的失落已久的魔法物品。

这枚带有浑浊内含物的深蓝色棱晶轻若鸿毛。它的共鸣力量使你在特技检定上获得+1物品加值。

激活—自由飞翔 3 (专注)

频率 每天一次

效果 你获得1分钟的飞行速度，数值等于你的速度或20尺，以较高者为准。

Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these stones are sought across the cosmos for their connection with the building of the known universe. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or long-lost magical items called wayfinders.

This deep-blue prism with cloudy inclusions is light as a feather. Its resonant power gives you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate—Fly Free 3 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a fly Speed for 1 minute equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Punishment For Failure.name: 失败惩罚 Punishment For Failure
Punishment For Failure.description:
触发条件 七芒星卫队专家的生命值降至 0，且其在过去一年内使用过他们的“服从奖赏”反应。七芒星卫队必须在满足该触发条件时使用此能力

效果 七芒星卫队专家被彻底摧毁，只留下装备。其灵魂无法被复原，且任何魔法手段都无法与其灵魂取得联系。

Trigger The Sihedron Guard specialist is reduced to 0 Hit Points and has used their Reward of Obedience reaction in the last year. A Sihedron Guard must use this ability when the trigger is met

Effect The Sihedron Guard specialist is utterly destroyed, leaving behind only equipment. Their soul can't be restored, and no magical means can contact their soul.

Reward of Obedience.name: 顺从之赐 Reward of Obedience
Reward of Obedience.description:
频率 每年一次

触发条件 七芒星卫队 specialist 的生命值降至 0，但并非由于未留下任何遗骸的效果（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.xS4bqHnbodCwjpqI]）

效果 七芒星卫队 specialist 恢复 @Damage[5d8[healing]] 生命值，且不会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，也不会掉落其装备。

Frequency once per year

Trigger The Sihedron Guard specialist is reduced to 0 Hit Points, but not from an effect that leaves no remains (like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.xS4bqHnbodCwjpqI])

Effect The Sihedron Guard specialist restores @Damage[5d8[healing]] Hit Points and doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or drop their equipment.

Arcane Prepared Spells.name: 奥术预备法术 Arcane Prepared Spells

Promession.name: 普罗米申 Promession
Promession.description:
你将目标瞬间冰冻，然后向其体内传入次声波，可能将其化为细粉。对目标进行一次法术攻击检定。若你命中目标，则目标受到 6d10 点寒冷伤害，并且必须进行一次强韧豁免。生命值降至 0 的生物会被炸成细粉；其装备会保留下来。

大成功 目标不受后续伤害影响。

成功 目标额外受到 @Damage[floor(@item.level - 3)d10[cold]] 点伤害。

失败 目标额外受到 @Damage[floor(@item.level)d10[cold]] 点伤害。

大失败 目标额外受到 @Damage[floor(@item.level + 4)d10[cold]] 点伤害。

强化（+1） 寒冷伤害和音波伤害各增加 1d10。

You flash freeze a target then send subsonic waves through it, potentially reducing it into fine powder. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit a target, then the target takes 6d10 cold damage and must make a Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by further damage.

Success The target takes an additional @Damage[floor(@item.level - 3)d10[cold]] damage.

Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[floor(@item.level)d10[cold]] damage.

Critical Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[floor(@item.level + 4)d10[cold]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The cold and sonic damage increases by 1d10.

Wall of Plasma.name: 等离子墙 Wall of Plasma
Wall of Plasma.description:
你塑造出一道噼啪作响的等离子体墙，会灼烧穿过它的生物。你可以创造一道厚 5 英尺、呈直线延伸、最长 60 英尺且高 10 英尺的等离子体墙，或者创造一个厚 5 英尺、半径 10 英尺且高度相同的环形等离子体墙。无论哪种形式，这道墙都垂直竖立；如果你愿意，这道墙也可以更短或更低。墙两侧的一切，对于另一侧的生物而言都处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。任何穿过这道墙的生物，或在其回合开始时占据墙体区域的生物，都会受到 6d6 火焰伤害和 2d6 持续电击伤害。

强化（+1） 火焰伤害增加 1d6，持续电击伤害增加 1d6。

You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures that pass through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 6d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electrical damage.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d6 and the persistent electrical damage increases by 1d6.

Overload Systems.name: 系统过载 Overload Systems
Overload Systems.description:
你以电磁干扰充斥该区域。你对区域内所有其他生物造成 8d8 点电击伤害。区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全额伤害，且任何具有科技特征的物品获得 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 1}，持续 1 分钟或直到该状态被移除。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，且任何具有科技特征的物品获得 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障 2}，持续 1 分钟或直到该状态被移除

You flood the area with electrical interference. You deal 8d8 electricity damage to all other creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and any items with the tech trait gain @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and any items with the tech trait gain @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} for 1 minute or until the condition is removed

Shifting Surge.name: 位移涌动 Shifting Surge
Shifting Surge.description:
你释放出一股魔法能量浪潮，暂时改变目标武器造成的伤害类型。该武器下一次进行的 Strike 造成你所选择的酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波伤害，并额外造成 1d6 与该武器通常伤害类型相同的额外伤害。

强化（+2） 额外伤害提高 1d6

You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a target weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6

Caustic Conversion.name: 腐蚀性转化 Caustic Conversion
Caustic Conversion.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米机器洪流，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你造成3d8点强酸伤害外加1d6点持续性强酸伤害。重击时，初始伤害加倍，但持续性伤害不加倍。

强化（+2） 初始伤害增加2d8，且持续性强酸伤害增加1d6

You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6

Supercharge Weapon.name: 武器超充能 Supercharge Weapon
Supercharge Weapon.description:
你从周围吸收并凝聚环境中的魔法能量，为一把武器充能。使用该武器进行的下一次打击会被超充能。该次打击会额外造成 1d6 点与该武器通常伤害类型相同的额外伤害。

升阶（+2） 额外伤害增加 1d6。

You draw in and condense ambient magical energy from around you to power up a weapon. The next Strike made using that weapon is supercharged. That Strike deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6.

Analyze Target.name: 分析 Analyze Target
Analyze Target.description:
你专注于目标，在魔法全息影像显示信息的同时收集数据。当施法完成时，你会获知目标的生物特征信息，包括其指纹、医疗状况以及其他基础生理信息。你或任何经由你告知此分析结果的人，在冒充该生物时、进行用于 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} 的医疗检定时，以及针对该生物进行回忆知识动作时，获得+1处境加值。若该生物是虚幻的，或处于幻觉魔法的效果之下，只有当该效果的环阶低于你的分析目标法术的法术环阶时，你才会察觉到这一点。

强化（3环） 处境加值提高至+2，且你的目标至多可以为10个生物。

强化（6环） 处境加值提高至+3，且你可以将任意数量的生物作为目标。

You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Impersonate the creature, on Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, and to Recall Knowledge actions about the creature. If the creature is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the spell rank of your analyze target spell.

Heightened (3rd) The circumstance bonus increases to +2 and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The circumstance bonus increases to +3 and you can target any number of creatures.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友身上的魔法物品与持续生效的法术。只有当幻术魔法的效果环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到该幻术魔法。不过，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{隐形药水}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，由GM判定。

升阶（4环） 如同3环，但你还会锁定最高环阶魔法的来源。与不精确感官类似，你不会得知其确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到5尺立方体内（若其大于该范围，则锁定最近的那一部分）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Injury Echo.name: 伤势回响 Injury Echo
Injury Echo.description:
你将来自未来或过去的伤势显现出来，以伤害当前的一名生物。选择：钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。目标受到 1d6 所选类型的伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免失败，且在你的下个回合结束前受到相同类型的伤害，则其还会额外受到 @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] 伤害。

高阶化（+2） 初始伤害增加 1d6，失败时的持续伤害增加 1d4。

You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d6 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

Recharge Weapon.name: 武器充能 Recharge Weapon
Recharge Weapon.description:
你触碰一把没有剩余弹药的武器，并用魔法能量为其充能。目标获得等同于其用量的弹药或充能，持续到你的下个回合结束，使任何持有该目标的人都能用该武器进行一次打击。此法术只能为使用单次成本为10信用点或更少的弹药的武器充能

You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its usage until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less

Battle Casting.name: 战斗施法 Battle Casting
Battle Casting.description:
七芒星卫队专家用他们的永世步枪进行一次远程打击，或用他们的战斗手套进行一次近战打击，然后对同一目标施放一个需要 2 个动作或更少的法术。如果该法术需要进行攻击检定，则不要将这次远程或近战打击计入多重攻击减值。

The Sihedron Guard specialist makes a ranged Strike with their aeon rifle or a melee strike with their battleglove, then Casts a Spell requiring 2 actions or less against the same target. If the spell requires an attack roll, don't count the ranged or melee Strike toward the multiple attack penalty.

Virtue in Service.name: 服务中的美德 Virtue in Service
Virtue in Service.description:
当一名七芒星卫队专精者在与另一名七芒星卫队成员相邻时进行一次打击时，其此次攻击的伤害掷骰获得+4处境加值。

A Sihedron Guard specialist who makes a Strike while adjacent to another member of the Sihedron Guard gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage rolls for that attack.

Sihedron Guard Specialist.prototypeToken: 七芒星卫队专家 Sihedron Guard Specialist

Feral Ghoul.name: 野性食尸鬼 Feral Ghoul

Consume Flesh.name: 吞食血肉 Consume Flesh
Consume Flesh.description:
需求 食尸鬼邻接于一具生物的尸体，该生物在过去 1 小时内死亡。

效果 食尸鬼吞食尸体的一块血肉，并恢复 [[/r 1d6[healing]]] 点生命值。

它每具尸体只能借此恢复一次生命值。

Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains [[/r 1d6[healing]]] Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

Swift Leap.name: 迅捷跳跃 Swift Leap
Swift Leap.description:
食尸鬼跳跃至多不超过其速度的一半。此次移动不会触发反应。

The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Feral Ghoul.publicNotes:
很少有生物能像被称为食尸鬼的食肉不死生物那样，在荒凉的墓地和破败的地穴等阴森地点如此常见。

Few creatures are more ubiquitous to sinister locations such as lonely graveyards and ruined crypts than the flesh-eating undead known as ghouls.

Immolsivix.name: 伊莫尔西维克斯 Immolsivix

Fungal Armor.name: 真菌护甲 Fungal Armor
Fungal Armor.description:
焚焰真菌兽具有真菌护甲，使其获得对所有伤害的抗性 10，并且视为始终受益于掩护。若焚焰真菌兽将受到火焰伤害，其真菌护甲会被点燃；它失去其真菌护甲提供的所有益处，并受到 @Damage[3d8[persistent,fire]] 伤害或造成其受伤害之效果的持续性伤害（取较高者）。这会无视其火焰免疫。若焚焰真菌兽未受到持续性火焰伤害影响，则会在其回合开始时重新长出其真菌护甲。

An immolsivix has fungal armor that grants resistance 10 against all damage and counts as always benefiting from cover. If an immolsivix would take fire damage its fungal armor ignites; it loses all benefits from its fungal armor and takes @Damage[3d8[persistent,fire]] damage or persistent damage from the effect that damaged it (whichever is greater). This ignores its fire immunity. An immolsivix regrows its fungal armor at the start of its turn if it is not affected by persistent fire damage.

Immolation.name: 焚灭 Immolation
Immolation.description:
在承受持续性火焰伤害期间，焚灼希维克斯获得一个10英尺灵光；生物进入该区域或在该区域内开始其回合时，除非其 @Check[reflex|dc:30] 豁免成功，否则会受到与焚灼希维克斯相同数值的持续性火焰伤害。此外，焚灼希维克斯在燃烧时，其每次近战打击都会额外造成 1d8 火焰伤害。

While taking persistent fire damage, the immolsivix gains a 10-foot aura that causes creatures entering or beginning their turn in the area to take the same amount of persistent fire damage as the immolsivix unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:30] save. In addition, an immolsivix adds 1d8 fire damage to each of its melee Strikes while burning.

Reactive Strike.name: 借机攻击 Reactive Strike
Reactive Strike.description:
触发 immolsivix触及范围内的一个生物使用了一个操纵动作或一个移动动作、进行了远程攻击，或在其正在使用的移动动作期间离开了一个方格

效果 immolsivix尝试对触发的生物进行一次近战Strike。若此次攻击为重击，且触发条件是一个操纵动作，则immolsivix扰乱该动作。此次Strike不计入immolsivix的多重攻击减值，且其多重攻击减值也不适用于此次Strike。

Trigger A creature within the immolsivix's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The immolsivix attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the immolsivix disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the immolsivix's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Bomb Barrage.name: 炸弹齐射 Bomb Barrage
Bomb Barrage.description:
焚爆菌龙投掷两枚真菌炸弹。先确定每枚炸弹影响的区域，然后再让生物进行豁免。位于两枚炸弹区域内的生物照常各进行两次豁免。位于一枚炸弹区域内的生物其豁免获得+2处境加值。

The immolsivix hurls two fungal bombs. Determine the area affected by each bomb before having creatures make saves. Creatures in the area of two bombs make their two saves as normal. Creatures in the area of one bomb gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their saves.

Monstrous Fury.name: 怪物般的狂怒 Monstrous Fury
Monstrous Fury.description:
焚熔蜥进行一次颚击近战攻击，随后进行两次爪击近战攻击。爪击会同时发生，且必须以同一个生物为目标，两次攻击都使用相同的多重攻击减值。随后，焚熔蜥可以用其真菌炸弹进行区域火焰攻击，但区域内所有生物的豁免都获得 +2 处境加值。被任意一次攻击命中的生物，或未能通过对抗区域火焰豁免的生物，会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{受压制} 状态，直到其下个回合结束。

The immolsivix makes a jaws melee Strike followed by two claw melee Strikes. The claw attacks happen simultaneously and must target the same creature, using the same multiple attack penalty for both attacks. The immolsivix can then Area Fire with its fungal bomb, but all creatures in the area gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their saves. A creature hit by any of the Strikes, or who fail their save against the Area Fire, becomes @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until the end of their next turn.

Immolsivix.publicNotes:
这种巨大的掘穴野兽原产于科塔瑞亚的真菌丛林。每一只immolsivix都会培育生长迅速的共生霉菌，覆盖其甲壳板片。这些巨型恐怖生物栖居于地下，会从下层植被中猛然窜出伏击猎物。

这一切都是相互关联的吗？！

在深埋于科塔瑞亚丛林中的遗迹内发现的石板与金属板上，刻有immolsivix的图像，并附有一种早已灭绝语言的文字。任何研究过古代西弗语言的学者都能将这两种语言联系起来，尽管目前占据科塔瑞亚的阿兹兰提人报告称，他们从未遭遇过西弗霸权或其遗产。

This massive burrowing beast is native to Kehtaria's fungal jungles. Every immolsivix cultivates fast-growing symbiotic molds that cover its chitinous plates. These titanic terrors live underground, erupting from the undergrowth to ambush prey.

Is it all Connected?!

Stone and metal tablets found inside ruins buried deep within Kehtaria's jungles are carved with drawings of immolsivixes accompanied by text in a long-dead language. Any scholar who studied the ancient Sivv language could link the two languages together, though the Azlanti who currently occupy Kehtaria have reported no encounters with the Sivv Dominion or their legacy.

Shocking Twist.name: 电击转折 Shocking Twist

Open Fire.name: 开火 Open Fire
Open Fire.description:
触发条件 战斗开始

效果 一门加农炮对竞技场中的一名PC进行一次远程打击。随后，该陷阱掷先攻。

Trigger The combat begins

Effect One cannon makes a ranged Strike against a PC in the arena. The trap then rolls initiative.

Shocking Twist.disable:
@Check[computers|dc:25]（受训）以关闭一门加农炮，@Check[crafting|dc:25]（受训）以卡住一门加农炮，或 @Check[thievery|dc:23]（专家）以停用一门加农炮

@Check[computers|dc:25] (trained) to shut down one cannon, @Check[crafting|dc:25] (trained) to jam one cannon, or @Check[thievery|dc:23] (expert) to disable one cannon
Shocking Twist.hazarddescription:
四门加农炮向观众选定的目标发射电弧。

Four cannons fire arcs of electricity at audience selected targets.
Shocking Twist.routine:
（1 动作）发言人宣布观众选定的目标。然后，一门火炮对选定目标进行一次远程打击。

(1 action) Speakers announce the audience's selected target. Then, one cannon makes a ranged Strike at the selected target.

Emganat.name: 恩甘纳特 Emganat

Motion Sense.name: 动觉感知 Motion Sense
Motion Sense.description:
Emganat能够通过振动以及空气或水流的运动感知附近的生物。

An emganat can sense nearby creatures through vibration and air or water movement.

Swarm Mind.name: 虫群心智 Swarm Mind
Swarm Mind.description:
30尺。所有彼此位于所列范围内且具有虫群心智的盟友都会保持恒常心灵感应通讯，并知晓彼此所知道的所有威胁。当位于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友范围内时，若一只emganat在对抗精神效果的豁免中取得成功，则改为取得大成功。

30 feet. All allies with Swarm mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats they know about. While within range of at least one ally with Swarm mind, when an emganat rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

Burrowing Reveal.name: 掘地显露 Burrowing Reveal
Burrowing Reveal.description:
要求 先攻尚未掷定，且艾姆加纳特处于掘穴状态

触发 一个生物进入艾姆加纳特运动感应的范围内

效果 艾姆加纳特察觉到该生物，并在掷先攻前进行【掘穴】。此次移动必须使其从地面中现身。

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled and the emganat is burrowed

Trigger A creature enters the range of the emganat's motion sense

Effect The emganat notices the creature and Burrows before it rolls initiative. This movement must cause it to emerge from the ground.

Acidic Mouth Cannon.name: 酸液口炮 Acidic Mouth Cannon

Coordinated Digestion.name: 协调消化 Coordinated Digestion
Coordinated Digestion.description:
如果 emganat 用其酸性口炮成功对一个生物进行打击，且该生物已经在承受持续性酸蚀伤害，则将该持续性伤害的伤害骰提升一级（最大为 1d8）。

If the emganat successfully Strikes a creature with its acidic mouth cannon and that creature was already taking persistent acid damage, increase the damage dice of the persistent damage by one step (to a maximum of 1d8).

Emganat.publicNotes:
虫群起源于浩界深处一种名为虫族的昆虫状物种，对若干文化而言，它们被视为现存最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群落组成，而每个子群落又包含无数不同的构成亚种；这是一个庞大的群体，以灵能联合的方式行动，目的是吞噬宇宙中的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群拥有同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA的能力。由于在失落纪元前便已发展出星际航行，虫群在历史中断之前就已经吞噬了无数星系，而在获得了对信号以及名为漂流空间的超空间维度的利用后，它们扩张的速度更是进一步加快。

被虫群染指的世界会被抽干自然资源，沦为被称作“空壳世界”的荒芜之地。外界所谓的“虫群空间”，不过是一大片在其鲁莽推进中被虫群吞噬后的死寂世界。虫群对这些世界的掠夺彻底到令勘测者甚至难以找到哪怕微量的无机资源痕迹，例如稀有矿物和水。这些空壳世界中，鲜少有被彻底探索过的，因为探索往往会唤醒休眠的工蜂；理论认为，这些个体是被留在此处，以防被吞噬的星系未来再次遭到殖民并恢复生机。在这片太空区域之外更遥远的地方，也存在着零星的虫群活动，因为虫群在失落纪元前的漫长岁月里派出了无数子群落，而即便到了现在，也只有其中一部分抵达了预定目的地。

在当今时代，虫群或许最为人所知的是两件重要之事。其一，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的袭击，促成了这两大势力停止敌对并建立起脆弱的联盟。其二，虫群正是什瑞伦这一物种的直接祖先。什瑞伦在失落纪元期间的某个时候脱离了虫群，并在神祇海莱克斯那里得到了庇护；人们相信海莱克斯是由虫群出现之前的某种虫族进化而来，并背弃了虫群后来演变成的那个贪婪实体。

近年来，虫群几乎只被视为遥远的梦魇，除了在浩界苏斯基隆星系中一些机密行动外，几乎没有其他活动迹象。然而，最近对失踪的塞赞迪特世界克雷西斯卡的发现，意外唤醒了一个曾负责吞噬该世界的休眠子群落。自那以后，这个新近被命名为克雷西斯卡子群落的势力已成为近宇的一大祸患，正在积极入侵桑迪特联合体的世界，并且蓄势待发，可能会蔓延至维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力。这支被重新发现的子群落已经开始让其构成个体快速进化，虽然仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，但它依然对近宇构成了明确的威胁。令人畏惧的巴斯托罗克斯是一种生体有机堡垒，利用巨大的几丁质盾牌偏转伤害，同时向敌人射出生物电箭束。它会为推进中的克雷西斯卡子群落构成个体固守阵地，例如大批敏捷的战斗虫。这些生体巨兽只是克雷西斯卡子群落队列中新型演化成果之一；在罗德纳思围城战期间，它们就曾投入行动，在那颗世界危机四伏的沼泽中冷酷无情地推进。

战斗虫最初是在克雷西斯卡子群落突然现身并首次袭击桑迪特联合体领空期间被遭遇的。这些狼般大小的构成个体能够掘地潜行，以极高速度移动到适合设伏的位置。随后，一旦察觉到威胁，战斗虫便会猛然跃出，用位于口中的酸液炮猛烈攻击敌人。释放生物酸液攻击敌人的战斗虫越多，这种物质溶解目标的速度就越快，场面痛苦而骇人。

克雷西斯卡子群落

克雷西斯卡子群落最初由一名过于急进的什瑞伦星探员发现；自它在失落纪元前抵达后，便一直蛰伏于被吞噬殆尽的克雷西斯卡空壳世界中。一经暴露，这个子群落便迅速苏醒；但由于一连串涉及灵能调谐的塞赞迪特水晶的事件，该子群落与那名前来此地的星探员建立了强大的精神链接。如今，这名前星探员已被虫群彻底同化，成为克雷西斯卡子群落在世间的活体化身；与庞大的虫群整体不同，这个子群落已成为近宇中一个迫在眉睫且显而易见的威胁。

Developing from an insectile species far out in the Vast known as kucharns, the Swarm are considered the greatest threat in existence for several cultures. Composed of countless subcolonies, each consisting of countless different component subspecies, the Swarm is a vast host that acts in psychic union for the purpose of consuming all matter across the cosmos. Most frightening of all is the Swarm's ability to assimilate the knowledge and DNA of those they consume. Thanks to its pre-Gap development of star travel, the Swarm had already consumed innumerable systems before history short-circuited, and its pace only accelerated once it received access to the Signal and the hyperspace dimension known as the Drift.

Worlds touched by the Swarm are drained of their natural resources and rendered barren places known as huskworlds. What outsiders consider to be "Swarm space" is little more than a swathe of lifeless worlds that the Swarm have consumed in their reckless advance. The Swarm so thoroughly strips these worlds that surveyors struggle to find even trace amounts of inorganic resources, such as rare minerals and water. Few of these huskworlds have been thoroughly explored, as oftentimes exploration awakens inert drones, theorized to have been left behind in case the devoured system was ever colonized and repopulated. Pockets of Swarm activity exist well beyond this region of space, as the Swarm sent out countless subcolonies in the ages before the Gap, and even now, only some of them have reached their intended destinations.

The Swarm is perhaps most known in the current era for two important facts. First, their assault on the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium led to the cessation of hostilities and tenuous alliance between the two powers. Second, the Swarm are the direct ancestors of the shirren species. Having broken away sometime during the Gap, shirrens found succor with the deity Hylax, who was believed to have evolved from a pre-Swarm kucharn, and who turned her back on the ravenous entity the Swarm has evolved into.

In recent years, the Swarm had been seen as little more than a distant boogeyman, with no activities save for classified actions in the Suskillon system in the Vast. However, the recent discovery of the missing Szandite world of Krethiskar inadvertently awoke a dormant subcolony that had been responsible for the world's consumption. Since then, the newly dubbed Krethiskar subcolony has become a scourge of Near Space, engaged in an active invasion of Szandite Collective worlds and being poised to spill over into other powers like the Veskarium and Pact Worlds. This rediscovered subcolony has begun rapid evolution of its components and remains cut off from the wider Swarm, but it still represents a clear danger to Near Space. The dreaded bastorox is a bio-organic bulwark that uses an immense chitinous shield to deflect damage while loosing bolts of bioelectricity at foes. It holds positions for advancing Krethiskar subcolony components, such as the multitudes of agile emganats. These biohulks are but one of the new innovations found within the ranks of the Krethiskar subcolony, and they were active during the siege of Rodnarth, where they implacably advanced through that world's treacherous swamps.

Emganats were first encountered during the Krethiskar subcolony's sudden emergence and the first attacks on Szandite Collective space. These wolf-sized components can burrow beneath the ground, moving at great speeds to reach a location where they can set up an ambush. Then, once a threat is detected, the emganat springs forth and lays into its foes with an acidic cannon located in its mouth. The more emganats that unleash their bio-acid on foes, the faster the substance dissolves their targets in an agonizing display.

Krethiskar Subcolony

First discovered by an overeager shirren Starfinder, the Krethiskar subcolony rested in torpor within the consumed huskworld of Krethiskar following its arrival during the pre-Gap era. Once uncovered, the subcolony quickly sprung to life, but thanks to a series of events involved in the psychically attuned Szandite crystals, the subcolony formed a powerful mental link with the Starfinder who had arrived. Now completely subsumed by the Swarm, the former Starfinder has become a living avatar for the Krethiskar subcolony, which unlike the great Swarm, has become a clear and present danger in Near Space.
